༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronas gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / rdo rje gsum gyi snang ba'i bsdus don bzhugs so/dpal he ru ka la na ma 'dir lha mo rig byed ma la bstod pa'i rgya cher 'grelapa rdo rje gsum gyi snang ba'i bsdus pa'i don la/ klang kyi don/ gzhung dngos/mjug gi don gsum/ dang po la legs sbyar gyi skad du phyag 'tshal pa/ mtshan gyi don/mchod brjod gsum las/ dang po ni/ na mo ḍā ki ku ru kul+la ye/ gnyis pa ni rgyud kye khungs dang sbrags te ston par/ bcom ldan 'das ma khams gsum dbang sdud kyi lha mo rig byed ma ku ru kul+le la bstod pa'i glu dbyangs srid gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba/ gsum pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma dpal ku ru kul+le la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gnyis pa gzhung dngos la/ ji ltar bstod pa'i tshul/ bstod pa'i tshig don dngos bshad pa/ bstod pa'i dge ba bsngo ba 'dod gsol dang bcas pa gsum gyi dang por bstod pa'i sgo mang yang / lam bgrod tshul dang khyad par sngags lam gyi bgrod tshul sgos bstod pa mchog tu sgrub bo/ / gnyis pa la mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ rab 'byams nyi 'od rtse dgas rab rgod pa/ / chu lha'i ngogs su phyogs pa'i lhun po'i bzhin/ / dper mtshon me long nang gzugs shar ba'i dbyibs/ / ji bzhin sgyu 'phrul gar gyis rol der 'dud/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ sku la bstod pa/ gsung la bstod pa/ thugs la bstod pa/ thun mong du bstod pa dang bzhi/ dang po la spyi don gzhung don gnyis/ dang po ni sku 'grub byed gtso bor bskyed rim la sbyor tshul bskyed rim gal che tshul/ de'i chings tha dad pa'i dbye ba/ skabs 'dir gang dang gang gi gnad tshang tshul/ gtso gang che/ de la dogs slong dgag gzhag dang bcas bshad do/ / gnyis pa yan lag gi don la dang 224

༄/ /rdo rjegasum gyisnang ba'i bsdusadon/po spyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas rang don phun tshogs gsum mngon du byas tshul/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi teng nge 'dzin la brten nas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo spro zhing sdud pa'i bdag por gyur tshul/ lagargyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas zhi sogs kyi las rab 'byams bsgrub tshul gsum/ / dang po la'ang chos sku dang /longs sku dang / sprul sku mngon du byas tshul gsum gyi dang po ni/ mtha' bral mkha' dbyings 'dra ba'i 'od gsal las/ / 'ongs pa'i gsal dzogs dbyings su dag pa yi/ / skye 'gags gnas gsum bral ba'i chos nyid las/ / gnyis pa la rgyu long4sku'i lam 'khyer lugasaso so ba bkod cing / 'dir nyer sgrub kyi yan lag goms pa las chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin rlung sems tsam las longs skur ldang ba 'byung bas de mngon du byas tshul ni/ chu las chu bur tshul gyes nye bar mtshon/ /gsum pa sprul sku mngon du byas tshul sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor dgos shing sku'i rnam pa dngos kyi sgo nas bstod par/ sku spyi tsam dang sbyar te gdul bya dbang du byed tshul/ phyag mtshan so so'i sgo nas gdul bya dbang du byed tshul/ mtshan tsam gyis kyang dbang du byed tshul gsum/ dang po cha so so'i dag pa dang sbyar te ston pa ni/ nang gi phag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /ldem kyog sgeg pa'i zhi 'dzum bzhin ras kyis/ / srid gsum 'di dag yid kyi brtan pa yang / / gcig char 'phrog pa'i sbyor bas rnam par 'gyings/ / gnyis pa phyag mtshan so so dang 'brel bar gdul bya dbang du byed tshul la rtsa phyag dang / lhag ma'i phyag mtshan la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ ut+pal nyag phran chags byed rgyud ldan la/ / thabs shes go ba'i rna yi phyir sbyang nas/ / lha mi gnod sbyin klu dang grul bum sogs/ / gang snying bsnun de me yis bung ba bzhin/ / gnyis pa ni/ 'dab ldan lcags kyu zhags pas reg tsam gyes/ / tshangs dang brgya byin thos sgrog la sogs kyang / /rlung gi shugs kyis rings par 'ong ba ni/ / rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin dus las yol ba min/ /gsum pa mtshan tsam gyis kyang gdul bya dbang du byed tshul ni/ che zhing 225

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'itshonasa'i ga4 'bum/'gying bas dregs pa mtha' dag kyang / / khyed kyi mtshan tsam yid la dran byed pa'i/ / dbul po'i mdun sar rim gro'i sbyor ba dag / bgyid par 'gyur la myong ldan the tshom bral/ / gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas stoms 'jug gi dga' ba'i rol pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spro zhing sdud pa'i bdag por gyur tshul ni/ de lta mod kyi tshul 'di phra mo'i gtam/ / he ru ka dpal snyoms 'jug bde ba'i ros/ / dgyes dgur 'gugs pa'i rnal 'byor snying gi dbus/ / khrag 'thung dpal de ci dgar 'ongs min rnam/ /gsum pa las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas zhi sogs rab 'byams las kyi dngos grub la dbang 'byor ba'i tshul ni/ zhi dang rgyas dbang mngon spyod las rab 'byams/ / grub chen brgyad dang zung 'jug phyag rgya che/ / ma lus bde blag stsol mdzad bcom ldan ma/ / khyod la yon tan brjod nas bstod pa lags/ / gnyis pa gsung la bstod pa la/ phar phyin theg pa dang thun mong ba dang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mgrin pa chos kyi mgur las chad med pa'i/ / yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs kyis 'gro kun rnar/ / gnyis pa la mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ snyan 'jebs phe ka ra yi sgra skad kyis/ / khams gsum ma lus mkha' 'gror bcas te bsdu/ / gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ gsung gi sgo nas ji ltar gdams tshul dang /gsung rdo rje rang gis mngon du mdzad tshul gnyis/ dang po lam gyi lus cha tshang ba dang khyad par rgyud don mtha' dag gi snying po bde stong dbyer med kyi e waṃ la sbyor tshul 'phros dang bcas ston par/ sgrub po'i lam gyi man ngag cha tshang bar/ /dbugs dbyung tshig dang bcas te ston mdzad pas/ lhan skyes bde chen stong nyid mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /dga' ba'i ro la kun nas sbyor bar mdzad/ / gnyis pa gsung rdo rje 226

༄/ /rdo rje gsum gyisnang ba'i bsdusadon/rang gis mngon du mdzad tshul la/ spyi don dang / gzhung don gnyis/ dang po ni rgyud soso'i rdzogayorim la slob tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ 'on kyang dod thub kyi gnad tshang tshul/ lugs 'diyothog mar gtum mo nas brtsamasate slob pas gang la gnad du bsnun dgos pa dang gnad du bsnun sa'i rtsa 'khor sogs kyi rnam gzhag /bum pa can nam gtso bor me dmigs skyong tshul/ khyad par 'di'i gzhung rim pa lnga par bshad pa'i dmigs skor dang spyor lugs dgag bzhag dang bcas pa/ de dag gis kun rdzob sgyu ma'i sku 'grub tshul dang / de nyid gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub byed thun mong ma yin par sgrub pa rnams kyi sgo nas gtan la phab po/ /gnyis pa gzhung don la/ gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo'i yon tan dang / de'i nus pa'i yon tan gnyis/ dang po ni/ don ngo bo gcig kyang gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis gsung rdo rje la/ gsung longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / gsung rnam pa thams cad pa'i cha gnyis su phye ste rim bzhin rkang pa gnyis gnyis kyis ston par/ zab mo stong nyid snying stobs ches dpa' bas/ / lhan skyes bde chen g.yu yi ral pa gzings/ /mi zhum zhi ba skye med nga ro yis/ / log rtog bdag 'dzin wa tshogs skrag par mdzad/ /gnyis pa nus pa'i yon tan gang la brten nas 'khor rtsa thun mong dang thun ma yin pa rim gyis btul bas lhan skyes kyi bde chen 'dren tshul la bstod cing de'i yon tan mthong nas 'dun pa skyed tshul dang bcas ston par/ gang gi snying la cha shas zhugs pas kyang / /thog ma med nas 'phung zhen 'gong po'i dpung / /snying gas stong pa'i dbyings shi mgu dka'i sems/ / dbang du sdud gsung re ba'i yid kyis bstod/ /gsum pa thugs la bstod pa la/ phar phyin theg pa dang thun mong ba'i dbang du byasapa dang / sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du byayopa gnyis/ dang po la rnam pathamasacad mkhyen pa'i yon tan dang / stobs bcu'i yon tan la bstod pa gnyis/227

༄/ /gung ca bamaba'itshunama'igayo ཿma/dang po ni/ rgya mtsho lta bu'i gting ldan shes bya dang / / gaṅgā'i rdul snyed chos tshul ma lus pa/ / lag mthil shing tog ji bzhin mngon sum du/ / dus mtha'i skad cig yun la ma 'dres gzigs/ / gnyis pa ni/ mthar thug dbyings las ma g.yos rtse gcig tu/ / mnyam par bzhag bzhin sems can khams sna tshogs/ / ma 'dres gsal gzigs pas rang rang gi / bsam pa ji bzhin gang 'dod chos rnams ston/ /gnyis pa sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du byas nas bstod pa la/ spyi don/gzhung don gnyis/ dang po ni/ thugs chos sku 'grub byed 'od gsal de nyid mdo sngags kun gyi snying por gyur tshul/ khyad par du skabs 'dir gtso bor bstan tshul/'od gsal lhan skyes kyi ngos 'dzin/ de 'grub byed rlung dang gtum mo sogayonang gi rkyen rnams sngar bshad zin pas/ 'dir phyi'i rkyen phyag rgya'i rnam gzhag/ rkyen gnyis las dpe don gyi 'od gsal rim par 'grub tshul rnams kyi sgo nas bstan to/ /gnyis pa gzhung don la/ 'od gsal ye shes kyi ngo bo'i khyad par dang / de'i byed las kyi khyad paraganyis/ dang po ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' ltar rgya che zla ba'i ma/ / lta bur gting yangs dzing bu rnyog med ltar/ / dwangs pas chos tshul rgya mtsho'i gzugs brnyan kun/ / gcig car gsal rdzogs 'char la mkha' rlung 'dra/ /gnyis pa byed las la/ sgrib gnyis zad par sgong ba'i byed pa dngos dang /'phrosadon spyod pa'i khyad par gnyis/ dang po'ang sgrib gnyis spangs pas srid mtha' khegs tshul dang / thabs mkhas pas de'i shugs kyis zhi mtha' khegs tshul gnyis kyis ston par/ shes dang nyon mongs rmongs byed mchu ring bung / / snying rje stong pa nyid zhugs bsil yab kyis/ / ring du bskrad kyang brtse ba'i zhags pa yis/ /'gro la dam du 'khyud pas yang dag rol/ /gnyis pa 'phros don spyod pa'ikhyad par ni/ / dug gsum btags pa bar 'jog tshul dang / dngos gnas pa lam du byed tshul gnyis gyes bstan cing / don gyi 'od gsal gyi dod thub mdo la med 228

༄/ / rdo rje gsum gyisnang ba'i bsdusadon/pasazab khyad dang bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam du ston par/ chags pa min kyang brtse chen chags pas myos/ / khro dang bral yang nyon mongs dgra mgo gcod/ /gti mug kun bcom 'od gsal ngang du gzims/ / ya mtshan sgyu mas sa bcu pa yang rmongs/ /bzhi pa sku gsung thugs thun mong du bstod pa ni sngar dbang gsum gye lam bskyed rim dang kun rdzob sgyu ma'i rdzogs rim/ don dam 'od gsal gyi rdzogs rim gsum gyis sku gsung thugs sosor sgrub tshul bstan pas/ de gsum 'dusapa yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug gam/ lam 'bras kyi bshad pa ltar gsang gsum mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni dbang bzhi pa'i lam dbyer med zung 'jug gi rdzogs rim gyi bsgrub byar go nus la/de ltar byas na lam dang 'bras bu'i gnad kun tshang zhing de nyid rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi man ngag tu bstan pa/ zung 'jug dang / yan lag bdun ldan dang / gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo rnams don gcig kyang bshad thabs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang bcas te ston par/ de ltar sku gsung thugs kyi ngo mtshar ba'i/ / gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo la/ / bdag gis lus dang ngag yid rab gus pas/ / legs par bstod kyi dgyes pas snyan du bzhes/ /gsum pa brtsams pa'i dge ba bsngo ba 'dod gsol dang bcas te bshad pa la/bsngob dang / 'dod don gsol ba/ don bsdu ba gsum/ dang po la mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar bdag gis bstod pa'i nus mthu las/ / rab dkar dge ba zla ltar dkar ba des/ / mar gyur don du stobs bcu mnga' ba yi/ / go 'phang tshe 'dir bde blag thob par shog / gnyis pa rgyasapar bshad pa la/ rang don phun tshogs byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo ba dang /gzhan don phun tshogasa'agrin lasalhun gyis 'grub pa'i rgyur bsngo ba gnyis/ dang po ni/dpal ldan rig byed lha mo'i bskyed pa'i rim/ / rnal 'byor bsam gtan la gzhol ye shes mes/ / tha mal snang zhen bud shing ma lus pa/ / ring por mi 229

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronasa'i khrung ཿma/thogs myur du sreg par shog / gnyis pa gzhan don phun tshogs 'phrin las lhun gyis 'grub pa'i rgyur bsngo ba la/ dbang du sdud pa'i phyir smon pa dang / bsdus nas smin cing grol ba'i phyir smon pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ ting 'dzin sgyu 'phrul 'od zer kyo ba yis/ / dbang du bya ba'i bsgrub bya rlung dkyil steng / / bsil zer byed dmar la bkod 'thor byed shugs/ / drag pos skad cig nyid la 'gugs par shog / gnyis pa ni/ mdun du 'ongs snying ut+pa la mda' non gyis/ / phug par dpa' brtan snying stobs srog shi ste/ / rab myos gos bral bdag gi rkang ba'i mthil/ / lce yis bldag cing ci smras sgrub par shog /gnyis pa 'dod don la gsol ba 'debs pa la gsum/ skabs kyi 'dod don gtso bo ngos bzung ste gsol ba 'debs pa/ de la phyi'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshogayopa'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa/ nang gi mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ /dang po bstan 'gro spyi bye brag gi phan bde'i rtsa lag rgyal dbang rin po che'i'azin las la rag las tshul dang bcas te ston par/ khyad par bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen gye/ / rtsa lag mthar thug rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang / /gang sku'i sprul pa'i rol gar gsar 'dzum la/ / che phra'i 'gro ba ma lus 'dud par mdzod/ /gnyi4pa ni/ dbyar gyi lang tsho dar ba'i ku sha'i mdangs/ /rab bkra lo ma'i khur gyis lce ba'i mda'/ / 'dab ldan dha nu'i shugs kyis pha rol po'i/ / yid kyi khye'u myos byed zug rngus choms/ / gsum pa la/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa ltar lung rtogs kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa'i ched dang / de thams cad gtso 'khor ci rigs pa'i tshul du lam gyi mthar thug 'di'i sgrub byed du 'gyur ba'i phyir gsol ba 'debs pa gnyis rim bzhin sho lo ka gnyis kyis ston par/ dang po ni/ gting dpag dka' zhing mtha' bral gsung bstan bcos/ / sa bcu lam lnga'i grogs 'gugs dga' ma gang / / zur phud lnga pa dge slong gzugs 'chang ba'i/ / snying las 'ongs te 'di yi mdza' bor 230

༄/ /rdorje gsum gyisnang ba'i bsdusadon/khug / gnyis pa ni/ brtse dang gzhan phan ral gris brjid pa yi/ / dam bca'i go cha sra ba'i dpa' bo dang / / rnam dag tshul khrims grogs mchog mkhas btsun bzang / / g.yog 'khor bcas pa srog ni gcig tu sgrubs/ /gsum pa don bsdu ba'ang / srog ni gcig tu sgrubs/ zhesapa 'dis bstan pa yin no/ / gsum pa mjug gi don la/ bstan bcos dzi ltar brtsamasapa'i tshul/ brtsams pa'i dgos don 'grub par smon pa/ rtsom pa po'i mtshan bstan pa gsum/ dang po na/de ltar bstod dang smon pa'i ardo rnyil/ / bsam bzang srad bu ches dkar ring po la/ / star du brgyus pa'i rgyan phreng do shal 'di/ / tshul bzhin lha mo khyod kyis mgul bar chongs/ / gnyis pa ni/ las 'bras rten 'brel bsru pa med pa dang / / rig byed mdzes ma mthu stobs thogs med pas/ / je ltar re ba'i 'bras bu bde blag tu/ / gegs dang nyer 'tshe med par 'grub gyur cig / gsum pa ni/ ces khams gsum dbang sdud lha mo rig byed ma la bstod pa 'di ni chos smra ba stoms las pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyis don chen po la dmigs nas sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ / zhes gsungayote/'dir yang de dang rjes su mthun pa'i dgos don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /231

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'itshonas gas ཿma/༄༅/ / ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i lo rgyus bzhugs so/dge legs yongs 'du'i dga' tshal yangs pa na/ / byu ru'i 'khri shing dpal gyi 'jo sgeg can/ / dpag bsam 'dod pa 'jo pa'i yid bzhin nor/ / rgyal yum rig byed dbang mos 'gro 'di skyongs/ / khyod mtshan dri yi gos can bzung tsam gyes/ / mi bzad rgud pa'i sprul gdug mthar byed na/ / ngo mtshar rna ba'i bcud len grub pa yis/ / dngos grub dga' ston rgyas pa smos ci 'tshal/ / mthun pa'i dri bzhon g.yo ba'i rjes 'gro yang / /dus las mi yol rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs bzhin/ / 'gog med rgyal ba rnams kyi 'phrin las kyang / / gdul bya'i bsod nams mthu dang lhan cig spyod/ /sngon tshe 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i thig le mchog / skye bo blo ldan skal ba bzang po'i sa/ / grong khyer 'dab ma drug ldan rgya gar yul/ / chos srid dri bzang rdzogs pa'i skyed tshal na/ / grags pa phyogs kyi rna ba'i rgyan gyur mi bdag lhan skyes rol pa zhes/ / bsod nams brgya pa'i gzi byin 'jig rten mes po'i blo dang lhan cig pas/ / 'jug pa rnam bcu'i dpung gis rgyal phran bye ba'i zur phud 'dab ma la/ / nor bu'i rkang gdub sil sil sgra ldan bung bas nye bar rtsen pa byung / / dga' ba brgya pa'i drung na dpal mo'am/ / bde 'byung mdun sar gangs ri'i bu mo bzhin/ / de yi btsun mo gnang chen zla bzhin ma/ / yangs pa'i rgyal srid skyong ba'i grogs su thob/ / 'on kyang nag tshwa'i chu bo 'thung zhing skom/ / nags kyi me lce 'bar zhing mched pa ltar/ / 'dod 232

༄/ /ba ri lo tsā banasabargyud pa'i losgyus bzhugs so/ldan 'dod pa'i yul gyis mi ngoms pas/ / mdzes sdug bu mo gzhan yang khab tu bsus/ / me tog phreng mdzes snga ma ma snyigs kyang / / gsar ba gsar pa'i rgyan gyis mgu ba bzhin/ / rgyal bu dga' ba'i yid kyi shing rta yang / /smin legs na chung gsar pa'i phyogs su lhung / / dge ma chags bral drag po'i dka' thub la/ / nan gyes sbyor ba'i thub ba ji bzhin du/ / mi dbang 'dod pa'i zla ba chu shel las/ / gnang chen btsun mo gdung ba'i me char spros/ /des kyang kye ma chun ma'i ming can drang srong dmod pa'i ma mo 'di/ / rna ba'i rjes skyes rwa rtse ji bzhin bdag gi gong du brgal lo snyam/ / yid la zug rngu'i kun rtog bir gyis yang yang bris pa'i mtshan ma ltar/ / rab dkar zla ba rgyas pa'i bzhin la nag po'i ra ri'i dri ma chags/ / de tshe de la 'bangs mo blo ldan mas/ / bu mo 'di ni gnod la khyab bdag min/ / nyid kyi bde dang mi bde'i gnas skabs la/ / dbang sgyur rgyal po dbang du sdud par 'os/ / mi min rgyu ba 'dre yi tshong 'dus na/ / de lta'i rig sngags shes pa yod dam snyam/ / gdung ba'i yid kyis phongs pa mi sel bas/ / brtan pa skyed cig bdag ni der 'gro zhes/ / smras te tshong 'dus srang du phyin pa na/ / mig yangs bu mo cung zad bzhin 'dzum zhing / / lus kyi sha rgyas shin tu brjid bag can/ / ras bzang dmar po'i ang rag lus la bgos/ / g.yas na seng ldeng dmar po'i nyag phran gsor/ / g.yon pa 'od ma'i gzhu la rten byed pa/ / pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i mtshan dang ldan pa zhig / mthong ste gtam gyi go skabs gleng ba na/ / 'dod pa'i gdams pa yod par yid ches te/ / re ba'i gtam snyan bdag mar gsol ba yis/ / mngon dga' rgyas pa'i mod la rig —'dzin ma/ / pho brang khab tu nye bar spyan drangs te/ / chen po la 'os bkur stes rab mchod cing / / nang gi rang bzhin gsal ba'i gdung shugs 233

༄/ /yo ca bayo r+sātshonasa'i ga ཿma/kyis/ / sa yi dbang phyug dbang byed cho ga ni/ / yang dag mdzod ces nan tan chen pos gsol/ / de yis rig sngags 'ga' tsam btab pa yi/ /'bras chan sha kha ra dang bcas pa zhig / gtad de 'di ni rgyal por sbyin mdzod dang / / ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'grub ces de la gdams/ / 'phral la chags pas drangs kyang mnyes gshin gyi/ / gzhung bzang ma dor de yis rgyal po'i skur/ / gnod kyis dogs pas zangs kyi sgrom bu ru/ / bcug nas pho brang nye ba'i mtsho la bskyur/ / der gnas klu yi rgyal po rgya mtsho skyong / / las kyis bskul bas bza' ba de mthong zhing / / sred pas bskul bas nye bar longs spyad tshe/ / sngags kyis bskul bas mi yul bgrod snying 'dod/ / de yi srod nas gdengs can bdag po mi dbang gzugs su rol pa yis/ / mtshan re bzhin du nye bar btud cing dga' ba'i dngos po kun gyis bstabs/ /des kyang rang gi bdag por 'khrul ba'i rtse dga' nyams su myong ba las/ /dga' dang sdug bsngal brgya yi snod gyur srid ba skye ba'i mngal khur bzung / /de tshe khyab 'jug khros pa'i nga ro can/ / smin 'khyog g.yo ldan gtum drag rgyal po yis/ / rnam pa du mar bsdigs shing rgyus med pa'i/ / nal bu rigs gnyis sun 'byen 'di ni ci/ / 'bangs kyi phun tshogs rgyal po la gnas shing / / rgyal po'i dpal ni gtsang ma'i rigs la ltos/ / phun tshogs ma lus 'joms pa'i phra men ma/ / 'di ni chad pa drag pos brlag par 'os/ / rna nag ma 'di thos kyang mi spro na/ / mthong ba lta ci da lta kho na ru/ / snang min lnga pa'i lam du sgol cig ces/ / drag po'i chad pa gnam rdo bzhin du babs/ / de nas skrag pas bzhin gyi mdangs nyams shing / / skra grol mchi ma'i thigs phreng do shal can/ / bden pa'i yus kyis 'dar ba'i dbugs 'tshang ba/ / gdung ldan btsun mos zhu ba 'di skad phul/ / kye ho zla ba 'di 234

༄/ /ba ri lo tsābanasabargyud pa'i losgyus bzhugs so/snyed mtshan re bzhin/ / dgyes pa'i gzigs pa nam yang ma chad na/ / de ring shin tu mi 'tsham bsnyon gdeng ba/ / 'di ltar mdzad pa khyod thugs ma 'khrul lam/ / 'bangs kyi phun tshogs rgyal por gnas pa yang / / de yi bka' khrims gtsang ma'i drin las yin/ / nyes med bdag la thub chos 'di 'dra na/ / chab srid yangs pa'i bka' khrimayogang du thal/ / nyam chung bdag ni khyod kyi 'bangs mo ste/ / lus 'di dum bur gtub kyang khyod nyid dbang / / 'on kyang las 'bras bden pa mi 'chol zhing / / ye shes spyan ldan lha yis mi khrel lam/ / zhes pa shar nub ri ltar 'gal ba'i tshig / de thos blon 'bangs sder bcas ngo mtshar zhing / / shugs drag khro bas 'khrugs pa'i rgyal po yang / / skad cig nyid du the tshom khyogs la 'phyang / / dmar ba'i bzhin ldan mchu sgros rab bsdams shing / / khro ba'i mig 'bur mkha' la cher bgrad de/ / ring zhig bsam nas mdang gi mtshan mo yang / / 'ong ngam zhes ni de la nan tan dris/ / des kyang gtan tshigs bcas te gsol ba na/ / khyod smra bden tshe deng yang 'ong bas rigs/ / de tshe nyer spyad che phra ci rigs shig / zungs dang da ko gsal bar 'gyur zhes smras/ / srod la mi bdag ltar snang de 'ongs par/ / sgyu ma'i gzugs su mthong yang bden bden ltar/ / 'grogs pa'i zol gyis rtse dga' myong ba na/ / de yi sor gdub dgos pa'i don du blangs/ / pho brang khor yug rgyan phreng rgya chen kun/ / mog mog por byed 'bar ba'i gzi 'od can/ / dri med nor bu'i sor gdub de bstan pas/ / rgyal po 'byor pas khengs pa thung ngur byas/ /de mthu mthong bas skrag dang ngo mtshar dang / / rang gi spyod pas gnod dang 'gyod pa sogs/ / 'du shes sna tshogs g.yo ba'i dri bzhon gyis/ / mi dbang brtan pa shing bal gnas su bkod/ / ye ma khyod ni lha yi grogs mo ste/ /235

༄/ /yo cabayo ba me'i khrung 'bumalag pa'i nor bu rmongs pa bdag gis bor/ / sum rtsen dga' ba'i lam nas ma bgrod par/ / khab 'dir bzhugs pa khyod ni thugs rje che/ / nang gi rang bzhin mngon du ma gyur pas/ / 'phral la zla bzhin ma yi rmedzum zer gyis/ /bsru ba 'dod ldan spyi yi ngang tshul te/ / bdag la khon 'dzin med pa'i bka' drin mdzod/ / ces ni bzod par gsol ba'i rnga yab rtses/ /khro ba'i yid kyi sbrang bu bsal ba dang / / lhan cig mnyes gshin tshig gi bsang gtor gyis/ / chags pa'i kun rtog bsil ba'i go skabs phye/ / mchu sgros sbrang rtsis myos pa'i zim zim mig gi bung ba g.yo/ / 'jam mnyen sor mo'i 'dab phreng 'o 'dzin rgyas pa'i ze'u 'brur brum/ / mu tig do shal gzhan mtshungs bde drod rngul chu'i thigs phreng can/ / khyo shugs mdza' ba'i rtse dga' nam yang gtong min skal bzang myong / / dben pa'i mal du gleng ba'i 'bel gtam las/ / ngo mtshar rig sngags rgyal mo'i mthu mthong ste/ / dge ma khyod kyi bsod nams skol ba yis/ / bdag kyang bcom ldan ma dang mjal srid dam/ / zhes smra sa yi dbang phyug bzhed pa bzhin/ / lha cig btsun mo'i tshig gi mtshams sbyor gyis/ / rig 'dzin dbang mo nye bar spyan drangs te/ /'dud ba sngon byas mchod pa'i sprin gyis gtibs/ / de yi byin rlabs yongs 'du'i sa bon ni/ / sa skyong thugs kyi do rar smin pa las/ / nyams rtogs dpag bsam ljon pa rgyas pa'i rtser/ / zab rgyas gdams pa'i me tog ci yang bzhad/ / brtag gnyis gur dang sam bu ṭa la sogs/ / rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i 'jing gnas nor bu'i dpya/ /'di yi man ngag gru gzings la bkod de/ /skal bzang 'jig rten yangs pa'i longs spyod gyur/ / bzang po'i legs smon dar ba'i skye bo la/ / rkyen rnams mtha' dag legs pa'i lam du 'gro/ /srid 'byor dga' ba'i mching bu tshol ba yis/ / nges legs zung 'jug 236

༄/ /ba ri lo tsābanas brgyud pa'i lo rgyusabazhugs so/bsam 'phel nor bu rnyed/ / e ma 'di lta'i ngo mtshar gleng ba yang / / skal pa bzang snyam dga' bas g.yeng ba yi/ / smra mkhas dge dbang chos kyi sras po zhig / bris te 'khri shing yal 'dab lhag ma bzhin//rmad byung gdams ngag brgyud pa'i musnyi ka / / sgro skur nya phya'i rdog gis ma bslad par/ / sdeb legs tshig gi phreng ba spel ba 'di/ / rnal 'byor ma mchog mnyes pa'i rgyur gyur cig / ces ba ri lo tsā ba nasabargyud pa'i lo rgyusatshigs bcad du bsdebs pa 'di ni ska'i lung ring du bris pa'o/ / / /237

༄/ /༅ ca b.lo r+sā yo g.yo 4ma/ro༅/ / bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo rig byed ma la 'dod don gsol ba'i chigs su bcad pa bkra shis char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /lhun grub bde chen gyi chos dbyings kun gsal gyi ngos la/ / gzhan phan 'phrin las gyi rtsibs brgya khor yug tu bkra bas/ / srid zhi'i gdung sel gyi grib bsil 'gog med du spro ba/ / bcom ldan rig byed kyi dbang mos bu bzhin du dgongs la/ / ma zhum snying stobs kyis bzung ba'i lhag bsam gyi yu ba/ / mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi nyams len gos bzang gi sham bu/ / rnam grol nor bu yi tog gi gzi 'od dang bcas pa'i/ / bstan pa'i gdugs dkar 'di phyogs bcur bsgreng ba ru mdzod cig / ji lta ji snyed kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho yi klong na/ / mnyam rjes dbyer med kyi rol pas ci dga' ru rtsen zhing / / 'gro la rjes chags kyi gser mig nyi ltar du 'khyil ba/ / bcom ldan rig byed kyi dbang mos bu bzhin du dgongs la/ / mdo rgyud man ngag gi klung brgya lhan cig tu 'khyil ba'i/ / rnyog bral dge ldan gye lugs bzang yid bzhin gyi mtsho la/ / blo gros nya chung gi bang rtsal thogs med du 'gyu ba'i/ /klog pa thos bsam gyi dga' ston rgyas pa ru mdzod cig / bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis gser bzang las grub cing / / mchog thun dngos grub kyi rin chen dbye ba yis gtams pas/ / bgrang yas lus can gyi re skong 238

༄/ /lha mo rigabyedasa'i 'dod gsol bkra shis char 'bebs/'dod 'jo yi bum bzang / / bcom ldan rig byed kyi dbang mos bu bzhin du dgongs la/ / byin rlabs bum dbang gi chu rgyun spyi bo nas bsgrengs te/ /nyes ltung sdig sgrib kyi dri ma lhag med du sbyangs nas/ / nyams rtogs yon tan gyi nus pa bde blag tu smin pa'i/ / sbong ba bsam gtan gyi 'bras bu dar ba ru mdzod cig / khams gsum dbang byed kyi dpal yon dri bzang gi pho nyas/ / skal bzang thar 'dod kyi bung ba dbang med du bkug nas/ / phul byung dngos grub kyi sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston gyis tshim mdzad/ / bcom ldan rig byedakyi dbang mos bu bzhin du dgongs la/ / srid 'byor chu mtsho las skyes kyang srid pa yis ma gos/ / bshad sgrub thub bstan gyi dga' tshal mdzes byed kyi rgyan mchog / mthar thug nges legs kyi snying po'i ze'u 'bru yis spud pa'i/ / bstan 'gro'i don chen gyi 'dab brgya bzhad pa ru mdzod cig /sor rtog ye shes kyi sgyu 'phrul nā da yi rang sgra/ / bcu phrag drug ldan gye dbyangs snyan 'gag med kyi chos dung / / nub phyogs bde ldan gyi mgon dang dbyer med kyi lha mo/ / bcom ldan rig byed kyi dbang mos bu bzhin du dgongs la/ / zla bral rnam dpyod kyi rang mdangs zla shel ltar gsal zhing / / gnas lnga rig pa yi skye ba rnam lnga yi mthar son/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgra dbyangs sa gsum du khyab pas/ / skye bo gti mug gi gnyid las slong ba ru mdzod cig / dga' ba bcu drug gi lang tsho lhan skyes kyi gzhon nus/ / sgrib bral chos dbyings kyi mdzes mar rtse dga' yis rol pa'i/ / shrī gnyis med kyi ye shes dbal be'u yi rang mdangs/ / bcom ldan rig byed kyi dbang mos bu bzhin du dgongs la/ / lung rtogs dam chos kun gru bzhi lam lam du 'char zhing / / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi gzi 'od 'bum phrag tu 'khyug pa'i/ / thugs mtshan dpal be'u yi ri mo snying ga ru bkod nas/ /239

༄/ /yo ca bayo r+sātshaname'i gatshi ཿma/legs byas 'dod pa kun lhun gyis grub pa ru mdzod cig / mi mthun bdud bzhi yi dgra las rnam rgyal gyi mtshan ma/ / phyag bzhi'i gar stabs kyi ri mo mtshar sdug gis spras shing / / las bzhi'i 'phrin las kyi g.yer kha'i sgra brgya ru rgod pa/ / bcom ldan rig byed kyi dbang mos bu bzhin du dgongs la/ /mi dang mi min gyi nyer 'tshe thams cad las rgyal zhing / / ma smad snyan grags kyi dar lce srid gsum du g.yo bas/ / dregs ldan rgyal blon kun sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor dang bcas pa/ / bdag gi mnga' 'bangs su dga' bzhin gzhug pa ru mdzod cig / bden gnyis dbyer med kyi zung 'jug lte ba las thon zhing / / gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul gyi rol gar rtsibs stong du 'bar ba'i/ / khor yug dmigs med kyi snying rje'i mu khyud kyis bsdams pa/ /bcom ldan rig byed kyi dbang mos bu bzhin du dgongs la/ / mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi bdag nyid dam chos kyi 'khor lo/ / thub bstan gling bzhi yi mkha'ab thogs med du bsgyur bas/ / 'jam dpal snying po yi chos kyi rgyal srid la 'khod nas/ / mkha' ma nyam lus can gyi mgon du 'gyur ba ru mdzod cig / ces yul dang bya ba gnyis ka bkra shisapa'i rtagasabargyad la sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo rig byed ma la 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa bkra shis char 'bebs zhe4bya ba 'di ni/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dam pa snga ma'i gsung zur bcos pa tsam ma yin par/ rang blos dpyad de bsil ldan gyi chu bo gaṅgā yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i klung chen rma chu'i 'gram du sbyar ba'o/ / / / bkra shis/ /240

༄/ / rigabyedam phyi sgrub kyirjes gnangs tshuladangos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ro༅/ / 'phags ma rig byed ma phyi sgrub kyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ku ru kul+le ye/ dbang gi dngos grub nor bu'i dga' ston la/ / sbyor ba'i grags snyan gtam gyis yid 'phrog pa'i/ / skal bzang don mthun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ / sgol mdzad bcom ldan ma yis dge legs stsol/ / de'ang bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo rig byed ma'i rjes su gnang ba byed pa la/dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad dam/ 'phrod spyor bzang po la babs pa'i dus su gnasakhang byi dor dang chag chag byas/ ba byung dang dri bzang dmar po byugs pa'i stegs bur dur khrod me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su chos 'byung dang / de'i lte bar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i dbus su rdul tshon nam 'bra4kyi tshom bu dmar po dgod/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang / gtor ma pad 'dab bzhi pa sogs mchod pa thams cad kyang kha dog dmar po bya/ slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod rdo dril me tog rnams bsham/ rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa byed na/ tshom bu'i steng du malji'i khar maṇ+ḍal la zan leb sgor mo/ de'i steng du zla gam bcad kha gdan la bstan pa mar gyi nor bu sogasakyi rgyan sprasashig kyang dgod/ de nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du btang / bum pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras 241

༄/ /gung thangabamapa'izlanama' gas 'bum/bcas kyi byen rlabs thams cad bsdus te sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ 'khyil ba'i sngags bzla/zla ba hūṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu la thim par bsam/ de nas mdun gyi tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las bcom ldan 'das mar bskyed de/ mchod bstod bzlasapa gtor 'bul sogs gzhung bzhin byasal slob ma'i don du gsol ba gdab/ de nasaslob ma rnams khrusabyas te gral du 'khod par me tog bkye bsdu byas shing maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ / de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ / gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ / ces pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas kun slong 'chos pa ni/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ 'dir 'jug pa ni skal pa bzang ngo zhes/ /legs par soms la dga' ba'i bzhin gyi mdangs/ / rab gsal 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan pa yis/ / rnam g.yeng snod kyi skyon gsum spong la nyon/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rnyed dka' la don che ba'i dal 'byor gyi rten bzang po thob/ mdo sngags zung du 'jug pa'i bstan pa'i snying po dri ma med pa 'di lta bu dang mjal/ mchog dang thun mongagi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol ba'i lha mchog khyad par can 'di lta bu sgrub tu yod pa'i dus 'dir/ 'di snang spyon pa'i zlos gar lta bu'i rjes su ma 'brangs par/ gdams pa zab mo 'di lta bu legs par nyan cing / thos don sgrub pas nyams su blangs nas srid zhi'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag las grol ba'i go 'phang bla na med pa mngon du byas te/ sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor byengs pa'i ma rgan sems can thams cad kyang bde chen sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i phyir du dam pa'i chos zab mo 'di nyid gsan snyam du chos nyan pa don ldan du 'gyur ba'i kun slong kun spyod kyi rim pa mtha' dag legs par 242

༄/ /rigabyedam phyi sgrub kyirjes gnangaphya tshuladangos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gsal btab ste gsan dgos/ gsan bya dam pa'i chos ni dpal ldan sa skya pa rnams kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas shin tu zab cing gsang ba thun mong bsgrubs pas mchog zhar la 'byung ba dmar po skor gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan rgyal ba kun gyi so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang mdangs bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo rig byed ma'am ku ru kul+le zhes dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud 'bum lnga dang brtag gnyis sogs rgyud sde du ma las gsal bar gsungs pa'i lha mchog khyad par can/ 'di'i brgyud pa'i bka' babs la'ang rtsa ba lta bur gyur ba rgyal po lhan skyes rol pa nas brgyud pa'i phyi sgrub ba ma gtso rkyang dpa' mo gcig par grags pa dang / klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i nang sgrub lha lnga dang /ḍosnyi te du ka nas brgyud pa'i gsang sgrub lha lnga ste gsum du yod cing / phyi sgrub gsang sgrub gnyis la rjes gnang gi rgyun yang da lta'i bar du ma nyams par bzhugs pa las/ 'dir 'bul bar bya ba ni phyi sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba yin/'di'i lo rgyus ni sngon rgya gar du rgyal po lhan cig skyes pa'i rol ba zhes bya ba longs spyod mnga' thang che zhing btsun mo mang du yod pa/ de'i nang nas btsun mo rje'u rigs ma zhig la rgyal po 'khor du ma 'dod pas/ des rang gi bran mo zhig rgyal po dbang du byed pa'i rig pa tshol ba'i phyir mngags pas/ bran mo de nyid skud pa 'tshong ba'i tshong dus su phyin pa na/ der bud med dmar smug ras gos dmar po gyon pa mdzes shing brjid chags pa zhig mthong nas dris pas gdams pa yod par yid ches shing gsol ba btab pa na/ gang la dmigs pa de nyid la byin cig ces ril bu zhig gnang / des btsun mo la phul yang je tshom skyes te pho brang gi nye logs na mtsho chung zhig yod pa der bskyur bas/ de'i nub mo nas klu'i rgyal po de nyid lhan skyes rol pa'i rnam par brdzus nas btsun mo'i sar 'ongs shing de dang lhan cig 'grogs pas 243

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sa'i 'tshi 'chagasems can dang ldan par gyur pa na/ rgyal po khros te chad pa gcod par brtsams pa la sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams gsol bas rgyal po the tshom skyes te/ sngar ril bu bskur ba'i bud med de tshol du bcug nas pho brang du spyan drangs pas/de nyid rje btsun ma dngos su gyur te gdams pa dang rjes su gnang ba stsal/rgyal pos kyang tshul bzhin nyams su bzhes pas mchog gi dngos grub thob ste/gdams pa 'di'i sgo nas gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin cing grol bar mdzad/de nas bzung ste dam pa bar ma chad pa la rim par brgyud cing / de thams cad kyis 'di'i sgo nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pas byin rlabs kyi gter chen por gyur ba yin/ des na gdams pa 'di nyid nyams su len par byed pa la/ thog mar rgyud snod rung du sgrub pa sminabyed dbang gi dod thub rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa gal che ste/legs grub las/ gzhan gyis rjes su ma gnang bar/ / gsang sngags gzung bar mi bya ste/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum lha'i skugasung thugs gsum gyi rjes su sbyor bar byed pa la/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas de ltar du gnang ba stsal pa ni chos de nyid nyams su len pa la dbang bar 'gyur bas/ dbang gi go don dang yang phyogs mtshungs pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ sngags kyi nus pa skyed pa'i dbang /'byor pa skyed pa'i dbang / bgegs zhi bar byed pa'i dbang / snod rung du byed pa'i dbang ste bzhi gsungs pas/ snga ma gsum yang rjes gnang dang rigs gtad sogs la gtso bor byed pa yin/ de'ang chos 'di ni gsang sngagasajab mo'i gdams pa phul du phyin pa yin kyang / de theg chen kyi chos zab mor 'gro ba nyams su len pa po'i gang zag la rag las/ de bsam pa byang chub kyi sems la rag las/ de'i rgyu tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong la rag las 2la

༄/ /rigabyedam phyi sgrub kyirjes gnangabu tshul dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/pas/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs te mchod pa 'bul ba sogs kyi spyan dmigs ma yengs pa mdzad par zhu/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams steng gi cha la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ku ru ku l+le la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyes mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ yo badz+ra sa ma dza de nas thal mo sbyor du bcug la/ na mo gu ru rgya na ma ku ru ku l+le bh+ya0 zhesapa lan gsum gyi rjes zlos bya/ de nas slobadapon rang nyid kyis phyag rgya dang bcasate/ oṃ ku ru ku l+le badz+ra pu ṣ+pe ā :/nas/ shasta'i par gyis mchod/ de nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bya snyam pa byas la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod ces/ dkon mchog gsum la nas 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum bya/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas tshogs zhing rnams rim gyis bsdus te mdun bskyed kyi lha mo la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig / de dag gis sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams song zin/ dngos gzhi la sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ mdun bskyed kyi lha mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la zhugs pas tshe thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs te lus drangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ oṃ shu n+ya ta zhes sogs kyis mngon rtogs bzhin du slob ma lhar bskyed/ bla ma'i thugs ga'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros/ lho phyogs rig byed kyi phugs na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i thugs gar phog pas/ de'i thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas 'od zer dmarapo'i 'phreng ba bsam gyes mi khyab pa dmar khrig khrig byon te khyed rang rnams kyi lus la thim pas lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros snod bcud thams cad la phog pas/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang 245

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'itshonasa'i gatshi 4ma/dang bcud thams cad rje btsun ma'i rnam par gyur te tshur 'dus nas khyed rang rnams la thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pa lho phyogs rig byed kyi phugs na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i sku la phog pas/ de las rang 'dra'i sku che chung dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib kyis thim pas rje btsun ma'i sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dril bu gsil zhing gu gul gyis bdug/ sngags kyi mthar badz+ra a ba sha a a/ zhes dang / dza ( baṃ ho zhes btags pa gang mang brjod/ des rje btsun ma'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag/ lus lhar bsgom pa la dbang / rje btsun ma'i sku dang khyed rang rnams kyi lus dbyer med du byin gyes brlab byung snyam pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod cig / de nas gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du khyed rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs gar pad nyi'i steng du hrī yig cig gsal 'debs pa dang / bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma la gus 'dud drag po byas pa na de gnyis ga'i thugs gnas sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung /zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ga'i hrī yig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod pa'i mos pa byas te lag pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byas la/ sngags kyi rjes zlo4lan gsumaphya/ de'ang rjes zlos lan gsum gyi dang po'i tshe rang gi snying gar dam tshig pa'i tshul du 'khod/ gnyis pa de la ye shes pa'i tshul du bstem/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa dang bcas bla ma la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor bzhin 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi/ / bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum bya/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis phul ba'i me tog gi 'phreng ba sngags su byin gyis brlabs te spyi bor bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces me 246

༄/ /rigabyedam phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnangakhya tshuladangosagrub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/tog 'thor zhing / bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ / 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / sngags kyi dngos grub thob pa dang / / brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ / bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo ris byed ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa rdo rje slob ma'i rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig /des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang bar byas/ rje btsun ma'i gsung dang khyed rang rnams kyi ngag dbyer med du byin gyis brlab byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig / thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba byed tshul la gnyis las/ thun mong ba tsam byed na/ bla ma'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo rig byed ma'i thugs kyibyin rlabs ma lus pa hrī yig gi rnam par spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo — yig dang phyag mtshan sna tshogs pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar sib kyis thim pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang / sngags kyi mthar abe sha btags pa mang du brjod cing dril bu dkrol/thugs kyi rjes gnang thun mong ba'i ngo bo de tsam gyis 'grub/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi don bsgom pa la dbang bar byas/ khyed rang rnams kyi yid dang rje btsun ma'i thugs dbyer med du byin gyis brlab byung snyam pa mdzod byas te/ gtso bos ji ltarawags kyiyodam tshig gzung zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug / thun mong ma yin pa'i rjesaganang byed tshe/ thugs kyi rjesaganang thun mong ba'i ngo bo grub mtshams su/ bla ma'i thugs ga'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang /stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'od zer kha dog 247

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gas ཿma/dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs gar thim pas/de rnams kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ gu gul gyis bdug cing dril gsil dang bcas/ oṃ ku ru ku l+le hrī hrī hrī a be sha ya hrī hrī ༷ zhes gang mang brjod/ yang bla ma'i thugs ga'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ zhes sogs sngar ltar/ yang thugs kha'i hrī yig las 'od zer 'phros/tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba rnams dang / paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub pa rig 'dzin rnams dang / 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang skye 'gro bsod nams can rnams kye lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus te dīdī byerdo rna~X ༵ ༵༷ma ༷ ༷ dī /nid rdo~X rnyi ༷ngh+rurdo ༵ṭ+wāṃ ༷nidī dzhai dī~X diṭ+wāṃX thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag / sems ye shes su bsgom pa la dbang bar byas/rje btsun ma'i thugs dang khyed rang rnams kyi yid dbyer med du byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de yan chad bum dbang gi dod yin par rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ de nas dbang gong ma gsum ga'i dod bdag byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa'i steng nas byed pa la khyed rang rnams kyis spyan dmigs 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma mar sne lte bar zug pa/ lte bar yi dang snying gar hrī yig dmar po/ yar sne smin mtshams su gleb pa la haṃ yig mgo bo thur du bstan pas mtshan pa/ snying ga'i hrī yig la dmigs pa gtad pas de las 'od dmar po me'i rang bzhin gyen 248

༄/ /rigabyedam phyi sgrub kyirjes gnangs tshuladangos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/du 'phros pa dbu ma'i lam nas gyen du son pas haṃ yig phugs te smin mtshams kyi sha lpags kyi mtshams brgyud mgo bo la g.yon skor du song ba rna ba g.yon pa'i bug pa nas nang du zhugs/ g.yas kyi bu ga nas phyir thon/ mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du bkang ba'i mda'i ltong nas zhugs/ ut+pa la'i mde'u rgyas par byas te rtse mo nas phyir 'phros/ srid pa gsum gyi sems can thams cad/khyad par du gang zhig dbang du byed par 'dod pa rnams kyi rnying la zhugs pas/de thams cad bdag nyid kyi dbang du bsdus te bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par gyur pa tshur bsdus te ut+pa la'i mde'u'i nang du zhugs/ mda'i ltong nas rna bug g.yas su zhugs pa g.yon nas thon/ mgo bo la g.yas su bskor ba smin mtshams nas dbu ma'i nang du zhugs/ haṃ yig la thim pas de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ spyi bo dang mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor rnams gang zhing gsang dbang gi ngo bo bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes pa'i dmigs pa mdzod/ slar yang haṃ yig las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa snying ga'i rtsa 'khor brgyud de lte ba'i yi yig gi steng du babs pas me'i steng du snum phog pa bzhin lte ba'i yi yig las gtum mo'i me 'od cher 'phros/ haṃ yig las kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun chil chil babs te gsang gnas yan chad byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsis gang bas 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi ngo bo bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar dga' bzhi rim gyes drangs pa'i mthar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde ba chen pos rang gi lus dang snod bcud thams cad khyab par mos te/ gang la thog ma dbus mtha' med/ / srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ / bdag med gzhan yang yong ma yin/ /zhes pa'i don sems kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum gyes stong pa'i de bzhin 249

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan ba'izla ma'i gsung 'thum/nyid dang / 'khor 'das gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes dbyer mi phyed pa nam mkha' lta bu'i don la nges pa khyad par can skyes te tshig gi sgo nas dbang bzhi pa'i rtogs pa rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo rig byed ma phyi sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis lhan du sbrags te bla ma dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin legs par thob pa yin pas dam tshig mtha' dag tshul bzhin du srung snyam pa gyes la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod ces/gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /ces pa lan gsum dang / gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i rjes su/ bdag nyid bran du dbul ba'i rjes zlos mdzod / ces/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ / khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ / zhes pa lan gsum dang / bstan pa rgyasapa'i bsngo ba sogs kyis mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ /de'ang thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang bzhi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas skur tshul 'di ni rje dbang rab kyi gsung dang /dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha gnyis gung bsgrigs pa yin la/ cho ga'i bdag byin brlab kyi tshe dga' bzhi dang dbang bzhi sbyar yang 'dir de dang mi 'dra ste/ bum dbang gi dod thugs kyi rjes gnang yan chad kyis song zin par rje dbang rab kyis gsungs bas/ phyi mar spyor rgyu dbang gsum las med la/ gsang dbang dang sher dbang gi dmigs pa'i mtshams 'byed tshul yang zur 'debs kyi yi ge zhig tu 'di bzhin 'dug pa ltar byas pa yin no/ /garma 'phrin las gnyis pa'i bum thod me long sogs la brten pa'i rdzas kyi dbang bzhi bskur tshul bshad pa 'ang lugayogacig yin te/ mnyam med chen po dang / swo 'jigs med grags pas de lta bu'i dbang bzhi bskur tshul zhig gsungasapa la lasagasang sgrub lha lnga dang spyar yang / phyi sgrub dpa' bo gcig pa 'di nyid dang sbyor dgos par mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyisagasang ba lha lnga'i byin 250

༄/ /rigabyedam phyi sgrub kyirjes gnangs tshuladangosagrub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/rlabs kyi cho gar gsungs pas shes so/ / 'phags ma'i byin rlabs gter gye sgo/ / man ngag sde mig 'des phye bas/ / mchog thun 'dod dgu'i dngos grub kyis/ / lus can mtha' dag tshim byed shog / ces 'phags ma rig byed ma phyi sgrub kyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes su gnang ba bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yang dag pa'i sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i spong ba pa sdom brtson chen po dkon mchog byams pas bskul ngor/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bhi gru rat+na ā nan+ta'o/ /251

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i sgoname'i ga4 'bum/ra ste/ / dpal gsang ba'i bdag po 'khor lo chen po'i bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag rgya cher bshad pa gsang chen rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu ru badz+ra dhā rā ya/ sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang / / sa gsum 'gro ba'i mig gcig tsong kha pa/ / skyabs gsam kun 'dus byeXṭ+wāṃX rtoX ༷ṭ+wāṃX ༵༵maX /ṭ+wāṃrjo/ niṭ+wāṃ shaṃ/ t+t+waṃ /skru ༷ baṭ+wāṃ daṭ+wāṃX shaṃṭ+wāṃ ni ṭ+wāṃX bhe snye ṭ+wāṃbhe shaṃ ṭ+wāṃ bhe shaṃ shaṃ snyeshaṃ skre/ / rte bhe //༷/ /rteX ༷ sdi bherdo /bhe bherte shaṃ bhebhe bsngags/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe 'dzin 'khris yongs gang ba'i/ / phra rags 'khor ba rgya mtsho'i mthar brgal te/ / zung 'jug nor bu len 'dod skal bzang rnams/ / 'jigs bral ded dpon 'di nyid bsten par rigs/ /rang la sgrub pa'i nyams myong mi ldan yang / / 'phags bod mkhas pa'i legs bshad la brten nas/ / sangs rgyas 'khor lo chen po'i bskyed rim gyi/ /zab gnad go sla'i ngag gis bshad par bya/ / de'ang khams gsum chos kyi 252

༄/ / 'khor chen bskyed rim gsang chen rolamatsho/rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po de nyid nges pa'i don du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bye ba'i bdag por gyur cing / thun mong snang tshod dang mthun par yang yi dam gye lha ches mang ba'i bsnyen sgrub la gzhol bar mdzad na'ang / gsang bde 'jigs gsum 'khor chen dus 'khor te lnga gtso bor mdzad pas rje bla ma'i thugs dam gye lha lngar grags pa byung ngo / / de'i nang nas kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed dang 'khor lo chen po gnyis ni mthar thug mchog 'grub par ma zad/ da lta ches snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dbang gis phyi nang bgegs rigs kyi nyer 'tshe shin tu mang bas chos kyi mgo thon pa ches cher dka' ba'i dus 'dir gnas skabs bar chad sel ba'i lam gye ded dpon lta bur yang med mi rung du bsten dgos par gsungs te/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo chen po dang rdo rje 'jigs byed gnyis la yi dam dang bsnyen sgrub byed pa byung na bar chad bzlog pa sogs la phul du byung ba yin no/ / zhes dang / khyad par 'khor lo chen po la yi dam du byas na gnas skabs su tshe ring 'ing rims nad sogs kyang 'byung dka' zhing ma/thar thug mchog gi dngos grub 'thob pa'i zab gnad khyad par can yod do/ / zhes gsungs so/ /des na 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo chen po'i zab lam nyams su len tshul gtan la 'bebs pa la gsum/ gang las gsungs pa'i khungs dgod pa/ de nas gsungs pa'i yi dam lha'i mtshan don bstan pa/ mtshan don de dang mthun par lam gyi rim par slob tshul dngos bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ 'di'i rtsa ba drag po gsum 'dul gyi rgyud dang / de'i bshad rgyud gsang ba'i rgyud rnams kye rnam par 'byed pa drag po gsum 'dul gnyis ni gtso bo yin la/ phyag na rdo rje be+e con can gyi rgyud/ rdo rje gtum po me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud sogs de'i char gtogs pa'ang mang ngo / / bshad rgyud 253

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'di'i sngags la la bod skad lta bur yod pa sogs kyis bla ma gong ma kha cig the tshom gyi gzhir mdzad kyang / bcom ldan rig ral dang dmar chos kyi rgyal po sogs kyis rgyud rnam dag tu byas nas ṭī ga'ang mdzad la/ bu ston gyis kyang 'di rtsa rgyud dang 'jug pa gcig tu gsungs pas rgyud phyi ma yin par gsungs so/ / 'di dag slob dpon dza wa ri ba dang / bha ba ba sogs kyis rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du bkral pas de la mi mthun pa med kyang der pha ma'i rgyud gang yin gye gsal kha med pas/ dmar la sogs pa bla ma gong ma phal cher rgyud 'dirartsa rlung thig le'i rnam gzhag gtso bor ston pas rnal 'byor ma rgyud du gtogs par bzhed do/ / 'on kyang bu ston rin po ches pha rgyud la rigs drug tu yod pa las mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi rgyud du gtogs par bzhed cing / bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gye rgyud sde spyi rnam las kyang rdo rje'i rigs kyi gtso bo gsang 'dus dang / de'i rigs kyi sems dpa' phyag rdor 'di yin par bshad la/ 'on kyang bshad rgyud ni bod ma yin par byas snang ngo / / de dag gi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos kyang mang du yod na'ang gtso bor gyur pa nam gru'i rigs las dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po rdza wa ri ba'i gzhung rnams yin la/ der brgyud tshul yang / slob dpon sa wa ri bar grags pa ma chen dngos badz+rarat+na de ba zer ba de nyid byes pa'i dus mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis dmod pa bor ba'i rkyen gyis klu'i gnod pas zin te/bram ze gzhan la phan pa'i blo can bya ba'i slob dpon zhig la brten nas rdo rje rnam 'joms bsgrubs pas nad las grol/ sa wa ri zer ba sngon lha mo u ma bsgral ba'i nu ma g.yas yin par grags shing gdug ba can gnas pa'i ri zhig tusgrub pa mdzad pas thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes nas mtshan yang de ltar thogs/ de nas mchog sgrub pa'i phyir yi dam lhas lung bstan pa ltar u rgyan 254

༄/ /'khor chen bskyed rim gsang chen rolamatsho/du byon nas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong ba can dang mjal te 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur cing / drag po gsum 'dul gyi rgyud sogs gsan nas tshur byon te sngar gyi gnas de nyid du bsgrubs pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ slob dpon 'dis 'grel pa rin chen phreng ba sogs rnam 'joms kyi skor 'ga' zhig ma gtogs 'khor chen gyi gzhung ma mdzad kyang gdams pa rnams dza wa ri ba la rdzogs par gnang ngo / ja lnga ri ba ni rgya gar nub phyogs oṃ ta n+ta bu rir 'khrungs/ dge 'dun gye zhal ta ba mdzad pa'i tshe sa bdag gi nad kyis zin pas de zhi ba'i phyir sa wa ri ba'i zhabs la gtugs/ byin gyis brlabs pas nad thams cad sbrul gyis pags pa brjes pa ltar sos/ chos skor 'di gtad nas dza wa ri zer ba lha mo u ma bsgral ba'i nu ma g.yon par grags pa'i gnas der song nas sgrub na mchog 'grub par lung bstan pa bzhin mdzad pas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes shing gnas kyi ming gis mtshan yang dza wa ri bar thogs/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'phrin las kyi bka' bab yin pas phyi rabs kyi don du rgyud 'grel bdud rtsi'i myu gu/ sgrub thabs rgyas pa 'khor lo chen po/'bring bdud rtsi'i thigs pa sogs 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub thabs gsum/ 'jig rten pa'i sgrub thabs gsum/ zhi drag gi sbyin sreg gnyis/gtor ma'i cho ga sogs gzhung cha lag dang bcas pas mang du mdzad dza wa ri pa'i zab chos nyi shu zhes grags par paṇa chen ye shes rtse mos gsungs la/ da lta bstan 'gyur rnams su bco brgyad yod pa bu ston chos 'byung gi 'dren tshul dang 'grig par snang / slob dpon de nyid kyi drung nas bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta deb puzlo ma tis gsan te bsgrubs pas yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs shing byen gyis brlabs/ de la she'u lo tsā bas zhus kyang gdams pa thor bu las ma gnang /255

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/de bod du bsgyur ba dza wa ri pa snga 'gyur du grags la 'on kyang 'phrin las cher ma rgyas/ phyis su paṇ+ḍi ta de la ma gar lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos zhus nas gdams pa rdzogs par thob ste bod du byon/ gshen ston rin chen dngos grub la chos skor tshang bar gnang ste rang nyid ri bo rtse lngar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi drung du gshegs/ gshen ston gyis gdams pa rnams dmar chos kyi rgyal po la gnang / dmar chos kyi rgyal pos rgyud 'grel gyi ṭī ka / sgrub dkyil/bskyed rdzogs/ sbyin sreg sogs yig cha mang du mdzad de/ mdor na dza wa ri pa'i 'di skor gyi gzhung gang yod la dmar gye gsal byed kyi yi ge re'ang yod par snang / bu ston rin po ches kyang 'di'i bstod pa rgyas pa sgrub thabs kyi gnad tshang ba zhig mdzad/ rje bla ma rang gis dngos su yig cha mdzad pa med kyang rje'i gsung rgyun la brten nas 'dul 'dzin gyis 'di la sgrub thabs che chung gnyis dang dkyil chog rnams mdzad cing / 'jam dbyangs chos rje/byams chen chos rje/ 'brom btsun sher 'byung blo gros/ shar rgyal mo rong du 'khrungs pa'i rong ston blo bzang grags pa/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo rnams kyis kyang 'di'i bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa'i yig cha mang du mdzad do/ /gnyis pa de nas gsungs pa'i yi dam lha'i mtshan don ni/ drag po gsum 'dul gyi rgyud las/ thig le'i rang ba'in mi shigs la/ / kha sbyo ra nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las/ / bgegs rigs stong phrag 'joms mdzad pa/ /'khor lo'i bdag po khyod la bstod/ / ces gsungs pa'i steng nas shes dgos la / mtshan don 'di ni 'di'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i spyi chings lta bu yin te/ mtshan don dang rtsa sngags kyi steng nas rang lam yongs rdzogs la go ba rnyed dgos pa rgyud sde mang po'i spyi lugs yin no/ / 'dir yang mtshan don de nyid kyis lam rim pa gnyis ka mtshon pa yin te/ bskyed 256

༄/ /'khor chen bskyed rim gsang chen rolamatsho/rim la sbyar na gang du skye ba len pa'i gnas tha ma'i khu khrag gi thig le'i mtshon byed nyi zla kha sbyor gye dbus der/ bar do mtshon byed mi shigs pa'i rlung sems tsam gyi rang mdangs hūṃ yig de nyid zhugs nas 'dres pas nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rnam pa de nyid phyag mtshan du gyur cing / de las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros nas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad spyan drangs te 'dus shing thim pa las/ phyi'i bgegs kyi rigs su gtogs pa sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i dregs pa gsum gye tshogs thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i drag shul can khro bo chen po'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam par bzhengs te/ yum mdzes ldan ma dang snyoms 'jug gi sbyor bas khro bo bdud las rgyal byed la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ga'an rnams spro bar byed pas na dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i bdag por gyur tshul gsungs pa yin pas lam 'khyer phyi ma gnyis gsal bar bstan cing 'chi ba chos sku'i lam 'khyer shugs kyis go nus la/ yang na bar do mtshon byed hūṃ yig la mi shigs pa'i sgras bstan pa'i dgongs pa kun rtog rags pa mtha' dag mi shigs pa la bsdus pa'i 'chi ba 'od gsal las ldang ba mtshon pa'i don du byas na lam 'khyer gsum ga legasas par go nus shing /'khor lo'i bdag por gsungs pa'i shugs kyis dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog kyang 'grub po/ / de ltar mi shigs pa zhes pas hūṃ yig dang / bgegs rigs 'joms zhes pas sku'i khro nyams rdzogs tshul dang / 'khor lo'i bdag po zhes pas snyoms 'jug gi sbyor ba sogs bstan pa yin te/ bshad rgyud las/bdag po'i sa bon las byung ba/ / zla nyi thod pa rdo rje las/ / drag po'i rtags ldan khro bo che/ / mdzes ldan sku la yang dag 'khril/ / zhes pa dang rim pa ba'in rtsa bshad sbyor dgos so/ / grub chen gyi gzhung las rtsa rgyud kyi tshigs bcad de rdzogs rim la sbyar pa ma gtogs bskyed rim dang dngos su 257

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronaḥ khrung 'bumasbyar ba med kyang nges don gye khro bo chen po bde stong gi ye shes de nyid bzhin lag gi rnam par shar ba drang don gyi khro bo'i sku bskyed rim gyi bsgrub bya 'di yin pas de la'ang sbyor dgos pa'i phyir te/ rong ston gyi skyed rim las/tshigs bcad snga ma la nges don rdzogs rim gye bshad pa rgyas par mdzad/ ces pa nas/ dngos su mi gsal yang drang don bskyed rim la sbyar ba'i bshad pa gcig kyang 'thob dgos/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / bla med kyi rgyud gang las bskyed rim gsungs pa rnams la des mtshon rgyu'i rdzogs rim re dang /rdzogs rim bstan pa rnams la de'i smin byed du gyur pa'i bskyed rim re go rgyu yod pa spyi srol lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ ye shes rdo rje kun btus kyi ṭī ka las/dngos su bskyed rim bshad pa'i cha rnams la nges don dzogs rim gyi bshad pa re nges par 'thob pa ni/ mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i bshad pa 'jug pa'i bla med kyi rtsa rgyud rnams kyi spyi lugs yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mtshan don de nyid rdzogs rim la sbyor tshul ni dza wa ri ba'i rgyud 'grel las/ da ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa de kho na nyid kyi dbang du byas nas bstod pa ni/ thig le'i rang bzhin mi shigs la/ / kha sbyor nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las/ / bgegs rigs stong phrag 'joms mdzad pa/ / 'khor lo'i bdag po khyod la bstod/ / ces bya ba la bdag po ni bcom ldan 'das kyi sku ste lha'i bdag nyid do/ / 'khor lo ni sprul pa dang / chos dang / longs spyod dang / bde ba chen po'o/ / thig le ni byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'o/ / rang bzhin ni de kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin mi rtog pa'o/ / mi shigs pa ni dbyer mi phyed pa'am tha mi dad pa ste/ de bas na thabs shes rab dbyer med ces bya ba'i don to/ / de rang bzhin ji ltar rtogs par bya zhe na/ kha sbyor zhes bya ba ni 'khor lo'o/ / nyi zla zhes bya ba ni la la nā dang ra sa nā'o/ / 'phro 'du zhes bya ba ni bsregs pa dang / gso ba 258

༄/ / 'khor chen barma rim gsang chen rolamatsho/dang / srog dang gnad du 'phro zhing 'du ba'o/ / bgegs rigs stong phrag 'joms mdzad pa/ zhes bya ba ni rnam par rtog pa 'joms pa la bya'o/ /zhes rkang pa tha ma dang dang po gnyis 'khor lo chen po'i don dang / rkang pa gnyis pa de mngon du byed pa'i thabs dang / rkang pa gsum pa de'i dgos pa la sbyar nas gsungs so/ / de'ang go sla bar brjod na/ 'khor lo zhes pa lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo ste gang la gnad du bsnun pa las nges don gyi lha lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po 'dren pa'i gnad khyad par can gyi rtsa 'khor bzhi bstan/ bdag po zhes pas rtsa 'khor de dag gang la brten pa'i lus bstan to/ / 'dir rgyud 'grel las/ bdag po ni bcom ldan 'das kyi sku ste lha'i bdag nyid do/ / zhes gsungs pa'ang 'bras dus kyi lha sku dngos gnas pa kho nar mi gzung ste/ gtso bor lam dus mtshon dgos pas lha'i skur bsgom pa'i bsgrub pa po rang gi lus la'ang byed dgos pa'i phyir/ sher 'byung pa'i rdzogs rim la sa/ bcom lda na 'das kyi bdag nyid de de'i ngo bor bsgom pa'i bsgrub pa po'i sku ste lus nyid do/ / zhes so/ / de ltar na rkang pa tha mas ngesadon gyi lha 'grub pa'i ga'i bstan la/ nges don gyi lha dngos ni rkang pa dang pos bstan te/ di'ang thig le zhes pa byang sems zhu ba'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po dang / rang bzhin zhes pa chos rnams kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ mi shigs pa zhes pa bde ba chen po de stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu zhugs pa'i bde stong zung 'jug gam bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes bstan pa yin la/ yang nang gi 'khor lo bzhi la brten nas drangs pa'i thugs bde stong gi ye shes dang / bdag po zhes de'i rten du gyur pa sku dag pa sgyu ma'i sku gnyis ngo bo gcig tu tshogs pa bden gnyis zung 'jug gi tshul yang bstan pa yin 259

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgroname'i gsung ཿma/no/ / rkang pa gnyis pa'i bde chen 'dren tshul ni/ kha sbyor zhes pa 'khor lo ba'i po de'ang spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor kha thur lta dang / mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor kha gyen du lta ba'i kha spyor/ snying ga'i rtsa 'khor kha thur lta dang / lte ba'i rtsa 'khor kha gyen du lta ba'i kha sbo ra gyi tshul du gnas pa bstan/ de'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la yi ge sgozlo tshu' yang shugs kyis 'thob bo/ / nyi zla zhes pa nyi ma ste khrag 'bab pa'i rtsa ra sa nā dang / zla ba ste khu ba 'bab pa'i rtsa la la nā gnyis bstan la/ de'i 'phro 'du zhes pa de gnyis kye rlung dbu mar zhugs pas gsang gnas dang lte ba'i gtum mo sbar nas me 'od gyen du 'phro bas yi ge rnam sa dang khyad par spyi bo'i haṃ yig bsregs te bzhu ba dang / haṃ yig las byang sems zhu ba'i rgyun 'khor lo rnams kyi lte bar 'du ba'am bab pa las bde chen 'dren tshul gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ / rkang ba gsum pa'i bgegs 'joms tshul ni/ bden 'dzin dang tha mal gyi snang zhen bag chags dang bcas pa 'joms pa yin la/ bgegs 'joms tshul 'dir rgyud 'grel tu'ang phyi nang gi bgegs 'joms tshul gnyis gsungs snang bas/ de'i gnyen po dang drang nges kyi lha gnyis su byas te bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka la sbyor dgos pa grub chen rang gi dgongs par shin tu gsal lo/ / tshigs bcad 'di la rdzogs rim dang sbyar ba'i bshad tshul gzhan zhig mdzad 'dug na'ang mang gis dogs bas ma bris te/ mdor na 'khor lo chen po zhes pa bskyed rim la sbyar na dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i bdag por gyur ba dang / rdzogs rim la sbyar na 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i bde stong gi ye shes kyi steng nas 'jog dgos pas/ 'di'i lam rim ba gnyis kyi gnad thams cad mtshan don 'dir tshang ba yin no/ /gsum pa mtshan don de dang mthun par lam la rim gyis slob tshul 260

༄/ / 'khor chenabaskyed rim gsang chen rolamatsho/bshad pa la/ smin byed bskyed rim la slob tshul dang / gro' byed rdzogs rim la slob tshul gnyis/ dang po la drug gang gis sgom ba rten gyi mtshan nyid/gang du sgom pa gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ rdzogs rim gyi sngon du bskyed rim sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bskyed rim sgom/ tshul dngos/ goms pa mthar phyin pa'i tshad/ mthar phyin nas dngos grub sgrub pa'i tshul lo/ / dang po ri/bshad rgyud las/ shes rab snyeng rje gsang dbang ldan/ / zhes gsungs te/shes rab ces pa bla ma dang dkon mchog gi yon tan/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs la dpyad sgom gyi nges pa rnyed ba nas bzung mi rtag ba phra rags dang gnas lugs stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i bar shes rab kyi cha thams cad dang /snyingarje zhes pas dang por 'khor ba phra rags kyi sdug bsngal la 'jigs skrag rnal ma skyes pa na rang nyams la dpag ste sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i snying rje chen po skyed cing des drangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems spyod pa dang bcas pa thabs kyi cha rnams bstan te/ mdor na lam thun mong bas rgyud legs par sbyangs pa sngon du 'gro dgos par bsta na pa yin no/ / 'di la dgongs nas sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i thigs par/ byams pa dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos zhes gsungs shing / sgrub thabs ma/dor bsdus su/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhes gsungs pas kun slong de lta bu zhig dgos kyi/ da lta lha khyo bo'i bsgom/ bzlas byed pa phal cher mi dang mi ma yin ci rigs la sdang sems kyis 'jug pa ni 'di'i ldog phyogs kho na yin no/ / 'di la dgongs nas bla ma snga ma rnams tshad med bzhis sem/sa bskyed pa la rnal 'byor bsrung ba zhes btags pa yin te/ dmar gyi bskyed rim las/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i du kha dang bral 'ing / zag med kyi bde ba la 'god pa'i phyir bdag gis khro bo chen po bsgom par bya'o zhes smon sems bskyed de ma 261

༄/ /yo bayo pa'itshoname'i ga 'bumadang bu gcig pa'i dpe'o/ / de ni rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o/ / zhes dang /rong ston gyi rdzogs rim sngon 'gro'i yig chung las/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa yid 'khul nges pa yid ches gting nas 'drong ba bya ste/'di ni rnal 'byor bsgom pa dman pa'i lam du 'gyur ba las srung ba'i thabs yin pas rnal 'byor srung ba zhes bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bshad tshul 'di ni legs par rje bla mas kyang gsungs te/ 'dod 'jo las/ bod kyi bla ma snga ma mang pos tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnal 'byor bsrung ba dang /phung sogs byin gyis rlobs pa bdag bsrung ba dang / srung 'khor bsgom pa gnas bsrung bar bzhed pa'i dang po ni jo bo chen po'i 'grel pa dang mthun no/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sgrub thabs 'khor lo chen por khrus tsam las byams sogs bsgom pa ma gsungs snyam du mi 'dzin te/ rgyud dang grub chen gyes khrus zhes gsungs pa de phyi'i khrus tsam ma yin par bden 'dzin dang rang gces 'dzin tha mal gyi rnam rtog sogs 'khrud tshul du ma zhig go dgos pas shin tu rgya che ba'i phyir/ dper na rgyud rdo rje rtse mor/ khrus bzhi dag ni rtag tu bya/ / rnal 'byor ji ltar khrus bya ba/ / go rim bzhin du rab tu bshad/ /sdom pa gsum la rab gnas pa/ / dang po'i khrus su brjod pa yin/ / gnyis pa rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ / bshags dang gsol ba 'debs pa sogs/ /phyag rgya 'ching ba gsum pa'o/ / bzhi pa chu ste tha ma yin/ / zhes dang / saspu ṭi las kyang / dang por stong nyid rnam bsams te/ / lus can rnams kyi dri ma bkru/ / zhes dang / khyad par du 'di'i phyogs mthun rdo rje me lce'i rgyud las/ nang gi bdag nyid can dang yang / / phyi yi khrus sogs rab byas la/ / zhes pa'i 'grel par/ nang gi bdag nyid ni nang ste phyi'i chos dang nang gi chos rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag par byed pas khrus mchog tu gsungs 262

༄/ /'khor chen bskyed rim gsang chen rolamatsho/so/ / zhes dang / me lce'i phreng ba'i sgrub thabs las kyang / nang gi khrus ni mi rtog bas/ / thams cad dag par 'gyur ba yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de ltar lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs ba'i 'og tu rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung nas gsang sngags kyi 'jug sgo thun mong ma yin pa dbang rnam par dag pa thob cing / dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mig gi 'bras bu bzhin bsrung ba ni lam sgom pa'i rten la med mi rung yin te/ dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ gang dag rigs dang dbang bskur cho ga med/ / gang dag dkyel 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang / / gang dag byang chub sems ni ma skyes pa/ / de yis gsang sngags bzlas na phung bar 'gyur/ / zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ ji ltar nye bar bstan pa bzhin/ / phyi nas dam tshig spyod par brtson/ / snod du byas pa'i rgyun las ni/ / 'khor lo la sogs sgom rim gyis/ / yang dag man ngag phun tshogs rnams/ / 'grub par 'gyur ro gzhan du min/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ lam sgom pa la gnas phun sum tshogs pa shin tu gal che ste/ dper na 'phang lo bzhi dang ldan pa'i shing rta'i 'khor lo gcig ma tshang na bgrod mi nus la/ bzhi ga tshang na bgrod pa myur ba bzhin/ lam nyams su len pa la'ang mthun pa'i yul na gnas pa sogs theg mchog 'khor lo bzhi tshang dgos par bshes spring las gsungs pa bzhin yin pas/ bde gsang 'jigasagasum gyi rgyud sogs su gnas kyi de nyid ces yang yang nan tan du gsungs la/ 'di'i rtsa rgyud du mi gsal yang / bshad rgyud las/ lcags 'dri'i ri dang bya skyibs dang / / nags tshal mthug dang mchod rten nang / /zhes gsungs shing / de'i dgongs par mdzad de dza wa ri pa'i sgrub thabs che 'bringaganyi gar/ rgyal po dang rkun po dang stag la sogs pa ya nga ba thams 263

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i khrung 'bum/tsad dang bral ba'i ri'am/ yid du 'ong ba'i gnas 'du 'dzi med pa zhes gsungs so/ / de'ang lcags 'dra'i ri zhes pa ni gnod pa gang gis kyang tshur mi tshugs pas sra ba'i don nam/ yang na phyi'i khor yug gi lcags ris ri gling rgya mtsho thams cad brten pa ltar 'gal rkyen rnams khegs shing mthun rkyen 'dzom pa'i ngon no/ / de'ang ri mthon po'i rtse mor sgom sgrub byas na rig pa dwangs shing rtos pa ngar che la/ 'on kyang phal pas mi non pa'ang srid do/ /bya skyibs te rgyab mtho la/ mdun gzhol ba g.yas g.yo na du skyor dang bcas pa'i sa phyogs nyams spro ba dang nags tshal mthug po'i dkyil sogs mdor na sgrub pa byed pa la bar chad rtsom pa'i mi dang mi ma yin gyi nyer 'tshe'i rigs gang yang med cing sngon gyi skyes bu dam pas byin gyis brlabs pa ga'i bdag ngang yul mi rnams kyang chos la dkar ba/ skye bo mang po'i 'du 'dzi dang glag cor gyi sgra sogs med tsang chu shing 'dzom la bsil drod stoms pa'i gnas de lta bur sgrub pa byas na legs pas/ de lta bu'i gnas su sgrub khang rkyen dang 'tsham par phyag dar legs par byas la/ phyi rol tu tho slong tshul nang du yi dam lha'i sku dang de'i chos skor sogs sku gsung thugs rten dgram tshul phal cher spyi dang 'dra'ang / thugs kyi rten la paṇa chen ye shes rtse mos rdo dril sogs gtso bor mdzad pa ni/ slob dpon bha ba'i gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs las/ rdo rje dril sogs phyag mtshan rnams/ / 'u gas dang mthun pas mdzes pa ste/ / thugs kyi rtags su shes par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa dang bstun par snang bas legs so/ / gnas kyi bkod pa kha byang du phyogs te sdod pa dang stabs 'grig pa byung na legs te/ dza wa ri pa'i gnod sbyin sbyong ba'i sgrub thabs las/ bdag nyid lhor 'dug byang du'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/'di'i dgos pa sanod sbyin rnams 'di nas byang gi phyogs lhun po'i ngos la 264

༄༅/ /'khor chen bskyed rem gsang chen rol mtsho/—gnas pa'i rgyu ca/tshan gyes yin la/ dregs pa ga'an gnyis kyang gtso bor ri rab kyi steng phyos / dab rtsa bar gan sa paru / gdul bya'i dbang gis byang du khya ba 'brel chagab/ par ma ngon no/ / dngos su de ltar sdod pa'i stab mi 'grig na yid kyis der phyogs par ro/sa pas tshog par a bh+ya kā ras gsungs so/ gsum pa ni/ 'bras bu zung 'jug gi go 'phang sgrub pa'i nye rgyu rdzobs rimarnams yin kyang de pa bsgyed rim gye rnal 'byor rnams skas kyi gdang ngu bzhinasngon du 'gro dgong par rim lnga dang spyod bsdus las gsungs pa ni bla med kyi rgyud thams cad la 'dra bas/ skabs 'dir yang kha cig mchog sgrub pa la bskyed rim mi dgos par smra ba dang / la la rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gror bskyed rim zhig dgong kung de skad cig dkrong skyed tsam gyis chog par smra ba sogs mi 'thad de/ sa'i dus kyi skye shi bar do'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du skyes pa'i rdzogs rim gyis de gsur/ ga sa bon dang bcas pa sbyangs te sku gsum du sgyu ra bar byed pa la sngon du mos ngo tsam la de dang rnam pa mtshungs par skyes pa'i lam gyis tha mal gyi snang zhen mngon gyur pa mgo mnan pa 'ig sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ spang bya gang gi sa bon spong ba la mngon gyur nyams smad pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa bcos min skye ba la bcos ma sngon du 'gro dgos pa mdo sngags spyi'i lugs srol yin pas/ tshul 'di dag zhib par ni rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim pa sogs las shes par bya'o/ / bskyed dzogs gnyis la slob pa'i dus kyi mtshams kyang 'phags pa yab sras rnams rim pa dang po la brtan pa ma thob bar du gnyis pa mi sgo ma par bzhed la/ lugs 'di'i slob dpon chen po bha bas kyang / yang na bskyed rim brtan pa yis/ / rdzogs pa'i man ngag gang bsgoms kyang / /zhes sogs de dang phyogs mthun par gsung snang ngo / / 'on kyang bod kyi bla 265

༄/ /yo ca bayo r+sāskyonama'i gatshi 4mam snga ma rnams kyi phyag len du thun stod la bskyed rim bsgoms nas thun smad la dzogs rim sgom par mdzad pa ni/ tshe la yid brtan med cing chos 'di lta bu dang yang yang mjal dka' bas lam gyi lus yongs dzogs la bag chags re 'jog rgyu mi lus pa'i thabs mkhas su snang bas legs par gsungs so/ /bzhi pa bskyed rim sgom tshul dngos la/ thun gyi ngo bo la ji ltar bya ba dang / thun mtshams su ji ltar bya ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la gsum/ thun gyi mgor ji ltar bya ba dang / dngos gzhi la ji ltar bya ba dang / mjug tu ji ltarakhya ba'i tshul lo/ / dang po la'ang / nang mchod dang sngon 'gro'i mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs nas dbul ba dang / bdag bskyed mchod pa byen gyes brlabs shing rdor sems bsgom bzlas bya tshul gnyis/ dngapo ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar bdud rtsi ril bu 'am med na byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod kyis kha dag par byed pa phyi'i khrus dang / rang rgyud la brtag ste rlung ro dgu phrugs sogs kyi sgo nas kun slong ngan pa mtha' dag bkag nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i kun slong khyad par can gsal 'debs pa nang gi khrus rnams sngon du btang / mdor bsdu na/ bde bas phongs shing sdug bsngal gyes mnar ba'i ma rgan sems can thams cad gting mtha' med pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las sgrol ba'i phyir du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che tshe gcig nyid la thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i bskyed rim zab mo bsgom parakhya'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bcos ma tshun chad shugs drag po zhig gsal btab la/ de'i shugs ma nyams pa'i dran 'dun dur re ba'i ngang nas rnal 'byor bsgom pa la 'jug pa ni chos theg pa chen po'i chos su 'gro bar byed pa'i thabs mkhas kyi rtsa ba yin pas gal po cher bya/ de'ang rang tha mal 266

༄/ /'khor chen bskyed rim gsang chen rolamatsho/gyi snang zhen la gnas nas ma chod gtor sogs byin gyis drob mi nus pas skad cig dkrong skyed kyis lha'i skur ldang dgos 'a / nyer len gyi phung po 'di galharabaskyed pa'ang min pas rang gi lus 'od sngon po'i rnam par zhu zhing rim gyis yal bar mos te stong nyid kyi lta bsgom / de'i ngang nas rang gi go sa der sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ dbus su de'i lte ba dang tshad mnyam pa'i nyi dkyil/ de'i steng du rang bde stong gi ye shes su gsal ba de nyid spad cig gis sangs rgyas 'khor lo chen po sku mdog mthing nag dbyar gye char sprin stug po lta bu/ gos sngon pa'i stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum me ltar 'bar 'ing / khro gnyer smin phrag tu bsdus pa sogs khro bo'i nyams yongs su rdzogs pa phyag sayas kyis rwa rtse shin tu gdangs pa'i khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa phrag gong du 'phyar zhing / g.yon sprul zhags dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub rab tu bsgreng ba/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa la yum lha mo mdzes ldan ma sku mdog mthing nag g.yas gri gug 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing / g.yon pas thod khrag yab kyi zhal du sto ba pa/ 'bas g.yas brkyang 'ing g.yo na pas yab la 'khril te stoms par 'jug bzhin pa'i skur bzhengs par bsam mo/ / rang lhar bskyed pa ni phyag rgya chen po sku'i dam tshig yin la/ yum dang sbyor ba shes rab kyi dam tshig yin pas/ rdor dril byin rlabs kyi tshig dngos su 'don mi 'don gang ltar yang / lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i thabs kyi cha thams cad rdo rjes mtshon tshul dang / shes rab kyi cha thams cad dri' bus ma tshon tshul dran par byas te/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig dang dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gnyis bsnan nas dam tshig gsum mam bzhi po de cho ga'i mgo mjug thams cad du ma brjed par bya'o/ / / /267

r+sā gang thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i ba/sung 'bum///———— /de/denang mchod byin gi rje ri brlab pa la'ang bsang sbyang byed cing byin gīs brlab pa dang ba'ir ngo nga pa ra sa/ bsang ba ni las sngags brjod pa na rang na thugs ka nas rnga ngo bange sto nga gi ye shes yin pa la rnam pa khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i tshogs dpa ga tu re da pa spros te mchod pa la gnas pa'i bgebs thams cad rgya mtsho'i phar 'gram du bskrad pa'i mos pa byed/ phyi'i bgebang zlog pa la khro bo'i rnam/ nga spros pas chog kyang / bgegs kyi rtsa ba nang gi bden 'dzin spong ba la bde stong ge ye shes su mos pa shin tu gal che'o/ / sbyang ba rne su bhā wa'i sngags brjod pa na thog mar oṃ zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ de'i a a 3 gsum gyes sbyang ga'i sbyong byed sbyangs pa'i ngo bo gsum ga rang bzhin gyes med pa mtshon pas tha mal gyi snang zhen 'gog cing / sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum ga mtshon pas mchog gi snang zhen skyed pa yin te/ rgyud sde rnams su oṃ yig gis mtshog ster ba sogs su gsungs pa ni de lta bu'i don dran ba'in pa'i sgo nas brjod na phan yon de dag 'byung bar gsungs pa yin la/ rig byed pas sngags kyi nus pa bshad pa ni kun slong la ma ltos par sgra tsam la de 'dra'i nus pa rang chas su yod par 'dod pa yin pas gtan mi 'dra ba shes par byas te/phan yon 'dod na kun slong 'chos pa la gzab par bya'o/ / su bhā wa sogs kyi don gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid nga'o zhes pa yin pas/ sngags don bzhin nang mchod la tha mal pa'i snang zhen dang bden pa'i snang zhen sbyangs te stong bar bsam zhing de rtogs pa'i blo'ang 'bras dus kyi bde ba chen por mos/ de ltar byas na 'og gi skyed chog thams cad bde stong de'i rnam rol tu 'char ba'i gnad dang / 'bras dus na sgrib bral bde stong gi ye shes gcig nyid mkha' khyab kyi 'ing du gang la gang 'dul gyi brtan g.yo'i bkod pa sna tshogs su shar 268

༄/ / 'khor chen bskyed rim gsang chen rolasatsho/nas ga'an don lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i smin byed dang rten 'brel gyi slo thog ma nas bsgrig dgos so/ / skyed pa ni/ stong pa de'i ngang las nang mtshad kyi go sar yi sngo skya gyen 'greng thig thol gyis byung / de yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po leb mo gzhu'am zla gam gyi dbyeb4can bcad la rang la bstan pa zur gnyis su bum pa nas thon pa'i ba dan lhab lhab g.yo/ batshen pa gnyis kyis mtshan pa / de'i steng du ri dam/ra po 'ig thol gyis byung / de yongs su gyur pa las me'i / kyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa'i zur gcig rang la bsngan pa me 'bar ba'in pa/ de'i steng du a dam ra po'am dkar po las mi ma go rlon pa bcad ma thag pa lta bu ltag pa gsum nang du bsta na pa'i sgyed pu gsum/ gye steng du a dkarapo zhig tho'/ gyis byung / de 'od du ltem gyis zhu ba las byung ba'i thod pa stong nyid mtshon byed phyi dkar 'a bde chen mtshon byed nang dam ra ba/ bde stong dbyer med pa mtshon pas dum bu bcig pa sto nga gsum ltar yangs thing rgya che ba'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar trī sa ma tshan pa/ de'i shar du me long ye shes dang rnam snang gi ngo bo hūṃ yig dkar po 'ig thol gyis byung / de yongs su gyur pa las ba lang gi sha la de'i ming go yig dkar pos mtshan pa/ lhor ma nyam nyid ye shes dang rin 'byung gi ngo bo yi ser po 'a sa khyi'i sha la ku ku ra zhes pa'i ming yi ga dang po ku yig ser pos mtshan pa/ nub tu sor rtog ye shes dang 'od dpa ga med kyi ngo bo dz+rī dam/ra po las glang po che'i sha la darnyi zhes pa'i ri nga yig dang ngo/ da yig dmar pos mtshan pa/ byang du bya sgrub ye shes dang don grub kyi ngo bo kha ljang gu las rta'i sha la ha ya zhes pa'i ming yig dang po ta yig ljang gus mtshan pa/dbus su chos dbyengs le shes dang mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo hūṃ sngon po yongs su gyur pa 'a sa mi'i sha la na ra zhes pa'i ming yig dang po na yig sngon pos mtshan 269

༄/ /'khorachun barma rim gsang ོ rolamatsho/bor rtogs par byas shing kha dog dmar ser du gyur par bsam/ de'ang bdud rtsi'i skad dod a mṛ ta zhes pa 'chi ba med pa la 'jug cing gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med ni 'chi ba med pa tshe'i lha yin pas/ dang po nas dbus su trī yig bkod pa rdzas thams cad bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du skyed pa'i ched yin no/ / oṃ ni sku rdo rje rnam snang gi sa bon yin la/ de ni gzugs phung rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid de ma dag pa'i phung po sbyangs nas rnam par dag pa'i gzugasakyi khams rgya cher spros pa sogs 'di'i byed pa yin pas/ de'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin shegs pa thams cad kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas bsnan cing / oṃ yig kyang ltem gyis zhu nas rdzas rnams dang 'dres pas mgron rnams kyis ji tsam longs spyod kyang 'dzad pa med pa'i mang por sbar zhing spel bar bsams nas/ oṃ ā ྅ ha ho hrī zhes sam/ oṃ trī rtu/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byen gyis brlabs pa brnyan par byas par bsam/ 'dir oṃ 〉 rtu gsum rdo rje gsum gyi sa bon yin la/ha ho trī gsum yang / ha ser po snang mtha'/ ho dkar po rnam snang /trī sngonapo mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin can gyis rim bzhin kha dog dri nus kyi skyon gsum sbyang bar mos pa yin no/ / thog mar nang mchod byin gyes brlabs pa ni 'og gi mchod gtor rnams bsang ba'i don yin la/ bskyed pa'i snod thod par byas pa ka pā la zhes pa'i nges tshig gis bde ba skyong pa la 'jug pas lam dang 'bras dus kyi bde stong gi ye shes skyed pa'i ched dang /gzhi dus na'ang bde ba'i rten haṃ yig gnas pa'i snod du gyur pa'i rten 'bre' gyis yin no/ / de'i nang gi rdzas bcu'i sha lnga dang dri chen dri chu khams dkar dmar bzhi la mi mthun pa med kyang / bdud rtsi lnga pa la bshad rgyud rdor phreng /sdom 'byung / gdan bzhi'i 'grel pa rnams las sha chen/ tshil/ rkang /271
