༄/ /yothang bstan r+sā sgronama'i ga ཿmapa gcig tu na 'dod 'jo dang / sbas don kun gsal gnyis gar/ gnas la ni sgrub pa po'i gnas dang / dkyil 'khor gye lha'i gnas gnyis so/ /zhesabade mchog gi le'u tha mas rgyud don mtha' dag de nyid bcu bzhir sdud pa'i tshe/ gos dang zhes pa de nyid ba sa na zhes pa'i nges tshig gi steng nas gnas la'ang 'jug pas/ gnas der dkyil 'khor dang sgrub pa po'i gnas gnyis su byas pa ltar/ 'dir yang 'og tu/ rten la brten pa bzhugs sogs don/ zhes pa de nyid kyi rdo rje'i tshig gi nus pas gang du bsgrub pa'i gnas kyang ston par bshad du rung ngam snyam mo/ de nas sngon 'gro skyabs sems sogs ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ g.yam la rgyug gis tshigs bcad bklags pa tsam ma yin par/ rang gzhan 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul bsam pa'i 'jigs skrag dang / dkon mchog la de las skyob pa'i nus pa yod par yid ches pa gnyis tshogs kyi sgo nas blo lings kyis 'gel thub pa zhig dgos pas/ 'dir yang khyed shes khel ba'i dad brtan pos/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar ma yin par rgyun du dad pa yod yod ltar snang yang / rkyen mi bzod pa ni gting ma tshugs pa'i rtags yin pas dad pa can gyi grangs su mi 'gro ste/rin chen 'phreng ba las/ 'dun dang zhe sdang 'jigs pa dang / /rmongs pas gang zhig chos mi 'da'/ / de ni dad pa can zhes bya/ / nges par lags pa'i snod mchog yin/ / zhes dang / rgyal dbang bdun pa'i 'jigs byed bskyed rim las/ lha dang chos la rgyu mtshan yang dag mthong ba'i dad pa brtan pos rkyen ci byung yang de las mi ldog pa/ zhes so/ / de'i 'og tu bsam pa sems bskyed dang / tshad med bzhi la sogs pa bsgom dgos pas/ skyabs sems tshad bzhi dag la 'bad/ / ces gsungs te/ dngos zin skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa zhes so so ba lta bur gsungs kyang /408

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zabawa'i 'grel pa zaba.osnang ba/don gye 'gros gcig tu 'gro ste/ dang po 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas rgyu skyabs rnams la blo bkal te skyabs su 'gro ba theg pa thun mong ba'i dbang du byas pa'i skyabs su 'gro tshul dang/ de rjes sems can thams cad kyi don du 'bras skyabs su gyur pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid thob par 'dod pa'i sems bskyed bsgom pa theg chen pa'i skyabs su 'gro tshul yin la/ sems can gyi don zhes pa'ang / sdug bsngal sel zhing bde ba sgrub pa las ma 'das pas/tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni sems bskyed kyi dmigs rnams je rgyas su btang ba tsam ma gtogs de las logs shig min no/ / de la dgongs te rim lnga gsal sgron las/ thun mong gi skyabs su 'gro ba sngon du song nas so sor thar pa'i sdom pa blangs pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro sngon du song bas smon 'jug gnyis kyi sems dang ldan pa/ dbang yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor bas bsgrub dgos par bshad cing / de dag gi sgo nas blo 'khrid tshul zhib tu ston pa la lam rim gyi ming btags pa yin pas/ zhes thun mong ba'i lam rim mtha' dag sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro'i khongs su 'du bar gsungs/ der ma zad dngos gzhi lha'i rnal 'byor rnams kyang skyabs 'gro 'bras bu lam byed kyi tshul du bsgom pa yin pas/ mdor bsdu na lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa thams cad skyabs 'gro'i chos skor du 'du bas/ skyabs 'gro rgya chung ngu ma yin par mnyam med jo bo chen po dang / rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen sogs kyis gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ lha'i rnal 'byor ji ltar bsgom pa dang /bzlas pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la sgom tshul dngos dang / de nyid rgyud sde'i khungs dang sbrags pa gnyis/ dang po la'ang 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i rnam par bsgom pa dang / de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus 409

༄/ /gung ca b.lo yo ma'i ga4 ཿma/pa'ibadag nyid du lta tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ ma dag rnam shes stong pa'i gzhir/ / dag pa de bzhin nyid kyi ngang / / thabs shes gnyis med 'od gsal ba'i/ / bde stong zung du 'jug pa yi/ / ma ṇi pad+ma'i nges pa'i don/ /trī 'khrungs spyan ras gzigs dbang mchog / sku mdog dkar la 'od zer ni/ / phyogs bcur 'phro ba zhal gcig pa'am/ / phyag bzhi bcu gcig zhal la sogs/ / sku yi rnam rol dpag med par/ / nam mkha' thams cad gang bzhugs pa/ / yang yang gdung bas gsal 'debs bya/ /zhes byung / de'ang bod snga ma mang pos lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa tsam dang bskyed rim gyi dbye ba ma phyed cing / lha'i rnal 'byor dang sbrel nas stong nyid bsgom pa dang / rlung gi rnal 'byor thams cad rdzogs rim du 'dzin pa sogs shin tu mi 'thad par/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gye rim pa dang / bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs las gsungs pa bzhin yin pas/ rdzogs rim rnal ma yin na rang gi sngon du smin byed bskyed rim dngos sam/ de'i dod thub kyi lam zhig 'gro dgos la/ bskyed rim dngos gnas par 'gyur ba'ang lha'i rnal 'byor tsam gyes mi chog par mar sbyang gzhi dang rnam pa mthun pa/yar 'bras bu dang rnam pa mthun pa/ dzogs rim zab mo'i smin byed du gyur pa'i sgo nas thun mong ma yin pa'i lag rjes re 'jog rgyu yod pa nges par dgos so/ / des na 'di la'ang 'og tu/ rdzogs rim zab mo'ang bla ma yi/ / man ngag bzhin du sgom la brtson/ / zhes 'byung bas/ thog ma'i mngon rtogs kyi rim pa 'di'ang sku gsum lam 'khyer gyi gnad tshang bar byas te nyams su len dgos so/ / des na/ ma dag ces sogs nas/ nges pa'i don/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis 'chi ba chos sku'i lam 'khyer dang / hrī 'khrungs zhes pas bar do longs sku'i lam 'khyer bstan la/ de la spyir rgyu rdo rje 'dzin 410

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnang ba/pa bsgom pa dang / sa bon gyi yi ge 'jog pa sogs lugs mang du yod pa las/'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas shing / mngon byang gzhan rnams kyang shugs kyis bstan par bzhed dgos so/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang mchog / ces sogs ni sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa ste/ skye ba sprul sku'i lam 'khyer du shes sla'o/ / 'di la dogs pa'i gnas 'di yod de/ ma dag rnam shes stong pa'i gzhir/ / dag pa de bzhin nyid/ ces dang / stong gzhi chos nyid za ma tog / ces sogs ni/ nges don rgya mtshor/ stong gzhi chos nyid yongs grub la/ / zhes dang / stong gzhi don dam gzhan stong / zhes dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa/ stong gzhi don dam gzhan stong la dgongs pa yin gyi/ dngos po med pa stong nyid tsam gang yin pa rang stong la dgongs pa ma yin te/ zhes sogs rnam grangs du mar/ dag pa'i chos nyid bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po rtag brtan zer zug de nyid stong gzhir byas te/ de ma dag pa'i rnam shes nyon mongs pa dang mi dge ba'i chos rnams kyis stong pas gzhan stong gi 'jog tshul sor mo'i 'phreng ba'i mdo khungs su byas te bshad pa rnams la sgra 'gros shin tu mthun pas/ stong tshul de nyid kyi dbang du byas pa yin no snyam na/ de ni gtan ma yin te/ 'dir ma dag rnam shes stong pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ bskyed rim gyi thog ma'i stong nyid bsgom pa la dgag bya bden grub rigs pas bkag pa tsam gyes mi chog par/ ma dag pa'i snod bcud kyi snang ba rnams blo ngor bsdus te stong sang du bsgom pa ni/gnas skabs der yang tha mal gyi snang zhen 'gog pa dang / sgyu lus kyi mthar bsam gtan gnyis kyi sdud rim la brten nas 'od gsal du 'jug pa'i smin byed khyad par can yin pas/ de go ba'i phyir yin te/ 'dod 'jo las/snodabacud kyi snang ba don la ma dag bzhin du sdud pa'ang chad stong sgom pa 411

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonama'i gsung 'bumamin te/ zhes pa nas/ dgos pa'i dbang gis de ltar byed pa yin gye/ snang pa med par khas mi len pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / sgyu lus kyi rim pa mthar phyung bas kyang bsam gtan gnyis kyi sgo nas/ snod bcud kyi snang ba bsdus nas 'od gsal du 'jug par bsgom pa 'phags pa yab sras sogs du ma zhig gis bshad pas/ zhes dang / rje'i gsung 'bal ser dka' bcu'i zin bris las kyang / gal te lta ba dran nas kyang tha mal gyi snang ba blo ngo der mi ldog par snang na/ snang ba thams cad 'ja' yal ba bzhin du btang ba'i nam mkha' lta bu'ang bsgom dgos te/ mtshan nyid kyi theg par stong nyid bsgom nas snang ba nges par sdud pa'i bshad pa med kyang sngags kyi theg pa 'dir ni de nges par dgos te/ mchog gi snang zhen skye ba la tha mal gyi snang zhen sdud pa nges par dgos pa'i phyir te/ yid shes gcig gi ngo na de gnyis 'du bar mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / de ltar na bsgom bya'i yul gyi stong pa la dgag bya phra mo rags pas bkag tsam gyi stong nyid dngos dang / ma dag pa'i snang ba bkag pa'i stong pa gnyis tshogs pa padri'i nges don dang / sgom byed kyi blo'ang mos pa tshun chad kyi sgo nas gsal btab pa'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i snying rje ma ṇi'i nges don te/bde stong gnyis sam thabs shes gnyis dbyer med par zung du 'jug pa'i 'od gsal chos kyi sku'i bdag nyid de nga'o snyam du nga rgyal 'jog par byed pa ni 'chi ba chos sku'i lam 'khyer sgom tshul yin no/ / mdo lugs kyi thabs shes zung 'brel du byed tshul ni/ blo rdzas rgyun tha dad pa gnyis phan tshun gcig gis gcig rtsis zin par byed pa tsam yin la/ sngags lugs kyi thabs snying rje chen po dang / shes rab stong nyid rtogs pa gnyis sgron me dang de'i 'od bzhin sems gcig la ldog cha tsam gyis so sor bzhag pa yin pas/ 'o chu 412

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnang ba/'dres pa ltar dngos po so sor dbye rgyu med pa zhig dgos pa'i tshul/ bde mchog 'byung ba las/ shes rab snying rje'i dbye ba ni/ / sgron ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin/ / 'di gnyis mi phyed bdag nyid de/ / ro gcig dngos po'i sems yin no/ / zhes dang / saspu ṭa las/ chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin/ / gnyis med rnam pa'i sbyor ba yis/ / gnyis po 'dus pa gang yin pa/ / shes rab thabs zhes bya bar grags/ / zhes gsungs/ 'od gsal de nyid kyi mjug thogs su longs sku'i lam 'khyer bsgom pa'i tshul gzhi la 'chi ba 'od gsal 'gags te/ lugs ldog gi nyer thob grub ma thag srang mda'i mtho dman bzhin 'od gsal gyi rlung sems tsam las bar do'i lus 'grub pa ltar/dpe don gyi 'od gsal 'chi rim bzhin mngon du byas pas lugs ldog gi nyer thobagrub pa dang mnyam du/ rlung sems tsam las dag ma dag gi sgyu ma'i sgu dngos gnas la bar do bzhin du grub pa 'byung ngo / / bskyed rim gyi tshe 'od gsal 'chi rim bzhin 'char mi thub pas/ de las langs pa'i sgyu ma'i sku dngos gnas su mi 'grub kyang / mos ngor de ltar byas pas gzhi'i bar do sbyor ba dang / lam gyi bar do sgyu lus 'grub pa'i smin byed du 'gro zhing /'bras bu'i sgyu ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pas na/ bar do longs sku'i lam 'khyer zhes bshad do/ / de nyid sgom tshul dngos ni/ 'od gsal stong par bsgoms pa'i mjug thogs der/ chos dbyings stong pa nyid kyi ngang tsam du gnas na gdul bya'i don du mi 'gyur bas/ gzugs kyi skur ldang bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa dang bcas te/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa lha sku bzhin lag gi rnam pa'am/ sa bon gyi yi ge lta bu'i rnam par ldang ngo / / tshul de la'ang rgyud dang grub chen gyi bshad pa shin tu mang ste/ 'dus pa 'phags lugs sogs su mngon byang lnga las rgyu rdo rje 'chang skyed par gsungs pa bar do mtshon byed shin 413

༄/ /yo thang bayo pa'isgoname'i khrung 4ma/tu gsal ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ bde dgyes sogs las yi ge tsam bsgom par gsungs pa'i dgos pa/ brtag gnyis las/ yi ge las byung gong bu la/ / hūṃ phaṭa rnam pa'ang 'dod mi bya/ / zhes sogs kyang yin mod/gtso bor gyur pa ni zhal lung las/ rim pa dang po pa rnams la/ / yi ge'i gzugs su rab snang ba/ / gzhom du med pa rang lha yi/ / sa bon 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ zhes pas gsal bar bstan te/ shin tu phra ba'i rlung 'od zer lnga pa ni gzhi dus su bar do'i gdags gzhi dang / lam rdzogs rim gyi dus sgyu ma'i sku'i sgrub gzhi dang / 'bras bu'i tshe longs sku'i sgrub gzhi yin pas/ de nyid 'dir lha'i sa bon gye rnam par bsgoms nas rlung sngags dbyer med du byas pas snga ma sbyong zhing phyi ma smin pa'i gnad mang du yod do/ / de ltar yang sngags rim las/ sngags kyi theg par rten dang brten pa bskyed pa phal che'i rgyur yi ge re bsgom pa'i gnad kyang 'dis shes par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs shing / don 'di nyid gsal bar mkhas grub rje'i yig chung las/ 'byung ba rnams dang por snying ga nas chags la/ mthar yang snying gar sdud pa dang 'dra b.ralam bskyed rim gye skabs su snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la spro bsdu mang du byas te/ zhes pa nas/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs su bogs 'dod tshul gzhan dang ye mi 'dra ba la dgongs pa yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ 'di go ba shin tu gnad che'o/ / 'dir yang dngos zin la sa bon gyi trī yig tsam las ma smos kyang / sa bon de nyid gang du 'jug pa'i gnas zla gdan lta bu zhig nges par bsam dgos te/ gzhi'i gnas skabs su bar do pa skye gnas su 'jug 'dod pa dang 'dra bar/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa hrī yig gi rnam par nam mkha' la gnas pa des kyang bdag sgyu ma'i lus 'di tsam la gnas na'ang tha mal pa rnams kyis mthong bar mi nus pas/ de dag gi don 414

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnang ba/du rags pa'i sprul sku bzung bar bya'o snyam du/ pha ma'i khu khrag dang chos mthun pa'i zla dkyil de nyid la 'jug pa yin no/ / 'o na 'dir zla ba gcig pu las med pas/ khu khrag gnyis ka ma tshon byed dang / mngon byang gnyis kyi don tshang ba mi 'thad snyam na skyon med de/ brtag gnyis las/ zla ba me long ye shes ldan/ / bdun gyi bdun pa mnyam nyid ldan/ / zhes zla nyi gnyis bshad pa'i dgongs pa 'grel pa la/ de nyid kyi thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud kha sbyor gye brtag pa gsum pa las/ zla ba me long ye shes ldan/ / de bzhin mnyam nyid ye shes nyid/ / ces zla nyi gnyis char gyi dod du zla ba gcig pu byas kyang rung bar gsungs pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyu mtshan sbas don kun gsal las/ zla ba gcig las med na'ang dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/ khams dkar dmar gyi 'du 'phrod las bde chen skyed pa mtshon pa'i don du yin no/ / zhes dang / 'dod 'jo las/ zla nyi gnyis dang / zla ba dkar dmar gnyis dang / zla ba gcig byed pa'ang dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par dpa' bo rdo rjes bshad pa ltar byed la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir hrī yig shin tu dkar ba dri ma med pa'i dung gi mdog dang 'dra ba de nyid dang mdangs ma 'dres tsam gyi zla ba la cung zad dmar mdangs chags pa byas na rung bar gsungs so/ / de ltar na zla ba'i kha dog dkar ba me long ye shes/ dmar mdangs chags pa mnyam nyid ye shes/ sa bon sor rtog ye shes/ de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/tshur 'dus te zla ba dang sa bon gcig tu 'dres pa bya grub ye shes/ de las lha'i sku rdzogs pa chos dbyings ye shes las byang chub pa ste/ dmigs pa skyong tshul gyi gnad la mkhas na sa bon gsungs pa de tsam gyi steng nas kyang mngon byang lnga'i sgrub tshul bde blag tu rtogs par nus so/ / yang 'di'i hrī yig la 415

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i sgroname'i ga 'bum/so sor phral na/ nahra dra ste gsum 'byung bas/ dpyid dang thig le mnyam par sbyor ba mtshon tshul gyi bshad pa byar yod mod kyang / de tsam gyis skabs 'di'i mngon byang so so'i go mi chod de/ cho ga gzhan gyi skabs su rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dod ye shes lnga'i ring bzhin gye hūṃ yig bzhag kyang / mngon byang lnga'i sgrub tshul logs su byed dgos pa bzhin no/ / tshem bu dmar khrid kyi yi ge rnams su stong pa'i de bzhin nyid las byang chub pa dang / pad zla las byang chub pa dang / sa bon las byang chub pa/ phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa ste lngar mdzad pa ni thun mong ba'i dbang du byas par snang bas/ bskyed rim dngos gnas par byed na snga ma gtso che'o/ /de'ang mngon byang dang po bzhi 'dra ba la/ tha ma'i skabs kyi sku'i rnam pa ni rang rang gi mos pa bzhin du/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'am/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal bcu gcig pa/ phyag stong spyan stong sogs rgyud sde du mar spyan ras gzigs kyi sku'i rnam pa tha dad pa'i dbye ba mang du gsungs pa de dag gang la'ang sbyor du rung bar mngon no/ / de'ang thugs rgyud gcig pa'i lha rgyud sde so so nas 'byung ba rnams nyams su len pa'i tshe rang rang gi rgyud dang mthun par byed dgos pa spyir btang yin la/ skabs 'dir dmigs bsal la bla med kyi skyed chog dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas rgyud sde bzhi gar gsungs pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs mtha' dag sgom pa 'gal ba med de/ dper na sgeg rdor gyi mtshan brjod ṭī k+ka las/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal de nyid ni zhe sdang spyod pa'i sems can de nyid rjes su gzung ba'i don du rnal 'byor dang / spyod pa dang / bya ba'i rgyud rnams las gsungs pa'i khro bo'i gzugs su dmigs nas 'jig rten gsum 'dul pa'i don du de dag kyang rang gi lus las rnam par 'thon pa ni kun tu 'bar ba'i snying po can/ zhes 416

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mo snang ba/pa nas/ khro bo'i sku rnam par phyung nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gdug pa can thams cad gdul bar byas te/ yang slar log nas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gye phyi rol tu dkyil 'khor gnyis pa la mtshan gyi sngags kyi yi ge bdun cu rtsa gcig rnams rang gi rigs kyi kha dog dang gzugs rnams su gyur te ji lta bas rim pas yang dag par gnas par bsam par bya'o/ / zhes rgyud sde so so nas 'byung ba'i gshin rje'i gshed kyi rigs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ / ces pa nas/ sgra dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog / ces pa'i bar gyis bstan pa mtha' dag rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor dang sbyar te sgom tshul gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du lta tshul ni/ de nyid dus 'khor bde dgyes gsang / / sgyu dra rdor gdan ma ya dang / / gshin rje'i gshed dang rta mchog dbang / / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yum chen mo/ / phyag chen shin tu rnal 'byor dang / / sangs rgyas mnyam spyor dbu ma che/ / rang byung ye shes rdo rje sems/ / rdo rje 'chang sogs gshis lugs kyis/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun lha/ / sngags rgyud dkyil 'khor phyag rgya dang / / dngos grub thams cad 'dus pa yi/ / bla ma'i rnal 'byor gcig nyid du/ / yid ches dad gus drag po yis/ / gdung ba bya zhing 'dod gsol gdab/ / ces byung / de'ang mdo sde rgyan las/ zag med dbyings na sangs rgyas rnams/ / mkha' ltar lus ni med phyir dang / / sngon gyi lus rjes 'brang ba'i phyir/ / gcig min mang po nyid ma yin/ / zhes chu bo thams cad rgya mtshor 'dres pa bzhin du/ zag pa med pa'i dbyings su dbyer med par gsungs la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang rdo rje theg pa'i skabs 'dir gnyug sems lhan skyes kyi bde ba'i ngo bor bskyed de/ de nyid chos thams cad kyi gnas 417

༄/ /༅ thang bayo pa'i sgonas ga4 4ma/lugs stong pa nyid dang ro mnyam du gyur pas gang snang stong pa dang / stong pa bde bar shar ba'i bde stong gi ye shes gcig pu de nyid rgyud sde so so'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang / rten gzhal yas khang / sngags dang rgyud la sogs pa mtha' dag gi rnam par shar ba yin pas/ de ltar na de dag kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i ye shes bde stong dbyer mi phyed pa de nyid la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang rang gi skabs su byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dang / dga' ba chen po zhes nges don gyi dkyil 'khor lha'i gtso bor gsungs te/ dper na dus kyi 'khor lo dang / gsang ba 'dus pa lta bu btags chos kun rdzob pa'i lha sgu bzhin lag gi rnam pa can la mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba yod kyang / de dag gang gi rang mdangs lta bur 'byung ba'i gdags gzhi nges don gyi dus 'khor sogs su 'jog rgyu'i bde stong gi ye shes la khyad par cung zad kyang med pas/ 'dir yang ma ṇi pakhye'i nges don bde pa dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i steng nas thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa 'di nyid lha de dag thams cad kyi go 'phang sgrub pa'i thabs bla na med par 'gyur tshul bstan pa yin no/ / kha cig 'di snyam du/ gzhung 'dir ye dam gyi lha dang sngags rgyud thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du bshad rgyu ni gzhi 'bras dbyer med pa rtag brtan ther zug gi bde gshegs snying po de nyid yin te/ 'di'i bshad tshul dang nges don rgya mtsho las/ kā latsa kra dang / he badz+ra dang / 'khor lo sdom pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi dang / rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la sogs pa don dam gyi lha yab yum dang rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad dbyer med ro mnyam gcig pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ / zhes dang /de bzhin du dbu ma chen po dang / phyag rgya chen po dang lhan cig skyes sbyor dang 418

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabasazab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnangab/sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dang / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang shin tu rnal 'byor dang bde dgyes dang gsang 'dus dang dus 'khor la sogs pa de bzhin nyid kyi rnam grangs su gtogs pa ji snyed gsungs pa thams cad la'ang gzhung dang lam gang yin pa btags pa ba dang gzhi dang 'bras bu ngo bo dbyer med gang yin pa thams cad mtshan nyid pa nyid du don la gnas te/ zhes dang / kun rdzob kyi bden pas stong pa'i gzhi chos nyid yongs grub kyi 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la sogs pa gdod nas dag pa'i chos de rnams gsang sngags zab mo rnams su rang byung ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnam pa mang por gsungs pa zhes dang / de ltar gdod nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa chos nyid kyi gzugs sogs thams cad chos nyid kyi lha rnams yin pa ji lta ba de bzhin du/ de rnams thams cad chos nyid kyi sngags dang rgyud dang dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya la sogs par yang gdo nas rang bzhin lhun grub tu bzhugs pa yin la/ zhes bshad pa rnams dngos zin ji lta ba bzhin bkod par snang ba'i phyir ro snyam na/ ches shin tu mi 'thad de/ 'dis ni de dag drang don du 'grel par snang gi / 'di dag dang de'i don ches shin tu mi mthun pa'i phyir ro/ / de'ang cung zad zhib tu bshad na/ nges don rgya mtsho rang lugs kyi don dam pa'i lha ni/ de nyid du mdo drangs pa las sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kun tu nan tan du btsal yang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po skyes pa ma brnyes te/ sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi dbyings ma skyes pa mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i dbyings yod do/ zhes sogs la brten nas rgyu rkyen gyis 'du ma byas pa zhig tu 'dod kyang / 'dir bde stong gi ye shes rang rgyud la bskyed nas de'i rang mdangs 6 yig gi rnam pa las lha sku gsar du sgom pa'i rtsol bas sgrub dgos par 419

༄/ /gung ca bayo ཿ sgron me'i ga ཿma/gsungs pa'i phyir dang / de ltar lam gyis gsar du bskyed na nges don gyi sangs rgyas min tshul nges don rgya mtsho las/ bskyed pa'i sangs rgyas dang /lam gyi bden par 'chad pa rnams rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa dang mi mthun te/de rnams ni kun rdzob yin pa'i phyir dang / 'di ni 'gog pa'i bden pa don dam yin pa'i phyir dang / kun rdzob kyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa zhes ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ zhes nges don gyi lha la rang chas su yod pa'i 'gog pa'i bden pa ma gtogs/ rtsol bas bsgrubs pa'i 'du byas kyi cha gcig ma bshad la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'chad pa'i tshe'ang /bral ba dang bskyed pa'i 'bras bu zhes/ nges don chos kyi sku la sgrib byed dang bral bas gsal bar byed rgyu tsam ma gtogs/ sgom pa'i rtsol bas gsar du sgrub rgyu'i cha gcig med tshul mdo myang 'das khungs su drangs te bshad pa dang /'dir nges don gyi lha tshogs de thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo la 'jog rgyu der rim pa gnyis ga'i lam gyi sgo nas sgrub rgyu zhig gsungs pa don shin tu mi mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar na 'dir gsungs tshul gyi tshig zur de dang cha 'dra ba mang du 'byung ba ni/ de'i dgongs pa drang don du bkral te/ rje bla ma'i lugs ji lta ba dang mthun par ston pa'i ched yin no/ spyir na'ang gsung rab rnams su dran don gyi lung so so'i dgongs gzhi 'jog pa'i tshe/ sgras zin gyi don de dang 'gro phyogs mthun pa re 'jog dgos pa dper na/ kun gzhi gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhir 'khor 'das mtha' dag gi gzhir gyur pa'i chos nyid bzhag pa lta bu de dang rnam pa 'dra'ang don de ma yin pa re dgos kyi/bdag yod par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi la bden par med pa lta bu dgag sgrub kyi phyogs mi mthun pa re 'jog tshul med pas/ 'dir de dang tshig zin bstun pa'ang de'i dgongs pa'i don gzhan du kha 'khrid pa'i phyir yin gyi/ de 420

༄/ / ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mo snang ba/nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba ma yin no/ / mdor dril na/ lugs gnyis ga'i shes byed du 'dren rgyu'i lung khungs phal cher 'dra'ang / gang gi shes byed du 'dren pa dang lung gi dgongs pa 'grel tshul ma 'dra bas/ bzhed tshul tha dad par byung ba yin te/ dper na rgyud dang grub chen gyi gzhung rnams su rang byung gi bcom ldan 'das dang / rang byung gi ye shes zhes pa lta bu mang du gsungs pa'i don/ jo nang pas/ nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ / zhes sogs kyi sgra'i zin la brten te/ nam mkha' ltar rgyu med rkyen med du byung ba'i zer zug gi ye shes la 'dod/ rje bla ma'i lugs kyis/ rang byung zhes pa gnyug sems de nyid thog ma med pa nas rigs 'dra 'gyur ldog med par rgyun chags su 'byung bas/ de sngags kyi thabs mkhas la brten nas bde chen gyi ngo bor bskyed pa'i lhan skyes kyi ye shes de la rang byung ye shes su 'jog go /skabs 'dir las dang po pas dngos gnas la gnyug sems bde stong gi ye shes su bskyed mi thub kyang / mos ngor ma dag pa'i snod bcud mtha' dag bsdus te/ thams cad stong pa 'od gsal mngon du byas par bsgom pa'i ngang nas stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i stobs kyis lhan skyes kyi ye shes bsgom par 'gro ba yin te/ gzhan du na phar phyin theg par stong nyid dbyes phyin par bsgom pa dang / sems rten gyi dbang gis blo bde ba'i ngo bor skye ba gnyis tshogs yod kyang / lhan skyes kyi bde stong gi ye shes bsgom par mi 'gro ba bzhin no/ / de lta bu'i bde chen gyi ye shes des nges pa stong nyid la drangs shing / gzung rnam lha'i skur shar ba yin pas/ 'dir bshad pa'i rnal 'byor zab mo sgom tshul ni nges don gyi lha thams cad bsgom par 'gro ba rje bdag nyid chen po'i bka' srol 'di la shin tu 'grig gi / nges don gye lha gang yin rtsol bas sgrub tu med par 'dod pa la/ 'di nges don gyi lha thams cad sgrub 421

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i po gotshi ཿma/pa'i thabs su smra ba don du ma zad rang tshig 'gal bas kyang legs par khegs pa yin no/ / rang gzhan gnyis ga'i lugs la rang byung gi ye shes de rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs don mthar thug gi e waṃ du 'jog pa 'dra'ang / rang byung ye shes kyi ngos 'dzin ma 'dra bas/ rgyud so sor e waṃ la sogs pa'i tha snyad kyis gsungs pa rnams kyang / rang lugs kyi khyad chos zur du ston par bzhed nas phyogs snga'i tshul du gzhan gyekhungs su drangs pa'i rgyud rnams thar chags su smos pa yin no/ / 'o na rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa mthar thug e waṃ du 'du ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin snyam na/ gan 'di rtogs pa gal che ste/rgyud rnams su e waṃ dngos zin la smos ma smos ci rigs yod kyang / ma smos pa rnams la'ang de'i don nges par tshang dgos so/ / de'i rgyu mtshan rgyud gang yin kyang de'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa'i nges don gyi lha bde stong dbyer med kyi ye waṃ du 'jog par mtshungs dgos te/ kun rdzob lha sku'i zhal phyag sogs kyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba ltar/ rgyud so so la nges don mthar thug gi lha'ang rigs mi 'dra ba re yod na/ ye shes gcig gi rang mdangs dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs su 'char ba mi rung bas/ yi dam lha'i yon tan yang phyogs re ba tsam du 'gyur zhing / rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang du bshad pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /des na nges don gyi lha'i rnal 'byor bde stong gi ye shes bsgoms pas nges don gye lha thams cad bsgoms par 'gro ba shes pa la rgyud thams cad kye dgongs pa mthar thug ma ṇi pad+ma'i nges don e waṃ du dbyer med par shes dgos pas/de la thog mar e waṃ gyi don bshad pa dang / de nyid 'dir smos pa'i rgyud sde so so nas gtan la phab pa'i tshul bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdo phyogs su'ang ye waṃ gyi tha snyad tsam 'byung yang / de'i don bshad tshul sgra mdo ka lā pa 422

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zabaposnang ba/las/ e waṃ zhes 'di skad dam/ deng ngam/ de nyid la'o zhes pa ltar ma nor bar de kho na bzhin du shes pa'i don tsam la rgyan snang sogs su gsungs pa lta bu las gzhan med kyang / sngags kyi skabs su tshig zin de tsam ma yin par rdo rje'i tshig gi dgongs pa don so so ba du mar 'grel tshul bsam gyis mi khyab bas/ 'di la'ang thob bya 'bras bu'i e waṃ dang / thob byed lam gyi e waṃ/'dren byed rtags kyi e waṃ gsum du phye ste/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ e ni gsang ba mkha' dbyings dang / / bha ga chos 'byung pad+ma la/ / rnal 'byor seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs/ / mchog tu rmad byung ston par mdzad/ / ces ye yig gi don ston pa gang la bzhugs nas chos ston pa'i rten dang / rdo rje sems dpa' waṃ rdo rje/ / rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug dang / / te ru ka dang dus 'khor lo/ / dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs mtshan/ / zhes waṃ yig gi don de la bzhugs nas rgyud ston pa po gnyis tshogs dang / e waṃ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgya/ / gnyis su med pa'i mtshon byed dang / / zhes mthar thug gi skabs kyi bden gnyis dbyer med pa zung 'jug gi go 'phang ste 'bras bu'i e waṃ dang / yang rgyud de nyid las/ e ni stong pa nyid du gsungs/ / de bzhin wa ni thugs rje dang / / thig le de gnyis sbyor las byung / / de spyor ba yi rmad mchog go / zhes shes rab stong pa nyid dang / thabs snying rje chen po gnyis sbyor ba lam gyi e waṃ ste/ stong nyid kyi lta ba phu thag chod pa zhig med na 'khor ba las mi grol zhing ye yig gi don mi tshang / phyi nang gi lus la gnad du bsnun pa las byung ba'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba med na sngags kyi zab gnad mi thon zhing wa yig gi don mi tshang / de gnyis so sor yod kyang stong nyid kyi lta ba zhu bde'i ngo bor bskyed de stong nyid yul dang /bde chen yul can du byas nas bde stong sbyor mi shes na thig le'i don mi tshang 423

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i ma'i gsung 'bum/ba'i phyir ro/ / de lta bu'i lam dang 'bras bu'i e waṃ 'grub pa la de'i nang nas waṃ yig gis mtshon pa lhan skyes kyi bde ba'i cha skyed pa 'dren byed rtags kyi e baṃ la ltos dgos shing / de la cha gnyis su yod pas/ dang po phyi'i thabs shes la sbyar te e'i don yum gyi bha ga rten dang / wa'i don de la brten pa'i yab kyi rdo rje/ thig le'i don sna tshogs pa'i sprul pa ston par byed pa'i bde chen gyi gzhi la sbyar ba ni/ rdor 'phreng las/ e ni bha ga'i mtshan nyid de/ /pad+ma rten du shes par bya/ / brten pa rdo rje 'chang ba yis/ / de la gnas pa thig le'i gzugs/ / sna tshogs sprul pa ston par byed/ / bde ba kun gyi gzhi yi gnas/ / rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ / zhes gsungs so/ / nang du rang gi lus la gnad du bsnun pa las lam gyi e baṃ 'dren pa'i thabs/ lus gnad khyad par can la e baṃ du 'jog tshul yang / saspu ṭa las/ spyi bo lte bar son 'khor lo/ / e yig rnam par yang dag gnas/ / snying ga mgrin par yang dag gnas/ / waṃ gye yi ge 'dra bar 'dod/ / ces spyi bo dang lte ba'i rtsa ༷༵ ༵ ༷bhe ral ༵ ༵ga yi / ༷ marna ༵ / byi~Xba~X ༵ ༷༵/ /yiX ༷ ga /rdo ༵༵༷ kyang spyi bo dang snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gdugs kha spub bzhin thur du bstan pa dang / lte ba mgrin pa gnyis kyi rtsa 'khor gyen du bstan pa kha sbyor gyi tshul du yod do/ / brtag gnyis las/ e yi rnam pa lha mo spyan/ / waṃ gyi rnam pa bdag mor brjod/ / ma ni lha mo gos dkar mo/ / ya yi rnam pa sgrol mar brjod/ / ces e waṃ ma ya'i yi ge bzhi ga la'ang / e baṃ du ma 'dus pa'i skyon med la/ dbyebs kyis mtshon tshul snga ma dang shin tu mtshungs so/ / de lta thabs shes kyi gsang ba'i rtsa gnyis 'drin byed rtags kyi e waṃ du 'jog pa grags che la 'khor lo bzhi'ang 'dren byed rtags kyi e baṃ du 'jog dgos pa'i 424

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zabamo'i 'grel pa zab mosnang ba/rgyu mtshan ni/ brtag gnyis las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni/ / e waṃ rnam par rab tu gnas/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yab yum stoms par zhugs te ro rkyang gi rgyu ba ju tīr bkag pa las gtum mo sbar bas haṃ yig zhu ste yi haṃ yang dag par sbyar zhing sdom par 'gyur la/ de'ang 'khor lo bzhi'i lte bar dga' bzhi rim gyis bskyed pa'i mthar thams cad kyang lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i ngo bor sdom par 'gyur zhing / de 'dra ba'i 'od gsal las langs pa'i sgyu ma'i sku dang lhan skyes kyi bde chen ngo bo dbyer med kyi sku dang thugs su sdom pa las sku gsum dbyer med du sdom pa 'grub pas rdo rje theg pa'i lam 'bras kyi gnad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ / der ma zad dus 'khor las stong chen yi ge lnga dang drug las thog mar waṃ yig dang / de nas e yig sgrub tshul gyi sgra sgrub dang gzugs sgrub kyi bshad pa rgya cher bshad cing / de ltar bsgrubs pa'i e baṃ la phyi nang gzhan gsum du sbyar ba'i mtshon don mang du gsungs pa rnams kyi don mdor bsdus te/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas dus 'khor ṭīka chen gyi snying po bsdu ba las/ phyi la e yig gis rten nam mkha'i khams dang / waṃ yig gis nam mkha'i dbus su gnas pa'i brten pa zla nyi sgra gcan gsum ste/ waṃ yig gi sgrub gzhi rnam bcad kyi nyi ma srog tu zhugs pa'i yas sgra gcan/ steng gi rjes su nga ros zla ba mtshon zhing / nang la sbyar na e yig gis nam mkha' dang chos mtshungs pa'i ma'i gsang gnas pad+ma dang /chuyig gis pad+mar khu khrag rnam shes gsum 'dres pa mtshon te/ de'ang rnam bcad kyis ma'i rdul/ a yig gis kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi ming can yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ rjes su nga ros pha'i khu ba rnams mtshon zhing / gzhan bskyed rim la sbyar na/ mas chos dbyings mtshon pa'i chos 'byung gi dbus su chud pa'i rten gzhal yas khang gdan bcas dang / waṃ yig gis brten pa lha 425

༄/ /yo thang gas ཿsgronasa'i r+sāng ཿma/rnams mtshon/ gzhan rdzogs rim la sbyar na/ e yig gis rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo dang / waṃ yig gis de la brten pa'i mchog mi 'gyur gyi bde chen mtshon pa yin pa'i phyir zhes gsungs pa ltar/gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag thams cad de'i steng nas gtan la dbab tu yod cing / khyad par du zab mo'i lam gyi gnad thams cad la bde stong dbyer med pa'i ye shes kyis rgyas 'debs dgos pa'i tshul legs par shes na rdo rje theg pa'i gnad la mi 'phyugs pa'i gzer thebs par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa de nyid 'dir smos pa'i rgyud sde so so nas gtan la phab pa'i tshul bshad pa ni/ dang po dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes sku dang nyin mor byed pa'i sku ste pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan/ / sangs rgyas seng ge'i khri la bzhugs lha'i mchog rnams kyis ni btud la rgyal po zla ba bzang po yis/ mgo bos rab tu phyag 'tshal lag pa'i pad+ma sbyar ba yan lag mchog la sbyar nas zhu ba ni/ / rnal 'byor dpal ldan dus 'khor ka phreng ldan pa'i a 'dus su ste mi rnams dgrol ba'i don du'o/ / zhes thog mar gsungs pas/ dngos zin la e waṃ gyi tshigs med kyang don la yod de/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ ye gsang mkha' dbyings bha ga'am/ / chos 'byung chu skyes seng ge'i khrir/ / bzhugs pa rdo rje can waṃ dang / / rdo rje can dang rdo rje sems/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug dang / / te ru ka dang dus 'khor dang / / dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs ming / / sna tshogs yul gyi tha snyad kyis/ / rgyud gzhan dag tu bdag gis brjod/ / sna tshogs sems can bsam pas kyang / / rten gyi mtshan nyid gnas dang ni/ / brten pa dag kyang bdag gis brjod/ / ces 'dir seng ge'i khri'i ming gis bstan pa dang /rgyudagazhan las rten du bshad pa'i ye gnyis don 'dra la/ 'dir dang po'i 426

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnangab/sangs rgyas kyi sgras bstan pa dang / gzhan las brten par bshad pa waṃ gnyis don gcig pas/ 'di la e baṃ ma tshang ba sogs kyi skyon brjod pa 'jug pa'i gnas med do/ / der ma zad dbang bzhi pa'i lam zung 'jug gi rim pa rgyud gzhan las sbas pa'i tshul gyis gsungs pas/ gleng bzhi'i skabs su mthar thug gi e waṃ sbas don gye tshul du der bshad pa ma gtogs dngos zin la zung 'jug gi don med kyang / rgyud 'dir ni bshad pa'i rgyud la ltos mi dgos par dbang bzhi pa'i lam sogs rang nyid las shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa khyad chos yin pas/ gleng gzhi'i skabs nas bzung ste ye waṃ zung 'jug gi don 'dus pa sogs las kyang ches gsal zhing rgyas par bstan pa la tshig tsam gyi rjes su 'brang ste e waṃ gyi don gtan ma bstan par 'dod pa gnas ma yin pa'i phyir/ ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba las/ gleng gzhi'i skabs su de ltar bshad pa'i rgyud der ni ye shes kyi sku gsar du bsgrub pa'i tshul dang dbang bzhi pa'i lam tshig zin la mi gsal bar/ sbas don dang mthar thug gi don du byas nas 'chad dgos te/ 'dus pa las/ sgyu lus bdag byin brlab sbas don dang / zung 'jug dbang bzhi pa'i lam mthar thug tu byas nas tshig zin gyi yig don du mi 'chad pa bzhin no/ / dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'dir ni stong gzugs kyi ye shes kyi sku bsgrub pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag dbang bzhi pa'i lam ma sbas shing shin tu gsal bar tshig zin la ston pas khyad par du 'phags par ston 'dod pa yin pa'i phyir gleng gzhi'i tshig gi sbas don dubyas nas ston 'dod pa'i gnas med do/ / des na gleng gzhi'i tshig gis don de dag nges par bstan dgos shing sbas pa ma yin par gsal bar ston pa khyad chos su byas pa na gleng gzhi'i tshig zin la don de dag sbyar nas 'chad dgos par bsnyon du med par grub la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de ltar 427

༄/ /gung thang gas lo lo khrung ཿma/na bla med kyi rgyud la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum du byas te phyi mar kye rdor sogs 'jog pa rang gi 'dod zhen tsam las rgyu mtshan cher med cing /stag tshang pa'i dus 'khor spyi don dang / grub mtha' kun shes sogs su gsang dbang gi lam sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud/ sher dbang gi lam 'od gsal gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud/ rgyud gzhan dang mi 'dra bar dbang bzhi pa'i lam zung 'jug gtso bor ston pa dus 'khor ni gnyis med kyi rgyud du byed dgos zhes bshad pa mkhas pa'i gsung dpyad gzhi che bar snang ngo / / de'ang bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma phal che bas spyir zung 'jug gi dbye ba rim lnga las nyer gcig gam nyer gsum gsungs pa'i nang nas mthar thug pa bde stong dbyer med kyi zung 'jug tsam la bzhag cing / rje bla mas de nyid ya gyal gcig tu byas pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med kyi zung 'jug gtso bor 'jog dgos par gsungs so/ / de'ang 'dus pa sogs rgyud sde gzhan las gsungs pa'i bde stong dbyer med kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rang skad kyi bde stong dbyer med ni bden gnyis dbyer med kyi zung 'jug dang don 'dra bas/ de las lhag pa'i zung 'jug gi don bzhag rgyu med de/ sngags rim las/ thob bya mthar thug gi bde stong dbyer med kyi go 'phang ni sngar dbang bzhi pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin du bde ba thugs dang stong pa gzugs kyi skur byas shing de gnyis ngo bo dbyer med pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dri ma thams cad zad pa yin no/ / zhes dang / bde stong khyad par ba'i stong pa kun rdzob pa'i sku dang bde ba don dam pa la zhugs pa'i ye shes yin pas gzhung gzhan nas bshad pa'i bde stong gi ngos 'dzin dang cung mi 'dra'o/ /zhes so/ / de ltar na gleng gzhi nas brtsams te rgyud kyi thog mtha' kun tu rtsal bton nas 'chad rgyu'i nges don dus kye 'khor lo ni bde stong zung 'jug 428

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnang ba/g.ye shes las ma 'das pas/ ma ṇi pakhye'i nges don e waṃ dang mthun par nyams su len pa la nges don gyi dus 'khor bsgrub pa'i lam gyi gnad kyang legs par tshang ba yin no/ / jo nang pa dag dus kyi 'khor lo'i skabs 'dir gtso bor bsgom bya'i stong nyid ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan pa las/ phung po rnam dpyad stong pa nyid/ / chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ / rnam pa kun gye mchog ldan pa'i/ / stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin/ / zhes sogs khungs su byas te/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo yongs grub bden grub de nyid yin gye/ phung sogs bden grub rnam par dpyad pas bkag tsam gyi rang stong ni chad stong yin zhes zer la/ grub mtha'i 'jog tshul gzhan dang mi mthun pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'di la thug go / de 'gog pa dbang po rdo rje/ / thog tog / mdzes rgyan sogs ni ngan smras kyi phreng ba spel ba tsam las dgag sgrub kyi nus pa cher ma thon 'dug pas/ blo gros can yod na rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim par rigs pa'i gnad che long tsam zhig gsungs pa dang / mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma'i ṭīka chen rigs pa'i rgya mtsho dang / dus 'khor ṭīka chen gyi mgo mjugakun tu phra zhing zhib pa'i rigs pa brgya phrag gis bkag pa rnams las shes par bya yi/ 'dir mangs su dogs pas ma spros so/ / gnyis pa bde mchog gi rgyud kyang / mngon brjod 'bum phrag gsum pa'i dbur e baṃ gyi tshig yod la/ 'bum phrag gcig pa dang bsdus rgyud la e waṃ gyi tshig gsal bo med kyang don tshang bar gsungs te/ dper na bsdus rgyud kyi dbur/ de nas de las gsang chen bshad par bya/ / zhes pa'i de nas kyi skad dod ā tha la tshul bzhi'i bshad pa 'jug par nā ro bas gsungs pas/ mthar thug gi skabs su bden gnyis zung 'jugo la byed dgos pa'i phyir te/ sbas don kun gsal 429

༄/ /yo ca bam yoskyoname'i ga 4ma/las/ ā ni rnam par dag pa'i shes rab dang / tha ni dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje bde ba chen po ste mthar thug pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pas/ 'og gi bstan bcos lus thams cad kyes gtan la dbab bya'i nges don mthar thug gi bde mchog thabs shes dbyer med kyi zung 'jug de la byed par 'grub pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje gur las/ thabs dang shes rab shin tu 'dres/ / de nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog / de nyid mi 'gyur dam pa ste/ / de nyid kyis ni thams cad khyab/ / de 'dir sangs rgyas ye shes te/ / dpal ldan he ru ka zhes bya/ / zhes dang / kun spyod las/ de nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog /de nyid mi 'gyur dam pa yin/ / de nyid thams cad khyab byed de/ / lus kun la ni rnam par gnas/ / de nyid sangs rgyas ye shes te/ / he ru ka dpal yin par bshad/ / ces thabs bde ba chen po dang / shes rab stong pa nyid ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i lhan skyes kyi ye shes de nyid srog chags rnams kyispog dang / nges don gye dpal he ru gar gsungs so/ / kha cig / lus kun la ni rnam par gnas/ / zhes pa dang / srog chags rnams kyi srog /ces gsungs pa rgyu mtshan du byas te/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa'i snying po rtag brtan de nyid nges don gyi he ru gar bshad pa yin zer yang /rang lugs bde stong ye shes la byas nas/ de nyid sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la med kyang / de dang rang bzhin gcig tu zhugs pa'i chos nyid rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha thams cad la khyab par yod pa'i don yin te/ rdzogs rim dngos grub snye ma las/ de'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid sems can rnams kyi srog ngo bo nyid yin pa'i don no/ / zhes dang / mkhas grub rje'i brtag gnyis rnam bshad las/ srog dang 'dra bar shin tu gces pa dang / lhan skyes kyi de kho na nyid rang bzhin rnam dag de nyid skye 'jig gis mi 'gyur ba'i 4༅

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pajabaposnang ba/dam pa nyid yin la/ zhes so/ / 'dir ye shes srog tu bshad pa yin gyi/de'i yul stong nyid srog tu bshad pa 'brel med do snyam na/ de gnyis don mtshungs pas/ yul stong nyid la sbyor ba'ang rgyud las gsal bar gsungs te/mtshan brjod las/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog / don chen 'gyur med dam pa yin/ / srog chen po ste skye ba med/ ces gsungs pas/ khyad par gzhan snga ma dang shin tu 'dra'ang / khyad gzhi a yig gi don du gsungs la/a ni rang bzhin gyis skye ba med pa'i don du mdo rgyud gnyis gar grags pa'i phyir ro/ / 'di la dpe phal cher du/ don chen yi ge dam pa yin/ / zhes 'byung ba/ ak+ṣa ra yi ge dang mi 'gyur ba gnyis ka la 'jug pas 'grel tshul yang lugs gnyis 'byung ngo / / gsum pa kye rdor gyi rgyud brtag gnyis kyi dbur yang e waṃ 'byung la/ rgyud rang gi nang du'ang ye paṃ gyi don bde stong dbyer med la sbyor tshul mang du gsungs shing / khyad par du dbu'i a yig dang / brtag pa gnyis pa'i mjug tu'ang / ze'u 'bru la ā 'i rnam pa'o/ / zhes thog mtha'i a yig gnyis kyi bar du rgyud thams cad chud par mdzad pas/ rgyud don mtha' dag bde stong dbyer med kyi lam las ma 'das par gsungs pas ye shes de nyid nges don mthar thug gi kye rdo rjer 'grub bo/ / bzhi pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i gleng gzhir e waṃ ma ya sogs yi ge bzhi bcu byung ba de dag gis rgyud don mtha' dag bsdus tshul rdor phreng du sho lo ka re res gtan la phab cing / khyad par du phyi ma thams cad kyang thog ma'i yi ge gnyis su 'du ba dang / des lam dang 'bras bu'i gnad bstan pa gong du drangs pa rnams dang / lha'i dbang pos zhus pa sgron gsal du drangs pa las kyang / chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / / bzhi stong gi ni grangs snyed kyi/ /kun gyi gzhi dang pha ma ni/ / yi ge gnyis su de bzhin bstan/ / zhes sogs 431

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgronayo gsung 'bum/kyisagang la brten nas de kho na nyid tshol ba'i gsung rab kyang e waṃ/ de'i don go rgyu'ang e waṃ/ go ba la brten nas bskyed par bya ba'i lam yang e waṃ/lam bsgoms pas thob par bya ba'i 'bras bu'ang e waṃ du 'du bar gsungs pas mthar thug gi don thabs shes zung 'jug tu grub ste/ 'dus pa'i don yang der 'gyur ba 'og tu 'chad do/ / lnga pa sgyu dra ni kun dga' snying po dang /rab tu zhi ba'i bshes gnyen sogs kyis rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral bas/ e waṃ gyi don yang kun snying gi 'grel par/ 'di skad ces bya ba 'dis ni bdag nyid kyis thos pa'i shes pas mngon du gzung ba ste rgyud kyi don nges par gzung bas na rgyud kyi don phyin ci ma log pa nyid du bshad pa yin no/ / zhes sgras thob tshod kyi bshad pa tsam byas shing / gcig shos kyi 'grel par yang / 'di skad ni rgyud kyi don thams cad ston pa'i tshig gi phrad do/ / zhes snga ma ltar bshad kyang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul stong dang brgya/ / zhes bla med kyi rgyud du gsungs pa dang / mtha' dpyod myur gur 'dus pa'i phyogs mthun gyi rgyud du gsungs pas/ dgongs pa mthar thug snga ma rnams dang mthun no/ / de bzhin du gdan bzhi'ang / rnal 'byor ma yi dra ba sdom/ / ye shes stong pa can dbang phyug / gnas gtsang ma na bzhugs nas su/ / thams cad mkhyen pas 'di skad gsungs/ / zhes gsang ba mchog dang 'di skad gnyis ka tshang la/ / rdo rje snying 'grel las/ kye rdo rje dang bde mchog 'khor lo nyung ngu 'di ni gdan bzhis shes par bya/ zhes kye rdor dang bde mchog nyung ngu'i nges don yang 'di las shes dgos par gsungs/ ma hā mā yar/ de nas de las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba'i dbang phyug / ces sogs gsungs te/ 'di skad ma smos pa'i rgyu mtshan de'i dka' 'grel dang 'grel pa dran par rtag tu mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 432

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnang ba/bzhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin par bshad kyang / sbas don kun gsal du bshad tshul de mi 'thad par gsungs rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas 'di skad bdag gis thos pa la sogs pa gleng ga'i'i tshig phrad sbyar bar ma mdzad de/snga ma nyid la sbyar ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs shing / du dza ya tsan+d+ra'i dka' 'grel du/ tshig gnyis gsal bar mi ston yang / / don rnams ji ltar gnas bzhin yin/ / zhes don bde stong gi e waṃ las ma 'das par gsungs so/ /gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud stong phrag bco brgyad pa sogs dngos su e baṃ smos pa mang la/ de las bkol ba'i rtogs bdun lta bur e baṃ ma smos kyang / de nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi/ / sgrub pa yang dag rab bshad de/ / zhes pa'i de nas kyi skad dod la tshig spyi sbas pa mthar thug gi don bzhir yod pa 'di skad kyi skad dod dang 'dra ba'i phyir te/ grub chen dpal ldan bzang po'i rnam bshad skal bzang mig 'byed las/ ā la yi ge bsnan pa'i/ zhes pa nas/be+e ni skye ba med pa'i rnam par dag pa rtogs pa'i don gyi 'od gsal lo/ / tha ni dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dag pa'i sgyu ma'i sku ste mthar thug tu bshad pa'o/ / zhes gsungs so/ de lta bu'i shes rab stong nyid dang snying rje bde ba chen po zung du 'jug pa de sgrub bya mthar thug pa nges don gyi rdo rje 'jigs byed yin te/ rdo rje grub pa'i 'grel pa las/ de lta na stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pa'o/ / rdo rje sems dpa' ni rdo rje 'jigs byed do/ zhes dang /so na shrī'i 'grel pa las/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje tha mi dad pa rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo ni rdo rje 'jigs byed do/ / zhes dang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rtogs bdun rnam bshad las/ brjod med kyi rdo rje dang thabs bde ba chen po dga' ba bzhi mthar thug pa'i ye shes gnyis sgrib gnyis sgrol ba'i sku gsum gyi bdag nyid rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag de nges don 433

༄/ /gung ca bsapa'athonasa'i khrung ཿma/gyi rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / zhes gsungs pas/ gnad 'di legs par go na phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje 'joms tshul tha dad pa'i khyad par rnams kyang bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ro/ / rta mchog dbang bzhes rta mgrin ni/rgyud sde spyi rnam las/ dpal rta mgrin gyi rtogs pa bdun cu pa la sogs pa'i rgyud chen po rnams bod du ma 'gyur/ ha ya gro ba'i gzungs zhes bya ba khol du phyung ba zhig 'gyur ro/ / zhes bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bor bsdus te gsungs pa'i gzungs de tsam las sgos rgyud rtsod med bod du ma 'gyur la/rtsod pa can mang zhing bla med kyi'ang dkyil 'khor so so'i khro bcu'i grangs lta bur bshad pa mang ngo / / 'on kyang slob dpon ku ku rā dzas mdzad pa'i gsangadon rnam par 'god pa drug gi grangs su rta mchog rol pa'i lam sgom tshul bla med ltar gsungs pas/ de lta bu'i sgos rgyud dang rim gnyis bla med kyi lugs ji lta ba'ang yod par mngon no/ / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ni kha cig bde mchog gi bshad rgyud du 'dod kyang / don phyogs mthun gyi rgyud yin la/de'i 'grel pa pad+ma rdo rjes mdzad par sgron gsal bzhin du gleng gzhi'i yi ge re re nas bshad cing / khyad par e waṃ la bshad pa mi 'dra ba mang du byas snang na'ang don gyi gnad sngar bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi gleng gzhir/ sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ / rdo rje sems dpa' bdeba'i mchog / gsang ba mchog gis dgyes pa na/ / thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /zhes bde ba chen po'i ngo bo rdor sems de nyid gsang ba chos kyi dbyengs su bzhugs par gsungs pas rgyud don mthar thug thog ma nas gsal bar bstan pa yin te/ slob dpon brgya byin sdong pos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa las/ 'dir ni gnyis su med pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas rigs drug gi mtshan gye don gyis gleng gzhi bstan te/ de nyid ni brjod par bya ba'i don du 434

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnang ba/gnas so/ / zhes rgyud don mthar thug gleng gzhir bstan pa'i gnyis med kyi ye shes der 'dus par gsungs so/ / der ma zad spyod bsdus kyi le'u dgu pa las/ de ni spros pa dang bcas pa'i spyod pa/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud la 'jug par bya'o/ / zhes gleng gzhi nas brtsams te drangs shing / 'di la rtsa ba'i mdo'i ming gis btags te bshad gzhir mdzad pas bde chen 'dren pa'i thabs kyi khyad par ston pa la 'di nyid shin tu gsal lo/ / gzhan yang 'di skad dang de nas sogs kyis thog drangs pa pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis gar yod cing / gsang ba mchog gi zhes sogs ma rgyud kyi rang skad lta bu yin la/de'ang bskyed rim la sbyar te 'byung ba rim brtsegs sogs bshad pa'i nges don rdzogs rims la sbyor tshul ni/ mngon brjod las/ thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs par/ / gang zhig sngar nas bshad pa nyid/ / dkyil 'khor lus ni yin par bshad/ / de ni sgo dgu dag tu 'gyur/ / zhes gang la gnad du bsnun pas lhan skyes 'char ba'i gzhi bu ga'i sgo dgu can gyi rdo rje'i lus spyi dang bye brag gnas so so'i rtsa 'khor rnams ston pas na/ der gnad du bsnun pa las skyes pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes mthar thug pa de/skabs de dang de'i nges don gyi lha'i gtso bo dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po nyid du 'grub pa kun la 'dra'o/ / yum chen mo dang / phyag chen/ shin tu rnal 'byor/ dbu ma chen mo/ rang byung ye shes/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje 'chang sogs ni mdo rgyud mtha' dag las nges don mthar thug gi ye shes dngos dang rjes mthun ci rigs kyis bstan pa'i don bsdus pa tsam las/rgyud bye brag pa re re dang sbyar ba min nam snyam ste/ yul dang yul can gyi don dam la rgyal ba'i yum gyi tha snyad sher mdo las sbyar ba'ang 'di la 'khrid pa'i 435

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'itshonasa'i khrung 'chagaphyir yin pa ni/ gsang ba grub pa las/ phyag rgya chen po mchog tu dge /zhes pa nas/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa gnas/ / zhes sogs kyis shes shing /de la phyag rgya chen mo'i tha snyad dus 'khor las kyang gsungs/ shin tu rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor chen po la sogs pa'i tha snyad kyang rgyud dang grub chen du mas gsungs so/ /dbu mar 'jog pa'ang yul rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i dbus yin par ma zad/ yul can ye shes kyang ro rkyang gi rgyu ba ju tīr tshud pa'i cha nas gnyis spangs dbu ma'i lam du bshad do/ / gal te phyag chen zhes pa phyag chen thig le la byed na/ der/ bcom ldan mkha' 'gro ye shes nyi/ / gsang pad snying po'i kha 'byed pa/ / gsang pad lte ba'i nang na bzhugs/ / zhes gsungs te/ gsang ba mchog gis dgyes pa sogs dang phyogs 'dra'o/ / rang byung ye shes ni gong du bshad pa bzhin lhan skyes kyi ye shes la byed pa rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid kyi gsung gzhan las kyang / snang sems dbyer med bde chen lhan cig skyes/ / zhes sogs mang du 'byung ngo / / rdo rje sems dpa' dang rdo rje 'chang gnyis rgyud gang gi skabs su'ang rang rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang mtshan gye rnam grangs su 'byung ste/brtag gnyis las/ rdo rje mi phyed ces bya ba/ / sems dpa' srid pa gsum gcig brjod/ / ces gsungs shing / te badz+ra kyi don yang de dang gcig par rnam bshad las gsungs pa rgyud gzhan la'ang 'dra ste/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ / rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ / zhes sogs de 'dra ba shin tu mang ngo / / bde stong ye shes de nyid dkon mchog gsum du gsungs pa'ang mtshan brjod las/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ / zhes dang /rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / zhes sogs phyag rgya'i pad+ma la brten nas rlung dang ye shes rdo rje skyil krung ste lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen por bskyed pa la 436

༄/ / ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnang ba/sangs rgyas su bshad pa mang zhing / chos ni sngags kyi lam 'bras gang bshad thams cad la rdo rje'i sgra sbyar ba nyid de thams cad bde stong gi ye shes su 'di ba ston ched yin te/ dge 'dun yang de dang 'dra'o/ / der ma zad rdo rje phreng bar/ dri med sems ni sangs rgyas nyid/ / chos ni ngag tu yang dag gsungs/ / sku ni dge 'dun zhes bya ste/ / zhes sku gsung thugs la de gsum tshang ba'ang ye shes 'di nyid kyi mthu yin pas rdo rje gsum du bshad do/ /der ma zad/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun lha/ / sngags rgyud dkyil 'khor phyag rgya dang / / dngos grub thams cad 'dus pa yi/ / bla ma'i rnal 'byor gcig nyid du/ / zhes bla ma lha'i rnal 'byor zab mo 'dir yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ gsang sngags/ rig sngags sogs kyi bzlas brjod dang dka' thub sbyin sreg la sogs pa rgyud sde zab mo rnams kyis gtso byas/ gzhung lugs dang grub mtha' rab 'byams grangs med gsum gye tshogs dang sa bcu sogs la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ de dag gi bsgrub bya'i mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa 'dus par gsungs pa ni che ba brjod pa tsam ma yin par rgyud kyi dgongs pa 'khrul med yin te/ kun spyod las/ gang zhig sa la gnas rnams dang / / bstan bcos dag ni ma lus dang / / rig byed grub mtha' gnas pa rnams/ / 'jig rten 'di dang gzhan dag tu/ / de med par ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ / rig byed grub pa'i mtha' rnams la/ / 'di ni snying por rab tu bshad/ / ces dang / brtag gnyis las/ de ni sngags bzlas de dka' thub dang de sbyin sreg / de ni dkyil 'khor can dang de ni dkyil 'khor nyid/ / mdor bsdus na ni sems ni 'dus pa'i gzugs can no/ / zhes gsungs la/ de'i don mkhas grub rje'i rnam bshad las/ lhan skyes de ni yid skyob pas nges don gyi sngags bzlas pa dang /zhes sogs gsungs 437

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i me'i g.yo ཿma/shing / sasbu ṭa las/ de phyir de rgyas ci zhig bya/ / mdor bsdus pas ni sangs rgyas nyid/ / bskal pa bye ba grangs med pas/ / je srid sangs rgyas gang thob pa/ / gang gi dam pa'i bde bas khyod/ / skye ba 'dir ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes grangs med gsum gye tshogs kyang ye shes de nyid du 'du bar gsungs pa dang / kun spyod kyi don rdzogs rim dngos grub snye ma las sa la gnas pa ni sa bcu la gnas pa dang / bstan bcos ni rgyud sde rnams dang /rig byed ni phyi pa'i bstan bcos dang / grub mtha' ni nyan thos pa'i grub mtha' la ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas bshad de/ phyi nang gi gzhung las bshad pa'i dngos grub thams cad lam mdor bsdus pa 'di nyid kyis 'grub pa'i don no/ /zhes dang / lam gzhan gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don gang 'grub thams cad lam 'dir ma tshang ba med pa dang / ring por mi thogs pa/lam bde bas 'grub pa'i tshul gyi byed las kyi sgo nas 'dir 'dus pa'o/ /zhes shin tu gsal bar bka' stsal to/ / kha cig 'di snyam du/ lung de dag bde stong ye shes kyi byed par thams cad 'du ba'i don yin gyi lha'i rnal 'byor gyi byed par 'du ba'i don min no zer ba ni/ log par rtog pa chen po yin te/bde chen gye ye shes gcig pu des nges pa stong nyid la drangs shing / gzung rnam lha skur 'char ba dang / mdor na gang snang stong pa/ stong pa bde ba/bde ba lha skur 'char ba'i tshul blos ma lceg par/ thabs ni ston pa'i gzugs can no/ / zhes pa ltar gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i thabs shes gnyis ngo bo so sor 'khrul ba yin pas/ de ltar na de'i byed par tshogs gnyis mtha' dag 'du dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mthar thug stor bar 'gyur zhing / lha'i rnal 'byor de nyid srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod byed du 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan sgrub thabs kun bzang las gsal bar gsungs pa sogs du ma dang 'gal bar 'gyur ba'i tshul 438

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zabapo'i 'grel pa zab mosnang ba/brjod par bya ba mang yang yi ges 'jigs pas ma bris te/ bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs su blta bar bya'o/ / de ltar rgyud sde mtha' dag gi zab gnad bsdus pa'i nyams len gyi snyeng po/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pur gyur ba'i tshul la nges pa brtan po rnyed par byas nas g.yam la rgyug tsam ma yin par nyams len gan da du khel ba bya dgos so/ /gnyis pa rgyud sde'i khungs dang sbrags pa la/ ma ṇi pad+me zhes pa thabs shes zung 'jug tu grub tshul gyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa/ so sor phye ste ma ṇi zhes pa thabs kyi don dang pad+me zhes pa shes rab kyi don du sgrub pa gnyis/dang po ni/ ma ṇi zhes pa nor bu ste/ / de yang 'gyur med don dam pa'i/ /bde ba chen po mkha' khyab ste/ / sangs rgyas nyid do de bzhugs gnas/ /stong gzhi chos nyid zam tog tu/ / bzhugs pa de nyid pad+ma la'o/ / me zhes pad+ma la zhes don/ / de rnams sangs rgyas zam tog tu/ / bzhugs pa'i don yin za ma tog / bkod pa'i don yang de nyid do/ / e la waṃ dang a la haṃ/ / shes rab thabs dang stong la bde/ / stong la snying rje a kā li/ / rdo rje nyi ma rdo rje zlar/ / pad la rdo rje gru gsum thig / rten la brten pa bzhugs sogs don/ / yin phyir gshis lugs zab mo yi/ / yab yum lha dang thabs shes rab/ / rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor kun/ / 'dus pa ma ṇi pad+me ste/ / zhes byung / 'di dag gi don rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung las/ ma ṇi pad+ma'i nges don ni/ / nor bu snying rje bde chen thabs/ / pad+ma stong chen shes rab la/ / bzhugs pa'i don du 'doms mdzad pa/ / zhes dang / waṃ yig e la bzhugs pa dang / / haṃ yig a la bzhugs pa ltar/ / nor bu pad+ma la bzhugs pa/ / spyan ras gzigs su 'doms mdzad pa/ / zhes dang /439

༄/ /yo ca b.lo ཿsgonamatha ga ཿma/thabs dang shes rab dbyer med cing / / bde chen stong chen dbyer med la/ / snying rje stong nyid dbyer med pa/ / nor bu pad+mar 'doms mdzad pa/ / zhes dang / lha dang dkyil 'khor dbyer med cing / / rten dang brten pa dbyer med la/ / gtso bo gtso mo dbyer med pa/ / nor bu pad+mar 'doms mdzad pa/ /zhes sogs dang / gzhan yang mtshan brjod kyi lung ci rigs dang sbrags te mang du gsungs so/ / de dag gi don dang shes byed kyi khungs ni sngar smos pa rnams kyang yin la/ 'og tu so sor phye ste bsgrub pa'i skabs su'ang 'chad par 'gyur bas/ 'dir dngos zin tsam ni/ thabs lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po ma ṇi'i nges don dang / de gang la brten pa'i gzhi shes rab stong ba nyid ni pad+ma'i nges don te/ me'i 'greng bur 'gro rgyu'i e yig gis bde chen waṃ gyi bdag nyid de 'di la bzhugs par bstan pa ste/ za ma tog bkod pa zhes pa dang don 'dra bar gsungs/ za ma tog bkod pa nyid du'ang skabs la lar dkon mchog gi rgyal po snod bkod pa zhes kyang 'byung bas rten dang brten pa dbyer med kyi don du'ang 'gro'o/ / skabs gzhan du ma ṇi pad+ma zhes spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan nas bzung ste/ 'greng bur 'gro rgyu'i e ni kye zhes brgyad pa bod pa'i sgra dang / hūṃ thugs kyi sa bon yin pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ oṃ yig so sor phral ba'i a u ma gsum gyi mtshon don sku gsung thugs gsum gyi dngos grub stsol zhes pa'i don yin par bla ma rnams gsungs te/ rdo rje'i tshig re re la'ang dgongs pa 'grel tshul mang du 'byung bas mi 'gal lo/ / e la waṃ dang zhes sogs don rnam grangs yin kyang tshig gi nus pa 'don tshul gye khyad par cung zad re yod de/ e yig zur gsum pa'i mtshon don yul yul can gyi rnam thar sgo gsum gyi bdag nyid shes rab dbyings kyi ngo bor waṃ gyi mtshon don lha sku thabs kyi rnam pa bzhugs pa 440

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabasajab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnang ba/dang / dgag bya bcad tsam gye stong ba a'i rang bzhin la haṃ yig dbu mar zhu ba'i bde chen nam thun mong ma yin pa'i snying rje bzhugs pa'am/ a'i ngo bo lte ba'i gtum mo'i rang bzhin rnal 'byor ma la spyi bo'i haṃ gi bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs pa'i don no/ / a kā li zhes sogs dbyangs gsal rnams kyang thabs shes su 'du tshul dang / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis zla nyi'i sgras bstan tshul sogs gsungs pa yin pas/ don 'di la dgongs nas rje btsun dam pa nyid kyis sog yig gsar ba rang byung snang ba zhes bya ba mdzad pa'i tshe'ang yul skad kyi dbang gis dbri bsnan cung zad tsam ma gtogs dbyangs gsal gnyis su bsdus shing / yi ge'i rnam pa'ang ji skad du sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi gsang / / shin tu gsang zhing dpyad par dka'/ / yi ge'i tshul gyis rgyas btab pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ yig gzugs thams cad stod gru gsum e'i rnam pa la khog pa blum por yod pas/ phyi dbyibs phal cher bsgrubs pa'i e waṃ gye gzugs lta bur yod pa shin tu ngo mtshar can te/ mtshan la'ang rang byung snang ba zhes btags pa ni/ rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i bde stong gi ye shes mtshon zhing gsal bar byed pa'i don no/ / khyad par du dbur zla gnyis dang nā da/ de'i 'og tu gru gsum gnyis kyi bar du dga' 'khyil sogs bris pa'ang don 'di dag gi mtshon byed yin te/ de'ang yas rim nas bshad na/ na da ni shin tu phra ba gnyug ma'i lus sems te sngags kyi bsgrub gzhi mthar thug go / nyi zla ni dbang mdor bstan las/ nyi zla gcig tu dag par byed/ / ces pa ltar nyi zla'imatshon don ro rkyang gnyis su srog 'dzin dang thur sel gyi rlung 'bab pa dbu mar gcig tu zhugs pa dang / de'i mthus/ spyi bo lte bar son 'khor lo/ / zhes sogs gong du drangs pa ltar/ steng 'og gi rtsa 'khor gru gsum 441

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i ma'i khrung ཿma/gnyis/ bar gye blum po gnyis so sor kha sbyor lta bur yod pa la gnad du bsnyun pas lhan skyes kyi bde chen 'dren pa mtshon te/ dga' 'khyil gyi phyed ka gnyis kyis rtsa 'khor rlum po gnyis mtshon no/ / yang dga' 'khyil gyi phyogs gcig steng ngos nas mar je sbom du 'gro zhing / gcig shos 'og phyogs nas brtsams te yar je sbom du 'gro bas yas babs la 'og ma 'og ma'i dga' ba khyad par du 'phags pa dang / mas brtan la steng du rim pas lhag par 'gro ba mtshon te/ dga' ba 'khyil ba zhes pa'i ming don la'ang sbyor bzhed pa yin nam snyam mo/ / de ltar bar gye dga' 'khyil bde ba la sbyar na steng 'og gi gru gsum gnyis ka stong par sbyor te/ kye rdor gyi rgyud thams cad a gnyis kyi bar du chud tshul sngar bshad pa ltar/ bde ba de'ang bde ba rang dga' ba ma yinapar thog mtha' kun tu stong nyid kyi nges pas rgyas btab pa dgos pa'i don du bya'o/ / yang mas rim nas bshad na/ chos 'byung dga' 'khyil sogs phal cher 'asazhing / dga' ba 'khyil tshul khams dmar po gtsug tor nas drangs te nor bu'i rtser g.yo ba dang bral bar byas shing / dkar po nor bu'i rtse nas gtsug tor bar du drangs pa las/ rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che/ / rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ / ces pa ltar/ phyi nang gi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang zla ba'i 'phel zad kyi cha sgrib bral du gyur pa las dag pa'i sku gsum thob pa mtshon no/ / mjug gi nor bu dang pad+ma'ang bsngo ba sogs la sbyar ba mi rung ba med kyang / gtso bor gyur pa ni nor bu pad+ma'i nges don e waṃ bde stong dbyer med nyid du yang yang bsgrubs te/ yi ge 'di'i steng nas thos bsam sgomagasum byed pa thams cad kyang de'i yan lag tu 'khyer shes pa dgos so zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir du ma ṇi pad+ma nyid kyi bka' rtags phyag rgyas btab pa yin no/ / yi ge so so'i don la rgya gar gyi dbyangs gsal dngos gzhi'i la2

༄/ /ma ṇi'i ma thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zabaposnangab/bshad pa rgyud du mar 'byung yang 'dir ji lta ba bzhin mi 'byor zhing /gzhan gyi khungs rigs pas sbyar rung tsam snang na'ang gya tsom du bri bar ma sbobs so/ / kha cig / de yang 'gyur med don dam pa'i/ / bde ba chen po mkha' khyab ste/ / sangs rgyas nyid do zhes pa'i tshig zin tsam la brten nas gzhung 'dis sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la ma bsgom yang rang chas su yod pa'i nges don gyi bde ba chen po stong pa nyid dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i bdag nyid rtag brtan zer thug 'du ma byas pa'i ye shes zhig gis khyab nas yod pa'i don du 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ 'dir bde chen gyes kun la khyab par gsungs pa dang / brtag gnyis kyi le'u bcu par/ de nyid thams cad khyab pa po/ /thams cad yul la rnam par gnas/ / zhes sogs kyis khyab tshul don 'dra la/khyab tshul de nyid gsal bar ston pa la/ khams le'i mdor bsdus dang po las/ji ltar me ni shing la rtag gnas kyang / / gcad dang dbye ba'i thabs kyis mi mthong ste/ / gtsub shing gtsub stan lag pas bsrub pa las/ / de la gnas pa yang ni mthong bar 'gyur/ / de bzhin sems kyi 'od gsal rtogs pa yi/ / bsgom pa'i thabs rnams dag gis mi mthong ste/ / de nyid du 'di rkyang ma dag dang ni/ / ro ma gcig tu sbyar bas mthong bar 'gyur/ / zhes dang /mgon po bde ba chen po'i gsang ba grub pa las/ rtswa shing 'khril shing la sogs pa/ / kun tu gnas par gyur na yang / / me ni thabs dang bral ba yis/ / me ni mthong bar 'gyur ma yin/ / thabs dang bral na nam du yang / / lha rdzas yon tan kun 'byung ba/ / gnyug ma'i lus la gnas na yang / / shes rab zhan pas mthong mi 'gyur/ / zhes ye shes de nyid sems can thams cad la gnas tshul shing la me gnas pa dang 'dra bar gsungs la/de yang me dngos gnas pa yin na thams cad thal bar 'gyur bas 'byung rung 443

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'isgroname'i gsung ཿma/gi sa bon la byed pa ltar/ 'di'ang ye shes de nyid 'byung rung gi rigs dang nus pa la byed par bstan no/ / yang na ye shes kyi yul stong nyid la byas te/des brtan g.yo kun la khyab pa'i don du byas na/ 'dir mkha' khyab ces pa dang shin tu 'grig pas/ de'i tshul yang he ru ka mngon 'byung las/ gang de thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ / dpa' bo 'di rnams gsang chen po/ / phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ / kun la khyab cing rtag tu stong / / zhes gsungs shing / de'i dgongs pa man snye las/ stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa nyidakyi phyir stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyang stong pa nyid bzhin du de kho na nyid du brjod cing / de kho na'ang byang chub kyi sems te/ de'i phyir de'ang khyab par byed pa kho na'o/ / zhes pa'o/ / zhes yul gyis khyab pa la yul can gyis kyang khyab par btags nas bshad tshul gsal bar gsungs so/ / de dag gi gnad bsdus te rdzogs rim dngos grub snye ma las/ de ltar na lhan skyes kye bde ba'i steng nas cha so sor phye nas skabs su gang babs pa'i khyab tshul rnams so sor shes par bya yi/ chos 'di las phyi rol tu gyur pa rnams kyis rtag pa dngakhyab pa khas blangs pa lta bu don 'dra ba la ming bzang por bsgyur ba'i tshulakhas blangs par mi bya'o/ / zhes don grangs can gyi rtsa ba'i rang bzhin sogs dang 'dra ba la ming bde ba chen po'i ye shes dang / stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo sogs su btags te mngon par mi gsal ba'i tshul gyis dngos gnas la yod par 'dod pa shin tu mi 'thad par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa so sor phye ste bshad pa la gnyis las/ dang po ma ṇi zhes pa thabs kyi don du rnam grangs du mas bshad pa ni/ thabs mchog bde chen dmigs med kyi/ / snying rje'i rnam grangs nor bu dang / / rin chen thig le rdo rje dang / / a li haṃ yig waṃ yig dang / / te yig sdom pa 'dus pa 444

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zabalo snang ba/dang / / dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa/ / shin tu mang gsung / zhes byung / de'ang gzhung phal cher gyi spyi skad la/ bde ba dang stong pa zhes pa'i bde ba dmigs bcas dang / stong pa dmigs med kyi ldog cha nas bshad pa mang yang / 'dir bde chen dmigs med ces dang / 'og tu dmigs bcas kyi shes rab stong chen zhes go ldog ste bshad pa ni dus 'khor gyi lugs dang sgo bstun pa yin te/ sngags rim las/ de'i phyir rgyud 'dir bde ba la dmigs med du gsungs shing / stong gzugs dmigs bcas su gsungs la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'dir bshad pa'i snying rje'ang bde ba chen po la byed kyi/sems can sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi zeg pa thun mong ba'i snying rje tsam la mi byed de/ mngon brjod las/ bde chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes dang / man ngag snye ma las/ thabs ni dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po 'gro ba'i don byed pa lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin no/ / zhes gsungs shing / de gnyis ka la snying rje'i sgra 'jug tshu' ka ru ṇa nges tshig gis bshad na/ bde 'gog ces pa 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma bzod pas bde ba'i go skabs 'gog pa dang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde bas byang sems phyir 'dzag pa'i bde ba 'gog pa la bshad cing / lhan skyes kyi ngo bor sdud pas bde bsdus su'ang grub chen mtsho skyes kyis gsungs so/ / der ma zad 'di'i snying rje bde chen la byas na nor bu dang dpe sbyar ba'ang shin tu 'grig gi / thun mong ba'i snying rje tsam la de'i don ma tshang ste/ des ni sems can sdug bsngal dang bral na dang / bral bar gyur cig / bral bar bya'o snyam du sgom par byed kyang / dngos su rang stobs kyis de ltar byed mi nus par bsam pa bzang ba tsam yin la/ lhan skyes kyi bde bas rlung sems la dbang bsgyuraba'i stobs kyis ye shes rang nyid lha'i sku sogs gang la gang 'tsham gyi 445

༄/ /yo ca gas r+sā yo sa ཿma/snod bcud de dang de'i rnam par shar nas sems can gyi don byed pas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar byed las phun sum tshogs pa'i mthu dang ldan la/ ye shes 'di nyid med na gzhan don nyi tshe ba tsam 'byung yang / sa gsum gyi 'gro ba ma lus pa'i sdug bsngal drungs phyung ste/ phan bde la 'god pa'i byed las khyad par can gye sgo nas re ba tshim par byed mi nus pa'i phyir/ saspu ṭa las/yid bzhin nor ltar ma lus pa'i/ / sems can don byed snying rje nyid/ /ces dang / sa ra has/ bde ba gang gis rnam par rol pa ni/ / ci ste de bsten nus pa med pas na/ /sa gsum re ba gang gis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i snying rje 'di nyid la gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs dang / gzugs sku'i rgyu tshogs ma tshang ba med par 'du ba'i dbang gis grangs med gsum gyi tshogs tshe gcig la rdzogs par saspu ṭa las gsungs so/ /slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyis kyang / snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs/ / zhes gsungs te/ sgom bde'i 'jigs byed rdzogs rim las/ sgyu ma'i sku gnyis ni mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis kyang 'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang chos mtshungs te/ lus can kun gyis de mthong dang / / gang gis thos dang dran tsam gyis/ / bsam pa rdzogs mdzad zung 'jug sku/ / zhes sgyu lus nor bu dang 'dra bar gsungs pa'ang rgyu mthun 'di'i stobs yin no/ / de nyid rgyud so so las rnam grangs du ma'i sgo nas gsungs tshul ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ bzhugs pa rdo rje can waṃ dang / / rdo rje can dang rdo rje sems/ / rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug dang / / he ru ka dang dus 'khor dang / / dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs ming / / sna tshogs yul gyi tha snyad kyis/ / rgyud gzhan dag tu bdag gis brjod/ / sna tshogs sems can bsam pas kyang / / rten gyi mtshan nyid 446

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zabamo'i 'grel pa zabaposnang ba/gnas dang ni/ / brten pa dag kyang bdag gis brjod/ / ces sogs rgyud so so las mi 'dra ba ji snyed cig 'byung ste ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba las/ /ming du mas don gcig go bar byed pa dpes bstan pa/ zhes pa nas/ waṃ yig gi mtshon don bde ba chen po go bar byed pa'i ming gi rnam grangs/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ / thig le'i ming gis bstan pa'ang / / bde chen der ni thig ler 'gyur/ / zhes sogs dang / rdo rje'i sgras bstan pa rtsa rgyud 'bum lnga las/ mi phyed rdo rje zhes bshad gang / / waṃ gyi yi ger de rab grags/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ / ā li kā li gnyis ni/ spyir dus 'khor ṭīka chen las/ a la sogs pa shes rab kyi yi ge dang / ka la sogs pa thabs kye yi ger gsungs pa dang / yang ā li rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bo dang / kā li de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bor gsungs pa lta bu/ dbyangs yig / thams cad kyi srog tu zhugs pa'i cha nas dbyangs dang shes rab tu bshad la/ kā li thun mong ma yin pa'i don gsal byed yin pas thabs su byas pa grags che'ang /stag lo'i spyi don las/ waṃ yig rlum po 'grub pa ni dbyangs dang zla ba'i chos mtha' dag bsdus pas thabs gtso bo 'gyur pa dang / zhar la khams drug gi gsal byed sde pa drug gi re re la mtshon byed stong pa'i thig le dbyug pa'i rnam pa re re ste drug 'byung / drug po sa rlung gnyis/ chu me gnyis/ nam mkha' rnam shes gnyis rnams zung gsum du byas te gshibs pa gsum 'byung ba rtse sprad pas e yig gru gsum 'grub pa ni gsal byed dang nyi ma'i chos thams cad 'dus pas shes rab gtso bor gyur pa ste/ rgya gar dha ra'i yi ge la e baṃ gyi dbyibs 'di bzhin du yod pa legs par 'grub/ ces gsungs pa bzhin du/skabs 'dir dbyangs yig 'dus pa waṃ dang / gsal byed 'dus pa ye byed dgos pas/ 'dir yang dbyangs bcu drug dkar cha'i 'phel 'grib kyi cha yo7

༄/ /yo thang bayo ཿ me'i gsung 4ma/bcu drug sgrib bral du gyur pa'i cha nas zla ba dang thabs dang byang sems la spyor bar gsungs so/ / zla nyi gnyis ni so sor phye ba'i skabs 'dir ma gsungs kyang / gong gi mdor bstan tu/ a kā li/ zhes pa'i mjug thogs su/ rdo rje nyi ma rdo rje zlar/ / zhes gsungs pas/ kā li rdo rje nyi ma dang / ā li rdo rje zla ba'i ngo bor bstan pa yin no/ / haṃ yig ni dri med 'od las/ rdo rje yan lag med pa'i sgrub pa la haṃ yig ste/ zhes stong gzugs dus kyi 'khor lo'i yab kyi rdo rje haṃ gis mtshon pa dang / yum gyi bha ga k+ṣa yig gis mtshon par gsungs pa'ang yod la/ 'dir 'og tu k+ṣa yig ma bshad pas/ dngos zin a yig la spyor rgyu'i dbang du byas par snang bas/ de ltar na bde dgyes sogs ma rgyud phal che ba las lte ba'i gtum mo a'i rnam pa dang / spyi bo'i byang sems haṃ gi rnam pa ste/ dbying dang thig le mnyam par sbyor bas lhan skyes bde chen 'dren tshul mang du gsungs pa dang dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab bo cha gye don gong du smos zin la/ te yig sdom pa 'dus pa dang / / zhes pa la/bdag gi lag tu byung ba'i dpe 'dir/ nye yig ces 'dug cing / dpe gzhan la ji ltar yod pa ma shes kyang / 'di nas kye rdor dang bde mchog sogs rim pa bzhin gsungs par snang bas nges par he yig byed dgos te/brtag pa dang po'i dbur/ te ni snying rje chen po nyid/ / ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ / 'khor lo sdom pa'i don yang sbas don kun gsal las/ bde stong gcig tu sdom pa dang / sku gsung thugs gsum lhan skyes kyi te ru ka gcigagi ngo bor sdom pa ste/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'di la e waṃ gnyis ga'i don tshang zhing / de rjes/ 'dus pa dang / zhes pa 'dis gsang ba 'dus pa'i mtshan don la e waṃ gyi don tshul bstan pa yin te/ de yang rgyud phyi ma las/sku gsung thugs ni rnam pa gsum/ / gsang ba zhes ni bstan pa yin/ /448

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zabaposnangab/sangs rgyas thams cad ces bya ba/ / tshogs pa 'dus pa yin par bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ / 'dis e waṃ spyi tsam du ma zad/ lam dang 'bras bu'i e waṃ thams cad tshang tshul gsungs pa ni/ de'i 'grel pa nā ro pas mdzad pa las/ rdo rje gsum du sku gsung thugs snang ba de nyid sangs rgyas dang / pad+ma dang rdo rje 'chang gcig tu gyur pa ni yig don gyi gsang 'dus dang / yi ge gsum las rdo rje 'chang du gyur nas rig ma dang rdo rje dang pad+ma gnyis 'dus pani/ spyi don gyi gsang 'dus dang / snang ba gsum rlung gi bzhon pa dang ldan pa de nyid thabs shes kyi bdag nyid sgyu ma lta bur gyur pa ni/ sbas don gye gsang 'dus dang / bden pa gnyis zung du 'jug pa gnyis su med pa ni/mthar thug gi gsang ba 'dus pa ste/ zhes gsungs so/ / de bzhin du dus kyi 'khor lo zhes pa la yang / dus kyis thabs bde ba chen po dang / 'khor lo zhes pas shes rab stong pa nyid bstan tshul/ dri med 'od las/ dus ni 'gyur med bde ye shes/ / thabs dang snying rje'i bdag nyid de/ / 'khor lo zhes byas rnam 'gro dpal/ / shes rab stong nyid bdag nyid do/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin yin zhing / der ma zad kā la tsakra zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi so sor phral te/ kā yig las ni rgyu zhi ba/ / la yig 'di la thim pa nyid/ / tsa yig gis ni g.yo ba'i sems/ / kra yig rim pa bcings las so/ / zhes kā ru ṇa shāste sogs yi ge bsnan pas gnas skabs bzhi sgrib bral du gyur pa'i sgo nas sku bzhi dbyer med pa'i rnam bzhag rgyas par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa pad+me zhes pa shes rab kyi don du rnam grangs du mas bshad pa ni dmigs bcas kyi/ shes rab stong chen gyi rnam grangs/ / pad+ma chos 'byung gru gsum dang / / sems dpa' kā li a yig dang / / e yig badz+ra 'khor gsang 'khor/ / za ma tog dang seng ge'i khri/ / la sogs mang du gsungs la9

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i lo gatshi ཿma/phyir ro/ / zhes byung / waṃ yig gi don ni rgyud so sor rang rang gi lha tshogs de la gtso bor gsungs kyi/ rnam grangs de tsam mi mang la/ e yig ni rgyud du mar rnam grangs mang po'i sgo nas bstan te/ rdor 'phreng las/ e ni gsang ba mkha' dbyings dang / / bha ga chos 'byung pad+ma la/ / rnal 'byor seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs/ / mchog tu rmad byung ston par mdzad/ / ces dang / rdo rje gur las/ bde ba can dang gru gsum dang / / rdul med dang ni skyon bral dang / /rdul bral dang ni sdig bcom dang / / rang bzhin rba rlabs med pa dang / / mtha' yas bde dang bde rigs dang / / gsang ba mchog dang dgyes pa dang / / zhes sogs gsungs la/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las kyang /e gsang mkha' dbyengs bha ga'am/ / chos 'byung chu skyes seng ge'i khrir/zhes dang / dri med 'od las/ e yig dang / gsang ba dang / pad+ma dang /chos 'byung dang / nam mkha'i dbyings dang / bde ba chen po'i gnas dang /seng ge'i khri dang / bha ga dang / gsang ba'i ming rnams kyi nang nas e yig gcig pu gtso bo'i ming ma yin te/ thams cad kyis rnam pa thams cad pa'i stong pa nyid go bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes gsungs te/ lung phyi ma 'di'i nang du gsang ba zhes lan gnyis 'byung bas/ snga ma'i skad dod la ra ha sru/phyi ma'i skad dod gu h+ya zhes yod pas/ rim pa bzhin gsang chen dang gsang bar bsgyur dgos par de nyid snang ba las gsungs so/ / thabs kyi rnam grangs skabs su nor bu dang / 'dir pad+ma thog mar smos pa ni e waṃ gyi des don rgyud sde so so nas gsungs pa'i lam dang 'bras bu'i gnad thams cad ma ṇi pad+ma'i don du 'du bar bsgrub pa'i skabs don gyi dbang gis yin no/ /rgyudagazhan las kyang pad+ma'i sgrar bstan pa ni/ phyag chen thig ler/ gsang pad snying bo'i nang na bzhugs/ / zhes dang / sgron gsal du rgyud drangs ba 450

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zabamosnang ba/las/ bha ga legs sbyangs pad+ma'o/ / zhes gsungs pa lta bu shin tu mang ngo / /de bzhin du chos 'byung zhes bshad pa'ang mang la/ chos 'byung du 'jog tshul dri med 'od las/ chos 'byung gi sgras kyang de brjod de/ chos 'byung gang las rang bzhin med pa'i chos thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ba'o/ / rang bzhin med pa'i chos rnams ni/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams so/ / de rnams 'byung bar gyur pa ni chos 'byung ste sangs rgyas kyi zhing ngo / / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gnas te bde ba'i gnas dang skye ba'i gnas so/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos 'byung gi skad dod dha rmā dha tu zhes pa/ chos kyi 'byung gnas sam/ rgyu dang / khams dang / rigs dang / dbyings sogs du ma la 'jugago / gru gsum zhes pa ni/ chos 'byung gru gsum zhes sbrel kyang rung mod/ 'on kyang 'dir logs su byas nas gong du thig le zhes pa dang sbyar te/gnyis ka dbyibs kyi sgo nas mtshon byed la sbyor dgos pa yi ge gsar ba'i dbu'i mtshon tshul gyi dgongs pa yin zhing / de ltar rgyud sde nas kyang gsungs te/ saspu ṭa las/ gru gsum dkyil 'khor nyams dga' ba/ / rdo rje ra li rnam par 'byung / / btsun mo'i bha ga zhes kyang bya/ / chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes byar bshad/ / ces dang / rgyud rnams kun gye rtsa ba ste/ / gru gsum shin tu yangs pa'i gzugs/ / zhes dang / sangs rgyas kun gyis bsten pa yi/ / gru gsum rnam dag 'di nyid ni/ / zhes sogs mang du 'byung ngo / /sems dpa' zhes pa ni gong gi rdo rje zhes pa dang sbyor dgos te/ brtag gnyis las/ sems dpa' srid pa gsum gcig pa/ / shes rab 'di yis rig pa ni/ / zhes srid gsum bden stong du ro gcig par rig pa'i shes rab tu dka' 'grel pad+ma can las bshad pa ltar ram/ mu tig phreng bar/ shes 451

༄/ /yo ca bayo yosgroname'i ga 4ma/ rab 'di yis sbyor bas na/ / zhes gong du/ mi phyed rdo rje zhes bshad do / /zhes pa'i skabs kyi thabs bde chen de dang / srid gsum bden med du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi cha 'di gnyis sbyor bar gsungs te/ skabs thob kyi dbang gis rdo rje shes rab la sbyor ba 'og tu 'byung yang / 'dir rdo rje thabs su byas pa'i zlas drangs nas sems dpa' shes rab tu byas pa yin no/ / kā li ni dbyangs gsal sbyar te bshad zin la/ a yig dang / zhes pa ni/ a haṃ sbyar te bde chen 'dren pa'i skabs kyi a yig yin pas/ de ni brtag gnyis las/rnal 'byor ma lus dbus su ni/ / a yi rnam pa sdom pa'i gnas/ / ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / / sdom pa'i de nyid rab tu phye/ / zhes rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bo lte ba'i gtum mo a thung gis dpa' bo'i rang bzhin gyi byang sems drangs pas bde chen skyed pa dang / rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo dngos su 'dus pas bde chen skyed pa gnyis phyi nang du sbyar te gsungs pa'i don/ saspu ṭar rnal 'byor ma bdag med ma la byas nas gsungs kyang / dkyil 'khor so so'i skabs su ming 'dogs tha dad pa tsam las don ngo bo gcig pa'i man ngag gis rgyas bkab ste/ dpyid thig las/ phag mo te l+la ka zhes brjod/ / las kyi rlung gis bskyod nas su/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nas ni 'bar/ / ba san+ta dang phrad pas mnyes/ / snyoms par 'jug pas yang dag bzhugs/ / zhes don snga ma dang mtshungs kyang / ming phag mo la 'don pa spos pa bzhin du/skabs 'dir spyan ras gzigs kyi yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la'ang sbyar du rung ba sogs dkyil 'khor rang rang gi skabs kyi mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo gang yin de'i ngo bo byas chog pas/ mkha' 'gro thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du gsungs te/ sgom bde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi 'jigs byed rdzogs rim las/ bde mchog tu mkha' 'gro ma thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo 452
