༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnangab/phag mo dang / kye rdor du mkha' 'gro ma thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bdag med ma'i sgras gsungs shing / de dang mthun par rdo rje 'phreng ba las kyang /gang phyir mkha' 'gro rnams sdud pa/ / de phyir bsdus pa'i mkha' 'gror brjod/ / lte ba'i dbus na rtag bzhugs pa/ / nyi ma stong dang mtshungs pa'i 'od/ / ye shes chen po'i me byung bas/ / kun rtog thams cad sreg par byed/ / ces 'byung ngo / / zhes khungs dang bcas te gsungs so/ / e yig ces pa gong gi waṃ dang sbyar ba'i tshul bshad zin cing / badz+ra zhes pa ni/brtag pa dang po las/ hes ni snying rje chen po nyid/ / badz+ra'ang shes rab brjod par bya/ / zhes kyai rdo rje'i mtshan zur gyi rdo rje ni shes rab tu bshad pa yin pas/ gong du rdo rje thabs su bshad pa dang mi 'gal lo/ / 'khor gsang 'khor/ zhes pa ni/ gong du/ sdom pa 'dus pa dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas zhes pa gsum dang rim pa bzhin sbyar nas/ 'khor lo sdom pa zhes pa'i 'khor lo/ gsang ba 'dus pa zhes pa'i gsang ba/ dus kyi 'khor lo zhes pa'i 'khor lo gsum yin zhing / sbyor tshul khungs dang bcas te sngar smos pa bzhin no/ / za ma tog ces pa ni/ phyag chen thig le dang rdor 'phreng gnyis ka las/ chos kyi dbyings ni bha gar bshad/ / bha ga rin chen za ma tog / ces gsungs te/ za ma tog tu rin po che sna tshogs bcug pa dper byas nas/ 'di za ma tog gi sgras bstan pa gong gi rin chen zhes pa dang sbyor dgos pa'i phyir/ dri med 'od las kyang / rgyud thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig mngon du gyur pa sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog kha 'byed par mdzad pa/zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / seng ga'i khri zhes pa bsdus rgyud kyi lung gong du drangs pa de bzhin yin te/ 'dir dngos su smos pa'i tha snyad rnams dang /gzhan yang mkha' 'gro dra ba'i sdom pa las/ ye ni sa ste waṃ ni chu/ / e ni snying 453

༄/ /yo ca bstan ཿ me'igayo ཿma/rje waṃ ni byams/ / e ni 'gog pa waṃ ni lam/ / e ni sbyin pa waṃ tshul khrims/ / e ni rgyud la waṃ ni sngags/ / e ni bsnyen pa waṃ nye bsnyen/ / e ni snang ba waṃ snang mched/ / e ni chos sku waṃ longs spyod/ / ces sna tshogs su sbyar ba sogs rgyud sde rnams las e baṃ gyi don rnam grangs mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas bstan pas/ grangs kyi mtha' ni sus kyang dpogs par mi nus pas/'dir yang / la sogs mang du gsungs phyir ro/ / zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ bzla bya'i sngags kyi don gtan la dbab pa dang / de la bzlas pa ji ltar byed pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ oṃ 'dir thabs kyi ye shes lnga / / hūṃ 'dir shes rab ye shes lnga/ /shes bcu rnam dag bdag nyid can/ / gsang sngags rgyal drug 'gyur med drug / rgyal ba rigs drug la sogs pa'i/ / don dam drug tshan thams cad du/ / shes nas lha gci lha kun 'dus/ / sngags gcig sngags kun 'dus pa yi/ / zhes byung / de'ang oṃ la thabs dang / hūṃ la shes rab tu bshad pa ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud las/ oṃ ni thabs la hūṃ shes rab/ / ā ni gnyis su med pa'o/ / zhes gsungs shing / yang de nyid las/ oṃ ni srog yin hūṃ rtsol ba/ / ā ni gnas par shes par bya/ / zhes pas kyang 'grub ste/ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud las/ srog rtsol gnyis ni a dang haṃ/ / zhes pa dang 'dra zhing / de gnyis thabs shes kyi ngo bor sngar bsgrubs zin pa bzhin no/ / der ma zad rgyud snga ma las/ oṃ ni sku la hūṃ ni thugs/ / ā ni gsung du shes par bya/ / zhes oṃ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo dang / hūṃ thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor bshad pas kyang 'grub ste/ gzugs sku gtso bor thabs dang bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi lag rjes yin la/ thugs chos kyi sku ni shes rab kyi cha gtso bor gyur pa'i phyir ro/ / ya 'dir logs su ma brjod kyang skyon med de/ rjod pa sgra'i 454

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mo snang ba/dbang du byas na'ang de gnyis kyi srog tu gnas shing / de gsum gyi rang mdangs 'byung 'jug gnas gsum byas pa'i tshe/ dang por 'byung 'jug gnyis las gnas pa zur du med kyang / goms pa'i mthar 'byung 'jug gnyis gnas pa 'ba' zhig gi ngo bor 'gro ba dang / 'bras bu mthar thug gi tshe'ang sku thugs zung du 'jug pa las/ gsung logs su ma smos kyang der ma 'dus pa'i skyon med pa bzhin no/ / gzhan yang oṃ yig thabs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo/ hūṃ yig shes rab dang gshegs ma'i ngo bor byas nas ma ṇi pad+ma'i sngags kyi thog mthar sbyar ba don dang dgos pa shin tu che ste/ rdo rje phreng ba'i nges don gyi sngags btu ba las/ a ni chos 'khor pad+mar gnas/ /rlung gi 'khor lor la ni khyab/ / 'di nyid kho na rlung chen po/ / srog ces bya ba thams cad gsung / / u ni longs spyod 'khor lor gnas/ / me dang nyi ma 'dra ba yis/ / mgrin pa'i mthar gnas spyi gtsug mthar/ / khyab pa gzi brjid kyi ni lus/ / bde chen 'khor lo zhes byar gnas/ / yi ge ma ni thig le tsam/ / mtho ba'i tshad ni sor bcu gnyis/ / rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gnas na gnas/ / zhes oṃ yig so sor phral bas a u mā gsum gyi nges don/ srog 'dzin gyen rgyu haṃ gi thig le gsum dang / yang de nyid las/ ha ni thur sel ming can rlung/ / bshad sgo gsang ba'i dbus na gnas/ / yi ge lca ni steng 'gro'irlung / / mgrin pa'i pad+ma'i dbus na gnas/ / yi ge ma ni srog rlung yin/ / dpral ba rlung gi 'khor lo la/ / de dag gcig gyur snying ga la/ /thugs kyi sa bon du ni brjod/ / ces hūṃ yig so sor phral bas ha lca ma gsum gyi mtshon don thur sel sogs kyi rlung gsum ste/ steng 'og gi rlung rnams dru tīr bsdus pa las ma ṇi pakhye'i nges don lhan skyes kyi bde chen 'dren pa'i don dang / gshegs pa dang gshegs ma snyoms par zhugs pa las lhan skyes kye bde 455

༄/ /yo cabastan pa'isgronama'i ga ཿma/chen 'dren pa'i don du'ang sbyar rung ste/ gong du/ yab yum lha dang thabs shes rab/ / ces pa'i dgongs pa'ang 'dis gsal bar byas pa yin no/ /yi ge de gnyis so sor thabs shes kyi rang bzhin ye shes lnga lnga'i bdag nyid du 'jog tshul ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud las/ a ni rnam snang mi bskyod pa/ / na re rin chen 'byung ldan te/ / zla tshes 'od dpag med pa yin/ /thig le don yod grub pa'o/ / oṃ ni bde gshegs lnga rang bzhin/ / zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ zhabs skyed sgrol ma'i rang bzhin te/ / a ni gos dkar ngo bo yin/ / ha ni rdo rje dbyings phyug ma/ / zla tshes ma mā gī'i rang bzhin/ / thig le spyan du shes par bya/ / zhes gsungs shing / der ma zad/'byung ba lnga dang sku lnga dang / / 'khor lo lnga dang dga' ba lnga/ / zhes sogs don tshan lnga lnga la sbyor tshul mang du gsungs shing / de ltar 'jog pa'i rtsa ba ni/zhabs skyed bya ba nan tan yin/ / a ni mnyam nyid ye shes so/ / ha ni chos kyi dbyings yin te/ / zla tshes so sor rtog pa'o/ / thig le me long ye shes so/ / zhes ye shes lnga dang sbyor tshul 'di nyid yin te/ 'di go na gzhan rnams shugs kyis shes par nus so/ / 'o na 'di'i thabs kyi ye shes lnga dang /shes rab kyi ye shes lnga po 'di ngo bo tha dad pa so sor 'jog rgyu yong ngam zhe na/de ni ma yin te/ bde stong gi ye shes gcig la bde ba'i ldog cha nas thabs dang / stong pa'i ldog cha nas shes rab tu bzhag ste/ de gnyis re re la'ang byed las mi 'dra ba'i ldog cha nas ye shes lnga lngar byas pa tsam yin pas/'dir/ shes bcu rnam dag bdag nyid can/ / zhes gsungs shing / ye shes 'phreng ba'i rgyud las kyang / dmigs med gnas su snying rje dang / / dmigs med gnas su shes rab gnyis/ / blo dang lhan cig gcig gyur pas/ / nam mkhar nam mkha'i rang bzhin no/ / zhes ldog cha tsam las don steng nas dbye 456

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnang ba/ba 'byed rgyu med par gsal bar gsungs so/ / mtshan brjod las/ shes bcu rnam dag bdag nyid can/ / shes bcu rnam dag 'chang ba po/ / zhes pa'i don/ rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzod kyi shes bcu ltar gsungs shing / sgon ma rab gsal las/ sor ldud kyi rtags bcu mthong ba la bshad pa sogs bzhed tshul sna tshogs yod kyang / rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i ṭī k+kar/ bde chen gyi ye shes rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid thob pa ni shes bcu rnam dag 'chang ba'i don no/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar byas na/ yi ge gnyis po 'dir rnam bcu dbang ldan rdzogs rim la sbyar ba'i gnad tshang bar dngos su 'grub bas/ phyi nang gnyis dang gzhan bskyed rim la sbyar ba'i rnam bzhag kyang shugs kyis grub ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i don yongs su rdzogs pa zhig 'byung bas/ rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyis kyang dgongs pa mthar thug dus 'khor dang mthun par 'grel tshul 'di nyid du gnas sam snyam mo/ / gsang sngags rgyal drug ces sogs kyang spyir/ mtshan brjod kyi badz+ra ti snya la sogs pa'i sngags tshan drug gis ston tshul dang 'dra bar gzungs sngags yi ge drug gis kyang phyi nang gzhan gsum la sbyar ba'i rnam gzhag cha tshang bar mtshon pa yin te/ phyi ru nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ye shes kyi rang bzhin can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams mtshon zhing / der ma zad khams drug gi bdag nyid can gye mi ma gtogs pa'i bcud kyi sems can gye lus sgrub pa'ang mtshon la/ nang la ni mngal skyes khams drug ldan mi'i lus kho na dang sbyar bar bya ba yin te/dri med 'od las/ nang du ni mi'i lus kho na ste zhes 'byung bas so/ / de ltar sbyor ba'ang bla med kyi lam gyis tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i rten ni mngalaskyes khams drug ldan gyi mi'i lus kho nar nges pa yin la/ de nyid kyi chos kyang / nam mkha'/ rlung me chu sa/ ye shes kyi khams te khams drug dang /457

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'isgroname'i ga lam/rnam shes/ 'du byed/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ gzugs/ ye shes kyi phung po ste phung po drug dang / rna ba/ sna/ mig / lce/ lus/ yid kyi dbang po ste dbang po drug dang / sgra/ dri/ gzugs/ ro/ reg bya/ chos kyi skye mched de yul drug dang / gsang gnas kyi dbang po/ ngag gi dbang po/ lag pa'i dbang po/ rkang pa'i dbang po/ bshang lam gyi dbang po/ mchog gi dbang po ste las kyi dbang po drug dang / dri chu 'dor ba/ smra brjod/ len pa/'gro ba/ bshang ba 'dor ba/ khu ba 'dor 'dzin te las dbang gi bya ba drug rnams mtshon pa yin no/ / gzhan la sbyar na/ lam gye spang bya dug lnga so so dang / de dag cha 5nyam ste drug gam/ shes bya'i sgrib pa ste sgrib pa drug / de spong bar byed pa'i gnyen po la bskyed rdzogs gnyis las/ bskyed rim la rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor drug dbyibs lha drug gsang sngags drug rnams/rdzogs rim la gang la gnad du bsnun par bya ba'i gzhi/ srog 'dzin/ mnyam gnas/ gyen rgyu/ khyab byed/ klu/ thur sel te rlung drug dang / slar yang dga' ba'i rlung / ruyosbal/ rtsangs ba/ lhas byin/ nor las rgyal/ lhan cig sgyes pa'i dga' ba'i rlung ste yang rlung drug dang / gtsug tor kyi rtsa 'khor/ snying ga'i rtsa 'khor/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor/ smin ma'i dbus kyi rtsa 'khor/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor/ gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor te 'khor lo drug /khams drug rnams dang / de la gnad du bsnun par byed pa spyor ba yan lag drug rnams so/ / 'bras bu rgyal ba rigs drug ste/ de ltar phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi chos drug tshan de rnams gzungs yi ge drug gis mtshon nas gsungs pa yin no/ / de skad du bsnyen sgrub rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi zin bris las/khams drug ldan la yan lag drug gi lam/ / rigs drug rtsa la g.yo ba drug bcom nas/ /'khor lo drug la rgyal ba drug gi dngos/ /drug tshan drug gis 458

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mosnang ba/rgyud kun bsdus par mdzad/ / ces dus 'khor gyi rgyud don mtha' dag drug tshanagyi sgo nas gtan la phab bo/ / 'dir gsang sngags rgyal drug ces pas bskyed rim skabs kyi rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sogs drug la brten pa'i dbyebs kyi rnal 'byor lha drug dang gsang sngags drug sogs bstan/ 'gyur med drug / ces pas 'khor lo drug la gnad du bsnun zhing / rlung drug tshan rnams dbu mar bcings pas 'gyur med lhan skyes kyi bde chen 'dren tshul drug la sbyor ba'am/ yang na gsang sngags rgyal drug ces pa gzungs kyi yi ge drug la byas nas/ de'i lam rdzogs rim drug dang / 'bras bu rgyal ba rigs drug 'grub tshul dngos su bstan nas smin byed bskyed rim drug dang sbyang gzhi'i drug tshan rnams shugs la bstan par byas kyang rung ngo / / 'gyur med kyi skad dod ak+ṣa ra yi ge la'ang 'jug pas gzungs kyi yi ge drug la byed snyam na/ gsang sngags rgyal drug ces pa dang zlos shing / 'di rgya skad kyi a k+ṣa ra las tshur bsgyur ba ma yin par/ rtsom pa pos dang po nas bod skad du 'di bzhin gsungs pa yin pas sor gnas byed dgos te/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba la yi ge'i bde bar byas na mi 'brel ba bzhin no/ / dri med 'od kyi ye shes le'u las/ 'gyur med drug ni/ mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus dang yid sgrib pa med pa rnams te/ zhes dang / mi 'gyur ba'i sgras ni mchog tu mi 'gyuraba'i bde ba'i ye shes rdo rje sems dpa' 'o/ / zhes drug tshan rnams sgrib bral du gyur pa'i spangs pa dang bde chen zung du 'jug ba ma ning gi go 'phang ngo bo nyid kyi sku sogs la sbyar te/ mtshan brjod las/ thig le stong pa 'gyur med drug / ces sogs khungs su drangs so/ / 'di'i 'gyur la deng sang / thig le stong pa yi ge drug / ces gragayo 'ang / dri med 'od las/mi 'gyur bar brjod de mi 'gyur zhing mi g.yo ste gzhan gye gnas su mi 459

༄/ /yo thang b.lo pa'isgroname'i g.yo ཿma/'gro'o/ / zhes sgra don gsungs pa yi ge la mi 'grig pas/ rje btsun dam pa nyid kyi dgongs pa'ang / 'gyur med la byas pa der gnas par mngon no/ /de ltar lam dang 'bras bu'i gnad thams cad drug tshan so so'i sgo nas gzungs 'di'i don du tshang ba'i tshul mos mno tsam ma yin par tshad ma'i lam gyes drangs pa'i nges shes rnyed na/ lha mchog 'di nyid yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid du mthong bas dad pa shugs drag po skyes zhing / gzungs 'di nyid kyang byis pa chung ngu tshun chad kyi kha la grags pa tsam rgyu mtshan du byas pas chos chung ngu zhig tu mi 'dzin par/zabagasang rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i don gyi nying khu thams cad skye bo mchog dman mtha' dag la phan pa'i phyir tshig shin tu nyung ngur bsdus pa'i gdams ngag gi rgyal por mthong bar 'gyur te/ don gyi ngo bo la de ltar tshang ba nges na/ de dag nas bshad pa'i byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad kyang 'di'i 'bras bur 'byung ba dri ma med pa'i rigs pas 'grub po/ / des na tshem bu dmar khrid kyi yi ge rnams su/ bla ma yi dam gzungs sngags thams cad bsdus te bstem bas kun 'dus rnam gsum du grags pa las kyang / 'dir rang gi brjodadon la de dag thams cad tshang bar yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas te/ de thams cad kyi phan yon 'di la brten nas 'byung bar bsgrub pa gnad che ste/byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod du gtogs pa'i mdo sde nyan pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs shing gsal bar mdzad de/ bkrol zhing brtags nas bstan pa ji snyed pa de snyed kyi bsod nams kyi phung por 'gyur bar rig par bya'o/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/byang chub sems dpa'i sa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod bstan pa dang bshad pa'i sgo rnams bsdus shing bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin 460

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zabacasnangab/no/ /de la dgongs te dam pa gong ma rnams kyis kyang / lha gcig la byen rlabs che ba de/ / 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po yin/ / sngags gcig la byin rlabs che ba de/ gzungs mchog yi ge drug ma yin/ / zhes gsungs pa sogs 'di nyid kho na la gzhan las lhag pa'i bsngags brjod dang nan tan rgya cher mdzad do/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ man ngag zab mor yid ches dang / / ldan pa'i ngang nas dag cing gsal/ / rgyun mi 'chad cing ring thung ran/ / rtse gcig dad gdung drag po yis/ / bzlas pas rgyal sras ma lus pa'i/ / thugs rgyud bskul nas byin rlabs dang / / thugs rje'i 'od zer dpag med pa/ / 'phros te sems can thams cad kyi/ / sgrib bsal dngos grub kun thob nas/ / yig drug zlos pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ / nam mkha' gang bar rab bsams pas/ / zhes byung / de'ang dang po rkang pa phyed gnyis dang / rkang pa bzhi pas sngags bzla ba'i tshe kun slong ma dag pa rnams bsal nas/ bsam pa khyad par can gsal 'debs tshul dang / rkang pa phyed gnyis kyis ngag tu brjod tshul bstan la/ lhag mas 'od zer spro bsngu sogs kyi dmigs pa skyong tshul rnams gsungs so/ / de la dang po bsam pa'i khyad par ni/ 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u bdun pa las/ slong mo za zhing mi bzla ste/ /slong la'ang dga' bar mi bya'o/ / 'dod pa kun la longs spyod cing / /sngagasakyi yan lag ma nyams bzlas/ / zhes dang / sgron gsal las/ yan lag ma nyams pa ni lha'i rnal 'byor dang / mi phyed pa'i 'dod pa kun la longs spyod pa'i sngags pas bzlas par bya'o/ / zhes lha'i rnal 'byor brtan po dang ma bral zhing / 'dod yon lnga'i rang bzhin yongs su shes pa'i ngang nas bzla bar gsungs pa'ang 'di dang don gcig ste/ gong du bshad pa 461

༄/ /gung ca b.lo pa'i sgroname'i ga ཿma/bzhin rang bzhin med rtogs kyi lta ba'i ngang nas yi dam lha tshogs thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid sbyan ras gzigs kyi nga rgyal dang dag pa'i rten dang brten pa mtha' dag gi rnam pa gsal btab ste/ de dag la dmigs pa'i dang ba dang / thob par 'dod pa'i mngon 'dod dang / de dag sgrub pa'i lam 'bras kyi rim pa kun la yid ches pa ste/ dad pa gsum tshang ba'i sgo nas bzlas pa la 'jug dgos pa ni/ rtse gcig dad/ ces pa dang / gdung ba drag po/ zhes pa dang / yid ches zhes pa gsum gyis rim pa bzhin bstan pa yin no/ / de ltar mthun phyogs dngos su bstan pas/ mi mthun phyogs spong dgos pa shugs kyis 'grub cing / de'ang gong du drangs pa'i/ slong mo za zhing zhes sogs kyis bstan te/ de'i nges don rdor bzlas la sbyor dgos pa mdo bsre ltar yin kyang / drang don du bshad na/ sgron gsal las/ slong mo za ba ni nye bar mtshon pa'i don yin te/ de bas na slong du 'gro ba dang 'dra bar yongs su tshol ba la sogs pa dman pa la 'jug pa gzhan rnams dang ldan pas kyang zlos par mi bya'o/ / zhes rnyed bkur snyan grags 'dod pa sogs dman pa'i kun slong gi rigs mtha' dag spong dgos par gsungs so/ / de nas ngag tu brjod tshul ni/ dgra nag gi rim pa bcu gnyis pa las/ bzlas pa gang zhig rab bzlas na/ / dngos grub yangs pa thob pa ni/ / myur bar ma yin dal bar min/ / ring du ma yin thung ngu min/ / sngags ni cung zad thos par bzla/ zhes dang / de'i don grub chen dpal ldan gyis/ myur bar ma yin zhes bya ba ni skyen par ma yin pa'o/ / dal bar ma yin zhes bya ba ni yi ge re re nas dal bus brjod pa'o/ / ring du ma yin zhes bya ba ni thung ba rnams so/ / thung bar ma yin zhes bya ba ni ring ba rnams zhes bya ba'i lhag ma'o/ / cung zad thos par zhes bya ba ni/ ji ltar gzhan gyis mi thos par 462

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mo snang ba/ro/ / zhes gsungs shing / nag po'i 'grel pa las kyang / myur par ma yin te/ stug po mi dzogs shing ring po thung ngur 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dal bar ma yin te/ stug po lhag par 'phel zhing thung ngu ring por 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ / ring du ma yin te/ lhag pa 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ / thung ngu ma yin te/khongs nas 'byung ba med pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes sogs kyis sngags 'bru rang rang klog pa'i tshad las ring thung du gyur na chad lhag sogs kyi skyon du 'gyur bas/ 'dir yang sgra dag cing gsal la ring thung ran pa dgos par nan tan du gsungs la/ de'i bar du'ang tha mal gyi ngag la sogs pas mchod pa dgos pa'i phyir/ rgyun mi 'chad/ ces smas so/ / 'od zer spro bsdu sogs kyi dmigs pa skyong tshul ni/ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dang sprul pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs rje bskul zhing / rigs drug so so'i gnas su song ste rang rang gi sdug bsngal dang / sdig sgrib sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa bsal te/ ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad sbyangs nas/ bcud thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i ngo bo dang / snod thams cad de'i ye shes kyi rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ de thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gzungs yi ge drug pa'i sgra dbyangs phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar 'ur chem chem bsgrags pa'i dmigs pa bya la/ de'ang sngags thog mar brjod ba'i tshe lha tshogs spros pa'i dmigs pa dang / sngags brjod pa rdzogs pa na tshur sdud pa'i dmigs pa byed dgos te/ mdo bsre las/brjodanas rdo rje spro ba ni/ / rdzogs nas bsdu ba rab tu bya/ / zhes bya ba'i ngagagi bzlas brjod byas la/ zhes gsungs so/ / ru bcu gsum pa'i lung 'di'i don sgron gsal las sgrub thabs bsgoms pa'i mthar dkyil 'khor gye 463

༄/ /yo ca bayopa'isgronayo khrung ཿma/lha rang la bsdu ba la sbyar zhing / bla ma dam pa rnams kyis mchod pa'i tshe mchod lha spro ba dang sdud pa'i tshul du mdzad mod kyang / thams cad lha spro bsdu'i dmigs par phyogs mthun pas don 'gal ba med do/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ / nam mkha' gang bar rab bsam pa'i/ / ngang nas phyag skor mchod bstod dang / / gtor ma chab gtor sdig bshags dang / /yi rang bskul zhing gsol gdab pa/ / maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba la sogs pa/ / dge ba'i bya ba thams cad bya/ / rdzogs rim bab mo'ang bla ma yi/ / man ngag bzhin du bsgom la brtson/ / zhes byung / 'di dag gis mjug gi mchod bstod sogs kyang bstan la/ thun mtshams dang / rgyun par yang yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa la brtson pa sogs bsag sbyang la 'bad dgos tshul dang / rdzogs rim zab mo'i nyams len la'ang smon pa tshun chad kyis bag chags ci thebs byas te/ 'dir gtso bor bshad pa'i bskyed rim gyi bsgom bzlas de dag thams cad kyang dzogs rim zab mo de lta bu'i smin byed dang / rim gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon du byas te/lus can mtha' dag 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i rgyur bsngos tshul sogs bstan to/ de'ang yan lag bdun gyi dang po phyag 'tshal ba dngos su gsungs la/ skor ba byed pa'ang bkur bste'i yan lag yin pa phyag dang mtshungs pa'i phyir de dang mnyam du smos pa yin te/ blo gros brtan pa'i rgyan gye 'grel bshad las/ rnyed pas mchod pa dang / bkur stes mchod pa'o/ / de la chosagos dang lhung bzed la sogs pa 'bul ba ni rnyed pas mchod pa'o/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang skor ba byed pa la sogs pa ni bkur stes mchod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / mchod bstod dang gtor ma chab gtor zhes pa'i bstod pa phyag gi khongs su 'du'ang / rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa mchod pa'i 464

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grelapa zabaposnang ba/grangs su gsungs pa lta bu'ang yod pas don mi 'gal la/ gtor ma chab gtor sogs kyang yul gyi mgron la mchog dman gyi dbye ba yod pa las/ zang zing gi dngos po gtong bar rigs 'dra bas lhan du smos so/ / de nas sdig pa bshags pa/ rjes su yi rang / chos 'khor skor bar bskul ba/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa/ maṇ+ḍal rnams kyi dngos zin sla la/so sor phye na re re la'ang phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi khyad par/ rgyal dbang gi bla mchod cho gar 'byung ba dang / maṇ+ḍal gyi dbye ba lam 'bras sogs gzhan las kyang mang du 'byung yang / 'dir yi gis 'jigs pas ma bris/ bsngo ba dngos zin la med kyang / 'dir/ dge ba'i bya ba thams cad bya/ / zhes pa dang / rdzogs rim zhal 'phang mdzad pa'i shugs kyis go tshul sngar bzhin yin la/ der ma zad phan yon bshad pa'i skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu mang du gsungs pas/ dge rtsa 'di rnams gzhir bzung ste/'bras bu de dag gi rgyur 'phen pa gtong ba las gzhan na bsngo ba bya ba logs su med pas/ 'di dag gi khongs su bsngo ba'i don yang legs par tshang ngo / /gnyis pa bsgom pa'i phan yon ni/ de ltar byas na 'di phyi yi/ / don kun yid bzhin 'grub 'gyur zhing / / 'chi tshe mi mthun kun bral nas/ / rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ / 'khor dang bcas sam de sprul pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pas bsus te/ / po ta la yi zhing mchog gam/ / bde ba can du pad+mo las/ / brdzus te skye zhing skyes ma thag / gzungs dang ting 'dzin la sogs pa'i/ / yon tan mang thos rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / thams cad mnyes byed sa lam gyi/ / yon tan thams cad kun rdzogs nas/ / spyan ras gzigs dang mtshungs pa yi/ / go 'phang dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /465

༄/ /yo ca bsapa'isgronama'i ga ཿma/zhes byung / 'di dag gi dngos zin shin tu go sla ste/ tshe 'dir yang chos ldan gyi 'dod don smon pa bzhin du 'grub pa dang / 'chi ba'i tshe mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyis zhal bstan nas dag pa'i zhing du khrid de skye ba len zhing / /der tshig don gyi gzungs dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mang du thob ste/ sa lam gyi rtogs pa gong ma rnams bde blag tu bgrod nas/ ring por mi thogs par mgon po spyan ras gzigs dang spangs rtogs mnyam pa'i go 'phang bla na med pa mngon du 'gyur ba sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ gang zhig rab gsang 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di nyan pa dang / /'don par byed dang klog pa dang ni sems pa dang / / mchod par byed pa dang ni 'dri'am 'drir 'jug pa/ /byang chub rdo rje 'drar blta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ / gang zhig gtso bo sgrub pa po mthong reg pa dang / / legs par dran dang ming tsam nges par thos pa dang / /dad par byed cing phyogs gcig tsam zhig 'dzin pa dag / byang chub rdo rje 'drar blta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ / zhes rab thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa nas/ tha na mtshan tsam 'dzin pa yan chad kyang ring por mi thogs par byang chub rdo rje'am/ rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i nus pa khyad par can thob pas/ de dang 'dra bar bstod bsngags kyi yul du gsungs pa bzhin lam 'di'i sgrub pa po rnams kyang / lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'igasung las/ de ltar mkhas dang grub pa las brgyud pa'i/ / man ngag bdud rtsi'i snying po 'di lta bur/ /tshul bzhin spyod pa'i skal bar ldan rnams kyang / / rgyal sras dam pa'i dpe zlar bsngags par 'os/ / zhes tshem bu dmar khrid kyi mjug tu gsungs pa bzhin/ rmad du byung ba'i skal pa bzang po nges par thob pa yin pas/ bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis spyir dal 466

༄/ /ma ṇi'i sgrub thabasazab mo'i 'grelapa zabamosnangab/'byor gyi rten khyad par can thob cing / khyad par bstan pa'i snying po 'di lta bu dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir sgo gsum bag med du ma song bar ci nas kyang snying po lon pa zhig byed dgos so/ / gsum pa mjug gi don ni/ de ltar phan yon che la sgrub sla ba'i/ /man ngag zab mo khyad par 'phags pa 'di/ / rigs chos slob bu chos dbang rdo rje yis/ / bsgul ba'i byed pas dam pas byin brlabs pa'i/ / yo gi dzñā na badz+ra zhes bya yis/ / sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis gsungs pa bzhin/ /rang lo gya lngar yi ger bris pa 'di/ / glegs bur bkod po rab 'byams blo gros so/ / zhes gsungs te go bar sla'o/ / smras pa/ gsar ba'i legs bshad kurdo gzhon nu lung rigs ge sar rgod pa'i 'dzum/ / dus bzhi'i mtha' la skyo ba'i shugs 'chang thub bstan sgeg mo'i yid 'dzin 'di/ /'dzam gling mkhas dgu'i sa 'dzin rtse mor bka' yig 'od phreng rol pa can/ / yab rje 'jigs med dbang po'i drin no slar yang byang chub bar du skyongs/ / chos mdzod kun la rgyas btab gdams pa'i lcags/ / sngon byung 'grel pa'i lde mig ma mches kyang / / rnam dpyod sor mo'i 'phrul gyes phye ba 'dir/ / nongs pa mchis na bla ma lha yis sbyongs/ / zab gsang rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i snying po'i don/ / ma lus gcig gyur nor bu'i gter grol bas/ /kun tu rmongs pa dbul ba'i 'jigs 'phrog cing / / yang dag lam gyi dga' ston ci yang 'gyed/ / 'di ni rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchod sprin te/ / rang blo legs bshad lam la goms pa'i thabs/ / blo ldan 'ga' la phan par 'gyur srid pas/ / tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i ngal ba 'bras bur bcas/ / la la sngon gyi gzhung lugs 'grib pa'i dus/ / gsar ba'i rtsom pa dgos pa med do lo/ / mang bkur rgyal po'i dpal yang mi brtan pas/ / nor gyis dgos 467

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronasa'i gsung 'bum/med sngon du dgongs par mdzod/ / 'dir 'bad dge bas tshe rabs phreng bar yang / /rje btsun dam pa'i mgon gyis mi gtong zhing / /legs gsung bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis 'tsho ba yis/ / bde stong ting 'dzin lang tsho rgyas gyur cig /khyad par dge ldan ring lugs chu gter dang / / yangs pa'i 'jig rten bde 'byor kurdo'i tshal/ / legs bshad ga bur 'od kyi rtse dga' rnams/ / phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du rgyas gyur cig / ces byang phyogayobastan pa'i nyi ma gcig pu thugs rje'i bdag nyid rje btsun dam pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpalabazang pos mdzad pa'i ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs zab mo'i 'grel pa zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun dam pa'i khu re chen mo nas dad brtson rnam dpyod ldan pa dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis sku gsungs thugs rten/ gser dngul/gos sprugs/ spos sman sogs kyi maṇ+ḍal bcas nan tan chen poyobaskul ba'i ngor/mdo dang sngags kyis bsdus pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa 'dzin skyong spel b.rabyed pa la snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sa'i steng na 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 7rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigayomed dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten pa'i bka' drin layogasung rab kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad tsam thob pa'i 7shākya'i btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes/ rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i chos grwa chen po bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas bkra shis 'khyil gyi nye 'dabasadabon gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni blo dang ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog kun dgas bgyis pa 'dis kyang 'jam mgon bstan pa'i snying po dri med pa phyogs dus kun tu rgyasapar gyur cig / / /468

༄/ /dril bu lus dkyil gyimangonagogasasador bsdus/༄7/ / dril bu lus dkyil gyi mngon rtogs mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal te ru ka dang gnyis su med pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su bzung du gsol/ skad cig gis rang nyid te ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du skad cig gis thod pa dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas gang ba oṃ ā ྅ gis mtshan par gyur/ ha ho hrī sa kha dog dri ro nus pa'i skyon bcom zhing / de rnams zhu bas bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ be+e ḍū/ lan gsum gyes nang mchod byin gyis brlag bdag bskyed mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis thod pa'i nang du hūṃ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ a ā :/ oṃ pāhūṃ 〉 rtu/ oṃ añtsa ma ḍi ā :/ oṃ pro k+ṣa rna ā ྅/ oṃ badz+ra pukhri ju pe di pe gadhe ne+e khribya shasta ā :/de nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ / rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ bdag ni te ru gar gyur cig /469

༄/ /gung ca bayomi'isgroname'i g.yo ཿma/rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng du skad cig gis bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa'i yab yum gnyi ga'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā / thugs kur hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ lus gang / bde ba skyes/ chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te lus thams cad gang zhing sdeg sgrib thams cad dag par gyur/ he ru ga'i yigabargya bzlas la/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum rang la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ shrī he ru ga he ni chos kyi bdag med pa/ ru ni gang zag gi bdag dang bral ba/ga ni de kho na nyid kyi yul yul can mi mthun par mi gnas pa/ shrī stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i ye shes e baṃ gyi don bzhin rang dang snang ba thams cad stong par gsal ba'i ngang las skad cig gis te ru ka yab yum gyi skur gyur/ shrī he ru ko3nya/ lan gsum/ oṃ a ā/ i ste/ u lca/ ṛ rī/ tha shā/e i/ o au/ yi a ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa rta ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ k+ṣa rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum mam/ bsdu na oṃ 〉 rtu gis chog / rang gi lte ba'i phyogs su sngags 'phreng g.yon skor du gnas pa las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bskrad/ slar byon nas rang la thim par gyur/ rang he ru gar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i pad zla'i steng gi ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi hūṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 470

༄/ /drilakhu lus dkyil gyimangonatogasamador bsdus/bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs mdun gye nam mkha' spyan drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ oṃ gu ru tsakra sasba ra sadra ḍā ki ṭī bh+ya zhesaphyag bya/ oṃ arnya pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ pādu pra tī ts+tsha sāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye 〉 rtu swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra shasta 〉 rtu swāhā/ oṃ ā badz+ra a dadhe hūṃ/ oṃ ā badz+ra bi nī hūṃ/ yi be+e badz+ra gadhe hūṃ/ oṃ ā badz+ra ra se hūṃ/ oṃ ā badz+ra sparnye hūṃ/ oṃ ya badz+ra dha rme hūṃ/ oṃ 〉 rtu gis nang mchod phul/ yab yum stoms par zhugs pa'i bde stong gi ye shes gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ / 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / / sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / / tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas byin gyis brlab par gyur/ oṃ su bhā wa shu sarba dhazla su bhā wa shusgo ྅rta/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/ de ltar snang ba thams cad bsdus pa'i stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nā da'i gzugs gyen 'greng ba shin tu phra ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs ri rab sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su mtshan dpe'i ngo bo dbyangs so gnyis dang gsal byed brgyad cu las dbyangs gsal gyi gzugs brnyan dang ldan pa'i zla ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can me long dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ranganam mkha'i nā das zla ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can mthong ba na bdag gis sangs rgyas yab yum gye byang sems dkar dmar gyi dbus su skye ba blangs la sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa dang ldan pas/ zla ba'i dbus su nā da zhugs pa las rim bzhin hūṃ yig dkar la dmar ba'i dmangs 471

༄/ /yo ca bstan ༅ lo ga4 tshom/can du gyur pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus nā da la thim zhing hūṃ yig lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa ni bya sgrub ye shes so/ / oṃ ā :/ oṃ sazo bī ra yo gī dī kā ya wā gyi ta badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3rta/ oṃ badz+ra shur+ha saspru dhaspo badz+ra shurnyo ྅ho/zla ba dbyangs gsal hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rten dang brten pa'idakyil 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ de'ang gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta bab bzhi dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi gdan la rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal te ru ka sku mdog mthing ga zhal bzhi pa'i rtsa zhal nag / g.yon zhal ljang / rgyab zhal dmar/ g.yas zhal ser ba/ zhal re re'ang spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dpral rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo mnan cing / g.yon bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdor dril 'dzin pas rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug/ drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/g.yon pa'i phyag gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga/ bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can/ dbu re re la thod pa skam po lnga lngas brgyan cing / dbu'i g.yon du cung zad yo ba'i zla ba phyed pa 'chang ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba bzhi bzhigatsigs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham 472

༄/ /dril bu lusadakyil gyimangonanogasamador bsdus/thabs can/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug gis rgyas btab pa/ mi rus kyi thal bas lus thams cad la byugs pa'o/ / bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs par bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi phyag g.yon pas yab kyi mgul ba nas 'khyud pa'i thod pa na bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ g.yas pas phyogs bcu'i gdug pa can kun la gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs par mdzad pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing me ltar 'bar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab kyi brla'i steng du legs par 'khril ba/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i thod dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gnyi ga'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa gzhu'idabyibs su yod pa yongs su gyur pa las 'byung ba rim brtseg gi rlung gzhu'i dbyibs can dang / sum mdo gru gsum gyi gzugs su yod pa las me dkyil zur gsum dang / lto ba blum po'i dbyibs can las chu dkyil zlum po/snying ga gru bzhi pa las sa dkyil gru bzhi/ sgal tshigs las ri rab/ spyi bo'i rtsa so gnyis las pad+ma/ lus 'dom gang yan man dang phan tshun du mnyam pa las ngos bzhi mnyam pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ pha gu dang dra phyed sogs kyi rgyanagyis mdzes pa'i he ru ga'i dkyil 'khor/ rkang brgyad las ka ba brgyad/rang gi lus ngag yid gsum las 'khor lo gsum/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi byu tī'i nang gi byang sems pa mo lta bu 'dzag pa/ nyungs gar sbom po'i tshad kyi dpyid hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das te ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ lte ba'i dmar cha gtum mo'i me'i gzugs kyi thig le yongs su 473

༄/ /yo ca bayor+sā me'i lnga ཿma/gyur pa las phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa ste/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ dpyid dang thig le'i ngo bo gnyis snying gar phrad nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ snying ga'i shar la sogs pa'i 'byung ba bzhi'izung rgyu ba'i rtsa 'dab bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ lwa ma ljang gu/ dum skyes ma dmar mo/ gzugs can ma ser mo/ bzhi ga'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa'i mchan khung na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ shar lho la sogs pa'i mchod pa bzhi'i rtsa 'dab las bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi ste bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhi/ snu dzā o a go ra de mā kā o tri ko ka la kā hi pre kṛ sau su na si ma ku rnams thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rtsibs khong stong rtsibs shun gyi rnam pa dang ldan pa'i 'khor lo nyer bzhi'i rnam pa can phyi'i yul nyer bzhi'i ngo bor gyur/ gnas nyer bzhi'i rtsa dang khams ngo bo dbyer med du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rtsa nang gi khams las dpa' bo nyer bzhi dang / rtsa las dpa' mo nyer bzhir gyur pa ni/ skra mtshams pū li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum ma/spyi gtsug dza larnya rar ma hā gaṅka la dang gtum mig ma/ rna ba g.yas pa e ḍi ya nar gaṅka la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa adru tar mche ba rnam par gtsig pa dang sna chen ma/ rna ba g.yon pa go da ba rir su ra bai ri ṇa dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ smin mtshams rā me shā rir 'od dpag med dang kha rba ri/ mig gnyis de wī ko ṭir rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis mā la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha sku mdog sngon po nam mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyes bzhugs pa/ mchan khung gnyis kla ma rū par 474

༄/ /dril bu lusadakyil gyisangonatogasamador bsdus/myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ nu ma gnyis o ṭir rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byedachen mo/ lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/sna rtse ko sā lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ kha ka liṅkar rab tu bzang po dang sngo bsangs lha mo/ mgrin pa lam pa gar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ snying gañtsa ri 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ 'bras bu gnyis hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha sku mdog dmar po sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ mtshan ma bre ta pū rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ gshang lam kṛ ha de ba tar rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ brla gnyis sor ṣār rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ṭ+wāṃ/ra ṭ+wāṃ ༷༵ ṭ+wāṃ~X rdo sna ༷sdi ṭ+wāṃ ༷ra ka na/nga mnini ṭ+wāṃ rdo ༵ ༷dī 'aX lor+sha gog t+t+waṃ ༵ /sirdur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ mthe bong bzhi ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu ta ra rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i 'khor lo'i lha sku mdog dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ dpa' bo rnams rdor dril bzung nas yum la 'khyud cing / ral pa'i thor cog la sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla tshes kyis brgyan pa/ dbral bar rdo rje'i phreng ba dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag sham gsol zhing g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ dpa' mo rnams gri thod 'dzin cing yab la 'khril sbyor gyis bzhugs pa/ thod pa'i dum bus brgyan pa'i 'og pag dang thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gnas rang rang gi rtsa hūṃ ring po dang ngo bo dbyer med du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las sgo 475

༄/ /yojabalo pa'ithonapo sa 4ma/mtshams ma brgyad du gyur pa ni/ lce'i rtsa bar kha gdong ma nag mo/ lte ba'i bug par 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ rtags kyi sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/gshang lam gyi sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ mdzod spu'i bu gar gshin rje'i brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ rna ba'i bug pa gnyis su gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ mig gnyis su gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ sna'i bug pa gnyis su gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ brgyad ga'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa'i mchan khung na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can du gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po bya las nor bu dmar po rtse morasta ser pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas ā las pad+ma dmar po byā las ze'i 'bru dkar po rtse mor byā ser pos mtshan pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang thugs ka/ yum gyi mgrin pa dang spyi bor zla gdan la yum gyi snying po dang nye snying / yum gyi lte ba dang thugs ka/ yab kyi mgrin pa dang spyi bor nyi gdan la yab kyi snying po dang nye snying rnams kha dog dmar po phan tshun zhal sbyor zhing 'od zer 'khyud pa'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ stoms par zhugs pas dga' bzhi rim bzhin drangs/ lhan skyes kyi bde stong dbyer med du sbyar ba byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo lha so bdun gye rnam par shar ba nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla gdan la rdo rje sems dpa' ngo bo oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor nyi ma la rnam snang gi ngo bo na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la pad+ma gar dbang gi ngo bo swā hā hū dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su nyi ma la dpal he ru ga'i ngo bo bo ṣa ṭa te nag po/ mig gnyis su nyi ma la rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser/ dpral bar nyi ma la yan lag thams cad kye 476

༄/ /dril bu lusadakyil gyimangonatogasamadorabasdus/lus dbang gi rang bzhin rta mchog gi ngo bo phaṭa haṃ ljang gu/ gtso mo'i lte bar nyi ma la rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ baṃ dmar po/ snying gar nyi ma la gshin rje ma'i ngo bo haṃ yo sngon po/ mgrin par zla ba la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo bhā mo dkar po/mgo bor nyi ma la skyod byed ma'i ngo bo tho tho ser po/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūṃ hūṃ ljang gu/ dpral par nyi ma la yan lag thams cad kyi lus dbang gi rang bzhin tsaṇ+ḍi ga'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud khas mtshan par gyur/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la ā dmar po/thugs gar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ tho rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ 'od zer snying gar thim/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ arnya pra tīts+tsha ā hūṃ/ ma rtu baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shuste sarba dha spro yo ga shurnyo ྅rta/ oṃ a: pra nywats+tsha 〉 rtu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab bas/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sti ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs zhing dbang bskur bas gtso bo la rdor sems/ phag mo la mi bskyod pa/ mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi la rin 'byung / thugs 'khor gyi lha rnams la mi bskyod pa/gsung 'khor gyi lha rnams la snang mtha'/ sku 'khor gyi lha rnams la rnam snang /dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la don grub kyis dbu brgyan cing dbang gi lha rnams rang la thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnya nas shasta'i bar dang /oṃ badz+ra waṃ ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ she hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ ti ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra mu ra dze hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ha sru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lā sru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra gīrte hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rna t+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra blu pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū 477

༄/ /yo ca gas pa'i r+yā sa ཿma/pa badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra sa badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ spar+sha badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dha rmā dhā tu badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces rig ma bcu drug gisamachod/ bsdu na/ shasta'i rjes su oṃ ya badz+ra ād r+sha hūṃ/ debazhin du/ wi ṇi garnyi ra sa sparnye dharme zhes rig ma drug gis mchod/ de nayodrin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza larnya ra pa/nag po spyod pa/ gu rgya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ te lo pa/ nā ro pa la sogs brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ gzhan yang chos skyongasrung ma la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ rang gi lce la bdud rtsi bzhag la/ oṃ a mṛ ta ā ྅/ mgron thams cad bdud rtsis tshim par gyur/yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi dang khyad par lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen pos rang dang lha thams cad kyis bde ba chen po nyams su myong zhing /bde ba de dang stong pa nyid ro gcig tu gyur pa'i de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas dgyes par gyur/ de nas yab yum gyi snying po nye snying gnyis gnyis dang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi sogs kyi sngags brjod pas sngags mchod bya/ spro na sngagayodang bod skad kyi rkang brgyad ci rigs pas bstod cing / bsdu na te ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ / rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang / / rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ / rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/ / gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing / / 'du dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ / dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma/ / kun la bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ phreng ba mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/ yab yum gyi thugs gar nyigadan la hūṃ dang baṃ gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba'i dbus kyi ye ge las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs spros/ 'gro ba'i don byas dbus kyi yi ge la thom par 478

༄/ /dril bu lus dkyil gyimangon rtogasamador bsdus/gyur par bsam la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ki hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā kyi nā dzī la shaṃ bar swāhā/ gtso bo'i snying po'o/ /oṃ hrī ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nyesnying ngo / oṃ badz+ra bai ro ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ṭ+wāṃ hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ ༷/ ༷hā/nyebye ṭ+wāṃ / snyerdo ༵༷/ oṃ/ḍā kyi sa ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ṭ+wāṃ ngh+ru ༵ ༵ ye ༵rdo ༵ṭ+wāṃ oṃ ya ma ma tha ṭī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar 'khomagyi sngags rgyas pa'am/ shin tu bsdus pa byed na/ oṃ ṛ 113 rmā/ ke khaṃ gi s+t+waṃ ram̐/ rtsa tsho rdza rnyi haṃ/ ṭaṃ shā ḍi rnye ṇi/te baṃ rda t+t+waṃ ne+e/ paṃ pho baṃ snyi/ yi ram̐ li waṃ/ shaṃ ṣe saṃ haṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces kyang rung ngo / de nas oṃ oṃ ha/ na ma nyi/ sā hā hū/ bo ṣaṭa he/ hūṃ hūṃ ho/ phaṭa haṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dang oṃ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yo/ hrī mo/ tho tho/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces go cha'i sngags bzla/ spro na yab yum gyi phreng sngags gnyis kyang 'don/ de nas te ru ga'i yig brgya bzlas la/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/thorang gi thugs gar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ lha rnams kyi ljags la hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar po nas 'bru tsam 'khod ba'i 'od zer gyi spu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a ra li ho dza ཿ baṃ ho badz+ra ḍā kyi n+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ tri sh+ya nyo tshar gcig gis gtso bo/ tshar gnyis pas yum/ tshar gsum pas rnal 'byor ma bzhi la 'bul/ oṃ ka ra sogs rtsa sngags tshar gcig gis 'khor lo gsum gye lha tshogs dang / badz+ra a ra li sogs tshar gnyis kyis sgo ma bzhi dang mtshamayom bzhi la dbul/ oṃ saze ta thāg ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇ+ḍa la wī ra yo gi dī badz+ra a: pratīts+tsha 〉 rtu swāhā/ nas/ shasta'i bar gyes mchod/ de la oṃ ā rtu/ btags pas nang mchod dbul/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ srid pa dang 479

༄/ /yo cabasapa'i po ga ཿmamanyam zhi ba'i chags bcom kun tu rtog pa 'joms/ / khyod ni dngos po mtha' dag mkha' ltar gzigs pa dang ldan pa/ /mgon po shin tu brtse bas lce ba'i chus brlan thugs kyi chus/ /mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzod/ / cesapasagasol ba gdab/ de nasadur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong klu la sogs pa thams cad skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las bde mchog gi lha yab yum gyi skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kye ljags la hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar po nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa'i 'od zer gyi spu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ kha kha nas 〉rtulaṭa swāhā/ lan gnyis kyis phyogs g.yon dang mtshams g.yas skor du gnasapa ladabul/ oṃ a pra tī ts+tsha swāhā/ /oṃ bahūṃ pra tī ts+tsha sāhā/ oṃ badz+ra buṣ+pe 〉 rtu swāhā/ nas/ shasta ā ( swāhā/ phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā :/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lusadang / zhesapanas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /yig brgya bzla/oṃ yo ga shurnya sadra dha rmā yo ga shusgo ྅nya/ oṃ badz+ra mu 'jig rten pa rnams rangaganas su gshegs shing / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bdag nyid la thim paragyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams snang bar byas te 'od du gyur pas/ srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang gtso bo yab yum la thim/ lus dkyil gye lha rnams rang rang gi gnas su thim/ gzhi'i te ru ka yabayum hūṃ yig la thim/ hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las he ru ka sngon po zhal gcigaphyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum dang bcas par gyur pa'i thugs gar zla ba la rdo rje sem4dpa'i ngo bo oṃ ha dkar po/ nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer 480

༄/ /drilakhu lusadakyil gyimangonalhagasamador bsdus/bzhir nyi gdan la snu dzā nas/ ku rnams thig les brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sum+bha ni susta sogayozhal bzhi pa'i sngagasabarjod/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ / 'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ / rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems dbang ldan/ / te ru ka dpal de dang lhan cig gar byed shog / lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / / des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ / bden pa 'di dag gis ni lha mo rnams/ / bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / sems can kun gyi don gye phyir/ / bdag ni te ru kur gyur nas/ / sems can thams cad he ru ga'i/ / go 'phang mchog la 'god par shog / ces bsngo smon dang bkra shisakyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / thun mtshamalosu gang snang thams cad te ru ga'i thugs bde stong gi rnam rol tubalta zhing spyod lam kun phyag rgya dang sngags sumos pas tshogs bde blag lardzogasapar bya/ zasalaspyod tshe/ lag pa g.yas su snod rnam snang gi ngo bo ho dkar po las skyes pa'i 'khor lo'i steng nas g.yon par snang mtha'i rang bzhin ha dmar po las skyes pa'i pad+mas bkab pa'i nang gi zas kyi steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hrī sngon po mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin gyis mtshan par gyur/ha ho hrī gsum/ kha dog dri nus kyi skyon sbyangs nas bdud rtsir bsgyur/trī 'i g.yas g.yon dang mdun du oṃ 〉 rtu gis mtshan pa zhu bas rgya cher spel zhing byin gyis brlab par gyur/ oṃ yā rtu/ lan gsum brjod/ phud kyis bla ma lhal mchod cing bde stong gi mo4pabartan po bya/ o yo ga shu sadru dhaspo yo ga shurnyo ྅ haṃ/ lce hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od kyi spu gus drangs te snying ga'i bde chen 'khor lo'i lha la phul bas tshim par bsams pa nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du spyod pa ni dus rgyun du byed dgosal/ 'di'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud las yar ngo mar ngo'i tshesabacu la lag mchod dang tshogayo'akhor sogasakyiyodapa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams 481

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'isgronasa'i khrung ཿmamanyes par byed par gsung zhing / slob dpon drilabu pa'i dgongs pa'ang zas kyi rnal 'byor dang dkyus gcig tu byed pa 'di yin pas/ de ltar na byin rlabs gong bzhin byas pa'i 'phror/ g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams rtse bsdus nas/ g.yas pas mtheb srin gyes nang mchod blangs te 'bru gsum gyis g.yon pa bsangs la/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong la zla gdan/ gzhan bzhi dang sen mo bsdus par nyi ma'i gdan la rdor sems sogs kyi ngo bo oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hūṃ/ bo ṣaṭa te/ hūṃ hūṃ ) phaṭa haṃ rnams dang / g.yon pa'i mthil du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte ba dang / shar nas g.yon skor gye 'dab ma rnams la phag mo sogs kyi ngo bo oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yo/ bhā tho/ ze gro/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/g.yon pa'i rgyab kyi bol la 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs gzugs brnyan bzhin du gsal zhing / lag pa'i sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams rnams kyang ltung byed ma sogs kyi ngo bor gyur/ go cha'i sngags dang ṛ dzā sogs brjod cing nang mchod g.yon pa'i phyi nang kun tu byugs/ zas rnams de'i lha tshogs kun la phul bar mos te 'bru gsum dang rkang brgyad kyi sngags brjod/ oṃ acha sogs kyis chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams dang / go cha'i sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dbul/yig brgya'i lhag chad bskang / 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ lag par 'gos pa'i rdzas rnams bsdus te/ hūṃ yu oṃ/ zhes brjod cing g.yon pa'i srin lag gis snying ga dang lce dang mgor byugs pas/ lag pa'i lha rnams spyi bo nas zhugs te rang la thim par bsam mo/ lag mchod kyi rdzas de'i phyed ka zas la bsre/ phyed snod du bsagasan longs spyod 'phel ba dang / lus la byugs na srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/tshogs 'khor byed na rgyas pa'am/ shin tu bsdus pa thu'u bkwan rin po che'i gsung bzhin bya/ nyal ldang khrus kyi rnal 'byor sogs kyang ji lta ba bzhin lag len du bstar te yang dag pa'i lam bzang 'di la bag chagasazebs nges pas dal 'byor don dang ldan par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni su nyid shog na4tshula'adi la mos brtson lhur byed cing lhag 482

༄/ /dril bu lus dkyil gyimangonatogasamadorabasdus/bsam dang rnam dpyod phul du byung ba'i zhabs drung dkon mchog rnam rgyal gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rje bla ma'i gsung dang / phyi nang gi 'dor len byed tshul bzang skyong ba'i slob ma mkhas dbang chos kyi gragasapas gsal bar phye ba dang / de'i don bzhin lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa gong mas mdzad pa sogs la gzhi byas/ rgyal ba dben sa pa dang paṇa chen chos rgyan sogs kyis bsdu tshul dang bstun te bris pa yin kyang / rje'i gsung gi tshig zur re la'ang don dang dgos pa che bas thub na cis kyang de'i steng nas bya dgos la/ blo ha cang rtul bas mi zin pa dang /brel bas long med byung tshe 'di'i steng nas nyams len ma chag pa byas na legs so/'di'ang lus can mtha' dag dpal 'khor lo sdom pas rjes su'adzin pa'i rgyur gyur ༵ /phro/gab dī ༵ dī rtoX ༵sdi~X ngh+ru/ pa'i /sdudi ༷༷ dhi/cig/ /rta ṭ+wāṃm ga ༵dī rdo ṭ+wāṃdī ra/ / myur ba myur bar bdag gi rgyud la zhugs/ / snying dbus lhan skyes dpyid kyi te ru ka / / rjes chags tilga ga dngos rnal 'byor mar/ / mi 'bral rtag tu mnyam sbyor dga' ba'i sgras/ / gnas gsum mkha' 'gro mtha' dag mgron du khugs/ / dbang bzhi'i drod gsher bcud du lon pa yis/ / rtsa khams sa bon yongs smin 'khor lo lnga'i/ / lha tshogs dgyes dgur rtsen pa'i gar stabs kyis/ / sdig ltung las nyon bdud sde cham la phobs/ / rab 'byams lha tshogs snang ba'i chu 'dzin 'phreng / / spro bsdu'i yum chen shes rab dbyings kyi mkhar/ / dga' pas rol pa phyi nang mkha' spyod kyi/ / rdo rje'i grong du 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mdzod/ / ji srid bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug gis/ / rang gi gnas su 'god pa de srid bdag /'bral med thugs kyi sras su yongs bzung ste/ / srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun las sgrol gyur cig / / /483

ro༅/ /gud 11daces ga kha 'bum༄༅/ / dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rim snyeng po'i don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpa' gcig gi bskyed rim ni/ rags pa bcu gsum ma'i dang po sbyor ba yan chad dang 'dra bas tho tsam la sgos chos rnams kyis cung zad zur brgyan te 'god pa ni/ lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs shing dbang thob/ dam tshig gtsang ba'i sgrub pa pos gnas dang yo byad spyod lam sogs rgyud dang mthun bar byas te kun slong bcos/ rang la tha mal gyi snang zhen 'gog pa'i phyir lus 'od du sbyangs nas pad nyi la 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur dkrong gis bskyed/las sngags brjod cing khro bo spros te bgegs bskrad/ stong par sbyangs te de kho na'i ngang las snang tsam pa sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam rol tu rlung me'i dkyil 'khor/mi mgo rlon pa'i sgyed bu/ de la gnas pa'i thod pa dum bu gcig pa bde stong mtshon byed/ de'i nang du gshegs pa lnga'i sa bon las sha lnga dang / yum lnga'i sa bon las bdud rtsi lnga rang rang gi ming yig dang pos mtshan pa/ steng du thugasagasung sku rdo rje'i ngo bo yi ge gsum brtsegs mar gnas pa lhung ste zhu bas/ chos dbyings ye shes kyis ma dag pa'i nyes pa'i rtsa ba sbyangs/ tshe dpag med gsung rdo rje'i sa bon gyis 'chi med bdud rtsir byas/ gzugs kyi phung pos rab tu phye ba rnam snang gis mang por spel bar bsams la sems 484

༄/ /dpa' bogacigapa'ibaskyed rimasnyeng bo'idon gsal/can thams cad kyi sgo gsum gyi nyes pa'ang sbyangs par bsams te 'bru gsum brjod/ phyogs skyong gi mchod pa kun kyang bde stong mtshon pa'i snod du bde stong gi sa bon kho na las/ rang bzhin/ rnam pa/ byed las kyi khyad par gsum gsum dang ldan par bskyed cing rdo rje gsum gyi bar du bcug pas byin gyes brlab/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma nang mchod ltar brlabs la/ de dag bkug nas so so'i phyogs su 'khod pa 'od gsal du bcug ste 'jigs byed kyi skur bsgom/ ljags byin gyes brlabs shing rtsa sngags kyis lha la phud dbul/so so'i sngags nye snying dang spel bas chos rgyal yab yum/ lha mo/ las bzhi'i gshin rje rnams dang / snying po dang brgya byin sogs phyogs skyong gzhan gyi ming spel bas de dag la phul te 'azin las bcol/ yig brgya'i skabs so so'i rigs bdag gi thugs ga'i hūṃ la yig brgyas bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dbab pas de dag gi thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa kun sbyangs par bsams/badz+ra 4 zhes phyir bkyed de phyogs de dang der bya ra byed cing bzhugs par bsams/ bdag skyed mchod pa'ang 'dra bas/ 'di dag ni thun mgor bya rgyu'i skor ro/ /thun dngos gzhi sku gsum lam 'khyer gyis bsdus pas/ dang po la chos sku'i lam 'khyer dngos dang de'i sngon du skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las gsog pa dang mtshungs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa gnyis te/ de'ang bla ma rigs bdag tu bzhugs pa'i 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs pa la phyag mchod sgrub pa'i mchod pa'i mchog sdom gzung sogs zhing khyad par can la brten pa dang / tshad med bzhi bsgom ste zhing phal pa la brten pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog tshul gnyis yod/ ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pa dang chos sku'i lam 'khyer dngos gnyis stabs gcig tu bya ba ni bcu gsum ma'i skabs 45

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/yab yum gye sbyor mtshams nas kyang 'od zer spro ba byed la/ 'dir thugs ga'i hūṃ kho na las spros pa'i 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad zhu ba rang dang /de'ang stod smad nas thugs ga'i hūṃ la bsdu zhing / mthar nā da'ang mi dmigs par yal ba'i stong sang la mnyam par bzhag ste sngags gnyis kyi don 'bras dus kye ye shes chos sku'i nga rgyal 'dzin/ nga rgyal de'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du bla'i zur gcig gis 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs/ srung ba'i 'khor lo/gzhal yas khang gdan bcas gsal 'deb dgos la/ 'byung bzhi rang rang gi sa bon las skyed tshul spyi dang 'dra'ang / rlung dkyil 'og ma bzhin nag la dmar mdangs chags pa'i dud khar byed pa ni 'di mngon spyod gtso che ba'i sgos chos yin/ 'byung bzhi'i steng gi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūṃ las 'od zer kun tu 'phros pas rdo rje drug cu rtsa bzhi re'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ rwa ba/gur/ bla re dang bcas pa bskal pa'i me dpung 'khrugs pas klubs pa'i srung 'khor thun mong ba bsgom/ za ma tog tu srung 'khor thun mong ma yin pa zhal 'phang tsam mdzad la/ bdud las rnam rgyal du gsal bar mdzad pa ni dgongs pa shin tu zab ste/ lha 'di sgrub pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo nor bu'i gling du 'jug pa'i ded dpon bzhin chos sgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog pa dang /yang de'i rkyen sel tsam ma yin par gdul bya dbang po mchog rnams las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dga' bzhis 'od gsal 'grub cing / de las sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pas pha ma'i rgyud kyi zab gnad gnyi ga tshang tshul/༷ ṭ+wāṃg/ ṭ+wāṃ /rdo la/ ṭ+wāṃ / ༷༷ rdo ༷ ༷ /t+t+waṃX ༷ di hūṃ ༷ teg ༷nyi ༷rayo ༵sapa ༵ da/ pa// ༵ gcig pa'i sgrub thabs gtso bor mdzad cing / de'i gnad kyis khro bcu'i srung 'khor yang rtsal 'don mdzad la/ sgrub thabs kyi mtshan yang bdud las rnam 486

༄/ / dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rimasnyeng bo'idon gsal/rgyal zhes btags so/ / dgos pa phyi ma'i dbang du mdzad de yum bcas bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs mdzad cing / rgyud don gyi nor bu ma lus pa 'di'i nang nas blang du yod pas za ma tog ces btags so/ / tshul 'di rgyud dang grub chen kun gyi dgongs pa'ang yin te/ saspu ṭa'i rab byed nyer brgyad par dpa' bo gcig pa'i cho ga gsal bar gsungs la/ der gzhan dang thun mong du khro bcu'i srung 'khor yang gsungs pas/ rje bla mas kyang khro bcu skyed tshul sogs rgyud kyi dgongs pa man snyer bkral pa bzhin mdzad do/ / kun mkhyen bla ma sku snga phyis kyang tshogs khang du dpa' bo gcig pa la khro bo bcus bskor ba dmigs rten du bri bar mdzad pa'ang dgag bya chung la dgos pa che ba'i gnad 'di thugs la bzhag pa yin no/ / de sgom tshul ni/ dbyibs mdung lcags gnyis kyi ting ba sprad pa lta bu'i spub stong nang du gnod mdzes bsgoms te/snyoms 'jug gi sbyor bas khro bcu zhal du drangs pa zhu ste yum gye pad+mar phab pa so so'i mdog can gyi dzig le bcu dang / de hūṃ bcu/ de khro bo bcur gyur te mngalanas spros/ rtsibs so sor gdan sum rtseg re yod pa'i steng du 'khod par bsams la gnad lnga dang ldan pa'i sgo nas khro bcu'i sngags bzla/ gnod mdzes rdor sems su bsgyur ba ni chos 'byung dang / de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar t+t+waṃ dang 'khor lo las rnam snang skyed/ 'di'i phyag mtshan gyi 'khor lo rdo rje phyed pa'i yu ba can du 'ga' zhig bshad kyang de tsam gri gug la'ang yod la/ 'dis rdo rje'ang 'dzin par bskyed rim chen mo las gsungs pas phyed pa yin min brtag dgos/ de las bsgrubs pa'i gzhal yas khang ni rgya dpangs sogs kyi khyad par zhib tu thig gis gtan la 'bebs dgos shing / bcu gsum ma dang 'dra la/ 'on kyang 'dir pha gu'i kha dog ser por byed pa dang / nang gi blum skor ni bcu gsum 487

༄/ /yo ca bayo 4sgroname'i g.yo ཿma/ma la rtsa thig dang tshangs thig 'phrad mtshams nas cha chung gcig nang du 'ongs te bskor yang / 'dir phyed kyi tshad nas bskor dgos pas/ gzhi la re mig dgur byas na gtso bo'i gnas ha cang chung bar 'gyur bas/ bdud las rnam rgyal rang las/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes 'byung ba bzhin du bya dgos la/ dpe du mar me mig dgu pa'i zhes 'byung ba ni/ steng du gdung bsnol mar 'phang tshe re mig dgu 'byung ba'i don yin kyang de dang lha gnas bstun mi dgos pas bri bya la'ang mi dgos so/ / gzhal yas khang bsgom pa ni gang du skye ba len pa'i gnas dang rnam pa mtshungs shing ma dag pa'i snod spyong ba dang / 'bras dus kyi dag pa'i gzhal yas khang 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /de nas longs sku'i 'a ma 'khyer ni/ ngag tu 'don pa'i tshe bar du 'gyang che'ang / yid ngor chos sku'i nga rgyal las bar ma chad par ldang ba yin pas/ gzhi la 'chi ba 'od gsal las lugs ldon gi nyer thob tu ldang ba na bar do 'grub pa srang mda'i mtho dman bzhin yin pa dang rnam pa mi mthun pa'i skyon med de/ gzhi la skye ba len pa'i gnas rang chas su yod kyang / 'dir blo'i zur gyis gsal ma btab par byar med pa'i khyad tsam yin no/ /de'ang chos sku'i ngang tsam du gnas pas gdul bya'i don du mi 'gyur bar mthong ste/ las kyi bar do sbyangs nas 'bras dus kyi longs skur ldang snyam pa'i 'phen pas/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs pa rje btsun gyi mkhyen pa dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i dhī ser po rang sgra sgrogs bzhin pa dang /de las ral gri gyen 'greng yu ba rdo rje phyed pa'i lte bar ji sa mtshan pa/ de las spros pa'i 'od kyis rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs te thim pa las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dpal gzhung bzhin skyed/ 'di'i zla ba/ sa bon/ phyag mtshan/ sku bzhis/ gzhi lam 488

༄/ / dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rim snying bo'idon gsal/'bras bu gsum ga'i skabs kyi bsgrub gzhi'i phra ba'i rlung sems dang / des bsgrubs pa'i ngag/ yid/ lus te bzhi bzhi mtshon no/ / sprul sku'i lam 'khyer ni/ sgyu ma'i lus de tsam gyis kyang gzhan don mi rdzogs pas/ tha mal gyes mthong nus pa'i rags pa'i sprul sku gzung snyam pa byas la/ 'jam dpal gyi thugs gar don gyi 'od gsal mtshon pa'i nyi dkyil bsams shing / de'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te rang nyid 'jam dpal du gsal ba dang bcas lhan cig tu nyi ma la zhugs pas/ nyi dkyil dpag tshad stong phrag brgyar khyab pa gdug pa can sreg bar byed pa'i 'od zer tsha sreg 'bar ba de lta bur gyur par bsam/gongagi zla dkyil bsgom pa zla ba'am me long ye shes las byang chub pa/ de'i steng du dhī bskyed pa nas 'di'i bar nyi ma dang mnyam nyid ye shes las byang chub pa yin/ yang de'i dbus kyi hūṃ yig 'od zer lnga ldan rang sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs pa las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas sras bcas 'jigs byed kyi rnam par spyan drangs te hūṃ la bstems pas khro bo'i rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur pa 'di sa bon dang phyag mtshan las byang chub pa'am sor rtog ye shes las byang chub pa yin/ yang hūṃ las rdo rje phra mo'i tshogs spros pa yongs su gyur pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis zhing khams rab 'byams su 'gro don mdzad/ sems can thams cad 'jigs byed kyi skur gyur te/ phar spros pa'i lha rnams dang lhan du tshur 'dus nas rdo rje hūṃ dang bcas pa la thim/ dang po nas gdan gyi tshul du yod pa'i zla ba dang / de'i steng gi nyi ma/ rdo rje/ sa bon thams cad gcig tu 'dres par bsams pa ni bya sgrub ye shes las byang chub pa'am skad gcig ma gcig la mngon par byang chub pa yin la/ de las rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i skur bskyed pa ni sku rdzogs pa las sam chos 489

༄/ /yo cabalo ༅sgonapo ga 4ma/dbyings ye shes las byang chub pa yin no/ / gong gi zla ba nayo'adi'i bar gyis pha ma'i khu khrag dang / der mtshams sbyobazhing rim gyis 'phel te phyir btsas pa dang chos mthun sbyor tshul sogs yod la/ sku'i nyams dang zhal gyi 'khor lugs/ phyag bsgrig tshul/ phyag mtshan dang zhabs 'og gi srog chags so so'i khyad par sogs dkyus su gsal zhing zhib par gzhan las shes dgos/skye mched byin rlabs ni/ lcags bsregs pa me'i ngo bor song ba bzhin rnam pa mig sogs su snang yang / ngo bos snying sogs kyi rang bzhin du bsams dgos la/ ma mtha'a'ang skye mched so sor lha so so'i ngo bo yi ge rnams me long la gzugs brnyan bzhin snang bar bsgom/ sems dpa' gsum ni ye shes pa 'phro 'du'i gzhir gyur bas dam tshig sems dpa'/ bde stong ye shes kyi ngo bo tsam yin pas ye shes sems dpa'/ gang la dmigs nas ting 'dzin mchog skye bas ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ste/ rags pa'i lus/ phra ba'i lus/ phra ba'i sems gsum dang chos mthun pa dang / 'bras dus kyi rags pa'i sprul sku/sgyu ma/ 'od gsal gsum yang mtshon no/ / de dag gis tha mal gyi skye shi bar do gsum sbyong zhing lam gyi sku gsum smin par byas te 'bras bu'i sku gsum sgrub pa'i bskyed rim gye gnad tshang ngo / / 'o na sku gsum po de'ang 'dod chags kyi chos kyis thob par bstan pa'i phyir rig ma 'du bya ba ni bskyed rim 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod byed du 'gro ba dang / rim pa 'dir 'dod yon lam du byed tshul bskyed rim gyi gnad mthar thug tu bshad pa ma yin nam/ dpa' gcig la de ma tshang bar bskyed rim mtshan nyid pa ji ltar 'byung snyam na skyon med de/mtshan ma gyen 'greng gis bde chen mtshon par gsungs pa bzhin dga' bzhis drangs pa'i bde stong spyor bar nus la/ ligo li ya ti zhes pa sbas don du bshad pa'i tshe bha gar thim pa la 'jug cing / rgyun du yum med na'ang 490

༄/ /dpa' bo gcigapa'i barma rimasnying bo'idon gsal/dmigasabasal gyi tshe yod chog pa dbang dang gsang mchod lta bu yin pas ma tshang ba min no/ / der ma zad gzhan gyi bskyed rim la ma mtha' lha lnga tshang dgos kyang / 'dir dpa' bo gcig pa la bskyed rim rung ba phyag mtshan gyi gnad yin par gsungs te/ zhe dgu ma'i skabs phyag mtshan dang zhabs 'og gi srog chags rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i rang bzhin du bshad pa'i gnad kyis yin no/ / 'o na phung po lnga rigs lnga dang / gzhal yas khang rnam snang gi rang bzhin yin pas gang la yin kyang lha'i 'khor lo tshang bar 'gyur ro zhe na/phung po lnga de'i rang bzhin tsam yin kyang so sor phye ste lha gnas su bkod pa med pas 'di dang mi mtshungs te/ lha'i gnas bzung nas bkod tshe dgra nag gi thod pa bzhi'ang grangs phan du byas te lha bcu bdun zhes grags pa bzhin no/ / sngags rim las bla med gzhan gyi bsnyen pa la lha'i 'khor lo tshang ba dgos kyang 'di dmigs bsal du gsungs pa'i don/ 'ga' zhig dpa' gcig la dpa' gcig gi bsnyen pas go chod mi chod dogs pa med pas/ bcu gsum ma la'ang des go chod zer ba don min te/ de'i dgongs pa gsang 'dus gtso bo gcig pur bsnyen pa btang nas de'i zur bka'i dbang skur tshul bshad pa med la/ 'di'i gtso bo gcig pu la bsnyen pa btang stode'i sgo nas dbang skur du yod pa dang / dbang gis ji ltar smin par byas pa bzhin dpa' bo gcig pa la brten nas rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bskyang du yod pa'i don no/ / de nas ye shes pa spyan drangs te dgug gzhug bcing mnyes/dbang lhas dbang bskur te rigs nges par bya ba'i phyir rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod cing bstod pa bya ba sogs spyi dang 'dra la/ bcu gsum mar 'khor rnams kyis bstod pa'i dod/ 'dir thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis brag cha'i dbyangs bzhin bstod par 491

༄/ /gung thangangastan pa'izlanama'igasung 'bum/mos pa yin no/ / rgyas par na kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas/ phyi nang gsang ba de nyid bzhis mchod bstod/ / lha mnyes tshogs rdzogs 'dod yon lam byed myur/ / zhes pa ltar yin pas yum gsal 'deb pa 'gal ba med par bshad zin to/ / de nas ma te'i zhal rwa sngon po zeng nge ba'am/shangs bug zangs dung dmar po bsregs pa bzhin dmar hur re ba lta bu 'charagang bde zhig nas brtsams te snga ma ma shor ba'i ngang nas dmigs pa bsnan gyin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la sems gzung / de nas zhal phyag rim par bsnan te yongs su rdzogs pa thog mar spyi bam dang / rjes su rgyan cha lugs spyan dkar nag gi cha phra mo tshun chad la gsal snang dang / de dang de dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan pos tha mal gyi snang zhen bzlog cing / de thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'i rnam rol tu blta ba'i zab gsal gnyis med kyi ngang du sems 'dzin/ de la sems brtan pa na steng 'og gi sna rtser thig le bsgom pa sogs bskyed rim phra mo la slob tshul gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ skyon dag pa dran pa gzhung bzhin te/ lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam pa thams cad mtshon zhing / bde stong gi ye shes gcig nyid rnam pa cir yang 'char ba'i gsang ba'i gnad la nges pa bskyed par bya'o/ / de nas 'phreng ba 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bskyed bstem 'od zhu sogs bya zhing / bzlas pa ni/ sbrags sgrub byed na ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ga'i nyi gdan zla gdan dang hūṃ yig dhī yig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol 'khor lo'i rtsibs drug la a ra pa tsa bkod de rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mkhyen rab bsdus par bsams la bzla/ de nas phyir bsgyur te hūṃ gi mthar nye snying tshar gsum/ de'i phyi skor la snying po tshar gnyis/ de'i phyir rtsa sngags rnams kyis g.yas skor du bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis lus thams cad gang bas sdig sgrib 492

༄/ / dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rimasnying bo'idon gsal/nad gdon thams cad sbyangs/ dbugs phyir 'gro ba na hūṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'jigs byed kyi sku'am 'od zer grangs med spros te sna bug g.yas nas thon/ sems can thams cad gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod dbugs tshur rngub pa dang lhan cig sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te spro gzhi la thim pa'i dmigs pa bya/ gegs 'tshub shin tu che ba lta bu'i tshe me dang khro bo'i tshogs spros pas gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad bsregs te thal bar brlag par bsam/ res 'ga' spro bsdu mi byed par dmigs rten la rtse gcig tu sems gtad de bsgom zhing / myur bul chad lhag sogs kyi skyon dang bral ba/ zhal thams cad nas 'ur 'ur sgogs pa'i mos pa byed tshul sogs man ngag bzhin bya/ bzlas pa zin nas rigs bdag gi thugs gar zla gdan la hūṃ yig gi mthar yig brgya dkar pos bskor ba las babs pa'i bdud rtsis chad lhag sogs kyi nyes pa byang bar bsams te yig brgya bzla/ thun gyi mthar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas 'das ma 'das kyi mgron spyan drangs/lngags byin gyis brlabs te dbul zhing 'phrin las bcol nas gshegs su gsol ba dang / gtang rag gi mchod bstod/ nyer bsdu/ bsngo bas mtha' brgyan pa sogs dkyus ltar bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dge slong ngag dbang don grub dang / yu cu mu chin shog gi dka' bcu blo bzang nor ldan sogs kyiyosnga phyir yang yang bskul pa'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngagasaram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / /na mo gu ru badz+ra snyi ra wā ya/ 'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rdzogs rim nyams su len tshul mdor bsdus te bshad pa ni/ lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs shing sngags kyi sgor zhugs te dam sdom tshul bzhin du bsrung bskyed rim sngon du btang ste/ nye ba'i sngon 'gro rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ bla 493

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i ma'i g.yo 'bumama'i3la 'byor thun mong ma yin pa/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs dang bcas spyi ltar byas la/ lus kyi gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan/ dus kyi gnad tho rangs dang phyi dro/ yul gyi gnad rang 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa yum bcas su gsal ba'i lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus/ rlung gi gnad rlung ro bsal nas stoms par gyur pa'o/ / rlung ro sel tshul lus kyi dbus su dbu ma gro sog tsam/ g.yas su ro ma dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po/ dang po'i yar sne smin mtshams dang gzhan gnyis sna'i sbu gu'i thad/ mar sne gsum ga rtags kyi bu ga dang mnyam pa/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa kha thur lta/mgrin par bcu drug pa gyen lta/ snying gar brgyad pa thur lta/ lte bar re bzhi pa gyen lta/ gsang gnas su so gnyis pa thur lta/ mgrin pa dang snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gyis mtshams kyi dbyibs blum po/ gzhan rnams gru gsum/ rtsa rnams mdud pas ma bcings par har re byed par mos la/ ro ma'i mar sne rkyang mar bcug ste g.yas nas lan gsum rngub pas ro ma brgyud cing rkyang ma'i zhar 'khum sogs kyi skyon bsal te drang zhing gsal bar gyur par bsams la g.yon nas 'bud/ dmigs pa de las bzlog ste g.yas nas lan gsum bus/gnyi ga'i sne dbu mar bcug la gnyis ka nas mnyam du rngub pa'i rlung gis dbu ma'i skyon sbyangs par bsams la mnyam du 'bud pa gsum ste dgu phrugs su byed pa yin no/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa skyong tshul la/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor/dam tshig gi rnal 'byor/ dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor/ rnam dag ye shes kye rnal 'byor bzhi/ dang po la lte bar gnad du bsnun tshul dang / snying gar rdor bzlasabyed tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa dang 'khor lo gong bzhin bsgoms pa'i byu tī'i mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi tsam gyi sar rang gi rnam shes 'od kyi thig leragasal bas sku'i rnam pa kun la blta/ de nas byu tī'i nang gyen la hril 494

༄/ / dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rimasnying bo'idon gsal/gyis song ste spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su phyin nas rtsa 'khor 'og ma rnams blta/ snying ga lte ba sogs su 'ongs nas yar mar la blta zhing yar 'gro mar 'gro byas te lam sbyangs/ der gsal snang thon pa na thig le de nyid lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su nyi gdan la ye shes sems dpa' 'jigs byed dpa' bo phyagaganyis pa yum bcas rgya sran tsam gyi skur bzhengs/ de'i thugs gar nyi gdan la hūṃ yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can yungs 'bru tsam gyes mtshan par bsam/ der sems brtan pa na lte ba'i ye shes sems dpa' yab yum stoms par zhugs pa'i 'od kyis ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad sbyangs te dag pa'i rten brten par gyur cing rim gyis bsdus pa dam tshig sems dpa' dang / de ye shes sems dpa'/ de hūṃ yig/ de'ang zhabs kyu nas bsdus te nā da la sems 'dzin cing / dbang po rab kyis nā da'ang mi dmigs par bsams nas lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus kyi thad der sems bzung bas zhugs gnas thim gsum 'byung la/ zhugs pa'i rtags mnyam rgyu shed mtshungs/ gnas rtags sna bug nas rgyu ba chad cing lto ba mi 'gul/thim rtags 'byung bzhi dzim tshe smig rgyu du ba me khyer mar me lta bu'i snang ba dang /snabamached thob gsum so so'i rang dus su dkar lam dmar lam nag lam 'char zhing 'od gsal gye tshe ston gnam g.ya' dag lta bu'i nyams 'char ro/ / 'od gsal de la gnas bzhin pa'i ngang nas blo'i zur gcig gis lha'i sku dang rtsa 'khor sngar bzhin la spyi bor haṃ yig mgo thur lta dang snying gar hūṃ yig byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin can/ mgrin par gtum mo'i me'i rang bzhinayā dmar po dang lte bar yang a thung shad kyi rnam pa zla tshes thig le dang bcas pa bsams la sna bug gnyis nas rlung rngub pa ro rkyang brgyud de yum gyidabu ma'i rlung dang lhan cig rang gi dbu mar zhugs/ lte ba'i a thung la 495

༄/ /gung ca bayo ba'ithonama'i gsung ཿmaphog pas 'bar la khad du byed pa me gso ba dang / yang bus pas rgya khab tsam 'bar ba me sbar ba dang / yang bus pas cher 'bar te spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu nas mgrin pa/ snying ga/ lte ba/ gsang gnas kyi rtse'i bar skeb pas dga' bzhi lugs 'byung dang / de las bzlog nas spyi bo'i bar du son pas lugs ldog gidaga' bzhi drangs te lhan skyes kye bde ba dang 'od gsal gnyis sbyar nas bsgoms pa ni sad dus kyi chos sku'i bsre ba yin/ de las 'phen pa'i dbang gis longs sku 'jigs byed du ldang ba na snga ma'i rtags rnams lugs ldog tu 'byung zhing sad dus kyi longs sku'i bsre ba dang / de phung po rnying pa 'jigs byed dam tshig par gsal ba la 'jug pa sad dus kyi sprul sku'i bsre ba'o/ /de goms na gnyid dus kyi bsre ba gsum bsgom zhing / de gnyis gomayol tshe 'dire lam gong ma ma thob na 'chi tshe 'chi dus kyi bsre ba skor gsum bsgom/'di dag ni lus dbon gyi dod thub yin zhing sngags kyi gzhi'i rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa snying gar gnad du bsnun pa'i sngags kyi rnal 'byor dngos la bum pa can dang rdor bzlas sgom tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ thugs ga'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su thig le dmar po 'og dang dkar po steng byas te kha sbyar ba sran chung tsam/ de'i lte bar hūṃ dkar po yungs 'bru tsam bsam par sems bzung la sna bug gnyis nas rlung cung zad rngub mchil ma sgra med cig mid pa dang mnyam du steng rlung srog 'dzin dkar po mar mnan/ 'og rlung thur sel ser po yar drangs te hūṃ la bstem nas bsgoms pas zhugs gnas thim gsum 'byung zhing / sngar bzhin gtum mo sbar bas dga' bzhi drangs la bde stong sbyar te bsre ba gsum sogs bsgom mo/ / rdor bzlas ni lha sku rtsa 'khor thugs ga'idamigs rten hūṃ yig rnams sngar bzhin gsal btab la hūṃ gi nā da las 496

༄/ /dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rimasnyeng bo'idon gsal/rlungaspos rengs kyi du ba phra mo lta bu zhig thon pas hūṃ gi gdangs de spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor bar du song / oṃ gyi gdangs kyis phyir dmigs rten la thim pa na ting la phu btab pa ltar ā 'i gdangs su gan4par bsam pa steng 'gro'i rdor bzlas dang / zhabs kyu nas sngar ltar 'byung 'jug gnas gsum byed pa 'og 'gro/ steng 'og gnyis gcig nas phyir thim pa dang gcig nas phyir 'byung ba mnyam du byed pa 'bros 'ded/ steng 'og gnyi gar mnyam du phyir 'byung ba sogs byed pa ltag sprod de rtsa ba'i rlung gi rdor bzlas bzhi dang / mig gi mngon shes sogs 'grub pa'i phyir rtsa'i rtse mo mig gi sgo sogs su zug par ro/sa layan lag gi rlung lnga'i rdor bzlas byed cing thim rim gyi mthar dga' bzhi 'dren tshul dang bsre ba sogs sngar bzhin bya ste ngag dben gyi lam mo/ / 'di la dang po sngags su phar mos pa tsam dang phyis sngags kyi gdangs su tshur 'char ba'i gsung gi nga rgyal du 'phos pa 'byung la/ gnas ba'ang dang po ched du byed pa dgos kyang phyis ngang gis je ring du song nas de 'ba' zhig par 'gro'o/ / gnyis pa dam tshig gi rnal 'byor ni/ de ltar rdor bzlas kyis rtsa mdud cung zad lhod kyang khyab byed ma 'dus pas/ de bsdu tshul dmigs rten sngar ltaral sems dben gye stong pa dang por 'dren dus pad+ma can sogs las rgya med mi rung yin zhing phyis ye rgya la'ang brten chog pas phyag rgya'i tu tī rang gi sgru tīr bcug / de gnyis nas rlung cung zad re byung ba phrad mtshams su 'khyil/ rlung phra mo re phan tshun gyi dru tīr zhugs pas yab kyi spyi bo nas thig le dkar po dang / yum gyi spyi bo nas thig le dmar po yungs 'bru tsam re phab pa spyor mtshams su kha sbyar bas rtsa rlung thig le'i rdo rje skyil krung gsum byas la/rtsa phran kun gyi rtsa pa dmigs rten la zug / rtse ba sru'i bu ga dang mnyam pa'i 497
