sa / / 18byu gzung 'bum/kharathong zil ba phrom me bar bsam/ dmigs rten las rtsa so so'i nang du rlung du ba lta bu hūṃ gi gdangayokyisa'azos/ sner sleb pa na des sna drangs te rtsa ba'i rlung dang bca4 gyi gdang4kyis 'dus/ dmigs rten la thim ste ā 'i gdangs su gnas pa dang / yang de las 'od 'phros snod bcud dag par bsgyur cing bsdus te rang yab yum dang yum yab la thim pa nas/ mthar dmigs rten la thim pas rtags rnams rim par 'char ro/ / skabs 'dir snying gar dga' bzhi lugs 'byung ldog tu 'dren tshul ni/ lte gsang gi gtum mo sbar bas rlung dang byang sems 'dus pa snying ga'i rtsa 'dab rim pa gsum gyi dang por sleb pa na dga' ba dang stong pa/ bar mar sleb pa na mchog dga' dang shin tu stong pa/ nang mar gleb pa na khyad dga' dang stong chen/ mi shigs pa'i thig le'i ngo bo hūṃ la thim pa na lhan skyes kyi dga' ba dang thams cad stong pa 'od gsal te lugs 'byung dang / de nas phyir rtsa 'dab gsum dang sgo kun tu sleb pas lugs ldog gi dga' bzhi dang stong bzhi 'byung bas lhan skyes kyi dus bde stong sbyor ba sogs sad dus kyi bsre ba gsum dang gnyid dus kyi bsre ba gsum yang sgom dgos so/ / gsum pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor ni/ sgyu lus 'grub tu nye bar mthong pa na sngar ltar phyi'i rkyen las kyi phyag rgya dang stoms par 'jug cing / nang gi rkyen rjes gzhig gi sdud rim la brten nas rlung mtha' dag 'chi rim ji lta ba bzhin snying ga'i mi shigs pa la dzogs par bsdus pas sems dben dpe'i 'od gsal mthar thug grub pa na de'i bzhon pa'i rlung gis nyer len dang / sems rang gis lhan cig byed rkyen byas pa'is lugs ldog gi nyer thob grub pa dang mnyam du dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor rim pa gsum pa'i sgyu ma'i sku rnam smin gyi phung po rnying pa las logs su phye nas 'grub pa rmi lam gyi lus khyad par ba 'ga' zhig dang 'dra la/ lus rags pa 498

༄/ /dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rim snying bo'idon gsal/ltar snang yang des stong pas rlung sems kyi mdangs tsam yin pa sgyu ma lta bu dang / gci ga las du mar sprul nus pa chu zla lta bu/ dpe'i 'od gsal gyi mjug thogs de ma thag rlung tsam las thol gyis 'byung ba chu bur lta bu/mtshanadape sogs kun cha tshang ba gzugs brnyan lta bu ste dpe lnga gsungs la 'dus par dpe bcu gnyis gsungs so/ / sgyu lus pa des kyang sngar ltar phyi nang gi thabs gnyis kyis yang yang 'od gsal du zhugs te yid ngor dag pa'i sgyu ma'i skur ldang ba sogs bya la/ rjes thob tu ldang ba'i tshe phung po rnying pa 'jigs byed du blta ba'i spyi bo nas zhugs te chos ston pa/ stoms 'jug /bza' btung sogs kyi rnal 'byor skyong ba'o/ /bzhi pa rnam dag ye shes kyi rnal 'byor la don gyi 'od gsal 'grub tshul dang / de las zung 'jug gi skur ldang tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ don gyi 'od gsal 'grub tu nye ba'i mtshan ma mthong ba na bogs 'byen gyi spyod pa ci rigs byed cing / 'grub pa'i srod la bla ma tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs kyis mnyes par byas shing des 'od gsal gyi gdams pa bstan pa bzhin phyag rgya bsten pa dang sdud rim gyi thabs gnyis la brten nas phyi'i mngon byang tho rangs g.ya' dag gi dus nang gi mngon byang thams cad stong pa don gyi 'od gsal lam rnam dag ye shes kyi rnal 'byor mngon du byed cing / des nyon sgrib kun btags lhan skyes thams cad kyi dngos gnyen byed cing stong nyid gsar du mngon sum du rtogs pas sngags kyi 'phags lam gye thog ma yinano/ /gnyis pa de las zung 'jug gi skur ldang tshul ni/ 'od gsal de'i tshe ma dag pa'i sgyu ma'i sku rgyun chad kyang dag pa'i sgyu ma'i skur ldang snyam pa'i 'phen pa'i shugs kyis mjug de ma thag 'od gsal des lhan cig byed rkyen dang /de'i bzhon pa'i rlung 'od zer lnga pas nyer len byas te phung po rnying pa las 499

༄/ /gungathang b.lo r+sālhanas gsung ཿmalogs su dag pa'i sgyu lus 'jigs byed dkar po yum bcas kyi skur dngos gnas la ldang ba 'byung / de'i tshe zung 'jug gtso bo ma thob kyang nyon sgrib spangs pa'i spangs pa zung 'jug thob ste dgra bcom par gyur pa yin no/ / de dang mnyam du lugs ldog gi nyer thob nas smig rgyu'i bar gye rtags rnams 'byung ngo / / de nas sdud rim gyi dmigs pa mi dgos par rang bzhin med pa'i stong nyid kyi don bsgoms pa kho nas rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum 'byung bas 'od gsal des sku dag pa sgyu ma'i sku dang / thugs dag pa don gye 'od gsal gnyi ga dngos su tshang ba'i slob pa'i zung 'jug thob la 'di nas shes sgrib spong ba'i mgo tshugs so/ / de las rjes thob tu langs pa na yid ngor mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi skur ldang snyam/ don slob pa'i zung 'jug la gnas shing phung po rnying pa sogs la zhugs nas sngar ma bslab pa gsar slob med kyang bslabs zin goms pa'i phyir rjes kyi nyams len ci rigs skyong zhing shes sgrib skor bar ba bdun rim par spong ngo / / de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi'i bgrod pa mthar son te 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i tshul ni saspu ṭi las 'byung ba bzhin mi slob pa'i zung 'jug 'grub tu nye ba'i mtshan ma mthong ba na tshes bco lnga'i srod la tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshams/ gung la bla mas dbang gsum pa dngos dbang du bskur/ tho rangs zung 'jug gi gdams pa phog pa bzhin phyi nang gi mngon byang sbyar te shes sgrib tha ma'i dngos gnyen slob pa mtha'i don gyi 'od gsal mngon du byas pa'i skad cig gnyis par mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byed pa yin no/ / gegs sel bogs 'byin zhal las shes dgos kyang / /rnal 'byor bzhi yi don gyi gnad tshang ba/ / gsang chen bcud kyi thig pa 'di bris pa'i/ / dge bas 'gro kun 'jam dpal gnas thob 500

༄/ /dpa' bo gcigapa'i bskyed rimasnying bo'idon gsal/shog /cesapa 'di ni lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa rdo ram pa yon tan legs grub kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes shin tu go bde zhing gnad tshang bar byas te bsgrigs pa yin pas gang byung la mi ston par sbas pa'i tshul gyes snying gi thig ler 'chang dgos so/ /zab cing gsang ba'i man ngag snying po 'di/ /dad brtson bloldanadakon mchog bstan 'phel gyis/ /par du bsgrun pa'i dge bas byang chub par/ /'jam dpal zhi khrosa'abral med rjes 'dzin shog / / /501

༄/ /yo ca bayopa'i sgonalo ཿnga 4ma/༄7/ / rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi sgo nas nyes stung spyong ba'i nyams len snying por zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra satā ya/ 'dir rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi sgo nas nyes ltung sbyong ba nyams len gyi snying por byed bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis dam tshig dang sdom pa'i bsngo bgrang / sdig ltung so so'i nyes dmigs rnams yid la dran pas sngar byas kyi nyes tshogs la 'gyod sems dang / lha sngags kyi byin rlabasal yid ches shugs drag po'i sgo nas skyabs semasasngon du btang la/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ rang gi spyi bor baṃ las pad+ma dang ā las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur ba las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje bsnyems ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ga'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ yab rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs gar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la 502

༄/ / rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyisgo nas nyes lhungastong ba'i nyams lenasnying po/mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya bre ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang / mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa bla med ltar byin gyisabarlabs la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa a nas shasta pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhayopa'i bar gyes dbul/ dmigs med bde chen rdo rje'i mtshon snon gyis/ / las nyon sdig ltung dra ba gcod mdzad cing / / zung 'jug gnas su 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mchog / bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal/ / spro na de'i 'phror/ phul byung byams dang snying rje phyag brkyangs te/ / ngan song g.yang las sgrol ba'i 'dren pa mchog / yab gcig bstan pa'i sgron me thugs rje'i gter/ /bka' drin dran pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ / dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'jig par sla ba dang / / ngan song sdug bsngal bsam pas 'jigs skrag gis/ / skyabs 'gro las 'bras blang dor la 'bad nas/ / ngan song skye sgo chod par byin gyes rlobs/ / bstan pa'i gzhi ma so thar khrims nod cing / /thar ba'i drung du 'jug pa'i lam ston pa/ / yab gcig bstan pa'i sgon me྾/ / bka' drin dran pa'i yid ma/ / rnam dag nges 'byung brtan pos rgyud 'khul zhing / / mi bzad nyes pa'i sgo bzhi yongs bkag ste/ / slabs gsum rnam par dag pa'i nyams len gyis/ / thar ba'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par byin gyis rlobs/ / theg pa mchog gi tshul khrims la bkod de/ / srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las yongs su 'dzin/ / yab gcig bstan pa'i sgron me྾/ / bka' drin nga/ / byams dang snying rje bdag gzhan rje ba'i blos/ / rin chen byang chub sems kyi rtsa brtan cing / / tshogs gnyis spyod pa'i yal 'dab rgyas pa yi/ / theg mchog lam bzang skye bar byin gyis 503

༄/ /yo cabam yosgronama'i ga ཿma rlobs/ / 'jug sgo rnam dag dbang gis smin byas te/ / gsang chen gdams pa'i dga' ston lhug bar stsol/ / yab gcig bstan pa'i sgon meng/ / bka' drin dran sa/ / dngos grub rtsa ba dam tshig rnam par dag /mtshan bcas mtshan med rim gnyis rnal 'byor sogs/ / gsang chen lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin te/ / zung 'jug go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / mdor na ci srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ / 'dren pa khyod kyis 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing / / zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi myang ba yis/ / stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa'i gsol 'debs 'di nyid sbyor/ de nas/ bla ma lha'i thugs gar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ yig gi mtha' mar yi ge brgya ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang /dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/de rnams kyi yon tan thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas thugs ga'i hūṃ la thim pas gzi brjid dang mthu stobs phun sum tshogs par gyur/ bzlas ba ci 'grubaco/ mjug tu mchod bstod gong bzhin byas la/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ / bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig / gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ / thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigasakyi bu/ khyod kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag go /zhesagasungasanas/ rang la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsungs thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ ces snga ma'i sdig 504

༄/ / rdor semasabasgom bablas kyisgonas nyes lhungasbyong ba'i nyams lenasnying po/ltungasasangasakyisadag song snyam du dga' ba skyed cing / phyin chad mi byed snyam pa'i sdom sems nan tan du bya ba ni bshags pa gnad du 'gro ba'i 'og 'byin kyi gtso bo yin no/ / zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa chos skyong rgya mtshosangag 'don du bya rgyur/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mesabasgrigs pa'o1 / /dkon mchog kun 'dus 'jigs med dbang po'i sde/ / bka' drin mnyam med mkhas grub bstan 'dzin zhabs/ thar lam gsal mdzad bstan pa'i sgron me ste/ / rje btsun bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / thog med dus nas mi dge ci bgyis dang / / khyad par sdom gsum bcas mtshams las 'das zhing / / bla ma mchog gsum zhing la brten pa yi/ / mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis mthol lo bshags/ / bdag sogs las nyon ji tsam mtha' yas pa/ / khyed rnams thugs rje'i mtha' yang de tsam phyir/ / sems kyi dbang du gyur la mi rmong bar/ / nyes kun lhag med byang bar byin gyis rlobs/ / sgo gsum dge ba phra rags ci mchis pa/ / bla ma'i thugs bskyed rgya mtshor ro gcig tu/ / 'dres ste dus gsum rgyal bas bsngags pa yi/ / rgyal sras spyod pa kun gyi rgyur gyur cig / 'di nas 'phos tshe bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal bstan nas dag zhing du/ / khrid de 'bral ba med par rjes bzung nas/ / gsung gi bdud rtsis smin cing grol gyur cig / 'di yang rje nyid kyi gsungs so1 / /505

༄/ /yo cabastan batshoname'i ga ཿma༄༅/ / gzugs mchog ma'i 'grel pa bzhugs so/ /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed bskyed rim las/ grub chen lwa li ta ni rgyud sdud pa po dang dbyer med pa yin pas grub chen 'di'i gsung rnams rgyud kyi tshigu dang dbyer med par byin rlabs shin tu che ba dang /don rgya che bar byed pas tshigs bcad 'di la bde chen chos sku'i sgo nas bstod pa dang / zung 'jug gzugs sku'i sgo nas bstod pa dang / mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi sgo nas bstod pa sogs bshad tshul mang du yod cing / rdo rje 'jigs byedakyi byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i sngags dang dbyer med pa yin pas rje rin po ches kyang 'di'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal tshul gsungs pa yin no/ / zhes pa 'di'idon 'grel tshul ji ltar yin zhes dris pa'i lan cung zad dgrol ba la/gzugs mchog mchog tu drag po che/ / zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad 'di ni lā li tas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs che ba zhe dgu ma'i mchod brjod yin zhing /bskyed rim rnams na 'di'i don mtha' chod par bkral pa mi snang yang mtshan brjod dang zhib tu bsgrags tshe rkang ba re res kyang bstod tshul de gsum gsum bstan pa'i bcu gnyis/ bstod tshul gsum re re'ang rkang pa bzhi bzhis bstan pa'i bcu gnyis/ rkang pa re dang bstod tshul re sbyar la rkang pa tha ma don bsdur byas pa'i bzhi ste bshad tshul nyer brgyad kyang rung bar snang 506

༄/ / gzugasamachogama'i 'grel pa/na'ang / 'dir gnad bsdus te bshad na/ gzugs mchog ces pa ni/gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa ste/ / zhes bde chen ye shes kho na 'ja' tshon ltar gzugs skur snang nas gzhan don sgrub pa ni rang don chos sku sgrib pa'i dri ma dang bral ba gzugs med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu de'i mthu las byung ba yin te/ nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ / zhes rang byung ni lhun gyes grub pa longs sku yin pas de chos sku'i nam mkha' las byung bar bstan pa yin no/ / 'di sor sdud kyi lam rtags la sbyar ba'i skabs yod kyang rdo rje'i tshig gcig don du mar 'jug pas mi 'gal lo/ / mchog tu drag po che/ / zhes pa shin tu khros pa'i nyams rdzogs pa'i gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur bzhengs pa la sbyar na gzugs mchog ces par bstod tshul snga ma gnyis/ drag po che zhes par phyi ma ste gsum tshang ngo / / rkang pa 'di chos sku gcig pur sbyar na gzugs mchog ces pa'i mchog tu 'gro byed kyi rgyu za ma tog gi nang gi nor bu lta bu chos sku yin pas de gtso che la/ drag po zhes pa'ang / drag po chen po drag shul che/ / zhes pa'i thad kyi 'jam dpal grags pa'i 'grel chen las/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra bo rtog pa'i bag chags rtsa ba nas 'byin pas na drag po chen po zhes pa ltar ro/ / longs sku gcig pur sbyar na/ gzugs mchog ces pa ngo bo'i sgo nas dag pa'i rlung sems kyi rang mdangs tsam dang mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i longs skur go sla la/ drag por snang ba'ang nges par khros pa min gyi/ rlung dbu mar zhugs pa'i bde chen gyis gang 'dod du snang nas 'gro ba'i gdung ba sel ba'i nor bu lta bu thun mong ma yin pa'i snying rje'i mthu yin te/rtsa rgyud las/ drag shul che zhing 'jigs par byed/ / ces pa'i 'grel par gzhon nu zla bas/ / shin tu drag po'i lha thams cad 'jigs par byed pa'i phyir de'ang snying rje'i 'bras bu nyid do/ / zhes dang / 'jam dpal 'grel 507

༄/ /yo ca bayo lasgronasa'i gatshi ཿma/chen las/ thugs rje ni drag po chen po la sogs pa'i skur ston pa/ zhes so/ /'di thun mong ba'i snying rjes kun slong byas pa lta bu tsam zhig min gyi/thun mong ma yin pa'i snying rje bde chen rang nyid de lta bur shar ba'i don yin te/ spyod bsdus su rgyud drangs pa las/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig bu nyid/ / gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i gar mdzad do/ / zhes gdul bya la phan pa'i thabs rnam pa thams cad du shar nas don sgrub pa nor bu lta bu yin pas/ don yod zhabs kyis/ yid bzhin nor bu chen po ltar/ / ji ltar 'dod pa'i skur ston mdzad/ / ces dang / zhi ba ye shes kyis kyang / thugs rjes gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ / zhes gsungs pas/ mchog tu drag por 'gro tshul mchog tu brtse ba'i bde chen lhan cig skyes pa la byed cing de gsang dbang gi lam gyi bsgrub bya yin pas 'bras bu longs sku dang 'brel lo/ /rkang pa de sprul skur sbyar na/ gzugs mchog tu 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan/gzugs rnam thams cad snang ba'i dpal/ / zhes gdul bya'i don la gang 'gyur de thams cad du shar nas skyob pa'i byed las 'bras bu'i cha de'i sgo nas gtso bor bzhag pa yin/ mchog tu drag po che/ / zhes pa/ khro bo gshin rje gshed mthong na/ / khro bo gzhan rnams thams cad kyis/ / thams cad thams cad lag cha 'chor/ / zhes shin tu khro nyams yongs su rdzogs pa la grags che ba ltar ro/ / rkang pa gnyis pa'ang dpa' bo ni/ dpa' po bdud dgra bdud 'dul ba/ / zhes bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rang don chos sku bstan/ lhag mas de thob nas gzugs sku gnyis kyis gzhan don la spyod pas don tshan phyi ma gnyis bstan to/ / yang 'grel chen las/ phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can gyi dgra bo nges par zlog par mdzad pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pas dpa' bo'o/ / zhes pa ltar naṣedapa' bo'ang nang gi dgra 508

༄/ / gzugasamachogasa'i 'grel pa/bo'am gshin rje nyon mongs bcom pas chos sku/ gsang pa'i gshin rje las rlung bcom pas longs sku/ phyi'i gshin rje 'byung po ma rung ba rnams 'joms pa'i drag po'i sprul sku gsum ga la so sor sbyar du rung / mchog gi spyod yul can/ / zhes pa'ang / sangs rgyas kun gyis mngon sum pa/ / zhes sangs rgyas nang phan tshun kho na'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa so so rang gi rig pa'i ye shes chos sku dang / dag pa'i brtan g.yo 'ba' zhig gi rnam par rol pas longs sku/ brtan g.yo rab 'byams kyi rnam par rol bas sprul sku ste/mchog gi sgra rab dang rgya chen po sogs du ma la 'jug go / rkang pa de longs sku gcig pur sbyor na/ dpa' bo ni dril bu ba'i dbang chog las/ dpa' bo bde ba chen pos rtogs/ / zhes zung 'jug gi yar gyur pa'i sgyu lus dpa' bo'i sgras bstan pa gzhan don la mi 'jigs pa'i thabs gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pas brten pa lha'i sku bstan cing / phyi mas rten gzhal yas khang sogs bstan no/ / rkang pa de sprul sku dang sbyar na shin tu khros pa'i rnam rol gyes 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la bsdegs par mdzad cing / khyad par du drag po sogs 'jig rten pa'i lha mthu bo che thams cad zhabs 'og tu mnan nas dbang du byed pa'i dpa' bo dang / de dag gi chung ma sti mo ste drag mo sogs phrogs nas dga' ba bzhis rol cing / gzhan yang gnas 'khor rgyan lag cha sogs thams cad phrogs nas longs su spyod pas mchog gi spyod yul can no/ / de gnyis ni sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/sdig med stobs kyis ngo mthon du/ / dbang phyug dam pa rab mnan nas/ /lha mo snyi mo phrogs nas ni/ / de tshe longs spyod rang gir mdzad/ / ces dang /zhi ba ye shes kyis/ g.yas kyi zhabs brgyad bskum zhes sogs don 'dra'o/ /srid pa'i ri bo chen po 'joms/ / zhes pa'ang drang don du bshad pa'i tshe 509

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i me'i khrung 4ma/'jig rten gyi lha chen po rlom pas dregs pa rnams kyi khengs pa bsnyil ba la gsungs shing / btul ba'i don dbang du byed pa dang / longs spyod pa dang /thim pa gsum du gsungs pas so sor phye na sngar bzhin yin la/ longs spyod pa dang dbang du byed pa yin pas gnyis ka gnyi gar sbyar chog ste/ 'grel chen las/ yang na tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / zhes pa nas/dga' mo mthu stobs kyis blangs te/ drag po'i stobs kyis len par mdzad pas na dpa' bo/ zhes so/ / rkang pa gsum pa ni/ gdul dka' 'dul ba rnams kyi mchog ces pa la drang nges kye bshad pa mdzad pa ltar/ shin tu gdul dka' ba nyon mongs dang las rlung dang 'byung po gdug can so so dang gsum char 'dul ba'i sgo nas don tshan re re ba dang gsum gar sbyor dgos la/gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa sogs grags tshod che ba dang bstun na drag po'i cho 'phrul gyisagashin rje dang ma mo phyogs skyong bcu sogs btul ba la sger du sbyar na 'brel che ste/ zhi ba ye shes kyis/ dur khrod chen po'i dkyil 'khor zhes sogs dang / dpal 'dzin gyi bstod pa de nyid lnga pa las/ sdigs mdzub drag pos gdul dka' 'dul/ / mgo ldog mnan nas rab tu gsol/ /zhes sogs shin tu mang ngo / / rkang pa bzhi pa'ang / 'jigs chen 'jigs par byed pa po/ / zhes pa'i 'grel chen las/ drag shul che ba'i 'jigs byed chen po'i gzugs 'jigs su rung bar bstan nas/ zhes pa lta bu phyi la sbyar ba drang don yin zhing / nges don ni dus 'khor ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba las/sems can rnams la 'jigs par byed pa'i sgrib pa'i bag chags dag kyang 'jigs par byed pa'i bde chen de nyid/ ces pa ltar/ bden gnyis dbyer mi phyed pa'i ye shes kyi sku la byed pas/ don tshan gsum ga de'i khongs nas thon zhing mtha' chod par ni mtshan brjod lugs drug sogs kyi bshad srol 510

༄/ /gzugasamachogama'i 'grel pa/gung bsgrigs te btsal par bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni bsod nams kyis mngon par mtho ba dze+e man wang gi sras blo dang brtson par ldan pa 'jam dpal rdo rje'i 'dun pa bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes mdo tsam du byas pa'o/ / / /511

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'isgranasa'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / srad rgyud lugs kyi 'pho ba'i gdams pa'i ngag 'don khrigs chags su bsdebs pa bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru mai tra ye/ 'dir srad rgyud lugs kyi 'pho khrid zab mo nyams sulen par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la lus gnad bcas te rlung gi skyon bsal zhing dge sems khyad par can gyi ngang nas 'di ltar/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/tshogs zhing nam mkha'i khams gang ba spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus rtag par bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ / sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ / chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ / dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ / lan gsum/ bdag gis sems can thams cad mu mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'di las bsgral te bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi snying po la 'god par bgyi/ de'i phyir du zab lam 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su blangs bar bgyi'o/ / mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng / / bzang po'i bzhugs stangs mdzad pa'i ma pham mgon/ / gser ri ltar brjid chos 'khor phyag rgya can/ / de yi thugs ka dpal gyi be'u'i nang / / rgyal ba'i dbang po rje btsun tsong kha pa/ / chos 'chad phyag rgyas glegs bam ral gri bsnams/ / sras kyi thu bo gnyis dang bcas pa yi/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las/ / 'od 'phros dga' ldan 512

༄/ /srad rgyud lugs kyi 'pho ba'i gdams pa'ingag 'don/gnas nas byams mgon dang / / rje btsun bla ma yab sras rnam pa gsum/ /spyan drangs dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du/ / 'dres shing srid mtha'i bar du bzhugs su gsol/ / shes bya'i khyon kun 'jal pa'i blo gros thugs/ / skal bzang rna ba'i rgyan gyur legs bshad gsung / / grags pa'i dpal gyis lham mer mdzes pa'i sku/ / mthong thos dran pas don ldan la phyag 'tshal/ / yid 'ong mchod yon sna tshogs me tog dang / / dri zhim bdug spos snang gsal dri chab sogs/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di/ / bsod nams zhing mchog khyed la mchod par 'bul/ / gang zhig thog med dus nas bsags pa yi/ / lus ngag yid kyi mi dge ci bgyis dang / / khyad par sdom pa gsum gyi mi mthun phyogs/ / snying nas 'gyod pa drag pos so sor bshags/ / snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mang thos sgrub la brtson/ / chos brgyad sbangs pas dal 'byor don yod byed/ / mgon po khyod kyi rlabs chen mdzad pa la/ / bdag cag bsam pa thag pas yi rang ngo / / rje btsun bla ma dam pa khyed3mas kyis/ / chos sku'i mkha' la mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ /ji ltar 'tsham pa'i gdul bya'i 'dzin ma la/ / lhun 'grub chos kyi char ba dbab tu gsol/ / bdag gis ji snyed bsags pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba kun la gang phan dang / / khyad par rje btsun blo bzang grags pa yi/ / bstan pa'i snying po ring du gsal byed shog / rang lus shel gye bum pa ltar gsal ba'i/ / tshangs bug nas bzung lte 'og sor bzhi'i bar/ / dbu ma smad phra stod yangs zangs thal dbus/ / rang sems ngo bo rje btsun rnam par bsam/ / kye ma gnag dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /brgal te dga' ldan chos kyi zhing khams der/ / ma pham 'jam dpal snying po sras bcas kyi/ / 'dzum zhal mngon du gyur na ci ma rung / / steng dga' 513

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgoname'i khrung 'bum/ldan lha brgya'i mgon po mchog / rje ma pham chos kyi bla ma dang / / dbyer med pa 'dren mchog thams cad mkhyen/ / pha blo bzang grags pa yab sras la/ /yid rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ / lam zab mo 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ / zhing dga' ldan mkha' spyod gnas mchog der/ / dus da lta nyid du bgrod pa dang / / rje bla ma yab sras zhal mthong zhing / / gsung bdud rtsi'i dga' ston myong ba las/ / lam zab mo'i rtogs pa mthar phyin nas/ / mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / pha khyed kyi thugs rje lcags kyu yis/ / 'od spu gu'i lam nas skad cig la/ / rje ma pham chos kyi mdun sa der/ / dus da lta nyid du drang du gsol/ / lam 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis zlobs/ / de ltar gdung shugs drag pos gsol btab mthus/ / byams mgon thugs ga'i rje btsun yab sras kyi/ / thugs ka nas byung 'od zer dkar po yi/ / spu gu sba lcags tsam zhig nar gyis byung / /rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar zug / de nas slar yang thugs ga'i sa bon las/ / lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer dkar po zhig / rgyangs te byung nas 'od kyi spu gu yi/ / lam du zhugs nas dru tī'i nang brgyud de/ / snying dbus rang sems dbyer med rje bla ma'i/ / thugs gar btab ste 'dren par mngon phyogs tshe/ / 'og rlung drag du 'azen pa'i gzhu mo la/ / hig gi mda' sbyar mgrin pa'i bar du sleb/ / hig / slar yang steng rlung mnan te rang gi gnas/ /snying ga'i thad kyi dru tī'i dbus su phab/ / ka de ba'in du spyi bo'i bar du spar nas slar rang gnas su 'bebs pa sogs res mos kyi tshul du hig dang ka sbrel ba nyer gcig sogs ji ltar 'dod pa sbyangs la/ mthar phaṭa ces brjod pas byams mgon gyi thugs ga'i rje bla ma'i thugs gar bstem nas/ de'i thugs dang dbyer med du 'dres par mos pa'i ngang la dar cig mnyam par bzhag / slar yang dmigs 514

༄/ /sradasgyud lugs kyi 'pho ba'i gdams pa'ingag 'don/rten rang gnas suphab pa'i mos pa dang bcas/ ka zhes brjod/ de nas/ mdun gye nam mkha'i dbyings bzhugs 'pho yul rnams/ / gser zhun lta bu'i 'od du ltem zhu nas/ / tshangs pa'i bu ga 'khyil gyis rab bkag ste/ / rang gi sgo gsum byin gyes brlabs par gyur/ / 'dir 'bad las byung dge tshogs rgya mtsho'i mthus/ / bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gag ma thag / yid dga' chos 'dzin gnas der skye bar shog / de tshe 'jam mgon bla ma yab sras kyis/ / dbugs dbyung gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ste/ / rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho'i zlos gar gyis/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba srid las sgrol bar shog / khyad par 'jam mgon bla ma yab sras kyis/ / tshe rabs kun tu dge ba'i bshes mdzad nas/ / rgyal bas bsngags pa'i lam bzang de nyid las/ / skad cig tsam yang ldog par ma gyur cig / / / ces srad rgyud lugs kyi 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyamasasu len tshul nag 'gros su bkod pa 'di ni/ dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dge 'dun rab rgyas dang 'jigs med dge 'dun gnyis kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du bris pa'o/ /515

༄/ /yo gas ཿsgroname'ig ཿma/༄7/ / mgon po 'od dpag med la brten pa'i 'pho khrid sogs 'pho khrid kyi skor dag zhing du mar bgrod pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'khor lo ma lus pa'i/ / mi shigs gsung gi gsang ba rdo rje chos/ / bde ldan zhing mgon snang ba mtha' yas kyis/ /dmigs med thugs rjes byang chub bar du skyongs/ / thub pa'i gsung gsang chos kyi rol mtsho las/ / bsngags pa'i rlabs phreng 'bum phrag spro ba'i gnas/ / skyon bral dag pa'i zhing mchog bde ldan du/ / bgrod byed thabs kyi gru gzings brten par rigs/ / de'ang ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis gdul bya'i mos pa bzhin du chos kyi phung po mtha' yas par gsungs pa rnams mthar srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' dag las grol ba'i mi gnas pa'i myang 'das su bgrod byed sha stag yin kyang / / de la thog mar 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang / de'i sngon du'ang ngan song gi sgo khegs pa zhig byed dgos pas/ btsan thabs 'tshang rgya 'pho ba'i gdams pa zhes bya ba sgrub par sla zhing shin tu don chen po dang ldan pa 'di lta bu la nyams len gyi mthil du bzung ste 'bad dgos shing / de'ang 'pho ba'i gdams pa ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa sogs bla med kyi rgyud sde ma gtogs gzhan las ngos zin gsal bar ma byung yang / dam pa gong ma rnams de'i rigs pas rgyas bkab ste 516

༄/ /'od dpagamed kyi 'pho khrid sogs 'pho khridasna tshogs/mgon po 'od dpag med dang rje btsun byams mgon sogs la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i rigs mang du gsungs la/ de rnams kyi nang nas kyang / rgyal ba 'od dpag med la brten pa'i 'pho ba ni shin tu zab cing don che ste/ rgyal ba rang nyid kyis sngon smon lam mdzad pa las/ sems can gang dag nga yi ming thos na/ / nga yi zhing du rtag tu 'ong bar shog / nga yi smon lam bzang po de dzogs pas/ / 'jig rten khams mang dag nas sems can 'ong / / de dag nga yi zhing du lhags nas ni/ / de dag skye ba gcig las phyir mi ldog / ces zhing der skye ba'i rgyu sgrub par sla zhing der skyes nas slar las nyon gyi gzhan dbang du gyur te/ 'khor bar nying mtshams sbyor ba mi srid par gsungs la/de'i rgyu mtshan gyis ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos kyang gzungs dang mdo sde du mar phan yon gyi skabs su dag pa'i zhing bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dag pa'i zhing thams cad las 'di nyid dmigs kyis bkar nas der skye ba'i thabs la sgo du ma nas sbyor bar mdzad do/ / der skye ba'i rgyu'ang zhing bkod kyi mdo dang / zhing mchog sgo 'byed sogs las gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med la dmigs pa'i dad pa/ zhing mchog bde ba can du skye 'dod kyi 'dun pa/ rang gi sngar byas kyi dge rtsa thams cad zhing der skye ba'i rgyur bsngo ba gsum ni med mi rung yin zhing / de na dngos kyi gdul bya rigs can gnyis su yod pa las/ theg pa chen po'i rigs can du skye ba la rgyu snga ma gsum gyi steng du byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'ang dgos par gsungs pas de dag rang rgyud la tshang ma tshang legs par brtags te mthun rkyen yongs su rdzogs pa'i rmang gzhi zin pa dang / tshe 'di'i lus longs spyod gnyen bshes sogs la chags pa ni ba la ha'i rtogs brjod ltar dag pa'i zhing du 'pho ba'i gegs byed kyi gtso bor gsungs pas mi mthun pa'i rkyen rnams dang bral bar 517

༄/ /༅ thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/byas te 'pho ba'i gdams pa dngos kyi nyams len la 'jug par bya'o/ / de la thog mar mgon po 'od dpag med kyi sku dang bde ba can gyi zhing bkod sogs dmigs rten rnams legs par bkram/ mchod pa gtsang zhing gya nom pa bkod pas mdzes par bshams/ / rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'khod de kun slong legs par bcos nas skyabs sems sngon du gtong ba sogs spyor ba'i chos rnams gdams pa spyi dang 'dra bar tshags su tshud par bya/ de nas/rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad zla'igadan la rgyal ba 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po byu ru'i mdog can/mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ sku la chos gos ngur smrig gsol zhing dbu gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs kha'i hūṃ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis nub phyogs bde ba can nas mgon po 'od dpag med ye shes pa spyan drangs te mdun gyi 'od dpag med la bstem pa'am/ yang na dam tshig pa mi skyed par lha mgron gyi tshul du spyan 'dren pa la ma gadha'i rtogs brjod ltar byas la/ tshogs gnyis rin chen dag pa'i khams las grub/ / srid pa'i skyon bral bde ldan zhing mchog nas/ / bcom ldan 'od dpag med mgon 'khor dang bcas/ / dgyes bzhin 'dir gshegs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ zhes spyan drangs/ sgo gsum mi phyed dang bas phyag 'tshal zhing / / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ / thog med nas bsags sdig ltung ma lus bshags/ / bdag gzhan dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rang / / mya ngan mi 'da' bskal brgyar rtag bzhugs nas/ / zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ / legs byas mtha' dag byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ zhes bsags sbyang gi gnad bsdus ba 518

༄/ /'od dpag med kyi 'pho khrid sogs 'pho khridasna tshogs/yan lag bdun pa dbul/ de nas rang gi lus shel gye phru ma bus pa bzhin du dwangs shing gsal ba'i dbus cung zad rgyab la nye ba'i phyogs su rtsa dbu ma mda' snyug gi tshad tsam pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba rtsa'i skyon rnams dang bral zhing smad phra ba lte 'og sor gsum tsam du skeb cing / stod yangs pa spyi bo'i gtsug dang kha da chad du yod pa'i mar sne'i nang du rnam shes kyi ngo bo yi ge 'am/'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa 'phar la khad pa zhig gsal gdab de'ang rang nyid 'phen pa po dang rnam shes 'phang bya lta bu'i ngo bo so so bar bzung nas ci tsam sbyangs kyang 'pho ba gnad du mi 'gro bar gsungs pas phyi'i lus 'di sdod gnas kyi khang ba lta bur byas te/ rang nyid ni dbu ma'i nang gi shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems kyi ngo bo thig le dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i tshul gyis tsen ne+e gnas par bsam la/ ngag tu tshigs bcad brjod pa dang lhan cig byas na 'jug pa bde bas/ rang lus drang por bsrang ba'i lte ba'i 'og/ sor gsum thad nas dbu ma mda' snyug tsam/ / rgal gzhung la nye tshangs bug la zug pa/ / smad phra stong sbom rag dung dbyibs can gye/ / mar sne'i nang du rnam shes yi ge'am/ / 'od kyi thig le dkar 'tsher 'phar la khad/ / rtse gcig bsgoms te mdun gyi bla ma lhar/ / snying khung rus pas gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs/ / dus gsum phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ / yon tan gcig bsdus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med skyabs mgon thugs rje gter khyod la/ / gsol ba 'debs so ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyobs/ / zhes gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs/ de nas mdun gye 'od dpag med de nyid spyi bor byon pa'am rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig byon par mos la/ ngag tu'ang / de ltar gsol btab mdun gye snang mtha' las/ / gnyis pa chad nas rang gi tshangs bug steng / /519

༄/ /yo ca bam ba'isgronamatha ga ཿma/rigs bdag tshul bzhugs thugs ga'i thad drang gi / dbu ma rag dud dbyibs can mar sne'i nang / / thal le yod pa'i kha dang rang nyid kyi/ / spyi bo'i dbu ma phrad mtshams gang gis kyang / / dbye mi nus par bsams la snang mtha' yi/ / thugs ga'i thad kyi ju tī'i nang du ni/ / trī yig dmar la shin tu 'tsher ba zhig / bsgoms te slar yang gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs/ /zhes tshig don dran bzhin pas dal bus brjod la/ rtsa dbu ma gnyis kha sbyor du yod pa'i rang gi dbu ma'i nang nas yar bltas pas/ spyi bo'i 'od dpag med kyi thugs ga'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hrī yig de nyid mthong ste rang yang der 'pho 'dod kyi 'dun pa shugs drag po sbyangs la/ de'ang rgyal ba de nyid kyi thugs rje byin rlabs la rag las par mthong nas blo lings kyis bkal ba'i re ltos rtse gcig pa dang bcas/ / bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ / ngan song 'jigs las sgol ba'i dpa' po ste/ / dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid pa'i ded dpon mchog / mgon po 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun sogs bajod/ de nas/ 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs las bsgral du gsol/ / 'khrul snang bar do'i 'phrang las bskyab tu gsol/ / bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i g.yang las drang du gsol/ /'di snang zhen pa'i 'ching ba gcad du gsol/ / zab lam 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyes rlobs/ / dag ba'i zhing du 'khrid par byin gyes rlobs/ / re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzigs/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas spyi bo'i —'od dpag med kyi thugs ga'i hrī de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu zhig nar gyes byung bas rang sems thig ler btab/ rang gis kyang 'og rlung drag tu 'phen pa'i shugs kyis gyen du 'phang ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas te hika ces brjod pas gyen du spar/ ka zhes brjod pas rang gnas su bab pa lan gsum 520

༄/ /'odadapagamedakyi 'pho khridalogs 'pho khridasna tshogs/ya sogs su bya/ / las sbyor dngos gzhi'i tshe nyika tha mas 'od dpag med kyi thugs dang dbyer med du bsres/ phaṭa ces brjod pas de nyid bde ba can du gshegs/ de'i thugs ka nas phyir phyung pad+ma'i sbubs su yid lus blangs te rgyal ba de'i gsung gi bdud rtsi la longs spyad par mos shing rgyun ldan du mthar spyi bo'i 'od dpag med de nyid 'od du ltem gyis zhu bas tshangs bug thal gyis bkag par mos na byin rlabs kyi khyad dang tshe sgrub kyi man ngag zab mor 'gyur ro/ / 'dir 'bad las byung legs byas pad+ma dkar/ / rnam dag bslab gsum sbrang rtsi'i snying bo can/ / bde ldan zhing mchog lha yi dga' tshal du/ /snang ba mtha' yas mdun sar mdzes gyur cig / ces mgon po 'od dpag med la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i nyams len mdor bsdus 'di ni/ bsngags 'os yon tan du mas mngon par mtho ba rga sho'u sbrul sku blo bzang dbang grags rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes ka ju'i mkhar du bris pa skye 'gro kun la phan thogs par gyur cig / / /bde ba can nas rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med skyabs kyi dam pa 'od dpag med/ / 'khor bcas thogs med rang mdun mda' gang gi /nam mkhar spyan drangs dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ / sgo gsum gus bas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gi / mchod 'bul sdig ltung bshags shing rang gzhan gyi/ / dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor pa dang / / mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs dge rnams bsngo/ / bla ma ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa 'khor rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mchod do/ skyabs su mchi'o/ / lan bdun sogs/ dus gsum phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ / yon tan gcig bsdus rtsa ba'i bla ma 521

༄/ /yo cabam bsopo ga ཿma/dang / /dbyer med skyabs mgon thugs rje'i gter khyod la/ / gsol ba 'debs so ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyobs/ / bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ / ngan song 'jigs las sgrol ba'i dpa' bo ste/ / dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid pa'i ded dpon mchog / mgon po 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/ / tshar gsum/ 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs las bsgral du gsol/ /bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i g.yang las bskyab tu gsol/ / tshe 'di blo yis thongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ / zab lam 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid par byen gyis rlobs/ / re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzigs/ / nyika gsum/ phaṭa ces mjugatu sbyor// //tshe ldan yin na yan lag bdun pa'i 'phror/ /khyod lus drang por bsrang ba'i lte ba'i 'og /sor gsum thad nas dbu ma mda' skug tsam/ / sgal gzhung la nye tshangs phug la zug pa/ / smad phra stod sbom rag dud dbyibs can gyi/ / mar sne'i nang du rnam shes yi ge 'am/ / 'od kyi thig le dkar 'tsher 'phar la khad/ /rtse gcig bsgoms te mdun gye bla ma lhar/ /snying khung rus pas gsol ba gsol ba 'di ltar thob/ / dus gsum phyogs bcu'i/ zhesapa nas/ 'jigs las skyobs/ / de ltar gsol btab mdun gyi snang mtha' las/ /gnyis pa chad nas khyod kyi tshangs bug steng / / rigs bdag tshul bzhugs thugs dka'i thad drang gi / dbu ma rag dud dbyibs can mar sne'i nang / / thal le yod pa'i kha dang khyod rang gi / spyi bo'i dbu ma phrad mtshams gang gis kyang / / dbye mi nus par bsam la snang mtha' yi/ /thugs ga'i thad kyi byu tī'i nang du ni/ / hrī ga dmar la shin tu 'tsher ba zhig /bsgoms te slar yang gsol ba 'di ltar thob/ / bslu med ma man 'dra/ hika / ga sbrel ba tshar gsum/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing 522

༄/ /'od dpag med kyi 'pho khrid sogs 'pho khridasna tshogs/dga' ba der/ / zhes sogs bsngo sgon gyiyomatshamasasbyar bar bya'o/ /bla ma 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'dir gshin po la 'pho ba 'deb pa'i tshul cho ga lho sgo sogasadang 'brel na des 'thus la/ min tshe 'pho ba'i sngon du gshin po'i rnam sheyodagug dgos pas/ mchog gsum gye bden brjod sogs dngos su byed ba'am/ min yang yid kyis gsol ba btab ste ra mdar sbran zhing bkug pa'i dmigs pa skyong ba gal che bas skyabs yul la dad pa dang gshin po la snying rje'i dmigs pa sngon du btang ste/ bde ba can nas rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med skyabs kyi dam pa 'od dpag med/ / 'khor bcas spyan drangs dus 'das mdun gyi mkhar/ / brtse zhing dgyes pa'i nyams kyis bzhugs par gyur/ / de nas yan lag bdun pa'i dmigs rnam dang bcas/ sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gi / mchod 'bul sdig ltung bshags shing rang gzhan gyi/ / dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskul ba dang / / mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs dge rnams bsngo/zhes dang / ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo /mchod do/ skyabs su mchi'o/ zhes gsol ba 'debasapa lan gang mang bya/ 'o/ /'jig rten 'di na mchog dman thams cad kyi steng du khyad par med par 'bab pa'i 'chi ba mi rtag pa bya ba de da lan khyod kyi steng du babs nas da lta srid pa bar don gnas pa'i skabs yin/ khyod rang gis legs par brtag na 'gro 'ong bya spyod snang tshul thams cad sngar dang mi 'dra ba de bar dor gnas pa'i rtags yin/ skabs 'dir dga' mi dga'i snang ba ci byung yang gson dus kyi rmi lam dang 'dra bas de'i rjes su 'brang mi nyan/ de las dkon mchog la gsol ba btab na da lta nyen che la sgyur sla ba'i dus yin pas/ khyed kyimagon skyabs su bla ma 'od dpag med nged kyis spyan drangs yod pa 'dir 523

༄ / /gung thang bston pa'izla ma'i gsung 'bum/ngas brjod pa'i tshig ris bzhin gsol ba rtse gcig tu thob cig / dus gsum phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ / yon tan gcig bsdus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med skyabs mgon thugs rje'i gter khyod la/ / gsol ba 'debs so ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyobs/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas 'od dpag med gshin po'i spyi bor byon te bzhugs pa'i dbu ma'i mar sne dang gshin po'i dbu ma'i yar sne dbyer med du sbyar ba'i lam nas rnam shes gyen du 'pho ba'i phyir slar yang / bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ / ngan song 'jigs las sgrol ba'i dpa' bo ste/ / dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid pa'i ded dpon mchog /bla ma 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs las bsgral du gsol/ / bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i g.yang las bskyab tu gsol/ / tshe 'di blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ / zab lam 'pho ba 'byongs par byen gyis rlobs/ / dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid bar byin gyis rlobs/ / re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzigs/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ga'i hrī las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu thur du 'phros/ gshin po'i rnam shes dbu ma'i lam nas gyen du drangs te hrī la thim par bsam zhing hika lan gsum bajod/phaṭa ces brjod pa dang mnyam du de nyid bde ba can du gshegs pa'i thugs ga nas rnam shes phyir thon/ pad+ma'i spubs su skye ba blangs te mgon po 'od dpag med kyi sras kyi thu bor gyur par bsam zhing / rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes sogs kyi smon pas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o// //bsngo ba'i mgo mjug thams cad spyi dang 'dra/ gshin po'i ched dmigs kyis cung zad rgyasapar byed na/ dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa de nyid kyi ched du dmigs te nye du mdza' bshes shul na mchis pa rnams kyis 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas dkon mchog la mchod pa/ dbul phongs la sbyin pa/ gzungs sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod/ mdo sde klog 'don/ dkyil 'khor du bcug 524

༄/ / 'od dpagamed kyi 'pho khrid sogs 'pho khridasna tshogs/ste dbang bskur ba sogs dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed cig bgyis pa thams cad kyang tshe 'das de nyid kyi rnam par shes pa khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug gang du gnas kyang de'i rjes su 'brang zhing rjes su 'jug par gyur cig / de'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i skye gnas rnams su nam yang mi skye bar dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan zhing mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun tshang ba'i rten bzang po bar ma chad du thob bar gyur cig / rten de dag la gzhon nu nyid nas rab tu byung zhing theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam spyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten des dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig / des ji ltar gdams pa bzhin du thos bsam sgom pa'i sgo nas lam thun mong ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung lam gyi gtso bo rnam pa gsum dngaskyes bu gsum gye lam gyi rim pas blo legs par sbyong bar gyur cig /thun mong lam sbyang gi rim pa sngon du btang ste thun mong ma yin pa gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi 'jug sgo dbang bzhi rnam par dag pa mnos/ dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung / smin byed bskyed pa'i rim pa dang grol byed rdzogs pa'i lam rim ba gnyis kyi bgrod pa la brten nas kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig / gzhan rnams 'dra/ zhes gshin po la 'pho pa dang bsngo ba byed tshul dmigs kyis bkar ba zhig dgos zhes hal ha ja sag thu hān gyi shog nas dad ldan dge slong blo bzang nyi mas bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni stigru rasdu yonan+ta'o/ / / /bla ma dang mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa dbyer mi phyed pa la phyag 'tshal 525

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i khrung 'bum/lo/ / de'ang bde ba can du skye bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis mgon po 'od dpag med la dad pa dang / zhing der skye 'dod kyi 'dun pa/ dge rtsa gang byas zhing der skye ba'i rgyur bsngo ba gsum rgyun du yid la byed cing 'bad pa ni rgyu'i gtso bo yin zhing /dngos gzhi lag len du bstar tshul ni/ 'od dpag med kyi sku dang zhing bkod sogs dgram/ mchod pa legs par bsham/ kha nub phyogs su bltas te skyabs sems sngon du btangal/ mi mjed zhing nas nub kyi phyogs nyid du/ / bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong sangs rgyas kyi/ / zhing khams rnams ni 'das par gyur pa ni/ / rmad byung bde ba can gyi zhing khams zhes/ / sdug bsngal rnams kyi ming yang mi grags shing / / zag med 'byor pa'i dpal dang ldan pa der/ / 'od dpag med mgon nye ba'i sras dang bcas/ / bzhugs rnams bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ / blang dor gnas rnams ma rig mthug pos bsgribs/ / khong khro'i mtshon gyis mtho ris srog phrogs shing / / 'dod sred zhags pas 'khor ba'i btson rar bcings/ / las kyi chu bos srid pa'i rgya mtshor khyer/ / na rga'i sdug bsngal rba rlabs mang pos g.yengs/ / mi bzad 'chi bdag chu srin khar chud pas/ / mi 'dod sdug bsngal khur gyis non gyur pa/ / mgon med bdag gis nyam thag nga ro yis/ / yid la smon pa 'grub pa'i dbang po ru/ / phongs pa'i gnyen gcig 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /'khor dang bcas la gus pas gsol 'debs na/ / dpag med bskal bar bdag cag rnams kyi phyir/ / thugs mchog bskyed pa'i dam bca' ma bsnyel bar/ / 'dab bzang gtso bo lha yi lam la bzhin/ / rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis brtse bas 'dir gshegs shig / bar do'i 'phrang las sgrol ba'i sa mkhan te/ / bzod dka' ngan song 'jigs las sgrol ba'i skyabs/ / srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i ston pa mchog / mgon po 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal 526

༄/ / 'od dpag med kyi 'pho khrid sogs 'pho khridasna tshogs/lo/ / dngos bsham yid sprul mchod tshogs thams cad dang / / dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po ci mchis pa/ / gus pas 'bul lo bde can zhing mchog tu/ / skye pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ / mi bzad sdig ltung khur chen ci mchis dang / / 'di snang zhen pa'i 'ching ba ma lus pa/ / thugs rje bden pa'i phyag gis nyer bsal te/ / myur ba myur bar zhing der drang du gsol/ / nam zhig tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba na/ / 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ba'i 'od dpag med/ / mig gi lam du gsal bar mthong gyur nas/ / dad dang snying rjes bdag rgyud gang bar shog / bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ / sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal te/ mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas/ / bde ba can gyi 'ing der rab tu 'gro/ / der song nas ni smon lam 'di dag kyang / / thams cad ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar shog / rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ / pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ / snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ / lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog / mdor na 'gro ba mgon med bdag gi mgon/ / khyod min re ba'i skyabs gzhan ma mchis pa'i/ / gdung ba'i 'o dod lhang lhang 'bod lags na/ / thugs rje phyag gis bzung ste drang du gsol/ / 'di snang zhen pa chod par byin gyis rlobs/ / gnad gcod sdug bsngal zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ / 'chi ba'i 'jigs skrag sel bar byin gyis rlobs/ / bar do'i 'phrul snang yal bar byin gyis rlobs/ / las ngan sdig sgrib dag par byin gyis rlobs/ / dag pa'i zhing du skye bar byin gyes rlobs/ / lam bzang rtogs pa skye bar byin gyes rlobs/ / mgon po khyod kyi thugs dang bdag gi yid/ / dbyer med gcig tu 'dre bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes mgon po 'od dpag med kyi thugs gar 'phos527

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron 'i gsung ཿma/pa'i dmigs pa bya zhing gtso bor blo ling4kyis bkal ba'i mos gus shugs drag po sbyong ba gal che'o/ / mjug tu'ang bsngo smon sogs kyis mtshams sbyor ci rigs bya/ zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa chos rgya mtshos bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / /na mo mdzi shri ye/ 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs la brten pa'i 'pho ba nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kun gzigs kyi bkod pa'i mdo las gsungs pa ltar/ lho phyogs su de'i zhing khams smon lam ji lta ba bzhin du yongs surdzogs shing dag la rngul med pa bsags pa zhes zag pa med pa'i bde 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing khams khyad par can yod tshul yang yang bsam nas der skye 'dod kyi 'dun pa spyong zhing dge tshogs rnams de'i rgyur bsngo ba sogs 'pho ba gnad du 'gro pa'i rgyu tshogs tshang bar byas la/ de'i zhing bkod kyi bris thang ngam sku bris 'bur ci rigs sogs bkram nas mchod pa legs par bsham/skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dmigs med ye shes mchog ma dag 'khrul ba'i dri ma kun dag cig / dngos 'dzin rdul bral zhing mchog dam pa nas/ / rje btsun 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs/ / thugs gsung sku yi yon tan rjes dran nas/ / gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod cing sdig ltung bshags/ / dge la yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ / dge tshogs kun kyang byang chub chen por bsngo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jam dpal dbyangs kun gzigs la sogs pa dag la rdul med pa'i zhing du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i bde bar gshegs pa rgyal sras dpa' bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes lan gang mang / rang lus dbus kyi a wa dru ti'i nang / / snying ga'i thad du rang sems thig le'i gzugs/ / shin tu dkar 'tsher yang zhing 528

༄/ /'od dpagayed kyi 'pho khrid sogs 'pho khridasna tshogs/g.yo ba yi/ / rnam pa shin tu gsal ba gnas par gyur/ / ma dag 'khor ba'i btson rar chud pa yi/ / nyam thag 'gro kun bde chen grong khyer du/ /'khrid pa'i sa mkhan thar pa'i mig gcig pu/ / rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ / deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar/ / khyod min skyabs gzhan med do brtser dgongs te/ byin rlabs thugs rje'i phyag gis bzung du gsol/ / gnas ngan 'khor ba'i 'dam las drang du gsol/ / sdug bsngal ljon pa'i rtsa ba dbyung du gsol/ / mi bzad las kyi lcags sgrog gcad du gsol/ / ma rig nyon mongs mun pa bsal du gsol/ / yang dag lam gyi rtogs pa skyed du gsol/ / khyod kyi zhing khams mchog der drang du gsol/ / mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ / re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzigs/ / mgon skyabs gzhan na med do byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad rnams lan gsum mam bdun sogs brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas mkhyen gter mchog / spyi bor byon nas rigs bdag tshul bzhugs pa'i/ / thugs ga'i thad du mkhyen rab cha0yig gzugs/ / rab 'bar 'od kyi dra bas 'khyud pa las/ / spros pa'i 'od kyi lcags kyus rang sems la/ / reg pas de yi thugs gar drangs par gyur/ / bar bsam zhing hika dang / phyir rang gnas su phab par mos nas ka zhes spel mar brjod/ mthar spyi bo'i 'jamamagon mar phebs te rang sems dang 'dres par bsams la/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos sogs smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / zhes ba 'di'ang da tshang lhun grub gling nas rnam dpyod yangs pa byams khang bla masabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes spyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / /na mo ār+ya lo ke sha rwa ya/ 'dir rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i rang gzugs 529

༄/ /yo ca bayomi'i po ga 4ma/'phag4pa thugs rje chen po labarten pa'i zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag gi sgo nas dag pa'i zhing du bgrod par 'dod pa rnams kyis tshe 'di'i gnyen nye du lus longs spyod sogs la zhen pa'i 'di snang gi 'ching ba mtha' dag btsan thabs su bcad de/'phags mchog phyag na pad+ma yi dam gyi lha'i gtso bor bzung nas rgyun gyi bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa dang / lhag par tshogayobasags sgrib sbyang gi gnad 'dus pa byin rlabs kyi gter chen po smyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga sogs la chig dril du brtson zhing / des mtshon pa'i dusagasum gyi dge tshogs mtha' dag kyang bdag dang pha ma rigs drug gi sems can thams cad 'phagayopa thug4rje chen po'i zhabs drung du skye ba'i rgyur bsngo ba sogs 'pho ba 'byongasapa'i rgyu tshogs rnams sgo du ma nas bsgrubs te/ dngos gzhi la skyabs sems sngon du btang ste tshig don dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas/ / ri po ta la yi rtse mo nas/ /lha gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / ma mgon med 'gro ba'i mgon gcig khyod/ / thugs brtse ba chen pos gnas 'dir gshegs/ /zhes spyan drangs/ mdun mkha' la pad dkar zla ba'i steng / /sku'i snang ba mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs/ / yid sgo gsum gus pas phyag dang bcas/ / dpal kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyes mchod/ / sdig nyes ltung gang bgyis mthol lo bshags/ / las rnam dkar dge la rjes yi rang / /chos zab rgyas 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ / dge mtha' dag byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa dbul/ lus shel gyi phru ma bus pa ltar/ /ches dwangs shing gsal ba'i dbus kyi char/ /rtsa dbu ma smad phra stod sbom pa/ / rtsa'i mar sne lte 'og sor gsum tsam/ / ye tshangs pa'i bu ga thal gyis phye/ / dbus chos kyi 'khor lo'i thad drang du/ / ches phra ba gnyug ma'i sems kyi dngos/ / mdangs dkar la dmar ba'i 'od chags pa/ / gsal 'tsher zhing 'phar la khad pa yis/ / 'od thig le'i gzugs su gnas par gyur/ ces rtsa dang thig le gsal gdab/ de'ang rnam shes kyi ngo bo thig le de nyid 530

༄/ / 'od dpag med kyi 'pho khrid sogs 'pho khridasna tshogs/'phenas dang / rang nyid 'phen pa po lta bu'i so sobar bsam nas ji tsam sbyang yang 'pho ba gnad du mi 'gro bar gsungs pas rtsa dbu ma'i nang der lam gyi 'du shes dang /rang dang phra ba'i rlung sems kyi ngo bo thig le gnyis dbyer mi phyed pa'i tshul gyis der 'gro ba por mos pa shin tu gnad che'o/ / de nas yang mdun gyi mgon po spyan ras gzigs la dmigs pa'i dad pa shugs drag po dang bcas/ / lha skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ rje drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / dbyer med pa 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter/ / bu nyam thag 'gro ba'i mgon mdzod cig / ces gsol ba gdab/ tshul de ltar gsol ba gtab pa yis/ / mdun mkha' la bzhugs pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ / tshur byon nas rigs bdag tshul bzhugs pa'i/ / sku'i dkyil du dbu ma stod phra zhing / / smad yangs pa rang gi tshangs bug dang / / dbyer med par sbyar ba'i yar sne'i nang / / thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dngos/ / hrī dkar zhing gsal bas mtshan bar gyur/ces brjod la mgon po spyan ras gzigs rang gi spyi bor byon nas bzhugs pa'i dru tī'i yar sne'i nang gi zag med ye shes kyi ngo bo trī yig de nyid rang gi dbu ma'i lam nas yar bltas te mthong bas rang nyid kyang der 'pho 'dod kyi 'dun pa shugs drag po bskyed la slar yang phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i gter/ / rgyal sras phyag na pad+ma snying rje'i lha/ / cher snyigs lnga bdo gdul dka'i 'gro ba rnams/ / sgrol pa'i thugs bskyed dam bca' nyer dgongs te/ / srid zhi'i rgud pa kun las bskyab tu gsol/ / 'khrul snang bar do'i 'jigs skrag bsal du gsol/ / bzod dka' ngan 'bro'i g.yang las bsgral du gsol/ / 'di snang zhen pa'i 'chang ba gcad du gsol/ /zhing mchog po ta la ru drang du gsol/ / byang chub bar du rjes su bzung du gsol/ / gsol ba 'debs so mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / byin gyis rlobs shig bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas steng gi — yig 531

༄/ /yo cabam ཿsgroname'i g.yo ཿma/las 'od zer thur du 'phro4pas rang semasathig le'i rnam pa de nyid nya la lcags kyus btab pa bzhin du yar drangs shing 'og rlung drag tu 'then pa'i shugs kyis gyen du 'phang ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas ngag tu nyika cesabarjod/ slar yang ka zhes brjod pasarang gnas sudabab pa lan gsum sogs subya la/ 'chi ga'i nyams len nam/gshin po lta bu'i don du yin na nyika lan gsum gyi mthar/ phaṭa ces brjod pas mgon pospran ras gzigs de nyid po ta lar rgyangs te byon pa'i thugs ka nasarnam par shes pa phyir thon pad+ma'i spubs suyid lus blangs nas de'i gsung gi bdud rtsi la longs spyad pa'i dmigs pa bya'o/ da'ang 'pho ba sbyangs pa'i skabs rnamasasaspyi bo'i lhag pa'i lha de nyid 'od du zhu ba'i bdud rtsi gser zhun ma lta bus tshangs bug tshol gyisabakag par mos na tshe sgrub tu 'gyur zhing byin rlabs kyi mjug pa myur ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /de nas/tshul 'di ltar 'bad pa'i dge tshogs dang / / gzungs yi ge drug ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ / zhing khyad 'phags po ta lar skyes nas/ /lha thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong shog /ces dang / rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyis mngon sum du/ / lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /ces sogs bsngo smon gye mtshams spyor bya'o/ /de ltar 'phags pa thugs rje chenapo dang 'brel ba'i 'pho ba byed tshul 'di ni/ sgyung gnas sogs kyi sgo nas dal 'byor don ldan du sgrub pa'i thabs la brtson pa'i ri khrod pa dge slong ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dang dge slong blo bzang dar rgyas gnyis kyis bskul ngor/ /7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes kyo'u kya'i gzhi khar bris pa'o/ /532

༄/ /'khor losdom pa lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bde chen dpal ster/ro༅/ / 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bde chen dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /thugs gsung sku dang dam tshig 'khor lo'i lha/ / kun gye 'byung gnas bde chen lhan cig skyes/ / dbang sngon lhun po g.yo ba'i zlos gar mkhan/ /khyab bdag te ru ka yis ring du skyongs/ / de yang bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes sgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis bris 'bur gyi sku dang / mchod gtor sogs tshul dang mthun par bsham/ bde ba'i stan la 'khod cing kun slong legs par bcos te/ thog mar bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bya bar 'dod na/dpal ldan rigs brgya'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / / snying rje'i gter chen mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen te/ / rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bde chen lhan skyes kyi/ / ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar byen gyis rlobs/ / dngos grub mchog brnyes nyi lo sher bzang dang / / rnal 'byor dbang phyug rol pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs/ / 'phags pas rjes bzung mi tra dzo ki ste/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bde chen lhan skyes kyi/ /ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis zlobs/ / 'jig rten mig gcig lo chen byams pa dpal/ / mkhas shing grub pa bsod nams dbang phyug dang / / nyams rtogs mthar son bsod nams seng ge'i zhabs/ / rje 533

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i me'i khrung 'bum/btsun rin chen seng ge rnam bzhi la/ / gsol ba 'debs so nga/ / ye shes mngon dum/ / thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ / khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams dang / / rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ / thub bstan yongs kyi mnga' bdag rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so ma/ ye shes mngon du ma/ smra ba'i nyi ma mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ / snyan brgyud bka' babs chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / / 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes chos rdo rje/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so ra/ ye shes mngon dum/ zab lam mngon gyur rgyal ba dben sa pa/ / mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas ye shes dang / / blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rje/ / mtshungs med bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bde chen lhan skyes kyi/ / ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ / sngags 'chang chen po dge 'dun don grub dang / / lung rtogs mnga' bdag ngag dbang bstan 'dzin zhabs/ / 'dul 'dzin dam pa blo bzang mkhas btsun te/ / gsang chen gdams pa'i gter mdzod rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bde chen lhan skyes kyi/ / ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ / kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde/ / rje btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhabs/ / smra ba'i dbang phyug blo bzang dar rgyas te/ / byang phyogs skye dgu'i 'dren mchog rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bde chen lhan skyes kyi/ / ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ / bcom ldan te ru ka dpal dus kyi mthar/ / ngur smrig gar mdzad 'jigs med dbang po'i sde/ / mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bde chen lhan 534

༄/ /'khor loldom pa lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bde chen dpal ster/skyes kyi/ / ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang nyid skad cig gis he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyes rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa shuja sarba dharmā su bhā wa shurnyo3rta/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ / stong pa'i dang las yi las rlung / ram̐ las me/ ā0las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du ā las byung ba'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūṃ i dz+re khaṃ hūṃ dang / lam̐ mi paṃ tai/ baṃ las byung ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga slar yang yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'i steng du oṃ lnga rtu gi yi ge gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i nang du rdo rje gsum rim gyis thim pas kha dog dri nus kyi skyon sbyangs shing zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa mang por sbar zhing spel bar gyur/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ lan gsum brjod la nang mchod byin gyes brlabs/ yang las sngags kyisabasangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i dang las ā las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ hūṃ zhu ba las byur ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug sbos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin bde stong / rnam pa mchod rdzas so so'i rnam pa can/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ arnya ā rtu nas shasta ā : gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang he ru gar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor ba'i lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi rnam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/na mo gu ru maṇ+ḍa le bh+ya sarba ta thā ga ta a nas shasta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ sangs 535

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i me'i sa ཿmargyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ / rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ / theg pa gsum po thams cad dang / / rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ / byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ / rtag tu skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ / bdag ni te ru gar gyur nas/ / sems can thams cad te ru ma'i/ / go 'phang mchog la 'god par bgye/ / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ / bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ / sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig / sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig / tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzña na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma ko3rta/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla re ste/ de thams cad dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me lta bu steng dang logs kun tu khyab par g.yon skor du 'khyil zhing 'bar ba'i me dpung gi phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi yongs su bskor ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs ri rab kyi steng sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma la 'jirgas byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng du te ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis 536

༄/ /'khor losdom pa lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bde ོ dpal ster/kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can/dbu la rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba stod smad du gnas pa gnyis la brgyus pa'i thod pa skam po lngas brgyan cing / dbu'i g.yon du cung zad yo ba'i zla ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lwa ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/bzhiga'ang g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ ro'i gdan la gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab mar bum pa la gnas pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/dza hūṃ baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ba'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/de rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/ / khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum pa'i/ / gnas las byung ba sbyin bar bya/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sti ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī 〉 rtu/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/lus gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ phag mo la rnam snang / mkha' 'gro ma sogs 537

༄/ /yo ca b.lo lotshanama'i ཿnga ཿma/bzhi la rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa pa ri ltar arnya pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ nas shasta'i bar dang / oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ she hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ tai ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mu rā dze hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra hā sru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lā sru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra brte hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ t+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ju pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pa badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra sa badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ spar+sha bajo hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dharmā dhā tu badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ces rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ yab yum gnyis kyi nye snying dang / mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dbul/ oṃ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bskal pa chen po'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ral pa'i cod pan mi bzad pa dang ldan hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa 'jigs pa'i zhal hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ stong phrag phyag ni 'bar ba'i 'od zer can hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dgra sta zhags gdengs mdung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'dzin pa can hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ 'phags ma rig ma'i dbang phyug khams gsum gyes mi thub hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ 'byung po'i 'jigs pa thams cad rdo rje chen pos 'joms hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rdo rje gdan bzhugs gzhan gyis mi thub dbang byed can hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gtum mo khro mo'i gzugs kyis tshangs pa skems pa dang hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bdud rnams skrag cing skems pas gzhan gyi phyogs las rgyal hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rmugs byed rengs byed rmongs byed kun las rnam par rgyal hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rdo rje phag mo spyor chen 'dod dbang ma la 'dud hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ cesarkang brgyad kyis bstod/ gtso bo'i 538

༄/ /'khor losdom pa lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bde chen dpal ster/thugs gar rang 'dra'i te ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ de'i thugs gar hūṃ yig la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las dkyil 'khor pa'i lha'i tshogs spros/'gro ba rnams 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs ma lus pa bsdus te sngags phreng la thim par gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he te ru ru ke hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā kyi nī dza la shaṃ ba re swāhā/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ṭ+wāṃ ༵bye t+t+waṃ bhe tsa ༵ ༵ t+t+waṃ t+t+waṃ~X t+t+waṃ ṭ+wāṃ ༷/ṭa/oṃ ༵༵ buṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ba~X /bhe ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ngh+ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū bi nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gtso 'khor gyi sngags rnams ji ltar 'tsham pa re bzlas la/ mjug tu he ru ga'i yig brgya bzlas te lhag chad bskang / gtor ma nang mchod ltar byen gyis brlabs te/ pho/ rang gi thugs gar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ lha rnams kyi ljags la hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar po nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a ra li ho dza nyu baṃ ho ḍā kyi n+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ tri byu hotshar gcig gis gtso po/ tshar gnyis pas yum/ tshar gsum pas rnal 'byor ma bzhi la 'bul/ mchod pa dang nang mchod rkang brgyad kyes bstod pa rnams sngar bzhin bya/srid pa dang mnyam zhi ba chags bcom kun tu rtog pa 'joms/ / khyod ni dngos po mtha' dag mkha' ltar gzigs pa dang ldan pa/ mgon po shin tu brtse ba lce ba'i chus brlan thugs kyi chus/ / mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzod/ / ces 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ dur 539

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i me'i ga 4mkhrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong / zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pa'i bar gyis mkha' 'gro'i spyi gtor dkyus bzhin bya/ oṃ yo ga shud+ngha sarba dharma ma ga shusnyo ྅ haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mu 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs shing / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud mtha' dag 'od du zhu ba gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang bcas pa gtso bo yab yum la thim/ de yang sku'i stod smad nas rim gyes zhu ba thugs ga'i hūṃ yig la thim zhing / hūṃ yig kyang je phra je phrar song ste nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin mi dmigs pa'i stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur pa'i thugs gar zla ba la rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor nyi ma la rnam snang gi ngo bo na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la pad+ma gar dbang gi ngo bo swāhā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su nyi ma la dpal te ru ga'i ngo bo bo ṣaṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su nyi ma la rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser/dpral bar nyi ma la yan lag thams cad kyi lus dbang gi rang bzhin rta mchog gi ngo bo phaṭa haṃ ljang gus mtshan par gyur/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ / 'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgyad stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems dpar ldan/ / he ru ka dpal de dang lhan cig gar byed shog / lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / / de brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ / bden pa 'di dag gis ni lha mo rnams/ bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / dge ba 'dis mtshon rang gzhan ma lus pa'i/ / rnam dkar legs byas gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / tshe rabs kun tu dal ba'i rten thob cing / / bshes gnyen 540

༄/ /'khor losdom pa lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bde chen dpal ster/dam pas rjes su 'dzin par shog / de tshe srid las nges 'byung skyo shas dang / / smon 'jug byang chub sems la goms byas te/ / rgyal sras spyod pa phyin drug bsdu bzhi sogs/ / thun mong lam rnams rgyud la skye bar shog /rnam dag dbang gis gsang chen sgor bcug ste/ / dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin srung byed cing / / bskyed rim phra rags thun bzhir bsgoms pa yis/ / gang snang lha yi 'khor lor 'char bar shog / zla nyi'i rgyu ba dhu tīr thim pa yis/ / spros kun 'od gsal dbyings su sdud byed cing / / de las sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i skur bzhengs pas/ / zung 'jug go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig / go 'phang mchog de tshe 'dir ma thob na/ / 'chi tshe rje btsun yab yum 'khor bcas kyis/ / yid 'ong mchod sprin snyan pa'i rol mo'i sgra/ / ngo mtshar ltas bzang mang pos bsu bar shog / de tshe 'chi ba'i 'od gsal zin pa yis/ / mkha' spyod gnas sam gsang sngags sgrub pa'i rten/ / blangs te zab mo'i lam bzang myur bgrod nas/ / te ru ka dpal go 'phang thob gyur cig /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / / lca nag dril gsum rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhabs/ / bka' drin gsum ldan dngos kyi 'dren pa sogs/ / rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog / te ru ka dpal mkha' 'gro lnga la sogs/ / yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog / rnal 'byor ma rgyud zab lam rim gnyis sogs/ / gsang chen dam pa'i chos kyi bkra shis shog / rnam dag sgrub la rtse gcig gzhol ba yi/ / rig 'dzin bye ba'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog / mthong thos dran pas dge legs dpal ster pa/ / bde chen gzhal yas mchog gi bkra shis shog / bslu med dkon mchog gsum gye bkra shis shog / dam can chos srung rnams kyi bkra shis shog / thub bstan 541

༄/ /ca thang bayo pa'isgoname'i khrung 'bum/phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / rnal 'byor bsam don 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces bsngo smon dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya la/ thun mtshams su yang kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang / gnyid dang ldang ba khrus kyi rnal 'byor sogs bla med spyi dang / g.yon pa'i kun spyod sogs ma rgyud kyi sgos chos rnams kyang ji lta ba bzhin lag len du btab ste dal 'byor don dang lda na par bya'o/ / 'dir mi tra brgya rtsa nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi bde mchog lhan skyes lha lnga'i dbang du byas pa yin la/sgrub thabs rin 'byung sogs nas bshad pa ltar gtso bo yab yum tsam gyis chog par byed na/ gong du lha skyed pa'i skabs rnal 'byor ma bzhi bzhag ste/ mchod pa dang bzlas pa'i skabs su'ang so so'i sngags dang / sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa lta bu'i mang tshig rnams dang / nyer bsdu'i tshe 'ang rnal 'byor ma bzhi bstim pa sogs mi dgos pa'i 'dor len shes par byas la/ lhag ma dkyus bzhin du nyams su blangs pas 'grub bo/ / smras pa/bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dngos/ / bde mchog 'khor lo yab yum sgrub pa'i thabs/ / bde blag nyung ngur 'dril 'di bkod pa'i dges/ /bde chen thar pa'i grong du 'jug gyur cig / ces 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bde chen dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bstan la gcig tu dge ba'i lhag bsam mchog gi rgyan dang ldan pa zhabs drung dkon mchog chos dar gyes bskul ngor/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ / / /542

༄/ / grub chenanag pospyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/༄༅/ / grub chen nag po spyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rje btsun rnal 'byor ma dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ / lhan skyes bde ba mchog gi rol pa las/ /rab 'byams 'khor lo lnga yi lha tshogs kun/ / spro mdzad dpal chen te ru ka yis skyongs/ / bde mchog sbas chu'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ / grub dbang bye ba'i bzhed dgongs rlabs 'khrug cing / / snying por gyur pa lca nag dril gsum gyi/ / gdams pa'i bdud rtsi thar 'dod srog gi zungs/ / de phyir spyod 'chang dbang po'i bka' srol bzhin/ / dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs kyi/ / ngag 'don rim pa tshang la ma nor ba/ / dam pa'i man ngag ji bzhin bri bar bya/ de la thog mar mthun pa'i gnas su yo byad rnams tshogs par byas te/ rang nyid skad cig gis lhar bskyed pa/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pa/sngon 'gro'i mchod pa dang gtor ma byin gyis rlabs te dbul ba/ bdag bsgyed mchod pabyin rlabs/ skyabs 'gro/ rdor sems bsgom bzlayornams lca i pa'i lugs ltar byas la/ sgo gsum dag par bya ba ni/ shrī te ru ga he ni chos kyi bdag gis stong pa dang / ru ni gang zag gi bdag dang bral ba ste/ ka ni de gnyis su zhen pa med pa'i ye shes dang / shrī yul dang yul can ro gcig tu zhugs pa/ e waṃ gyi don no/ / stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 543

༄/ /ca thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ lan gsum/oṃ a ā nas/ sa ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ / lan gsum/ lte ba'i phyogs su sngags phreng 'od zer lnga pa g.yon du sum skor gyis gnas pa las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs 'phros/ sna bug g.yas nas thon/ bgegs rnams bskrad de slar sngags phreng la thim par gyur/ rang te ru gar gnas pa'i snying gar paṃ ser po las sna tshogs pad mar i las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/dpal mchog dang po'i yi ge hūṃ yig sngon po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can/'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'phro ba'i 'od zer gyis rang gi spyi bo nas rkang ba'i bar gang ste/ thog ma med pa nas kyi sgo gsum gyi dri ma rnams sbyangs pas/ lus shel sgong bzhin du dag par gyur te/ ba sru'i sgo nas phyir 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba kun gyi lus sbyangs sgo gsum dag par byas/ sprin sgra'i yi ge'i 'od des bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can dang / sngon nas grub pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang lha dang lha mo dang / khro bos nam mkha'i khams til gye gang bu ltar gang ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs te/ 'od zer rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ la 'dus par gyur/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas/ / skad cig gis ni thob 'gyur ba/ / bla ma rin chen lta bu yi/ / rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ / te ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ / rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang / / rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ / rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/ / gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing / / 'dus dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ / dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma/ / kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal/ snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ shrī he ru ka arnya pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā kyi/ oṃ 5yo

༄/ / grub chenanag pospyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/pukhre 〉 rtu sā hā/ debazhin du/ dru pe/ dī pe/ gadhe/ dze+e wi te/ shasta/ rnam bcug la dbul/ oṃ badz+ra bī ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ṭ+wāṃ she hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra spi tai ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mu ra dze hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hā sru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lā sru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dri t+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ju pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pa bsgyu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra sa badz+re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ spa ṅge badz+re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dha rmā dha tu badz+re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ thugs ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis thod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi lngas lha rnams la mchod par gyur/ oṃ sazo badz+ra ka mi ni saspra bha k+ṣi sho dha ya gu h+ya badz+ra ṇi swā hā/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi phag mo la thim/ de dang te ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs te bde ba chen po bskyed pas/ lha thams cad kyis kyang bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ de nas rkang brgyad kyi sngags kyis bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ / 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / / sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ / rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgye/ / byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ / sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ / byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ / 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad bsal ba'i phyir nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ / rgyal ba mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa rnams 'gro ba kun la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du/ bskal ba zhing gi rdul snyed du 545

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgoname'i khrung 'bum/bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so/ / bgrod dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ / bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ / rang gi bdag nyid skad cig ma/ / sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar gyi/ / zhes brjod/ de nas sems can thams cad khyad par du 'phags pa'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad zhes pa sbyar nas/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig thob zin pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyes bdag la byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra te ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi zlo me bhā wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bhā wa/ su po byo me bhā wa/ a nu rakhyo me bhā wa/ sazu sid dhispe pra yasmo sarba garmā su tsa me tsi t+ta shrī ya ku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha ho bhā ga wān/ badz+ra te ru ka ma me muñtsa te ru ka bhā wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa ā ( phaṭa/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ mchod yul dang mchod mkhan dang mchod rdzas rnams rnam par rig pa'i sems kyis btags pa tsam du zad do/ / dpral ba'i dbus su sbyo dkar po yongs su gyur ba las rnam snang dkar po phyag g.yas 'khor lo 'phyar zhing / g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ lte bar i ser po las rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che'i 'phyar zhing / mgrin par trī dmar po las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po g.yas pad+ma dmar po 'phyar zhing / rkang pa gnyis kyi long bu'i 'og tu ho ljang gu las rdo rje rgyal po ljang gu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar zhing / g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu thugs gar 'dzin pa/ zhes pa gong ma gnyis la'ang sbyar/ snying gar hūṃ dkar po las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas thugs khar rdo rje 'dzin zhing /546
