༄/ / grub chenanag pospyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/spyigatsug tu hi nag po lis he ru ka nag po g.yas sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje 'dzin zhing / de drug ni phung po lnga dang de lnga ga'i de bzhin nyid byin gyis rlobs pa'o/ /mig gnyis su oṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las gti mug rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo 'phyar zhing / rna ba gnyis su hūṃ nag po las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po g.yas thugs gar rdo rje 'dzin zhing g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhes pa gong gi lhag ma rnamasala'ang sbyar ro/ / sna bug gnyis su tram̐ ser po las ser sna rdo rje ser po/ / g.yas rol pa dang bcas pas rin po che 'phyar zhing / lce'i rtsa bar yi dmar po las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po/ / g.yas rol pa dang bcas pas pad+ma dmar po 'phyar zhing /dpral bar khaṃ ljang gu las phrag dog rdo rje ljang gu/ g.yas rol pa dang bcas pas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar zhing / g.yon rol pa dang bcas pas dril bu thugs gar 'dzin pa/ zhes pa gong ma gnyis la'ang sbyar/ snying gar haṃ dkar po las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po/ / g.yas rdo rje thugs gar 'dzin cing /g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ de drug ni skye mched drug byin gyis rlob pa'o/ / thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ lte ba sa la li ser po las ltung byed ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang 'khor lo/ / snying ga chu la mi nag po las gsod byed ma nag mo/ / mgrin pa me la paṃ dmar po las 'gugs byed ma dmar mo/ / dpral ba rlung la tai ljang gu las gar gyi dbang phyug ma ljang gu/de gsum ga'i g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rdo rje pad+ma ral gri rnams ma gtogs zhal phyag snga ma ltar ro/ / de bzhi ga'i g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas nam mkha'i khams la khaṃ dud kha las/ pad+ma'i dra ba can dud kha rtsa zhal 547

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i sgoname'i ga4 ཿma/dud kha g.yas dkar g.yon dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyarga drug gi g.yas gri gug tshangs mgo lcags kyu/ g.yon thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga zhags pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ 'di khams lnga byin gyis rlob pa'o/ /lha de rnams gnas de rnams su bkod pa tsam ma yin par lha re re nas nga rgyal 'dzin dgos par kun spyod kyi dgongs pa yin zhes 'dod 'jo las gsungs so/ / phung khams sgye mched byen rlabs 'dir bkod pa ni mngon spyod kyi dgongs pa yin par 'dod 'jo las gsungs shing / de dang 'di'i sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams mthun par snang bas 'dir bkod pa yin no/ / de ltar lha bcu bdun po bskyed pa'i mthar/ oṃ pra kri ta pa ri shudha sarba dha〉 pra kri ta pa ri shurnyo3rta/ rang gi spyi bor te dkar po/ / mgrin par ru dmar po/ / snying gar ka mthing ga de gsum gyi don rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i rgyu dang / brjod pa dang bral ba dang / gang du yang mi gnas pa nyid do/ / sems can rnams kyis chos rnams kyi yin tshul 'di lta bu ma shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams pas na bdag gis te ru ga'i go 'phang mngon du byas la gzung 'dzin bden pas stong pa'i sems can gyes yin tshul 'di rtogs par byas te 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar par bya'o/ / snyam du chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje bskyed/ oṃ su bhā wa shud dha sazu dharmā su bhā wa shud bho3rta/ khams gsum po rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong par gyur/ yi ge gsum po yongs su gyur pa las/ smon lam gyi dbang gis rang gi sems de steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'i oṃ dkar po/ / ā dmar po/ / hūṃ sngon por gyur/ de gsum las rim pa bzhin du sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams spros te/ sa 'og dang mi yul dang / mtho ris rnams 'khor lo gsum gye lha'i ngo bor byas nas stoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas sku'i 'khor lo'i lha 548

༄/ / grub chenanag pospyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/rnams zhu ba oṃ dang / gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams zhu ba ā dang / thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams zhu ba hūṃ la thim zhing / oṃ yang ā la dang / ā yang hūṃ la thim zhing hūṃ gi zhabs kyu u ha la ha ni ha'i mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la thim zhing / nā da yang skra'i rtse mo brgya stong gi cha'i tshad tsam du gnas par gyur/ sems can rnams kyi chos nyid ma togs pas 'khor bar 'khyams pas na bdag gis chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs par byas la/ rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i sems can rnams kyes kyang chos nyid khong du chud par byas te 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar bya'o/ / snyam du dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje bsgoms la/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3rta/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa/ shar gyi rwa dkar/ byang gi rwa ljang / nub kyi rwa dmar/ lho'i rwa ser/ lte ba mthing nag hūṃ gyis mtshan pa'i hūṃ las hūṃ phyogs bcur 'phros de rnams yongs su gyur pa las shar dang steng du khu gdong ma dkar sngon du snang ba gnyis/ byang du 'ug gdong ma dkar ljang du snang ba/nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong ma dkar dmar du snang ba gnyis/ lho phag gdong ma dkar ser du snang ba/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser pa/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar pa/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can/ g.yas kyis rdo rje tho ba dang /g.yon gyis rang 'dra'i phur bu bsnams pa/ de rnams kyis rang 'dra du ma phyogs bcur 'phros te phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug nas sna tshogs rdo 549

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung las/rje'i rwa rtse'i phyi rol dang nye bar hūṃ/ hūṃ ring po nag po bcu las grub pa'i khron pa gru gsum pa bcur so so'i bgegs rnams bcug par gyur/ oṃ gha gha gru ta ya bhā ta ya sarba dukhyi bisgru na hūṃ phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya sadra pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra gī la ya badz+ra dha ro adzña pa ya ti sarba dukhye bisgyug ka ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kyi la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yung ga ra badz+ra gī la ya a ko ṭa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ces lan bcu brjod la/ shar nas brtsams te phyogs g.yon skor dang / me nas brtsams te mtshams g.yas skor dang / steng 'og tu bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bu zug khro mo rnams kyis phyag g.yas kyi tho bas brdungs pas/ spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar du son par phur bus btab pas/ bgegs thams cad bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor ro gcig tu gyur/ rang nyid he ru gar gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis phyogs rere se gol gtogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ shar du sngags de nyid kha dog nag po/ / oṃ grit+na grit+na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ byang du sngags de nyid kha dog ljang gu/ oṃ gri jo pa ya gri rngo pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nub tu sngags de nyid kha dog dmar po/ / oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān dī byu rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lhor sngags de nyid kha dog ser po rnams 'khod par gyur/ sngags de rnams las rang rang gi kha dog can gyi 'od zer 'phros pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas 'og gser gyi sa gzhi la thug par khyab pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i gzugs chen po rnams su gyur/ sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar nag byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa rgyar khor yug gi lcags ri'i tshad dang mtho khyad tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa'i bar du khyab par gyur/ rwa ba grub pa dang dus mnyam du sna tshogs rdo rje ste/hūṃ gi 'od zer las gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa'i 'og gi sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo 550

༄/ / grub chenanag pospyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i hūṃ gi 'od zer las phyi rol du steng dang logs kun tu khyab par rdo rje rtse lnga ba'i rnam pa can gye mda'i dra ba dang /de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i gun dang / gur gyi 'og rwa ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla re rnams bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i me 'jig dus kyi me lta bus bskor bar gyur/ oṃ me di nī badz+ra bha ba badz+ra ban dha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pru ka ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra patshi ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tram̐ saṃ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā a na lā rka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ kha gdong ma la sogs pas bgegs lhag ma rnams rgyang ring du bskrad nas rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa la thim pas/ chu la chu brdabs pas zegs ma phyir 'thor ba bzhin du 'od zer phyir 'phros pa las rdo rje dang pad ma dang 'khor lo'i ra ba blum po gsum par mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu byur pa'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i me g.yon skor du 'khyil zhing 'bar ba/ steng dang logs kun tu khyab pas 'gro ba thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad du bgegs dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pra kā rā hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma pra kā rā hūṃ/ oṃ tsakra pra kā rā hūṃ/ gong gi dz+wa la yang 'dir len/bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su e las chos 'byung dkar po zur gsum pa gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs shing rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa'i nang du/ yi sngon po yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po dbyebs gzhu lta bu g.yas g.yon gnyis su rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ dmar po las me'i dkyil 'khor kha dog dmar po dbyebs gru gsum pa/ grwa gsum du ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ dkar po las chu'i dkyil 'khor kha dog dkar po dbyibs blum po dbus su bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du li ser po las sa'i dkyil 'khor kha dog ser po/ / dbyibs gru bzhi pa/ grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sum̐ las ri rab lhun po gru bzhi pa/ rin po 551

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgron me'i g.yo 4ma/che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can steng gi phyogs mtshams su cog brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa/ de'i steng du baṃ ser po las sna tshogs pad+ma/ / de'i lte bar hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte bar sbyo las 'khor lo/ / de yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams shing / rang snang gi shes rab mas 'khyud pa/ g.yas brkyang gyi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i khang ba brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar lngang sngo ba'i rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i rtsig pas bskor ba'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu gzhi dmar po la rin po che zur gsum dang gru bzhi la sogs pas spras pa/ de'i steng na gnas pa'i gser gye ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas mu tig gi do shal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i phyi ngos su bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu/ de'i steng na pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyebs can gyi mda' yabal gnas pa'i gser gyi bum pa nas 'thon pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan brgyad brgyad kyis mdzes par byas pa/ phyi'i steng gi zur bzhi la gdugs bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i 'gram nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la bzhugs stabs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i mtshams dang / rtsig pa'i phyi nang gi zur bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i rin po che dmar po'i steng du rdo rjes brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs/ snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/rtababs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum pa bzang po las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gye 552

༄/ /grub chenanag pospyodapa'i lugs kye 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/shing la rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang / bar bar du grub pa thob pa dang /sprin gyi gseb nas byung ba'i lha me tog gi 'phreng ba bzung ba rnams kyis kun nas mdzes par byas pa/ de'i phyi rol tu sna tshogs rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang /'khor lo'i ra ba gsum gyes bskor ba la sogs pa'i bsrung 'khor/ de'i phyi rol tu bskal ba 'jig pa'i dus kyi me lta bu/ rdo rje'i me kha dog sna lnga pas logs kun tu khyab par g.yon skor du 'khyil zhing 'bar ba/ de'i phyi rol tu gtum drag la sogs pa'i dur khrod brgyad na shi ri ṣa la sogs pa'i shing brgyad/shing gi rtsa bar dbang po la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad dang / rtse mor glang po'i gdong can la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ thugs rje'i chu brgyad dang nor rgyas la sogs pa de la gnas pa'i klu brgyad/ lhun po la sogs pa'i ri brgyad la gnas pa'i mchod rten brgyad dang grub chen brgyad ye shes kyi me brgyad dang de dag gi steng gi nam mkha' la sgog pa la sogs pa'i sprin brgyad/gzhan yang bya mi ro za ba rnams dang ce spyang dang sbrul ba lang gi mgo can la sogs pa phyogs su rgyu zhing / mi ro gsar rnying sna tshogs pa dang keng rus du ma gcal du bkram pa/ gnod sbyin dang / ro langs dang / srin po rnams kyis ki li ki li'i sgra chen po sgogs pa/ grub pa thob pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang /dam tshig spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ba dang / rnal 'byor ma bcom ldan 'das la rtsegacig tu blta ba/ gcer bu skra bshig pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ cang te'u dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ thod pas spyi bor brgyan pa/ rgod cing dur khrod du 'jug pa rnams kyis ngo mtshar bar byed pa'o/ / gzhal yas khang gi nang gi steng dang 'og gi sa gzhi thams cad shar dkar/ byang ljang /nub dmar/ lho ser ba/ dbus kyi sa gzhi sngon po la gnas pa'i sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i mu khyud la 'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i 553

༄/ /ca thang b.lo r+sā me'i ga4 ཿma/ltebar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i mu khyud la pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i mu khyud la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar bde chen gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i brgyad 'og dang / brgyad steng du kha phyogs pa'i mu khyud la gri gug gi phreng bas bskor ba/ 'khor lo bzhi po re re la mtshams rnams na gnas pa'i 'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje gri gug rnams kyis mtshan pa'i ka ba brgyad brgyad kyis btegs pa'i gdung blum rim pa bzhi'i thog gis je mtho je mthor gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan/ lha gzhan thams cad kyi gnas su ro dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/gdan dbus ma'i steng du mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo a ā i ste u lca ṛ nā le lī e i o mo yi a ste/ dbyangs yig dkar po bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yas skor dang / slar yang a ā nas a ste/ dbyangs yig dkar po bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yon skor te/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khorayongs su rdzogs pa ā lis mtshan pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ / ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍa rta khye ṇa/ ta tha da da dha dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ya ra la la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa ste/ gsal byed dmar po bzhi bcu pa phrag gcig g.yas skor dang /slar yang ka kha nas k+ṣa ste/ gsal byed dmar po bzhi bcu pa phrag gcig g.yon skor te/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kā lis mtshon pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ zla nyi'i dbus su nā da de las thig le/ de las zla phyed/ de las ha'i mgo bo/ / de las ha'i lus/ de las u grub pa'i tshul gyis hūṃ yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can yongs su gyur pa 554

༄/ /grub chenanag pospyod pa'i lugs kye 'khor loldom pa'i sgrub thabs/las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gyis mtshan pa ni so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ hūṃ las kha dog sna lnga ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba'i rtse mo las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs rnams 'thon te/ 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs kyi go 'phang la 'god pa dang / sngon thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa rnams lhan cig spyan drangs te/ mnyam par sbyar ba sngon du 'gro bas zhu bar gyur te hūṃ yig gi nā da la thim zhing / hūṃ yig lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ / de nas/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo ki nī kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3rta/ oṃ badz+ra shudha sadru dhaspo badz+ra shurnyo3nya/zla nyi dbyangs gsal phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi skur yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ chos kyidabyings kyi ye shes te/ de yang rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'chang he ru ka sku mdog dkar po sku'i 'od zer las rgyal ba rigs drug gi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros nas sems can rnams smin grol mdzad pa/ zhal bzhi pa'i rtsa zhal dkar/g.yon zhal dmar/ rgyab zhal ser/ g.yas zhal gnag pa zhal re re yang spyan gsum pa phyag bcu gnyis pa dpral bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma g.yas ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon ral gri 'dzin pa'i mgo bo mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo/ / lag pa bzhi pa'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma g.yas thod pa dang g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'i nu ma mnan pa/ gdan gnyis ga'ang gdong gcig pa/mig gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ / phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa'i g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / g.yon pas dril bu 555

༄7/ /gung thangabastan pa'izla sa gsung 'bum/bsnams pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa dkar po khrag dang bcas pa'i na bza' phyag g.yas pas lag pa g.yon pa dang g.yon pas rkang pa g.yon pa'i pags pa rang gi rgyab tu sdig mdzub dang bcas pa'i phyag gis brgyangs te 'dzin pa'i sdig mdzub kyi rtse gnyis smin ma'i thad sor gnas pa/g.yas kyi gsum pa na mdung rtse gsum pa bsgreng ba/ bzhi pa na gri gug lnga pa na dgra sta/ drug pa na ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gyi phyag gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhi pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ lnga pa na khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa/drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams shing / sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral ba'i thor cog can/ dbu re re la rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba stod smad du gnas pa gnyis la brgyus pa'i thod pa skam po lnga lnga'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ dbu'i g.yon du cung zad yo ba'i zla ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba bzhi bzhi cung zad gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa ste sku'i nyams gsum dang / rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung ba ste/ gsung gi nyams gsum dang / snying rje dang rngam pa dang zhi ba ste thugs kyi nyams gsum ste nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug gis rgyas btab pa/ mi rus kye thal bas lus thams cad la byugs pa'o/ / bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs par/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo drag mo chen mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum pa/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ thod pa'i dum bus brgyan pa'i 'og pag can/ phyag g.yon pas yab kyi mgul ba nas 'khyud pa'i thod pa na bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i khrag gis bkang ba bsnams nas yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ g.yas pas phyogs bcu'i gdug pa can kun la 556

༄/ / grub chenanag pospyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdeg mdzub kyis bsdegs par mdzad pa/ bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me 'od lta bu'i sku las 'od zer du ma 'phro ba khro gnyer rlabs ltar 'khyug cing khro chags kyi zur mig blta ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ nyi ma'i 'od can gyi gzi brjid che ba/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab kyi brla'i steng du legs par 'khril ba/ lhag mthong gi rang bzhin gye bde ba chen por gnas kyang 'gro ba'i don byed pa'i thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i thod dang / mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ byā dmar po las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po rtse mo la byā ser pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa byā dkar po las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems mtshon pa'i lte ba dkar po/ / rtse mor byā ser pos mtshan pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang thugs gar zla gdan la/ yum gye snying po dang nye snying / mgrin pa dang dpral par nyi gdan la/ yab kyi snying po dang nye snying / yum gyi lte ba dang thugs gar nyi gdan la/ yab kyi snying po dang nye snying / mgrin pa dang dpral par zla gdan la/ yum gye snying po dang nye snying /sngags thams cad kha dog dmar po 'od zer 'phro ba/ g.yon skor du gnas pa/sngags rnams kyang phan tshun zhal sbyor zhing / 'od zer 'khyud pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ ā ཿ/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/mkha'akhyab kyi sangs rgyas thams cad bkug ste rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs/byang chub kyi sems dang lhan cig tu zhu ba/ spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying gar sleb pa na mchog dga'/ snying ga nas lte bar sleb pa na khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lte ba nas nor bu'i rtser sleb pa na lhan 557

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'isgroname'i g.yo 4ma/cig skyes dga'i ye shes nyams su myong zhing brtan par byas nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i byang sems ā li dang / yum gyi zla mtshan kā li'i dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ye shes pa zhugs/ nā da dang de las rim gyis rdzogs pa'i hūṃ yig dang lhan cig 'dres pas/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang 'dra ba'i he ru gas gtso bo byas pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ mngal gyi gtso bo yab yum stoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ sems can thams cad bkug nas slob ma 'jug pa'i rim pas bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du bcug pas/ chos 'byung gi phyag rgya'i 'od kyis reg pa tsam gyis sgrib pa dag nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur gyur/ rnam snang la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sku la bcugarjes su chags pa'i spyor bas zhu bar gyur pa'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i lam nas phyung nas sems can gyi tshogs de rnams la dbang bskur bas de rnams kyi phung khams skye mched rnams rnam par sbyangs shing / phung khams skye mched rnams bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gye dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur te/de yang gzugs kyi phung po hūṃ las rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba'i phung po tram̐ las rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes kyi phung po hrī las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'du byed kyi phung po ho las rdo rje rgyal po/ / rnam shes kyi phung po hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa'/ phung po lnga'i de bzhin nyid nyi las dpal te ru ga mig oṃ las gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba hūṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna tram̐ las ser sna rdo rje/ lce i las 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus khaṃ las phrag dog rdo rje/ yid haṃ las dbang phyug rdo rje/ sa'i khams lam̐ las ltung byed ma/ chu'i khams mi las gso byed ma/ me'i khams baṃ las 'gugs byed ma/ rlung gi khams tai las gar gyi dbang phyug ma/nam mkha'i khams khaṃ las pad+ma'i dra ba can/ lus oṃ las sku rdo rje/ ngag 558

༄/ / grub chenanag pospyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/ā las gsung rdo rje/ yid hūṃ las thugs rdo rjer gyur te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas lha rnams mngal nas spros te phyogs bcu'i sems can gyi don la gshegs shing / rten gye dkyil 'khor yang mi dmigs par gyur/ rang nam mkha'i nā das rgyu rdo rje 'chang yab yum stoms par zhugs pa mthong nas bdag gis sangs rgyas yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar gyi dbus su skye ba blangs la sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa dang ldan pas skar mda' 'pho ba bzhin du 'ongs te yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gye pad mar zhugs te yab yum gyi byang nub kyi sems dkar dmar gnyis 'dres pa la thim pa'i mthus zhu bas rkyen byas nas yab yum gnyis kyang chags pa chen po'i mes zhu nas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le'i ngo bor gnas par gyur/ de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus nas/ oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa jo rtu baṃ ho / su ra tas tri sh+ya ho zhes bskul bas thig le de nyid hūṃ dang i du gyur/ hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte bar hūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yi las thod pa yi gis mtshan pa/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi gdan gyi stengadu rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing ga zhal bzhi pa'i rtsa zhal nag g.yon zhal dmar/ rgyab zhal ser/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ zhal re re'ang spyan gsum pa/ zhes pa nas/ mche ba'i skabs su cung zad ces pa ma gtogs pa/ lus thams cad la byugs pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin no/ / bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs par bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ / zhal gcig ma/ phyag gnyis pa/spyan gsum pa/ gcer mo/ / zhes pa nas/ bsdigs par mdzad pa/ zhes pa'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ / 'gro ba stong pa nyid du mnyam par rtogs pas bskal ba 'jig pa'i dus kyi me lta bu/ shin tu dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang pa dang ldan pas 559

༄/ /ca ca b.lo pa'ithoname'i khrung las/nyi ma'i 'od can gyi zhes pa nas/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhes pa'ibar sngar bzhin / gtso bo'i zhal bzhi nas g.yon skor du rim pa bzhin/oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grit+na grit+na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grit+na pa ya grit+na pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bit+ya rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gsungs pa'i sngags las khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros phyogs bcu'i gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ slar 'dus zhal bzhi la thim bas byin gyis rlabs par gyur/ oṃ dharmā dha tu swā bhā wa at+pa ko3rta/ chos kyi dbyings thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems chen po'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid can de nga'o/ / rang gi snying gar zla ba la rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo oṃ oṃ hā dkar po/ / mgo bor nyi ma la rnam snang gi ngo bo oṃ na ma hi ser po/ / spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la pad+ma gar dbang gi ngo bo oṃ swā hā hu dmar po/ / phrag pa gnyis su nyi ma la dpal te ru ga'i ngo bo oṃ bo ṣaṭa te nag po/ / mig gnyis su nyi ma la rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser/ dpral bar nyi ma la yan lag thams cad kyi lus dbang gi ngo bo rta mchog gi rang bzhin oṃ phaṭa haṃ ljang khu/gtso mo'i lte bar nyi ma la rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ oṃ baṃ dmar po/ / snying gar nyi ma la gshin rje ma'i ngo bo oṃ haṃ yo sngon po/ / mgrin par zla ba la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo oṃ tho mo dkar po/ / mgo bor nyi ma la skyod byed ma'i ngo bo oṃ tho tho ser po/ / spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la skrag byed ma'i ngo bo oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu/ dpral bar nyi ma la lus dbang gi ngo bo tsan+ḍi kha'i rang bzhin oṃ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha/yab kyi thugs gar zla gdan la thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hūṃ nag po/ / mgrin par zlagadan la gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo oṃ hri ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dmar po/ / dpral bar zla gdan la sku rdo rje'i ngo bo oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ke hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍa ki nī dzā la shaṃ ba ram̐ swā hā dkar po/ / thugs gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar/ ye shes sems 560

༄/ /grub chenanag potsud pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/dpa'i ngo bo hūṃ sngon po/ / yum gyi thugs gar zla gdan la thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo ṭ+wāṃ dhirdoX ṭ+wāṃ rdo ṭ+wāṃngadī rdom rjedīdz+ra ngoḥ ni rtsa dī ṭ+wāṃ hūṃ ༷/ rdo ༷ ༷ dī po/ da/༵༷ dīX bye gdan la sku rdo rje'i ngo bo oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dkar po/ / thugs gar zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo baṃ dmar po/ yum gyi spyi bo'i nang du zla ba la oṃ dkar po sku'i rigs kyi rang bzhin zhu ba'i rdul phran gyis snying ga'i bar du khyab/ snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ / thugs kyi rigs kyi rang bzhin zhu ba'i rdul phran gyis lte ba'i bar du khyab/ lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i swā ser po rin po che'i rigs kyi rang bzhin zhu ba'i rdul phran gyis gsang ba'i bar du khyab/ gsang ba'i pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la nyi ma la gnas pa'i ā dmar po gsung gi rigs kyi rang bzhin du zhu ba'i rdul phran gyis brla'i bar du khyab/brla gnyis su nyi ma la gnas pa'i ha ljang gu las kyi rigs kyi rang bzhin zhu ba'isdul phran gyis rkang ba'i mthar thug par khyab par gyur/ rang gi thugs gar zla gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma ye shes 'khor lo/ / dpang gi lha dkyil 'khor ba dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ la 'dus par gyur/dbang gi lha mo rnams ni ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang pa'i thod pa dang ḍa ma ru 'dzin pa/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ badz+ra yi ku sha dza badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/badz+ra spo ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghartse ho yab yum gnyis ga'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ / mgrin par pad+ma la ā dmar po/ / thugs gar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ / oṃ yo ga shud dha sarba dha ma yo ga shurnyo ྅ haṃ/ zhes brjod cing rnam lnga 'dod pa'i phyogs su bskor ba byas la/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ zhes mthar 'khyud pa'i tshul byas 561

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i ma'i ga4 ཿma/la byin gyi4brlab po/ / dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis ro mnyam du sbyar ba ni chos thams cad kyi de kho na chad dang bde ba chen po'i ye shes gnyis ngo bo dbyer med yin la/ de nyid rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du shar ba yin zhing / de yang gtso bo yab yum du shar ba'i cha shas so/ / sngar gyi skad cig ma'i sngags brjod la lag pa gnyis kyis snying gar pad skor byas pa'i mthar/ phyag rgya sdud pa na 'khyud pa'i tshul byed pa'i snying po'i phyag rgya sbyin par bya zhing / sngagasadon ltar nga rgyal gzung ngo / / slar yang rig ma bcu drug gis dbang gi lha rnams la mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs bskrad/dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa bajod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum bzhi phag mo dang lngas phyag g.yon pa'i thod pa cung zad yo bar byas te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ / de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ / lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ / de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ yab yum gnyis ga'ang / bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur/spyi bo nas sku la zhugs pa'i chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ phag mo la rnam snang gis dbu brgyan cing dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par gyur/ mchod pa ni phyi dang nang mchod 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya la/ gsang mchod ni/ yi 〉 rtu/ gnas bzhi dang gsang gnas byin gyis rlabs pa'i yab yum stoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems zhu ba spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying gar sleb pa na mchog dga'/ snying ga nas lte bar sleb pa na khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lte ba 562

༄/ /grub chenanagapostod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/nas norabu'i rtser sleb pa na lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes nyams su myong zhing /bde ba chen po dang de kho na nyid dbyer med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyomayopar zhugs pas/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis ga'ang bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa pū dza badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3rta/ rang gi thug ga'i hūṃ gye 'od zer gyis thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas byang segs kyes bskor ba rnams spyan drangs/ rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs te/ smin mtshams kyi dbus kyi ju tī'i yar sna nas brgyud de spyi bo'i haṃ la zhugs/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis lte ba'i a thung gtum mo'i me skad cig gis 'bar bas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo'i haṃ yig bzhus nas/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams rlung dang thig le'i rta la zhon nas rdo rje'i lam nas yum gye pad+mar babs pa'i thig le'i cha gcig hūṃ de yongs su gyur pa las gzhan yas khang / gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas par gyur/ thig le'i cha gcig gdan de rnams kyi steng du cha sum cu so bdun du gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/hūṃ baṃ lī ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ hūṃ/ ki khaṃ gi snyi rnga rtsa tsho rdza/ dzña haṃ ṭaṃ shā/ ḍi rnye ḍi ti/ ze de t+t+waṃ ni/ paṃ pho baṃ s+t+waṃ/ yi ram̐ li waṃ/ shaṃ ṣe saṃ haṃ rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang 'dra ba'i mi bskyod pa he ru ka gtso bor gyur pa'i lha sum cu so bdun thod pa bzhi dang bcas par gyur/ hūṃ baṃ gtso bo yab yum gyi pad+ma nas phyung / phyogs bcur 'phros sems can rnams kyi zhe sdang dang rnam shes kyi phung po sbyangs/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus rang dang yum la thim par gyur/ 'di phyi dkyil dang lus dkyil gnyis phyogasagacig tu bsgom pa'i lugs yin zhes gsungs pas/ lusarten gyi dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa ni/563

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i me'i ga4 ཿma/de yang rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa gzhu'i dbyibs su yod pa yongs su gyur pa las/'byung ba rim rtseg gi rlung gzhu'i dbyibs can/ sum mdo gru gsum gye gzugs su yod pa las me dkyil gru gsum pa/ lto ba blum po'i dbyibs can las chu dkyil blum po/ / snying ga gru bzhi pa las sa dkyil gru bzhi/ sgal tshigs las ri rab/ spyi bo'i rtsa so gnyis las pad+ma/ lus 'dom gang yan man dang phan tshun du mnyam pa las/ ngos bzhi mnyam pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ pha gu dang dra phyed sogs kyi rgyan gyis rab tu mdzes pa'i he ru ga'i dkyil 'khor rkang brgyad las ka ba brgyad/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum las 'khor lo gsum du gyur/ lus brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa ni/ rang gi snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi dru tī'i nang gi byang sems ba mo lta bu 'dzag pa/ nyungs dkar sbom po'i tshad kyi dpyid hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/bcom ldan 'das he ru ka zhes pa nas/ mi rus kyi thal bas lus thams cad la byugs pa/ lte ba'i dmar cha gtum mo'i me'i gzugs kyi thig le yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo zhes pa nas/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhes pa'i bar 'bras bu te ru ka yab yum bzhin no/ /dbyid dang thig le'i ngo bo gnyis snying gar phrad nas stoms par 'jug pas bzhugs pa'o/ li mi paṃ tai/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi yum gyi pad+ma nas phyung / bde chen 'khor lo'i phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar 'khod/ bde chen 'khor lo'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma dang snying ga'i shar la sogs pa'i 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa 'dab bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma dkar sngon du snang ba/ byang du lā ma dkar ljang du snang ba/ nub tu dum skyes ma dkar dmar du snang ba/ lhor gzugs can ma dkar ser du snang ba/thams cad kyang zhal gcig ma/ phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum ma/ spyan rtsa 564

༄/ /grub chenanag pospyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/dmar ba/ hūṃ gyi sgras bsdigs shing / ha ha'i gad rgyangs kyis gdug pa can skrag par mdzad pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas kyis gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon gyis thod pa rnams na glang po che dang / ce spyang dang /mi dang / ba glang bsnams pa'o/ / gsal zhing rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer du ma 'phro ba khro gnyer rlabs ltar 'khyug cing khro chags kyis zur mig blta ba'i nyamasadang ldan pa/ zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga ba gyen du 'greng ba'i rtse phran lngas dpral par brgyan pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod pa'i dum bus brgyan pa'i 'og bag dang / zhabs gdub dril bu g.yer khas sil sil gyi sgra sgrogs pa/ ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i brla la g.yas pa'i rtse mos reg pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/oṃ 〉 rtu/ thod pa bzhi yum gyi pad+ma nas phyung / bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir 'khod/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma dang / snying ga'i shar lho la sogs pa'i mchod pa bzhi'i rtsa 'dab bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa la sangs rgyas lnga'i gzugs kyis nye bar mdzes pa'i bde chen 'khor lo ste/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhir/ glu dza/ o a/ go rā/ de mā/ kā o/ / tri ko/ kā la/kā hi/ bre gri/ sau su/ na si/ ma ku rnams thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rtsibs khong stong rtsibs shun gyi rnam pa dang ldan pa'i 'khor lo nyer bzhi'i rnam pa can phyi'i yul nyer bzhir gyur/ / gnas nyer bzhi'i rtsa dang khams rnams ngo bo dbyer med du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpa' bo nyer bzhi dang dpa' mo nyer bzhir gyur/ ke khaṃ ge snyi nge tsi tsho rdza/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams yum gyi pad+ma nas phyung / thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs 565

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i khrung 'bum/brgyad la 'khod/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pu l+li ra ma la ya dang / skra mtshams pul+li ra ma la yar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum ma/ byang rtsibs dzā lan dha ra dang /spyi gtsug dzā lan dha rar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ ma hā gaṅka la dang gtum mig ma/ nub rtsibs o ṭi ya na dang /rna ba g.yas pa o ṭi ya nar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ gaṅka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho rtsibs a rbu ta dang / ltag pa athu tar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas so/ / dbang ldan gyi rtsibasago dā ba ri dang / rna ba g.yon pa go dā ba rir gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa yis/ su ra bai ri ṇi dang / dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ me rtsibs ra me sha ri dang / smin mtshams ra me shā rir gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od dpag med dang kharba ri/ bden bral gyi rtsibs de bi ko ṭi dang / mig gnyis de bi ko ḍir gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje 'od dang li ga'i dbang phyug ma/ rlung rtsibs mā la ba dang / phrag pa gnyis mā la bar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas so/ / thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams nam mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po/ / dzhai haṃ ṭaṃ shā ḍi t+t+waṃ ḍi ti/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams yum gyi pad+ma nas phyung / gsung gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la 'khod/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kā ma rū pa dang / mchan khung gnyis kā ma rū par gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ myu gu can 5yo

༄/ / grub chen nag pospyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/dang sa srung ma/ byang rtsibs o ḍi dang / nu ma gnyis o ḍi ru gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje ral pa can dang /'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing ngo / / nub rtsibs tri sha ku ne+e dang / lte ba tri sha ku ner gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho rtsibs ko sā la dang sna rtse ko sā lar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing ngo / / dbang ldan gyi rtsibs ka ling ka dang / kha ka liṅkar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rab tu bzang po dang / sngo bsang lha mo/ me rtsibs lam pa ka dang / mgrin pa lam pa gar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste tshasdo ha'o/ /bden bral gyi rtsibs galce dang / snying gañtsir gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsaganyis yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ rlung rtsibs hi ma la ya dang / 'bras bu gnyis nyi ma la yar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyi4yongs su gyur pa las/ mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste nye ba'i tshasdo ha'o/ / gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ ze rda t+t+waṃ rna paṃ pho baṃ sti/sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams yum gyi pad+ma nas phyung / sku'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la 'khod/ sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs bre ta pū ri dag mtshan ma bre ta pū rir gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs gri ha de ba ta dang /bshang lam gri ha de ba tar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma ste 'du ba'o/ / nub rtsibs 567

༄/ /yo ca bam yosgronama'i ga 4ma/so'u raṣā dang / brla gnyis so'u raṣār gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ lho rtsibs su ba r+ṇa di ba dang / byin pa gnyis su ba r+ṇa di bar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba'o/ / dbang ldan gyi rtsibs na ga ra dang / sor mo bcu drug na ga rar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ / me rtsibs sin dhu dang / bol gong gnyis sin blur gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod do/ / bden bral gyi rtsibs ma ru dang / mthe bong bzhi ma rur gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ rlung rtsibs ku lu ta dang / pus mo gnyis ku lu tar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod do/ / sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams sa 'og la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po/ / dpa' po nyer bzhi po thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje dang /g.yon du zla ba tshes pa/ dpral par rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / dar dpyangs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdor dril bsnams nas yum la 'khyud cing /g.yon gyis rang gi yum gye nu ma 'tshir ba/ yum la gzigs shing sgos 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug gis rgyas btab pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs 'phyar ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ / dpa' mo 568

༄/ / grub chenanag potsud pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/nyer bzhi po thams cad kyang zhal gcig ma zhes pa nas/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba zheyopa'i bar snying po'i rnal 'byor ma dang 'dra la/ yab la 'khyud pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas gdug pa la bsdigs pa'i sdig mdzub dang bcas pas gri gug 'dzin cing / g.yon pas khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin cing stob pa/ gsal zhing zhes pa nas/ sil sil gyi sgra sgrogs pa/ zhes pa'i bar sngar dang 'dra la/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab kyi brla'i steng nas legs par 'khril ba/yi ram̐ li waṃ/ shaṃ ṣe saṃ haṃ sgo mtshams ma brgyad yum gyi pad+ma nas phyung / sgo bzhi dang mtshams rnams su 'khod/ shar sgo dang lce'i rtsa bar gnas pa'i rtsa yongs su gyur pa las/ kha gdong ma dkar sngon du snang ba/ byang sgo dang lte ba'i bug par gnas pa'i rtsa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'ug gdong ma dkar ljang du snang ba/ nub sgo dang rtags kyi sgor gnas pa'i rtsa yongs su gyur pa las/ khyi gdong ma dkar dmar du snang ba/ lho sgo dang gshang lam gyi sgor gnas pa'i rtsa yongs su gyur pa las/ phag gdong ma dkar ser du snang ba/ shar lho dang mdzod spu'i bug par gnas pa'i rtsa yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub dang rna bug gnyis su gnas pa'i rtsa yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang dang mig gnyis su gnas pa'i rtsa yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje mche ba ma g.yasadamar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar dang sna bug gnyis na gnas pa'i rtsa yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig ma zhes pa nas/ sil sil gyi sgra sgrogs pa/ zhes pa'i bar snying po'i rnal 'byor ma dang 'dra'o/ khyad par ni/ phrag pa g.yon par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchod phyir thogs kyi tshul du 'khyud pa/ stag lpags kyi na bza' can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ ā nyu gzhal yas khang yum gyi pad+ma nas 569

༄/ /yo ca b.lo 4 po ga 4ma/phyung / sngar gyi gzhal yas khang la thim par gyur/ de nasarang dang lha thams cad ces brje ba ma gtogasasngar ltar ye shes pa spyan drangasanas mchod la dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas la/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor zla gdan la oṃ dkar po zhes sogs sngar ltar ro/ / dbang bskur gyi skabasasu yang rig ma bcu drug gis mchod pa nas/ spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas zhes pa'i bar sngar dang 'dra la/ khyad par ni/rang dang lha thams cad bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur/ spyi bo nas zhes pa nas/ phag mo la rnam snang / mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi la rin 'byung /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la 'od dpag med/ sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams la rnam snang / dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la don grub kyis dbu pargyan cing / dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngar ltar byas la/ mchod yon nas rig ma bcu drug gi bar tshogs zhing ltar mchod pa ni phyi mchod do/ / de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyiyorlabasal/ mgron rnams kyi ljags la hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse gsum pa nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa/ oṃ a sri ta u da ka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ja tha tram̐ ā / hūṃ/ oṃ ā ྅/ lha mo ro rdo rje mas bdud rtsi bstabs pa rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi spu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ bla ma rnams kyi mtshan gyi mthar yi ge gsum btags la dbul/ de nas dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams kyi sngags rgyas bsdus gang rung gi mthar yi ge gsum btagasal dbul/ de nas rang gi sgosakyi chos skyong dang phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i bar la'ang dbul zhing rang gi lce la bzhag la/ oṃ a sri ta su da na su bhā wa at+pa ko3rta/ zhes brjod de/ mgron thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mnyes shing tshim par gyus/ snyig ga'i sa bon las byung / zhes pa nas/ badz+ra ṇi swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar gyes sngar bzhin mchod pa ninang mchod do/ / de naloyab yum gyi gsang gan4sbyang ba sogs dran par byas la sngarabazhin/ snyoms par 'jug pas dga' ba skyed de/ phyi nang gi lha thams 570

༄/ /grub chenanag pospyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/cadakyis kyang lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ ces pa ni gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ / dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams kyis kyang lhan skyes kyi bde ba dang de kho na nyid dbyer med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mnyes par gyur/ cesapa ni/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o/ / de nalososo'i sngags brjod pa ni/ soso'i lha sku la gsal bar dmigs nas yab kyi snying po ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ke hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki tī dzā la shaṃ ba ram̐ swā hā/ zhes dang / nye snying ni/ oṃ spyo ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ / yum gyi snying po ni/ oṃ sarba bud dha ḍā kyi nī ye badz+ra wa r+ṇa ni ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nye snying ni/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sngags ni/ oṃ ḍā kyi nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro nyi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ṇi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ cesapa'o/ / dpa' bo nyer bzhi dang dpa' mo nyer bzhi'i sngags ni/ oṃ ka ra ka ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsarnyi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsani ak+ṣi ye rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bharnyi bharnyi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bha ba tī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tā sa ya tā sa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā se hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ khro bha ya khro bha ya bha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dī ra ma tī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hre hre hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kharba ri ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ 4 hra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ li ke sha ri ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bo tho hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dru mcho ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ e rā ba tī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bhe ra wā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bā yu be+e ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru rnyi rān+d+ra mā lā ba li bi ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su rā bhak+ṣi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ griṇ+ḍa griṇ+ḍa sasta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzi gi sarna pā ta rdza ya tardza ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ byā mā de bī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā ga ā gzu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha tri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ spyo bhā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ ha ya gaṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rngo rngo hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kha gā na ne hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grwa 571

༄/ /yo bayopa'itshaname'i bang ཿma/sgru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ btsakra be ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro nyi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tī tī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shoṇ+ḍi ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra ba ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su r+pā re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ nyi li nyi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakrabarti nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bīr+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ces pa'o/ / sgo ma bzhi'i sngags ni/ oṃ kā ka gye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ u lca kā gye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shā nā gye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shu kā rā gye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ mtshams ma bzhi'i sngags ni/ oṃ ya na dā rnye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dru tī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dikhyi ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha dī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ceyopa'o/ / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wī re shā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ka wā sdi saṃ ni bhā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā ma ku stod ṭā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rdaṣā ka rā lo gra snyi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā shi bya ta thu la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dha ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gru dziṭ+wāṃ bā ra dha rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dru ban+ta kā ra wayu ṣā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi rkang brgyad dang / oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra bā rā tī baṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ā r+ya a pa rā dzi ta tre lo kya mā te bībya shā rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo sazo sgru ta bha sde ba te ma hā badz+re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bajo sa ni a dzi te a pa ra dzi te bā bye ka ri ṇi tra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bh+ra ma ṇi sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ni klo dhe ka rā le ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo tā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra ste dā nī pa rā dza ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzasta ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā rā tī ma hā yo gi dī kā me sha ri kha ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis kyang bstod de sngags kyi mchod pa yang yin no/ / oṃ 〉 rtu/ gnas bzhi dang gsang gnas byin gyis rlabs pa'i yab yum stoms par zhugs pas byang sems zhu ba spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying gar sleb pa na mchog dga'/572

༄/ / grub chenanag pospyodapa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/snying ga nas lte bar sleb pa na khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lte ba nas nor bu'i rtser sleb pa na lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes skyes pas/ bde stong dbyer med du sbyar ba de nyid byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bor gyur pa ni lha so bdun du shar ba yin zhing / de yang lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang / tshor ba dang /chosadang / sems rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi ni/ rim pa bzhin mkha' 'gro ma dang / lā ma dang / dum skyes ma dang / gzugs can ma/'dun pa'i dang / brtson 'grus kyi dang / dpyod pa'i dang / sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gye rkang pa bzhi ni rim pa bzhin/ rab gtum ma dang / gtum mig ma dang / 'od ldan ma dang / sna chen ma/ dad pa'i dang / brtson 'grus kyi dang / dran pa'i dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po bzhi ni/ rim pa bzhin dpa' bo'i blo can ma dang / mi'u thung ma dang / li ga'i dbang phyug ma dang /shing grib ma/ shes rab kyi dbang po dang / dad pa'i dang / brtson 'grus kyi dang / dran pa'i stobs bzhi ni/ rim pa bzhin sa srung ma dang 'jigs byed chen mo dang / rlung shugs ma dang / chang 'thung ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bzhi ni/ rim pa bzhin sngo bsangs lha mo dang /shin tu bzang mo dang / rta rna ma dang / bya gdong ma/ dga' ba dang shin tu sbyangs pa dang / chos rab tu rnam 'byed dang / dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bzhi ni/ rim pa bzhin 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang / dum skyes ma dang / chang 'tshong ma dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / rtog pa dang / ngag bzhi ni/ rim pa bzhin shin tu dpa' mo dang / stobs chen ma dang / 'khor los sgyur ma dang / brtson 'grus chen mo/ / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' 573

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgronayo bang 'bum/dang / 'tsho ba dang / rtsol ba dang / dran pa bzhi ni/ rim pa bzhin kha gdong ma dang / 'ug gdong ma dang / khyi gdong ma dang / phag gdong ma/yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal te ru ga'o/ / dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyed pa dang / skyes pa rnams bsrung ba dang / mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spong ba dang / ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed pa'i yang dag spong ba bzhi ni/rim pa bzhin gshin rje brtan ma dang / gshin rje pho nya mo dang / gshin rje mche ba ma dang / gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ / rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das dang 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi sku las rang 'dra'i sku dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus rang rang gi rtsa ba'i sku la thim par gyur/ bzlas bya'i sngags ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ sa steng na ni rin chen bzhi/ phreng ba'i sngags ni dam pa yin/ zhes yab yum gyi rtsa sngags dang /snying po dang / nye snying dang / go cha'i sngags te rin chen bzhi'i sngags dang / phreng sngags mchog tu gsungs so/ / de la rtsa sngags sam/ 'phreng sngags la gnyis yod pa'i yab kyi 'phreng sngags ni ka ra ka ra sogs sngags tshan pa nyer bzhir ma bcad par phyogs gcig tu sbrel te/ mgo bor oṃ/ mthar hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sbyar ba'o/ / yum gyi 'phreng sngags la mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang / 'khrul spong sogs rgya gzhung 'ga' zhig las ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wā ti badz+ra ba rā tī baṃ/ yā r+ya a ba rā dzi ta tri lokya mā te/ dībya shwa ri/sarba sgru ta bhā ya ba te ma hā badz+re/ badzā sa ni a pa rā dzi te pā bye ka ri ne tra/ bh+ra ma ṇi sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dhe kā ra le ni/ tā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da nī ba rā dza ye/bi dza ye dzasta ni/ stasta ni/ mo ha ni/ badz+ra bā rā tī ma hā yo ki dī kā me sha ri kha ga tabya thā/ pro tane pro taṅge ha na ha na phru ḍi/ ki ke ṇi/ kho khi ṇi/ ju na ju na badz+ra ha ste/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la dha ri ṇi/ ma hā bi shi ta 574

༄/ / grub chen nag pospyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/rmā sā sa ni/ ma nu ṣāchu pra bri te sa na dh+ya na ra si ra mā la grwa dzi ta dha ra ṇi/susta ni sum+bha ha na ha na pra ṇi sarba pa sha bā ṭ+wāṃ/ ma hā ma d+ma ts+tsha da ni kro dha nu/ rte rdaṣā ka rā li ni ma hā mu tre/ shrī te ru ka de ba sgyu/ gra ma hi ṣ+pe sa ha sra shī re ha sa sra ba ha be/ sha ta sa ha sra na ne+e dz+wa li ta te dza se/ dz+wa lha mu khe saṃ ga la lo tsa ne/badz+ra shā ri re badz+ra sa ni/ mi li ta tsi li ta/ he he/ hūṃ hūṃ/ kha kha/ dru ru gyo ru/mu ru mu ru/ a de te/ ma hā yo gi nī/ pa khri ta sirnye/ ltadhi tre+e t+t+waṃ/ gri gro he te/ ha ha/ bhi me ha sa ha sa bī re/ hā hā/ he he/ hūṃ hūṃ/ tre+e lokya bi nā sha ni sha ta sa ha sra ko ṭi/ ta thā ga ta pa ri ba re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ si ha ru pe kha ga tsa ru pe ya tri lokya u dha re sa mu tra me kha le/ gra sa gra sa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dī ra de te hūṃ hūṃ/ ha ha/ ma hā pa shu mo hā dī yo gi sha ri ṇi/ ḍā ki nī sarba lo kā ṭ+wāṃ bharnya ni sa du pra t+ya ya ka re ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zu ta tā sa ni ma hā bi ra pa ra ma sidha yo gi shā ri phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ go cha la yoha sogs kyi thog mar oṃ dang /mthar hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sbyar ba'am/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'grel bar/ so so'i mthar swā hā sbyar bas kyang chog par gsungs so/ / snying po gnyis dang nye snying gnyis dang lha so so'i sngags ni sngar bshad zin to/ / gzhan yang lha drug cu'i sngags shin tu bsdus pa byed na/ṛ tha bzhi dang / ma yig dor ba'i ka tsa ṭa ta pa'i sde tshan gyi yi ge nyer bzhi dang / ya ra la wa bzhi dang / sha ṣa sa ha bzhi'i mgor thig le byen nas/ thog mar yi dang / mthar hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sbyar ba rnams rim pa bzhin du snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang / 'khor lo gsum gyi lha zung nyer bzhi dang / sgo ma bzhi dang / mtshams ma bzhi'i sngags su mngon brjodalas gsungs so/ / sa bon sodrug sprel nas thog mthar sngar bzhin sbyar yang chog go / sngags zlo ba'i tshul ni/ mi rus kyi 'phreng ba'am po te tse la sogs pa/ phreng thag gzhon nu ma ma nyams pas bkal ba'i ras bal gyi skud pa las byas pa bsang sbyang byas te/ phreng ba'i skyed chog rgyas pa'am/ de ma grub na/ skad cig gis gsung rdo rje pad+ma gar dbang du bskyed/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang gcig tu byas/ bum chus gtor 575

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronama'i khrung ཿma/la mchod nas/ oṃ pad+ma nirte sha ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'am sā hā hu'i thog mthar sngar bzhin sbyar ba brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te gsung rdo rje yongasasu gyur pa las phreng ba'i rnam par bsams la/ lag pa'i mtheb srin gyis bzung ste/ gtso bo rang gi snying po dang nye snying zlo na/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gan4pa'i hūṃ sngon po'am/ nā da rkyang pa la bltas la/ de la bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs te/ dbusakyi yi ge las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs spros nas 'gro ba'i don byas slar sdud pa'i tshe dbus kyi yi ge la sdud pa'i tshul gyes zlo la/ yum gyi snying po dang nye snying dang lha gzhan rnams kyi sngags zlo na/ rang rang gi thugs gar nyi gdan la ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ma hūṃ yig bkod la de la bzlasabyu'i sngags kyis 'khor bar dmigs nas/ sngar bzhin spro bsdus tshul gyis zlos te/ dam tshig gi bzlasapa'o/ / yab yum gyi 'phreng sngags zlo na/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi nga rgyal gyis/ sngags 'phreng rang gi zhal nalozhugs te/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar zhugs/ de'i byu tī'i lam nas steng du byung ste/ gtso mo'i zhal nas 'thon nas rang gi zhal du zhugs shing nā dar thim pa dang / yang sngar bzhin 'khor bar bsgoms nas zlos te do li'i bzlas pa'o/ / sems ma g.yengs pa la 'bad nas bzlas pa'i skyon ha cang myur bul dang / ha cang sgra ches pa dang / ring thung gi tshad las nyams pa dang / de gnyis bzlog nasa'adzin pa sogs dang bral bar bya zhing / mthe bong lcags kyur byas la lha rnams 'gugs pa'i tshul gyis bzla'o/ / 'di la yid bzlas rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / ngag bzlas gsum ga yod la/ de yang thun gyi ngo bo la ma yengs par bzlas pa rnams grangs su gzhug gi thun bar du bzlasapa dang / sems g.yengs nas bzlas pa sogs ni grangs la mi phan yang bzlas par ni bshad do/ / gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma sha chen gyis brgyan pa gnyis/ dum skyes ma'i sngags kyis bsangs/ nang mchod ltar byen gyis brlabs te/'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ phe dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa phyogs skyong dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ shrī he ru ka arnya/ zhes sogs chu gnyis nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod nas/ lag pa gnyis a ā/ zhes pa nas/ k+ṣa 576

༄/ /grub chenanag potsud pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lordom pa'i sgrub thabs/yongs su gyur pa las zla bdang nyi ma'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dbus su hūṃ/oṃ a byo n+ya/ a nu ga ta sarba dharmā ba ra spa ra/ a nu pra biṣā sarba dharmā ya t+ya n+ta/ a nu pra biṣā sarba dharmā ā (/ zla nyi hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje thal mo gyur/ thal mo'i dbus su gtor snod bzhag pa'am bzhag par mos la/ de nas mgron gyis gtor ma bdag gir mdzad pa'i phyir rang gi 'dod don brjod de/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / / des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ / bden pa 'di dag gis ni lha mo rnams/ / bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces brjod de/ mchod pa'i 'khor gsum bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor gyur/ mgron rnams kyi ljags la hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar po nas 'bru tsam 'khod/ oṃ a mṛ ta u da ka hūṃ hūṃ tha tha/ tram̐ ā ka hūṃ/ oṃ a rtu/ lha mo ro rdo rje mas bdud rtsi bstabs pa/ rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi spu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/oṃ a ra l+li ho dza ka baṃ ho / sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tri bya ho badz+ra dā ke ni kha kha khā hi khā hi i mi ba ci bhuñdza tha pi ba tha/ ma ma da kā t+ya/ sa dha ya tha/ oṃ 〉 rtu phe phe swā hā/ zhes pa lan lngas 'khor lo lnga'i lnga la phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor gyis dbul lo/ / rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod la/'dod don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ srid pa dang mnyam zhi ba'i chags bcom kun tu rtog pa 'joms/ / khyod ni dngos po mtha' dag mkha' ltar gzigs pa dang ldan pa/ / mgon po shin tu brtse ba lce ba'i chus brlan thugs kyi chus/ / mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzod/ces brjod/ dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong dang klu la sogs pa skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las bde mchog gi lha yab yum gye skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kyi lngags/ zhes pa nas/ gsol bar 577

༄/ /yo ca bamapa'i 0me'i ga 'chagagyur/ cesapa'i bar sngar bzhin byasal/ oṃ kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/bhu ta bre ta/ pi shā tsa/ ud+ma da/ yobasma ra/ badz+ra dā ka dā ki dī da ya/ i mi ba pogri t+na tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣachu/ mā ma sarba sid dhi spe pra yats+tshan tu/ ya the baṃ/ya the khye/ bhu dza tha/ pi bā tha/ dzi gra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba garta ya/sad su khaṃ bi shu ye/ sa ha yi ka bha bachu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭas hā/ zhes lan gnyis bajod de/ phyogs dang mtshams na gnasapa la dbul lo/ / oṃ badz+ra rta bu la ye swā hā/zhesaso rtsi dang / rig ma bcu drug dang / nang mchod kyis kyang mchod/ rkang brgyad kyiyobastod de/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / / klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / / zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog ces 'dod don la gsol ba gdab po/ / de nas lhag chad skong ba'i don du dril bu dkrol zhing yig brgya bzlas pa'i 'og tu oṃ yo ga shud dha sarba dha rmā go ga shurnyo3rta/ zhes brjod cing snying gar pad skor gyi phyag rgyas mnyes par byas la phyag rgya sdud pa na lag pas 'khyud pa'i tshul bya zhing / mthe bong dang srin lag gisasigol gtog pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ badz+ra mu 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs shing / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang nyid la thim par gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas gtso bo yab yum dang phyi nang gi lha rnams dang / khang ba brtsegs ma rnams snang bar byas te 'od du gyur pa'i dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ rten gyi 'khor lo sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang bcas pa sku 'khor la thim/ de gsung 'khor la thim/ de thugs 'khor la thim/ de'i shar nas brtsams te/ phyogs na gnas pa bzhi ni/ mkha' 'gro ma nas bzung ste g.yon skor gyis lha mo bzhi la thim/ me nas brtsams te mtshams na gnas pa bzhi ni gzugs can ma nas bzung ste g.yas skor gyis lha mo bzhi la thim/ thod pa bzhi yang gzugs can ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhi la 578

༄/ / grub chenanag pospyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor losdom pa'i sgrub thabs/thim/ lha mo bzhi yang rang nges kyi gtso bo'i zhal bzhi la thim/ lus dkyil gyi sgo mtshams ma brgyad sku 'khor la thim/ de gsung 'khor la thim/ de thugs 'khor la thim/ de lha mo bzhi thod pa dang bcas pa la thim/ de rnams kyang snying ga'i te ru ka yab yum la thim/ de gnyis kyang rang gnas su thim pas rtsa dang khams rnams byin gyis brlabs par gyur pa dang / lus dkyil gyi lha rnams rang rang gi gnas su thim pas rtsa dang khams rnams byin gyis brlabs par sems pa gnyis ka spel mar bya'o/ / rang gtso bo yab yum 'od du zhu nas snying kha'i hūṃ yig la thim/ hūṃ gyi zhabs kyu u ha la thim pa nas/ nā da yang mi dmigs par byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid te ru ka yab yum gyi skur bzhengs pa la/ yab yum gyi go cha bsduyopa 'god pa dang go cha chen po'i bsrung ba rnams kyang byas nas thun mtshams su 'jug par bya zhing / srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ / 'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ / rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems dpar ldan/ / te ru ka dpal de dang lhan cig gar byed shog / ces dang / lha motshad ma zhes sogs dang / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ zhes pa nas/ go 'phang mchog la 'god par shog / ces sngar gyi sems bskyed smon lam du bsgyur ba la sogs pas dge ba bsngo bar bya'o/ / thun mtshams su rang te ru ka phyag gnyis pa yum bcas kyi nga rgyal la gnasapa4mtheb mdzub kyis shar nas g.yon skor du se gol gtog cing / zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod de tsham rngams kyis srung ba dang / mthong thos thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog tu blta ba'i tshangs spyod la rtag tu gnas shing / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku gang mthong bde mchog tu mos nas/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod pa dang / g.yon pa kun spyod la sogs pa ma rgyud kyi sgos chos mtha' dag tshul bzhin du bsrung zhing / gzhan yang zas kyi rnal 'byor dang / gnyid dang ldang ba dang / khrus kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa/bla med spyi'i thun mong ba rnams kyang / dam pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin lag len du 579

༄/ /yo ca b.lo rmā ma'i go ཿma/btab ste/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bye ba'i gshegasabashul/ dpal he ru ga'i grong khyer chen por 'jug pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o/ / smras pa/ bye ba bcu drug rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud/ / kun gyi bla ma dpal ldan te ru ga'i/ / sgrub thabs nag po spyod pa'i bzhed gzhung bzhin/ / sbyar ba'i dge 'dis 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / gsang chen theg pa mchog gi sgor zhugs te/ / rnal 'byor ma tshogs bye ba'i grogs dang bcas/ / brtan g.yo'i dngos kun lhan skyes bde chen du/ / sdom mdzad bcom ldan dpa' bo'i gnas thob shog / cesagrub chen nag po spyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabasangag 'don gyi rim par bsgrigasapa 'di ni 'di'i mngon dkyil sa skya gong ma'i gsung ngag tā ra nā tha/ sgam po bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs kyi gsung mang du 'dug na'ang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po thang ston rdo rje bzang pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabasabade chen sgron me ni nag po'i gzhung rnams dang mthun zhing / rje bla ma'i dgongs pa ji lta bar snang bas de nyid gzhir bzhag ste hal ha ja sag thu han gyi phyogs nas lam 'di la mchog tu mos pa/ dge bshes bsod nams dbang rgyal gyis bskul ba'i ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes rgyal ba'i lungagis zin pa'i chogagrwa chen po bkra shis 'khril du sbyar ba 'dis kyang rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bstan pa phyogs dus thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig / / / bkra shis/ / gcig zhus/ / dga' ldan chos 'khor gling du par du bsgrub/ / / /580

༄/ /gung bang bayo pa'itshonasa'i ga 'bumagung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/dpar sgrig dpe skrun mi sna/blo 'dri sa/ bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan/dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/ gling rgya bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/gung thang thub bstan/bsod nams rgya mtsho/gtso sgrig pa/gtso sgrig pa gzhon pa/ 'jam dga'/spyo khrab jus 'doms pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/rtsom sgrigasmyongs mi/ mgon po dar rgyas/ phur kho/ rta mgrin rdo rje/'phrin las rgyal mtshan/ pan de mkhar/ting 'dzin bkra shis/lag bstar rtsom sgrig pa/ 'brug mo skyid/

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronas r+sāng 4dkon 4gakun da4 'jig rarabang ཿ sdes/ /tshodaspabar+yāpa'ijagapharadabang bskuratshon/ /lung rtoganya zungarga me 4/ /skye tsho'i rmongs maselaba'adi rmadabyung /r+ṣa da4 mang pajirka mdzad pa'i rmakha 4da ྾ 4na ༄sa te mkha grub yongs kyi gzug ma rje ༄na dkon 4ga ༄na pa'i za lo 4nga 4mjape skrunathud par yas ma spyar mal a ri'i zam pa'i thes mtshogasaparazagarje chetha/ zladhe 'i 7༅ cho

spyi khyab jus 'doms pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/ṣ+ṭha zo tho1 po ca me3zhu chen pa/ blo gros sbyin pa/ṣ+ṭha 11 tshotho༅༅ rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ 'brug mo skyid/r+sā/zozatsho tha ོmdzes cha jus 'god pa/ garma rdo rje tshe ring /zoyo yo1 / zo za༄/ / gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/(nya)gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes brtsams/tshemi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun zhing 'grems spel byas/(pe cin ho phing li byang lam yang 14pa/ sbrag ang 1sa 13khapar ang grangs581༅509)pe cin kreng ta'o khang nayopar btab/2)bolo'i tsho5par paragazhi dang po bsgrigs/2ma lo'i bla5par pe cin du par thengs dang po brgyab/deb tshad 8ma74mo116877 1khri2 dpar shog 18 5dpar grangasami 1—2 sa deb rer sgor 35 ཿ
